                        noResultBrowserClickAttempts < 2
                        ? completedSteps + "I reached the page, but two repeated explicit inspections " +
                          "returned the same document with no new evidence. " +
                          "I stopped the unchanged-page loop rather than spend more " +
                          "model calls pretending a new inspection is progress. " +
                          "A different grounded navigation or a more specific " +
                          "source is needed to finish the request."
                        : authenticationRetryProhibited
                        ? completedSteps + "I couldn't verify the requested information. " +
                          "The trusted login system has already recorded a credential attempt " +
                          "for this task and will not submit credentials again automatically. " +
                          "I stopped rather than repeating the login. A fresh explicit user " +
                          "instruction is required for another authentication attempt."
                        : completedSteps + "I reached the website, but the requested information is not verified. " +
                          "The clicked control returned without displaying the needed result. " +
                          "Another attempt without meaningful progress was blocked; " +
                          "repeating the same action or inspecting an unchanged page " +
                          "would not establish the answer. A site-side validation error, " +
                          "delayed response or embedded result remains possible, but " +
                          "I cannot identify the cause from the observed page.";
                    Debug.WriteLine($"[Executive] DIRECT BROWSER LOOP STOP | Run={runId:D} | " +
                        $"Cycle={cycle} | AuthRetryProhibited={authenticationRetryProhibited} | " +
                        $"SameControlBlocked={repeatedNoProgressClick} | " +
                        $"UnchangedClicks={noResultBrowserClickAttempts} | " +
                        $"UnchangedInspections={unchangedBrowserInspections} | " +
                        $"CognitionCalls={cycle} | CompletionReviewCalls={completionReviewCalls}");
                    await PersistBlockedTaskAsync(
                        mindEvent, ResolveTaskGoalId(
                            mindEvent, ownedGoalId, goalResults, branchResults),
                        haltReason, cancellationToken);
                    string deliveredHalt = await DeliverEarlyReplyAsync(
                        mindEvent, haltReason, NIRAPublicReplyKind.Protected,
                        cancellationToken);
                    await RecordResponseAsync(mindEvent, deliveredHalt);
                    yield return new NIRAOutputChunk
                    {
                        RunId = runId, Source = mindEvent.Source,
                        Type = NIRAOutputChunkType.Text, Content = deliveredHalt,
                        VoiceExpression = NIRAVoiceExpression.Neutral
                    };
                    yield return new NIRAOutputChunk
                    {
                        RunId = runId, Source = mindEvent.Source,
                        Type = NIRAOutputChunkType.Completed, Content = string.Empty,
                        VoiceExpression = NIRAVoiceExpression.Neutral
                    };
                    yield break;
                }
            }

            // Browser feedback is based on the actual dispatch result, never
            // a proposed action or model claim. Never report auth as verified
            // until the resulting page has been inspected by cognition.
            if (mindEvent.Source == NIRAMindEventSource.User &&
                capabilityResults.Any(result =>
                    result.CapabilityId.StartsWith("browser.", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)))
            {
                // Once a browser task is active, keep the two generic recovery/
                // discovery primitives ready without another context-expansion
                // round. This is capability-family state, not user-intent phrase
                // routing and is independent of any particular website.
                expandedSections.Add(
                    "capabilities");
                expandedCapabilityIds.Add(
                    NIRACapabilityIds.BrowserBack);
                expandedCapabilityIds.Add(
                    NIRACapabilityIds.BrowserExplore);

                browserExploreRuns +=
                    capabilityResults.Count(result =>
                        result.Succeeded &&
                        result.CapabilityId ==
                            NIRACapabilityIds.BrowserExplore);

                bool failedStep = capabilityResults.Any(result =>
                    result.CapabilityId.StartsWith("browser.", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) &&
                    !result.Succeeded);
                bool noResultClick = capabilityResults.Any(result =>
                    result.CapabilityId == NIRACapabilityIds.BrowserClick &&
                    result.Output.Contains("ObservedPageChange=False", StringComparison.Ordinal));
                bool authenticated = capabilityResults.Any(result =>
                    result.CapabilityId == NIRACapabilityIds.BrowserAuthenticate && result.Succeeded);
                bool navigated = capabilityResults.Any(result => result.Succeeded &&
                    result.CapabilityId is NIRACapabilityIds.BrowserNavigate or
                        NIRACapabilityIds.BrowserFollow or NIRACapabilityIds.BrowserSessionOpen);
                string observedStatus = failedStep
                    ? "That browser action was rejected or failed. Checking the exact reason…"
                    : noResultClick
                        ? "The click returned, but no page or form result appeared. Checking a different approach…"
                        : authenticated
                            ? "The sign-in action returned; checking the page the site displayed…"
                            : navigated
                                ? "The website loaded a page. Checking its actual contents…"
                                : string.Empty;
                if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(observedStatus))
                    yield return new NIRAOutputChunk
                    {
                        RunId = runId, Source = mindEvent.Source,
                        Type = NIRAOutputChunkType.Progress,
                        Content = observedStatus,
                        VoiceExpression = NIRAVoiceExpression.Neutral
                    };
            }

            int newRuntimeVisuals =
                CollectRuntimeVisualPresentations(
                    runtimeVisualPresentations,
                    runtimeVisualPresentationSignatures,
                    capabilityEvidence,
                    dynamicToolCapabilityResults.Concat(capabilityResults),
                    verifiedImageDeliveryPaths);

            if (newRuntimeVisuals > 0)
            {
                NIRADiagnosticTrace.Event("IMAGE-DELIVERY",
                    $"Run={runId:D} Cycle={cycle} Stage=RuntimeVisualQueued Count={newRuntimeVisuals}");
                capabilityEvidence.AppendLine();
                capabilityEvidence.AppendLine(
                    $"RUNTIME VISUAL DELIVERY: {newRuntimeVisuals} grounded image artifact(s) " +
                    "are queued for user presentation after the terminal response. " +
                    "They remain inline in chat and, when chat is inactive, " +
                    "Surface=Auto may also show the existing non-activating desktop peek. " +
                    "Do not tell the user to open the backing file manually.");
            }


            int newExecutiveEvidenceCount =
                newBranchWorkEvidenceCount
                +
                (modelContractCorrectionThisCycle ? 1 : 0)
                +
                (capabilitySchemaCorrectionThisCycle ? 1 : 0)
                +
                AppendExecutiveMutationEvidence(
                    executiveEvidence,
                    goalResults,
                    branchResults);


            bool mutationRejected =
                goalResults.Any(
                    result =>
                        result.Action ==
                            NIRAGoalApplyAction.Rejected)
                ||
                branchResults.Any(
                    result =>
                        result.Action ==
                            NIRABranchApplyAction.Rejected)
                ||
                branchWorkResults.Any(
                    result =>
                        result.Action ==
                            NIRABranchWorkApplyAction.Rejected)
                ||
                dynamicToolMutations.Any(
                    result =>
                        result.Action ==
                            NIRADynamicToolApplyAction.Rejected);


            bool ownershipRoutingCorrection =
                topLevelMachineActionsDisallowed
                &&
                (
                    suppressedTopLevelCapabilities > 0
                    ||
                    suppressedTopLevelToolInvocations > 0
                );


            bool continueForRuntimeCorrection =
                mutationRejected
                ||
                ownershipRoutingCorrection;

            // Defensive migration path for already-persisted mixed-attempt
            // goals: this branch is actually complete, but an older REQUIRED
            // root of the same goal prevents parent completion. Deliver the
            // VERIFIED, committed branch summary once on the branch-result
            // event instead of spending more model calls and then silently
            // suppressing the only answer. Do not mark the parent complete.
            bool independentlyCompletedBranchReply = false;
            if (mindEvent.Name == "PersistentBranchResult" &&
                decision.State == NIRACognitionState.Complete &&
                IsCommittedCompletedBranchResult(mindEvent) &&
                TryReadMetadataGuid(mindEvent, "branchId", out Guid completedResultBranchId) &&
                _branches.TryGetBranch(completedResultBranchId, out NIRABranchState? finishedBranch) &&
                finishedBranch is { Status: NIRABranchStatus.Completed } &&
                !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(finishedBranch.ResultSummary) &&
                goalResults.Any(result =>
                    result.Action == NIRAGoalApplyAction.Rejected &&
                    result.Reason.Contains("REQUIRED root branch", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)) &&
                _branches.GetForGoal(finishedBranch.GoalId).Any(other =>
                    other.Id != completedResultBranchId &&
                    other.ParentBranchId == null &&
                    other.JoinPolicy == NIRABranchJoinPolicy.Required &&
                    other.Status != NIRABranchStatus.Completed &&
                    other.CreatedAt < finishedBranch.CreatedAt &&
                    (other.IsResolved || other.Status == NIRABranchStatus.Blocked)))
            {
                independentlyCompletedBranchReply = true;
                continueForRuntimeCorrection = false;
                decision = decision with
                {
                    State = NIRACognitionState.Complete,
                    EmitReply = true,
                    Reply = finishedBranch.ResultSummary!
                };
                Debug.WriteLine($"[Executive] HISTORIC ROOT ISOLATION | " +
                    $"Branch={completedResultBranchId:D} | Goal={finishedBranch.GoalId:D} | " +
                    "Delivering persisted branch result; older goal remains unresolved.");
            }

            // A queued/ongoing assignment owns the NEXT observation. Do not
            // spend another cognition turn guessing its result, or open a new
            // browser session before the worker has returned its evidence.
            bool awaitingDelegatedWork =
                branchWorkResults.Any(r => r.Action is
                    NIRABranchWorkApplyAction.Queued or
                    NIRABranchWorkApplyAction.Duplicate)
                || (IsInternalBranchLifecycleEvent(mindEvent) &&
                    ownedGoalId is Guid delegatedGoalId &&
                    _branchWork.CurrentWork.Any(w =>
                        w.GoalId == delegatedGoalId && w.IsOpen));
            if (awaitingDelegatedWork)
            {
                Debug.WriteLine($"[Executive] Run={runId} | Cycle={cycle} | " +
                    "DELEGATED WAIT: worker owns the next result; no extra model cycle.");
                // Hand off only after an authoritative queued item exists. The
                // user can send another message while the branch runner works.
                if (mindEvent.Source == NIRAMindEventSource.User &&
                    branchWorkResults.Any(r => r.Action == NIRABranchWorkApplyAction.Queued))
                {
                    string handoff = "I've handed the next step to background work. " +
                        "You can keep chatting while I follow it through.";
                    string deliveredHandoff = await DeliverEarlyReplyAsync(
                        mindEvent, handoff, NIRAPublicReplyKind.Natural,
                        cancellationToken);
                    await RecordResponseAsync(mindEvent, deliveredHandoff);
                    yield return new NIRAOutputChunk
                    {
                        RunId = runId, Source = mindEvent.Source,
                        Type = NIRAOutputChunkType.Text,
                        Content = deliveredHandoff, SpeechContent = deliveredHandoff,
                        VoiceExpression = expression
                    };
                }
                yield return new NIRAOutputChunk
                {
                    RunId = runId, Source = mindEvent.Source,
                    Type = NIRAOutputChunkType.Completed,
                    Content = string.Empty,
                    VoiceExpression = expression
                };
                yield break;
            }


            bool continueForCapabilityResults =
                capabilityResults.Count >
                0
                ||
                dynamicToolCapabilityResults.Count >
                0;

            // A trusted OS failure creating the exact requested parent is a
            // terminal prerequisite blocker for this serial action batch.
            // Another cognition round cannot repair an unavailable storage
            // provider; never spin through 10+ LLM calls or infer Defender.
            if (mindEvent.Source == NIRAMindEventSource.User &&
                !continueForRuntimeCorrection &&
                NIRAFilesystemPrerequisitePolicy.TryDescribeBlockedPrerequisite(
                    newCapabilityRequests, capabilityResults,
                    out string blockedFilesystemReply, out string blockedFilesystemKind))
            {
                decision = decision with
                {
                    State = NIRACognitionState.Blocked,
                    EmitReply = true,
                    ReplyReady = true,
                    Reply = blockedFilesystemReply,
                    Speech = blockedFilesystemReply,
                    DecisionSummary = "Windows rejected the required directory creation; " +
                        "no dependent write is verified."
                };
                continueForCapabilityResults = false;
                continueForRuntimeCorrection = false;
                (IReadOnlyList<NIRAGoalApplyResult> stoppedGoals,
                 IReadOnlyList<NIRABranchApplyResult> stoppedBranches) =
                    await PersistBlockedTaskAsync(
                        mindEvent, ResolveTaskGoalId(
                            mindEvent, ownedGoalId, goalResults, branchResults),
                        blockedFilesystemReply, cancellationToken);
                goalResults = goalResults.Concat(stoppedGoals).ToArray();
                branchResults = branchResults.Concat(stoppedBranches).ToArray();
                goalChanges += stoppedGoals.Count(r => r.Changed);
                branchChanges += stoppedBranches.Count(r => r.Changed);
                NIRADiagnosticTrace.Event("FILESYSTEM-PREREQUISITE-BLOCKED",
                    $"Run={runId:D} Cycle={cycle} Kind={blockedFilesystemKind} " +
                    "ReplanCallsSkipped=True DefenderBlockConfirmed=False");
            }

            // A confirmed OS access boundary needs a useful manual handoff,
            // not additional Gemma/Ultra calls trying the same forbidden action.
            // Only terminalize a single failed close; multi-operation batches
            // still go through the evidence-preserving review path.
            if (mindEvent.Source == NIRAMindEventSource.User &&
                !continueForRuntimeCorrection &&
                NIRADesktopManualHandoffPolicy.TryDescribeBlockedOperation(
                    newCapabilityRequests, capabilityResults,
                    out string manualDesktopReply, out string manualDesktopKind))
            {
                decision = decision with
                {
                    State = NIRACognitionState.Blocked,
                    EmitReply = true,
                    ReplyReady = true,
                    Reply = manualDesktopReply,
                    Speech = manualDesktopReply,
                    DecisionSummary = "Windows denied a normal window close; " +
                        "NIRA provided a safe, user-actionable handoff."
                };
                continueForCapabilityResults = false;
                continueForRuntimeCorrection = false;
                (IReadOnlyList<NIRAGoalApplyResult> stoppedGoals,
                 IReadOnlyList<NIRABranchApplyResult> stoppedBranches) =
                    await PersistBlockedTaskAsync(
                        mindEvent, ResolveTaskGoalId(
                            mindEvent, ownedGoalId, goalResults, branchResults),
                        manualDesktopReply, cancellationToken);
                goalResults = goalResults.Concat(stoppedGoals).ToArray();
                branchResults = branchResults.Concat(stoppedBranches).ToArray();
                goalChanges += stoppedGoals.Count(item => item.Changed);
                branchChanges += stoppedBranches.Count(item => item.Changed);
                NIRADiagnosticTrace.Event("DESKTOP-MANUAL-HANDOFF",
                    $"Run={runId:D} Cycle={cycle} Kind={manualDesktopKind} " +
                    "RetriesSkipped=True ModelEscalationSkipped=True " +
                    "TargetExitVerified=False");
            }

            // A fresh same-HWND inspection already disproved completion.
            // Another 8-13 LLM cycles cannot make a corrupted insertion true,
            // and potentially destructive cleanup is blocked for this run.
            if (desktopTextMismatchObserved &&
                mindEvent.Source == NIRAMindEventSource.User)
            {
                const string mismatchReply =
                    "I opened the editor and sent the text, but the text " +
                    "in the editor could not be verified as the complete " +
                    "requested paragraph. I stopped without clearing or " +
                    "rewriting it, so this " +
                    "task is not complete.";
                decision = decision with
                {
                    State = NIRACognitionState.Blocked,
                    EmitReply = true,
                    ReplyReady = true,
                    Reply = mismatchReply,
                    Speech = mismatchReply,
                    DecisionSummary = "Live editor content did not pass exact postcondition verification."
                };
                continueForCapabilityResults = false;
                continueForRuntimeCorrection = false;
                // Keep the persistent task ledger consistent with the actual
                // incomplete desktop result; an active goal must not claim
                // success or silently restart the same corrupted insertion.
                (IReadOnlyList<NIRAGoalApplyResult> stoppedGoals,
                 IReadOnlyList<NIRABranchApplyResult> stoppedBranches) =
                    await PersistBlockedTaskAsync(
                        mindEvent, ResolveTaskGoalId(
                            mindEvent, ownedGoalId, goalResults, branchResults),
                        mismatchReply, cancellationToken);
                goalResults = goalResults.Concat(stoppedGoals).ToArray();
                branchResults = branchResults.Concat(stoppedBranches).ToArray();
                goalChanges += stoppedGoals.Count(r => r.Changed);
                branchChanges += stoppedBranches.Count(r => r.Changed);
                Debug.WriteLine($"[DesktopAction] TEXT MISMATCH TERMINAL | Run={runId:D} | Cycle={cycle}");
            }


            bool continueForDynamicToolResults =
                dynamicToolMutations.Count >
                0
                ||
                dynamicToolExecutions.Count >
                0;


            if (continueForRuntimeCorrection)
            {
                executiveEvidence.AppendLine();
                executiveEvidence.AppendLine(
                    ownershipRoutingCorrection
                        ? "The runtime rejected direct machine-action routing from an internal branch lifecycle event. Reconsider using authoritative branch-owned work instead of repeating the top-level request."
                        : "One or more proposed executive mutations were rejected. Reconsider the proposal using the authoritative result above before emitting a success claim.");
            }


            if (branchResults.Any(r => r.Changed &&
                    r.Branch?.Status == NIRABranchStatus.Completed) &&
                goalResults.Any(r => r.Action == NIRAGoalApplyAction.Rejected) &&
                deferredGoalCompletions.Length > 0)
            {
                // A committed branch emits PersistentBranchResult. Let that
                // single authoritative wake reconcile its parent; no parallel
                // retry from the older work-result event.
                continueForRuntimeCorrection = false;
                decision = decision with
                {
                    State = NIRACognitionState.Wait,
                    EmitReply = false,
                    Reply = string.Empty
                };
            }

            if (decision.State ==
                    NIRACognitionState.Continue
                ||
                continueForRuntimeCorrection
                ||
                continueForCapabilityResults
                ||
                continueForDynamicToolResults)
            {
                NIRAMemorySearchRequest[] newSearches =
                    decision.MemorySearches
                        .Select(
                            request =>
                                request.Normalize())
                        .Where(
                            request =>
                            {
                                string signature =
                                    request.BuildSignature();


                                return executedMemorySearches.Add(
                                    signature);
                            })
                        .ToArray();


                NIRAConversationSearchRequest[] newConversationSearches =
                    decision.ConversationSearches.Select(r => r.Normalize())
                        .Where(r => !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(r.Query) &&
                            executedConversationSearches.Add(r.BuildSignature()))
                        .Take(3).ToArray();
                int newConversationCount = AppendConversationSearchEvidence(
                    memorySearchEvidence, newConversationSearches, surfacedConversationIds,
                    mindEvent.SocialEventId);

                int newEvidenceCount = newConversationCount;


                if (newSearches.Length >
                    0)
                {
                    newEvidenceCount +=
                        await AppendMemorySearchEvidenceAsync(
                            memorySearchEvidence,
                            newSearches,
                            surfacedMemoryIds,
                            cancellationToken);
                }

                // Full memory mode is already exhaustive. Once one explicit
                // structured long-term-memory search has run, another differently
                // worded search cannot expose an omitted ACTIVE memory because the
                // entire active set was already supplied in the prompt. Move to one
                // bounded synthesis cycle even when the first ranking returned new
                // candidates.
                bool fullMemoryCoverageReached =
                    context.MemoryContextMode == NIRAMemoryContextMode.Full &&
                    newSearches.Length > 0 &&
                    mindEvent.Source == NIRAMindEventSource.User;

                // Outside Full mode, search novelty is established by returned
                // record identity, not query wording. Paraphrasing the same search
                // cannot turn a retrieval loop into apparent progress.
                bool repeatedMemoryEvidence =
                    (decision.MemorySearches.Count > 0 ||
                     decision.ConversationSearches.Count > 0) &&
                    newEvidenceCount == 0 &&
                    mindEvent.Source == NIRAMindEventSource.User;

                if (fullMemoryCoverageReached)
                {
                    memoryEvidenceSaturated = true;
                    memorySearchEvidence.AppendLine();
                    memorySearchEvidence.AppendLine(
                        "FULL MEMORY COVERAGE: Every active durable memory was already " +
                        "supplied to cognition and one explicit structured memory search " +
                        "has now completed. The next decision must synthesize from these " +
                        "records instead of issuing synonym memory searches or switching " +
                        "to archived conversation merely to repeat the same lookup.");
                    Debug.WriteLine(
                        $"[MemoryRetrieval] FULL COVERAGE | Run={runId} | Cycle={cycle} | " +
                        $"Active={context.ActiveLongTermMemoryCount} | " +
                        $"Surfaced={surfacedMemoryIds.Count}");
                }
                else if (repeatedMemoryEvidence)
                {
                    memoryEvidenceSaturated = true;
                    memorySearchEvidence.AppendLine();
                    memorySearchEvidence.AppendLine(
                        "RETRIEVAL NOVELTY: This search added no new records to " +
                        "the memories already surfaced above. On the next " +
                        "decision answer from available evidence and explicitly " +
                        "distinguish missing/current facts. Do not run a synonym " +
                        "of the same search.");
                    Debug.WriteLine($"[MemoryRetrieval] SATURATED | Run={runId} | " +
                        $"Cycle={cycle} | PreviouslySurfaced={surfacedMemoryIds.Count} | " +
                        $"NewRecords=0");
                }
                else if (newEvidenceCount > 0)
                {
                    memoryEvidenceSaturated = false;
                }

                bool madeProgress =
                    newEvidenceCount >
                        0
                    ||
                    newExecutiveEvidenceCount >
                        0
                    ||
                    newCapabilityEvidenceCount >
                        0
                    ||
                    newDynamicToolEvidenceCount >
                        0
                    ||
                    newRuntimeVisuals >
                        0
                    ||
                    dynamicToolChanges >
                        0
                    ||
                    goalChanges >
                        0
                    ||
                    branchChanges >
                        0
                    ||
                    branchWorkChanges >
                        0;


                if (!madeProgress)
                {
                    noProgressCycles++;


                    memorySearchEvidence.AppendLine();
                    memorySearchEvidence.AppendLine(
                        "The previous cognition cycle requested continuation but produced no new memory, executive, capability, dynamic-tool, goal, branch-state, or branch-work progress.");
                }
                else
                {
                    noProgressCycles =
                        0;
                }


                // Evaluate the exact registered, normalized request signature
                // directly against the completed result ledger. The earlier
                // repeat guard only counted duplicates the *first* time they
                // were logged, and required the whole result ledger to contain
                // exactly one entry. Those unrelated conditions let a repeated
                // successful Observe read consume additional cognition cycles.
                // Never infer equivalence merely from a capability ID: different
                // arguments (e.g., different targets) are independent requests.
                NIRACapabilityResult? exactPreviousObservation = null;
                bool exactPreviouslyObservedRead =
                    requestedCapabilities.Length == 1 &&
                    capabilityResultsBySignature.TryGetValue(
                        requestedCapabilities[0].BuildSignature(),
                        out exactPreviousObservation) &&
                    exactPreviousObservation.Succeeded &&
                    exactPreviousObservation.Risk == NIRACapabilityRisk.Observe;

                bool saturatedSingleObservation =
                    mindEvent.Source == NIRAMindEventSource.User &&
                    decision.State == NIRACognitionState.Continue &&
                    exactPreviouslyObservedRead &&
                    newCapabilityRequests.Length == 0 &&
                    !madeProgress &&
                    decision.MemorySearches.Count == 0 &&
                    decision.ConversationSearches.Count == 0 &&
                    decision.GoalProposals.Count == 0 &&
                    decision.BranchProposals.Count == 0 &&
                    decision.BranchWorkProposals.Count == 0 &&
                    decision.DynamicToolProposals.Count == 0 &&
                    decision.DynamicToolInvocations.Count == 0;

                // Diagnostic-only repeat-guard trace. Never write raw arguments,
                // paths, tokens or result data into the log. This lets us
                // distinguish a changed request signature from a guard whose
                // other conditions were not met, without changing the policy.
                if (cycle > 1 &&
                    mindEvent.Source == NIRAMindEventSource.User &&
                    decision.State == NIRACognitionState.Continue &&
                    requestedCapabilities.Length > 0 &&
                    newCapabilityRequests.Length == 0)
                {
                    Debug.WriteLine(
                        $"[Executive] REPEAT GUARD TRACE | Run={runId:D} | " +
                        $"Cycle={cycle} | Requests={requestedCapabilities.Length} | " +
                        $"ExactPriorSucceededObserve={exactPreviouslyObservedRead} | " +
                        $"MadeProgress={madeProgress} | " +
                        $"MemorySearches={decision.MemorySearches.Count} | " +
                        $"ConversationSearches={decision.ConversationSearches.Count} | " +
                        $"OtherWork={decision.GoalProposals.Count + decision.BranchProposals.Count + decision.BranchWorkProposals.Count + decision.DynamicToolProposals.Count + decision.DynamicToolInvocations.Count} | " +
                        $"NoProgressCycles={noProgressCycles} | " +
                        $"Saturated={saturatedSingleObservation}");
                }

                if (saturatedSingleObservation)
                    Debug.WriteLine(
                        $"[Executive] REPEATED OBSERVATION SATURATED | Run={runId:D} | " +
                        $"Cycle={cycle} | NewDispatch=0 | ExactSignature=True | " +
                        $"Risk={exactPreviousObservation!.Risk}");

                // Recover once from a model repeating a verified Observe read.
                // No capability is dispatched by this branch: the repeated
                // request was already excluded from newCapabilityRequests.
                // Preserve the original evidence, avoid false completion and
                // never turn an unchanged source into an invented second source.
                if (ShouldReconsiderRepeatedRead(
                    saturatedSingleObservation, repeatedReadRecoveryUsed, noProgressCycles))
                {
                    repeatedReadRecoveryUsed = true;
                    executiveEvidence.AppendLine();
                    executiveEvidence.AppendLine(
                        "AUTHORITATIVE REPEATED READ: The exact Observe capability " +
                        "request you just proposed already succeeded in this run. " +
                        "Its original result is in CAPABILITY EVIDENCE. The duplicate " +
                        "was NOT executed and adds no new evidence. Reconsider the " +
                        "ORIGINAL user objective ONCE. You may (a) answer from " +
                        "already verified evidence while clearly stating any " +
                        "missing information, (b) propose a genuinely DIFFERENT " +
                        "registered read-only action grounded in observed links " +
                        "or facts, or (c) explicitly state the remaining blocker. " +
                        "Never claim unobserved sources, and do not repeat this " +
                        "or an equivalent unchanged read. A further unproductive " +
                        "continuation will be stopped by the Executive.");
                    Debug.WriteLine(
                        $"[Executive] REPEATED READ REPLAN | Run={runId:D} | " +
                        $"Cycle={cycle} | Retry=1 | DuplicateDispatched=False");
                    continue;
                }

                bool deniedCloseAlreadyObserved = capabilityResultsBySignature.Values.Any(
                    result => (result.CapabilityId is NIRACapabilityIds.DesktopAct or
                        NIRACapabilityIds.DesktopClose) &&
                        result.Summary.Contains("WINDOW_CLOSE_ACCESS_DENIED:", StringComparison.Ordinal));
                bool forceTerminal = noProgressCycles >= 2 || saturatedSingleObservation ||
                    (deniedCloseAlreadyObserved && noProgressCycles >= 1);


                if (forceTerminal &&
                    TryReadMetadataGuid(mindEvent, "goalId", out Guid waitingWorkGoalId) &&
                    _branchWork.CurrentWork.Any(item =>
                        item.GoalId == waitingWorkGoalId && item.IsOpen))
                {
                    // The worker, not another LLM cycle, owns the next result.
                    // Do not misreport an active task as permanently blocked.
                    Debug.WriteLine($"[Executive] Run={runId} | Cycle={cycle} | WAIT FOR BRANCH WORK");
                    decision = decision with
                    {
                        State = NIRACognitionState.Wait,
                        EmitReply = false,
                        Reply = string.Empty,
                        DecisionSummary = "Waiting for the authoritative branch-work result."
                    };
                }
                else if (forceTerminal && !deniedCloseAlreadyObserved &&
                    !partialEvidenceSynthesisUsed &&
                    mindEvent.Source == NIRAMindEventSource.User &&
                    capabilityResultsBySignature.Values.Any(result => result.Succeeded &&
                        result.Risk == NIRACapabilityRisk.Observe))
                {
                    // A stall is not the same as lack of evidence. Give cognition
                    // one LAST answer-only synthesis turn over the already
                    // verified observations before resorting to a fallback.
                    // No repeated capability was dispatched by the guard.
                    partialEvidenceSynthesisUsed = true;
                    executiveEvidence.AppendLine();
                    executiveEvidence.AppendLine(
                        "FINAL EVIDENCE SYNTHESIS: Your continuation stalled. " +
                        "You have already observed read-only data for this user request. " +
                        "Produce the BEST concrete, truthful user-facing answer NOW. " +
                        "Report observed items and exact useful values; clearly qualify " +
                        "unverified matches and incomplete scans. Do not request more " +
                        "actions, do not output tool diagnostics, and do not claim " +
                        "unperformed changes. It is acceptable to answer partially " +
                        "rather than suppressing all useful observed information.");
                    Debug.WriteLine($"[Executive] BOUNDED EVIDENCE SYNTHESIS | " +
                        $"Run={runId:D} | Cycle={cycle} | ExtraDispatch=0");
                    continue;
                }
                else if (forceTerminal)
                {
                    string fallbackReply =
                        BuildNoProgressFallbackReply(
                            decision,
                            lastCapabilityResult,
                            capabilityResultsBySignature.Values.ToArray());

                    (IReadOnlyList<NIRAGoalApplyResult> stoppedGoals,
                     IReadOnlyList<NIRABranchApplyResult> stoppedBranches) =
                        await PersistBlockedTaskAsync(
                            mindEvent, ResolveTaskGoalId(
                                mindEvent, ownedGoalId, goalResults, branchResults),
                            fallbackReply, cancellationToken);
                    goalResults = goalResults.Concat(stoppedGoals).ToArray();
                    branchResults = branchResults.Concat(stoppedBranches).ToArray();
                    goalChanges += stoppedGoals.Count(r => r.Changed);
                    branchChanges += stoppedBranches.Count(r => r.Changed);

                    Debug.WriteLine(
                        $"[Executive] Run={runId} | " +
                        $"Cycle={cycle} | " +
                        "NO-PROGRESS GUARD -> BLOCKED");


                    decision =
                        decision with
                        {
                            State =
                                NIRACognitionState.Blocked,

                            EmitReply =
                                true,

                            Reply =
                                fallbackReply,

                            DecisionSummary =
                                "Executive stopped repeated continuation after two cycles without authoritative progress."
                        };
                }


                if (!forceTerminal)
                {
                    continue;
                }
            }

            // CONTRACT-RECOVERY COMPLETION INTEGRITY
            // A prior schema/model-contract rejection has NOT fulfilled the
            // current request. Only a real capability result clears that debt.
            // A failed/denied capability result also counts as evidence of the
            // attempt; cognition may then explain the actual limitation, never
            // pretend the requested data was observed.

            // Generic UI execution has a separate action/observation boundary.
            // A successful click, key, invoke or text entry is not proof that
            // the requested document/application result exists. Re-observe
            // once before the user-facing completion review; if the model
            // refuses to inspect, report unverified work, never false Done.
            if (mindEvent.Source == NIRAMindEventSource.User &&
                decision.State == NIRACognitionState.Complete &&
                decision.EmitReply && desktopActionNeedsObservation)
            {
                if (!desktopVerificationReplanIssued)
                {
                    desktopVerificationReplanIssued = true;
                    executiveEvidence.AppendLine(
                        "DESKTOP ACTION COMPLETION BOUNDARY: A desktop.act " +
                        "operation dispatched but no successful post-action " +
                        "desktop.inspect has established the new application " +
                        "state. Inspect that exact HWND now; do not say Done yet.");
                    Debug.WriteLine($"[DesktopAction] VERIFICATION REQUIRED | Run={runId} | Cycle={cycle}");
                    continue;
                }
                const string unverifiedDesktopReply =
                    "I issued the desktop action, but I couldn't verify " +
                    "the final application state. I won't call the task done.";
                decision = decision with
                {
                    State = NIRACognitionState.Blocked,
                    Reply = unverifiedDesktopReply,
                    Speech = unverifiedDesktopReply,
                    EmitReply = true, ReplyReady = true,
                    DecisionSummary = "Desktop action dispatched without verified postcondition."
                };
            }

            // USER-OBJECTIVE DELIVERY GATE (ALL USER SURFACES)
            // The cognition model can accidentally turn an executable request
            // into a greeting or unrelated response without even proposing a
            // capability. No tool-based or embedding-similarity heuristic can
            // catch every case: zero tool requests is precisely the failure mode.
            // Judge EVERY model-written terminal USER reply against the ORIGINAL
            // request before releasing it. The reviewer is a separate model
            // assessment, not world evidence or an authority to invoke tools.
            // This policy is domain-agnostic; it has no phrase or app routing.
            // Visible instrumentation: this checkpoint must execute on every
            // user-source terminal decision. If it is absent from a running log,
            // the compiled application is not using this patched Executive.
            Debug.WriteLine(
                $"[NIRA-Fidelity-V3] TERMINAL_CHECK | Run={runId:D} | " +
                $"Cycle={cycle} | State={decision.State} | " +
                $"EmitReply={decision.EmitReply} | ReplyChars={decision.Reply?.Length ?? 0} | " +
                $"ObservedCapabilities={capabilityResultsBySignature.Count}");

            // Final delivery invariant for one successfully observed read-only
            // web result. If an upstream state-repair still produced a silent
            // terminal envelope, do not publish an empty user turn. This is a
            // last-resort non-factual explanation, not a synthesized web claim;
            // it never activates on ordinary direct chat or real ongoing work.
            if (mindEvent.Source == NIRAMindEventSource.User && cycle > 1 &&
                latestContext is not null &&
                NIRACognitionPromptCompiler.IsSingleSuccessfulWebSearchReceipt(latestContext) &&
                NIRAWebResearchReplyPolicy.IsSilentTerminal(decision))
            {
                NIRADiagnosticTrace.Event("WEB-TERMINAL-DELIVERY-GUARD",
                    $"Run={runId:D} Cycle={cycle} PreviousState={decision.State} " +
                    $"Emit={decision.EmitReply} ReplyChars={decision.Reply?.Length ?? 0}");
                decision = NIRAWebResearchReplyPolicy.TruthfulFailure();
            }

            bool userTerminalDraft =
                mindEvent.Source == NIRAMindEventSource.User &&
                (decision.State == NIRACognitionState.Complete ||
                 decision.State == NIRACognitionState.NeedUser) &&
                decision.EmitReply &&
                !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(decision.Reply);

            // Due reminders already include an authoritative commitment ID.
            // Gemma may decide to DELIVER and include a structured Complete
            // proposal in the SAME cognition call. We don't need a separate
            // experience-formation model merely to transition that known ID.
            // Do not complete a deferred, unsent, or recurring occurrence.
            if (string.Equals(mindEvent.Name, "TemporalCommitmentDue",
                    StringComparison.Ordinal) &&
                decision.State == NIRACognitionState.Complete &&
                decision.EmitReply && !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(decision.Reply) &&
                mindEvent.Metadata.TryGetValue("commitmentId", out string? dueId) &&
                Guid.TryParse(dueId, out Guid dueGuid))
            {
                NIRACommitmentFormationProposal[] dueTransitions =
                    decision.CommitmentProposals
                        .Where(p => p.Action == NIRACommitmentProposalAction.Complete &&
                            p.EvidenceSource == NIRACommitmentEvidenceSource.NIRAReply &&
                            Guid.TryParse(p.CommitmentId, out Guid proposalGuid) &&
                            proposalGuid == dueGuid &&
                            !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(p.EvidenceQuote) &&
                            decision.Reply.Contains(p.EvidenceQuote, StringComparison.Ordinal))
                        .Take(1).ToArray();
                if (dueTransitions.Length == 1)
                {
                    int verifiedChanges = await _selfModel.ApplyCommitmentProposalsAsync(
                        mindEvent, decision.Reply, dueTransitions, cancellationToken);
                    if (verifiedChanges > 0)
                    {
                        directTemporalWakeVerified = true;
                        formationAppliedBeforeReply = true;
                        Debug.WriteLine($"[TemporalCommitment] DIRECT_WAKE | " +
                            $"Run={runId:D} | VerifiedChanges={verifiedChanges} | " +
                            "ExtraModelCalls=0");
                    }
                }
            }

            // FUTURE OBLIGATION: PERSIST BEFORE OBJECTIVE REVIEW.
            // Temporal reminders belong to the authoritative self-model, NOT
            // a made-up timer capability and NOT a fresh persistent goal.
            // A review of a 'scheduled' claim would otherwise fail because
            // the old post-review formation order offered no world evidence.
            // This path adds ONE formation call only when primary cognition
            // already proposed reviewCommitment in its normal JSON decision.
            if (ShouldPreReviewCommitment(
                    mindEvent.Source, decision, formationAppliedBeforeReply) &&
                latestContext != null &&
                ShouldApplyMemoryFormation(mindEvent, goalResults, branchResults))
            {
                // Capture the pre-mutation snapshot so reviewer evidence
                // describes the actual changed commitment, not just a model
                // claim or an unrelated previously scheduled reminder.
                Dictionary<Guid, NIRACommitmentState> commitmentsBefore =
                    _selfModel.CurrentCommitments.ToDictionary(item => item.Id);
                int appliedCommitmentChanges = 0;
                // Fast structured path: the SAME cognition result may include
                // a grounded commitment and relative-time proposal. The real
                // self-model is still the sole persistence authority. Do not
                // invent a parser or accept the model's success claim.
                NIRACommitmentFormationProposal[] directReminders =
                    decision.CommitmentProposals
                        .Where(p => p.Action == NIRACommitmentProposalAction.Create &&
                            p.EvidenceSource == NIRACommitmentEvidenceSource.NIRAReply &&
                            p.Temporal is { Mode: not NIRATemporalTimingMode.None } &&
                            !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(p.EvidenceQuote) &&
                            decision.Reply.Contains(p.EvidenceQuote, StringComparison.Ordinal))
                        .Take(1)
                        .ToArray();
                if (directReminders.Length == 1)
                {
                    appliedCommitmentChanges =
                        await _selfModel.ApplyCommitmentProposalsAsync(
                            mindEvent, decision.Reply, directReminders,
                            cancellationToken);
                    Debug.WriteLine($"[TemporalCommitment] DIRECT_PROPOSAL | " +
                        $"Run={runId:D} | Accepted={appliedCommitmentChanges} | ExtraModelCalls=0");
                }
                if (appliedCommitmentChanges <= 0)
                {
                    // Older/partial model responses remain compatible: no
                    // speculative scheduling if the structured proposal is
                    // absent or rejected. Original formation remains intact.
                    memoryFormationCalls++;
                    appliedCommitmentChanges = await ApplyMemoryFormationAsync(
                        runId, mindEvent, interaction?.Event, latestContext,
                        decision, decision.Reply, cancellationToken);
                }

                formationAppliedBeforeReply = true;
                preReviewCommitmentSucceeded = appliedCommitmentChanges > 0;
                Debug.WriteLine($"[TemporalCommitment] PRE_REVIEW | " +
                    $"Run={runId:D} | Persisted={preReviewCommitmentSucceeded} | " +
                    $"Changes={appliedCommitmentChanges}");

                if (preReviewCommitmentSucceeded)
                {
                    NIRACommitmentState[] changedCommitments =
                        _selfModel.CurrentCommitments
                            .Where(item => !commitmentsBefore.TryGetValue(
                                item.Id, out NIRACommitmentState? previous) ||
                                !Equals(previous, item))
                            .Take(6)
                            .ToArray();
                    executiveEvidence.AppendLine();
                    executiveEvidence.AppendLine(
                        "AUTHORITATIVE TEMPORAL COMMITMENT PERSISTENCE: " +
                        "The trusted NIRA self-model stored a future obligation " +
                        $"change (Changed={appliedCommitmentChanges}). " +
                        "The commitment scheduler owns future wake-ups; no " +
                        "separate timer capability is required. " +
                        "A saved unscheduled obligation is NOT proof of a " +
                        "specific-time reminder. Check the actual schedule below.");
                    foreach (NIRACommitmentState item in changedCommitments)
                    {
                        executiveEvidence.AppendLine(
                            $"CommitmentId={item.Id:D}; Status={item.Status}; " +
                            $"Summary={item.Summary}; " +
                            $"IsScheduled={item.Temporal?.IsScheduled == true}; " +
                            $"NextWakeAtUtc={item.Temporal?.NextWakeAtUtc?.ToString("O") ?? "none"}");
                    }
                    if (changedCommitments.Length == 0)
                        executiveEvidence.AppendLine(
                            "No changed commitment snapshot was found; do not " +
                            "infer an exact scheduled wake from change count.");
                    // Prevent a second commitment-formation call in finalization.
                    decision = decision with { ReviewCommitment = false };
                }
                else
                {
                    // Never allow the completion reviewer, expression model,
                    // or another cognition round to claim unsaved scheduling.
                    const string failedCommitmentReply =
                        "I couldn't reliably save that future reminder or " +
                        "commitment, so I won't pretend it's scheduled.";
                    decision = decision with
                    {
                        State = NIRACognitionState.Blocked,
                        EmitReply = true,
                        Reply = failedCommitmentReply,
                        Speech = failedCommitmentReply,
                        ReviewCommitment = false,
                        ReplyReady = true,
                        DecisionSummary = "Authoritative commitment persistence failed."
                    };
                    userTerminalDraft = false;
                }
            }

            // No user-visible model-written terminal reply bypasses this gate,
            // including replies following a successful state-changing action.
            // Failed persistence is blocked by trusted runtime evidence above,
            // rather than repeatedly asking an LLM to schedule a nonexistent tool.
            // Gemma can produce the final character-ready answer in one call for
            // a shape-checked, evidence-free first-turn conversation or a truly
            // self-contained knowledge explanation. No tools, commitments, prior
            // objectives, or evidence-dependent claims are authorized by flags.
            // No tool, action, reminder or factual task can opt in via a flag alone.
            bool directConversation = userTerminalDraft &&
                NIRAConversationFastPath.CanUseDirectReply(
                    decision,
                    firstUserCycle: cycle == 1,
                    hasTrustedWorkEvidence: capabilityResultsBySignature.Count > 0 ||
                        preReviewCommitmentSucceeded ||
                        capabilityEvidence.Length > 0 ||
                        dynamicToolEvidence.Length > 0,
                    hasPendingOwnedTask: GetPendingTaskForEvent(mindEvent) != null,
                    embeddedApplication: mindEvent.Metadata.ContainsKey("externalAppId"));
            if (directConversation)
            {
                completionReviewConfirmedComplete = true;
                Debug.WriteLine($"[ConversationFastPath] REVIEW_SKIPPED | Run={runId:D} | " +
                    $"Reason={(decision.SelfContainedAnswer ? "StandaloneKnowledge" : "VerifiedInterpersonalDecision")} | ExtraModelCalls=0");
            }

            if (userTerminalDraft && !completionReviewConfirmedComplete)
            {
                NIRACapabilityResult[] observedResults = capabilityResultsBySignature.Values.ToArray();
                bool hasSingleSuccessfulImageGeneration = observedResults.Length == 1 &&
                    string.Equals(observedResults[0].CapabilityId, NIRACapabilityIds.ImageGenerate, StringComparison.Ordinal) &&
                    observedResults[0].Succeeded &&
                    observedResults[0].VisualArtifacts.Count == 1;
                bool hasNoOutstandingWork =
                    decision.State == NIRACognitionState.Complete &&
                    decision.CapabilityIds.Count == 0 &&
                    decision.CapabilityRequests.Count == 0 &&
                    decision.ContextRequests.Count == 0 &&
                    decision.MemorySearches.Count == 0 &&
                    decision.ConversationSearches.Count == 0 &&
                    decision.BranchWorkProposals.Count == 0 &&
                    decision.DynamicToolProposals.Count == 0 &&
                    decision.DynamicToolInvocations.Count == 0 &&
                    !decision.ReviewCommitment;

                if (hasSingleSuccessfulImageGeneration && hasNoOutstandingWork)
                {
                    completionReviewConfirmedComplete = true;
                    Debug.WriteLine($"[ImageGenerationFastPath] REVIEW_SKIPPED | Run={runId:D} | Cycle={cycle} | ExtraModelCalls=0");
                }
            }

            // Image-only evidence certificate: when the user's ENTIRE request is
            // a bounded photograph request, one registered image.search has
            // already emitted exactly the requested number of distinct files,
            // and no other work is involved, independent semantic review cannot
            // add execution proof. No subject/product examples or trigger lists.
            // Mixed requests, partial images, uncertain/failed work, and unclear
            // wording retain the independent reviewer unchanged.
            if (userTerminalDraft && !completionReviewConfirmedComplete &&
                taskCompletionReviewCount == 0 &&
                NIRAImageTurnDeliveryPolicy.IsSimpleImageOnlyRequest(mindEvent.Content) &&
                NIRAImageTurnDeliveryPolicy.ReadExplicitImageCount(mindEvent.Content) is int requestedImages &&
                imageDeliveryTarget == requestedImages &&
                verifiedImageRetrievalCount == requestedImages &&
                !preReviewCommitmentSucceeded &&
                GetPendingTaskForEvent(mindEvent) == null &&
                !mindEvent.Metadata.ContainsKey("externalAppId") &&
                string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(dynamicToolEvidence.ToString()) &&
                !IsFalseImageUnavailableClaim(decision.Reply) &&
                decision.Reply.Length <= 800 &&
                decision.State == NIRACognitionState.Complete &&
                decision.CapabilityIds.Count == 0 &&
                decision.CapabilityRequests.Count == 0 &&
                decision.ContextRequests.Count == 0 &&
                decision.MemorySearches.Count == 0 &&
                decision.ConversationSearches.Count == 0 &&
                decision.BranchWorkProposals.Count == 0 &&
                decision.DynamicToolProposals.Count == 0 &&
                decision.DynamicToolInvocations.Count == 0 &&
                !decision.ReviewCommitment &&
                capabilityResultsBySignature.Values.Count == 1 &&
                capabilityResultsBySignature.Values.All(result =>
                    result.CapabilityId == NIRACapabilityIds.ImageSearch &&
                    result.Succeeded &&
                    result.VisualArtifacts.Count(visual => visual.PresentToUser) >= requestedImages))
            {
                completionReviewConfirmedComplete = true;
                NIRADiagnosticTrace.Event("IMAGE-RECEIPT-FASTPATH",
                    $"Run={runId:D} Cycle={cycle} Requested={requestedImages} " +
                    $"Delivered={verifiedImageRetrievalCount} ReviewerCallsSaved=1 " +
                    "Scope=SimpleImageOnlyWithVerifiedPixels");
            }

            // A local, calculator-backed numeric certificate can avoid a third
            // cloud call for a single grounded metric. This does NOT accept a
            // model flag alone: the original registered request, successful
            // read-only capability receipt and exact displayed numeric value
            // must agree. Multi-result/action/uncertain turns keep model review.
            if (userTerminalDraft && !completionReviewConfirmedComplete &&
                capabilityResultsBySignature.Values.Any(result =>
                    result.CapabilityId == NIRACapabilityIds.MathCalculate))
            {
                // Executive narrative is always populated, even by harmless
                // run bookkeeping. It is not an independent action/receipt.
                // Reject when there is ANY noncalculator capability, dynamic
                // tool, commitment, or owned work instead of rejecting merely
                // because the trusted bookkeeping string is nonempty.
                bool otherWork = preReviewCommitmentSucceeded ||
                    !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(dynamicToolEvidence.ToString()) ||
                    capabilityResultsBySignature.Values.Any(result =>
                        result.CapabilityId != NIRACapabilityIds.MathCalculate);
                var numericReview = NIRAVerifiedNumericCompletionPolicy.Evaluate(
                    decision, capabilityRequestsBySignature, capabilityResultsBySignature,
                    hasPendingOwnedTask: GetPendingTaskForEvent(mindEvent) != null,
                    hasOtherWorkOrEvidence: otherWork,
                    priorReviewObjection: taskCompletionReviewCount > 0);
                if (numericReview.Eligible)
                {
                    completionReviewConfirmedComplete = true;
                    NIRADiagnosticTrace.Event("NUMERIC-RECEIPT-FASTPATH",
                        $"Run={runId:D} Cycle={cycle} Verified=OneExactReadOnlyMetric " +
                        "ReviewerCallsSaved=1 Scope=CalculatorExpressionOnly");
                }
                else
                {
                    NIRADiagnosticTrace.Event("NUMERIC-REVIEW-FALLBACK",
                        $"Run={runId:D} Cycle={cycle} Reason={numericReview.Reason}");
                }
            }

            if (userTerminalDraft &&
                !completionReviewConfirmedComplete)
            {
                string? originAppId = mindEvent.Metadata.TryGetValue(
                    "externalAppId", out string? originApp) &&
                    !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(originApp)
                        ? originApp.Trim().ToLowerInvariant()
                        : null;

                // The reviewer needs the *trusted surface boundary*, not
                // hypothetical capabilities suggested by generated text.
                // This is descriptive only; Executive still prevents access.
                string surfaceEvidence = originAppId is null
                    ? "ORIGIN: Main NIRA desktop. Only registered capabilities " +
                      "subject to runtime authorization can perform operations."
                    : $"ORIGIN: Embedded ELVARA app '{originAppId}'. " +
                      $"Only registered elvara.{originAppId}.* capabilities can " +
                      "execute here. System-wide storage, filesystem, shell, " +
                      "process and browser capabilities cannot execute here. " +
                      "Independently available app-scoped subtasks still matter.";

                // Pass the same trusted source receipt that allowed focused
                // synthesis to the independent reviewer. The general result
                // tail may truncate search extracts; this projection cannot
                // grant authority or bypass review.
                string webResearchReviewEvidence =
                    NIRACognitionPromptCompiler.WebResearchReviewEvidence(latestContext);
                if (webResearchReviewEvidence.Length == 0)
                {
                    webResearchReviewEvidence =
                        NIRACognitionPromptCompiler.WebResearchReviewEvidence(
                            capabilityResultsBySignature.Values.ToArray());
                    if (webResearchReviewEvidence.Length > 0)
                        NIRADiagnosticTrace.Event("WEB-RESEARCH-EVIDENCE-REVIEW",
                            $"Run={runId:D} Cycle={cycle} Source=MixedReadOnlyBatch");
                }
                if (webResearchReviewEvidence.Length > 0)
                    NIRADiagnosticTrace.Event("WEB-RESEARCH-EVIDENCE-REVIEW",
                        $"Run={runId:D} Cycle={cycle} SourceChars={webResearchReviewEvidence.Length} " +
                        "Review=Independent");

                // A real web response must not invent unseen citation URLs or
                // claim unsupported precise measurements. This guard is cheap,
                // topic-independent and checks only observable source structure;
                // the independent LLM reviewer continues to judge semantic truth.
                if (webResearchReviewEvidence.Length > 0 &&
                    decision.State == NIRACognitionState.Complete &&
                    decision.EmitReply)
                {
                    string visibleDraft = NIRAPresentationPolicy.ForObjectiveReview(
                        decision.Reply, decision.DisplayBlocks);
                    var grounding = NIRAWebResearchGroundingGate.Check(
                        webResearchReviewEvidence, visibleDraft);
                    NIRADiagnosticTrace.Event("WEB-GROUNDING-PREFLIGHT",
                        $"Run={runId:D} Cycle={cycle} Accepted={grounding.Accepted} " +
                        $"Code={grounding.Code} DraftChars={visibleDraft.Length} " +
                        $"SourceChars={webResearchReviewEvidence.Length} " +
                        $"PriorObjections={taskCompletionReviewCount}");
                    if (!grounding.Accepted)
                    {
                        webGroundingCorrectionCount++;
                        if (webGroundingCorrectionCount < 2)
                        {
                            executiveEvidence.AppendLine();
                            executiveEvidence.AppendLine(
                                "AUTHORITATIVE WEB DRAFT GROUNDING REJECTION: " +
                                grounding.Explanation + " Use the observed source " +
                                "extracts to correct or REMOVE the unsupported " +
                                "numeric claim or unobserved citation. Do not repeat " +
                                "the same ungrounded draft; give a useful partial " +
                                "answer if full verification is impossible.");
                            NIRADiagnosticTrace.Event("WEB-GROUNDING-RECOVERY",
                                $"Run={runId:D} Cycle={cycle} " +
                                $"Reason={grounding.Code} Action=Reconsider " +
                                $"NextCycle={cycle + 1}");
                            continue;
                        }
                        // The numeric check is NOT a reason to erase the user's factual
                        // answer. If the second draft still includes an unsupported
                        // precise claim, fall back to bounded, mechanically attributed
                        // source EXCERPTS, never an unchecked model claim.
                        string? partial = !preReviewCommitmentSucceeded &&
                            !desktopActionNeedsObservation &&
                            NIRAWebResearchReplyPolicy.IsGroundedAnswerShape(decision)
                                ? NIRAWebResearchReplyPolicy.ObservedSourceDigestFromResults(
                                    capabilityResultsBySignature.Values.ToArray())
                                : null;
                        if (partial is not null)
                        {
                            decision = decision with {
                                State = NIRACognitionState.Complete,
                                EmitReply = true, Reply = partial,
                                Speech = string.Empty, ReplyReady = true,
                                DisplayBlocks = Array.Empty<NIRARichBlock>(),
                                DecisionSummary = "Bounded attributable source excerpts after web grounding failure."
                            };
                            // This is *not* an LLM-authored researched claim. The
                            // trust-validated source-only handoff can be delivered
                            // without the same reviewer asking the LLM to rewrite it.
                            completionReviewConfirmedComplete = true;
                        }
                        else
                        {
                            decision = decision with {
                                State = NIRACognitionState.Blocked,
                                EmitReply = true,
                                Reply = "I couldn't verify the exact figures I drafted. " +
                                        "I won't present them as established results.",
                                Speech = string.Empty, ReplyReady = true,
                                DisplayBlocks = Array.Empty<NIRARichBlock>()
                            };
                        }
                        NIRADiagnosticTrace.Event("WEB-GROUNDING-RECOVERY",
                            $"Run={runId:D} Cycle={cycle} " +
                            $"Reason={grounding.Code} Action=SourceAttributedPartial " +
                            $"Available={partial is not null}");
                    }
                }

                // Source-only digest is already mechanically validated: do not
                // ask the semantic reviewer to turn safe excerpts into invented
                // figures, then reject its own replacement again.
                if (!completionReviewConfirmedComplete)
                {
                completionReviewCalls++;
                Debug.WriteLine(
                    $"[ObjectiveGate] REVIEW | Run={runId:D} | Cycle={cycle} | " +
                    $"Surface={(originAppId ?? "desktop")} | " +
                    $"ObservedCapabilities={capabilityResultsBySignature.Count} | " +
                    $"PriorObjections={taskCompletionReviewCount}");

                var reviewRequest = new NIRATaskCompletionReviewRequest(
                            mindEvent.Content,
                            NIRAPresentationPolicy.ForObjectiveReview(decision.Reply, decision.DisplayBlocks),
                            string.Join(Environment.NewLine + Environment.NewLine,
                                surfaceEvidence,
                                executiveEvidence.ToString(),
                                "CAPABILITY RESULTS ARE INDEPENDENT OUTCOMES: " +
                                "if any registered permitted read returned useful data " +
                                "for a requested part, a refusal-only draft cannot " +
                                "satisfy the full request. Explain restricted parts " +
                                "separately while reporting already obtained results.",
                                capabilityEvidence.ToString(),
                                dynamicToolEvidence.ToString()),
                            latestContext?.ConversationContext ?? string.Empty,
                            GetPendingTaskForEvent(mindEvent)?.Objective ?? string.Empty,
                            originAppId,
                            string.Join(Environment.NewLine + Environment.NewLine,
                                "SCOPED RECENT CONVERSATION (historical, not a new action):",
                                latestContext?.ConversationPulseContext ?? string.Empty,
                                "DURABLE MEMORY AVAILABLE TO COGNITION (historical, not live verification):",
                                latestContext?.LongTermMemoryContext ?? string.Empty,
                                "PERSISTED SOCIAL CARRYOVER (context, not proof of a new check):",
                                latestContext?.SocialCarryoverContext ?? string.Empty),
                            decision.State.ToString(),
                            webResearchReviewEvidence);
                NIRATaskCompletionReview? taskReview =
                    await _taskCompletionReview.ReviewAsync(reviewRequest, cancellationToken);
                // Recheck ONLY an unavailable verdict following real web evidence.
                // Normally this uses no extra calls. Preserve the independent
                // review contract: a missing verdict never certifies draft facts.
                if (taskReview is null && webResearchReviewEvidence.Length > 0)
                {
                    NIRADiagnosticTrace.Event("OBJECTIVE-REVIEW-RECOVERY",
                        $"Run={runId:D} Cycle={cycle} Stage=RetryUnavailable " +
                        "SourceEvidence=True");
                    completionReviewCalls++;
                    taskReview = await _taskCompletionReview.ReviewAsync(
                        reviewRequest, cancellationToken);
                }

                // Audit the review outcome without writing private prompt,
                // user text or model-authored objection into the log.
                NIRADiagnosticTrace.Event("OBJECTIVE-REVIEW-RESULT",
                    $"Run={runId:D} Cycle={cycle} " +
                    $"Verdict={taskReview?.Verdict ?? "Unavailable"} " +
                    $"Reconsideration={taskReview?.NeedsReconsideration == true}");

                if (NIRAProductionContinuityPolicy.AcceptsObjectiveReview(
                        decision, taskReview))
                {
                    completionReviewConfirmedComplete = true;
                    acceptedNeedUserResumesPriorObjective =
                        decision.State == NIRACognitionState.NeedUser &&
                        taskReview!.ResumesPriorObjective;
                    Debug.WriteLine(
                        $"[ObjectiveGate] ACCEPT | Run={runId:D} | Cycle={cycle} | " +
                        $"Outcome={taskReview!.Verdict} | " +
                        $"ResumesPriorObjective={acceptedNeedUserResumesPriorObjective}");
                }
                else if (taskReview is null)
                {
                    // A failed reviewer must not silently certify a factual
                    // draft. However, we can present URLs from a trusted,
                    // successful read-only source receipt as an explicitly
                    // UNREVIEWED partial handoff. Do not do this for actions,
                    // commitments, unsafe outcomes or unverified tool output.
                    string? sourceHandoff = !preReviewCommitmentSucceeded &&
                        decision.State == NIRACognitionState.Complete &&
                        !decision.ReviewCommitment &&
                        !desktopActionNeedsObservation &&
                        decision.CapabilityRequests.Count == 0 &&
                        decision.ControlRequests.Count == 0 &&
                        decision.GoalProposals.Count == 0 &&
                        decision.BranchProposals.Count == 0 &&
                        decision.BranchWorkProposals.Count == 0 &&
                        decision.DynamicToolProposals.Count == 0 &&
                        decision.DynamicToolInvocations.Count == 0 &&
                        capabilityResultsBySignature.Values.All(r => r.Risk == NIRACapabilityRisk.Observe) &&
                        webResearchReviewEvidence.Length > 0
                        ? NIRAWebResearchReplyPolicy.ObservedSourceHandoff(
                            capabilityResultsBySignature.Values.ToArray())
                        : null;
                    NIRADiagnosticTrace.Event("OBJECTIVE-REVIEW-RECOVERY",
                        $"Run={runId:D} Cycle={cycle} Stage=Terminal " +
                        $"ObservedSourceHandoff={sourceHandoff is not null}");
                    Debug.WriteLine(
                        $"[ObjectiveGate] UNAVAILABLE | Run={runId:D} | Cycle={cycle}");
                    decision = decision with
                    {
                        State = NIRACognitionState.Blocked,
                        EmitReply = true,
                        Reply = sourceHandoff ?? (preReviewCommitmentSucceeded
                            ? "I saved the future commitment, but couldn't verify " +
                              "the rest of my answer right now."
                            : "I couldn't verify my answer to that request just " +
                              "now, so I won't pretend it's completed. " +
                              "Please try again."),
                        Speech = string.Empty,
                        ReplyReady = true,
                        CharacterReady = true,
                        DecisionSummary = "Independent objective check unavailable; " +
                            (sourceHandoff is null ? "no source-only fallback" : "observed URLs only")
                    };
                }
                else
                {
                    taskCompletionReviewCount++;
                    Debug.WriteLine(
                        $"[ObjectiveGate] REJECT | Run={runId:D} | Cycle={cycle} | " +
                        $"Verdict={taskReview.Verdict} | " +
                        $"Objection={taskCompletionReviewCount} | " +
                        $"Gap={TrimLog(taskReview.Gap)}");

                    if (taskCompletionReviewCount < 3)
                    {
                        executiveEvidence.AppendLine();
                        executiveEvidence.AppendLine(
                            "INDEPENDENT OBJECTIVE-FIDELITY CORRECTION (model " +
                            "assessment only; NOT world evidence or action permission):");
                        executiveEvidence.AppendLine(
                            "THE PREVIOUS FINAL DRAFT WAS REJECTED. You MUST answer " +
                            "the ORIGINAL CURRENT USER REQUEST, NOT an earlier " +
                            "greeting or previous conversation topic.");
                        executiveEvidence.AppendLine($"OriginalRequest: {mindEvent.Content}");
                        executiveEvidence.AppendLine($"MissingOrWrong: {taskReview.Gap}");
                        executiveEvidence.AppendLine($"CorrectionNeeded: {taskReview.NextStep}");
                        executiveEvidence.AppendLine(surfaceEvidence);
                        bool retrospectiveCorrection =
                            string.Equals(taskReview.TemporalMode, "Retrospective",
                                StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
                        executiveEvidence.AppendLine(
                            retrospectiveCorrection
                                ? "RETROSPECTIVE CORRECTION: The user asked about PAST " +
                                  "events, not for fresh measurements. Use only the " +
                                  "actual scoped conversation, grounded social history, " +
                                  "and durable memory. Drop unsupported numbers/details, " +
                                  "and say " +
                                  "what cannot be remembered precisely. Do NOT request " +
                                  "new live capabilities just to manufacture evidence " +
                                  "for a past observation. Never present current readings " +
                                  "as if they were historical records."
                                : "Preserve verified independent outcomes. If current " +
                                  "data is needed, request a permitted registered " +
                                  "capability; if sufficient evidence is already " +
                                  "available, ANSWER NOW and cover all requested parts. " +
                                  "If a part is unavailable, explain exactly that part " +
                                  "while completing the others. Do not merely greet " +
