```csharp
/*
 * filename: ParticleMorphEngine.cs
 */

using System.Numerics;

using NIRAAgent.Embodiment;

namespace NIRAAgent.UI.Companion.Particles;

public sealed class ParticleMorphEngine
{
    // =========================================================
    // STATE
    // =========================================================

    private readonly ParticleRuntimeState[]
        _particles;


    private readonly ParticleTarget[]
        _targets;


    private readonly ParticleFormRegistry
        _forms;


    // =========================================================
    // INTENT
    // =========================================================

    private NIRAVisualIntent
        _intent =
            NIRAVisualIntent.RestingOrb;


    // =========================================================
    // PROVIDER
    // =========================================================

    private IParticleFormProvider
        _provider;


    // =========================================================
    // TIME
    // =========================================================

    private double
        _time;


    // =========================================================
    // STARTUP MATERIALIZATION
    // =========================================================

    // =========================================================
    // CINEMATIC STARTUP
    //
    // 1. distant dust wakes from darkness
    // 2. particles spiral through the local volume
    // 3. the living blob collapses into its real body
    // 4. NIRA resolves and the body gives one soft pulse
    // =========================================================

    private const double StartupEntranceDurationSeconds =
        3.20;


    private bool
        _startupEntrancePrepared;


    private bool
        _startupEntranceActive;


    private double
        _startupEntranceElapsed;


    private float
        _startupVisibility =
            1.0f;


    private float
        _startupCorePulse;


    // =========================================================
    // OUTPUT
    // =========================================================

    public int Count =>
        _particles.Length;


    // =========================================================
    // CONSTRUCTOR
    // =========================================================

    public ParticleMorphEngine(
        int particleCount,
        ParticleFormRegistry forms)
    {
        if (particleCount <=
            0)
        {
            throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(
                nameof(particleCount));
        }


        _forms =
            forms
            ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(
                nameof(forms));


        _particles =
            new ParticleRuntimeState[
                particleCount];


        _targets =
            new ParticleTarget[
                particleCount];


        _provider =
            _forms.Resolve(
                _intent);


        InitializeParticles();
    }


    // =========================================================
    // INTENT
    // =========================================================

    public void SetIntent(
        NIRAVisualIntent intent)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(
            intent);


        _intent =
            intent.Normalize();


        _provider =
            _forms.Resolve(
                _intent);


        RebuildTargets();
    }


    // =========================================================
    // PREPARE STARTUP ENTRANCE
    //
    // Particles are moved into a dispersed orbital field before
    // the first visible frame. The actual entrance begins only
    // when StartStartupEntrance is called by CompanionWindow.
    // =========================================================

    public void PrepareStartupEntrance()
    {
        RebuildTargets();


        _startupEntrancePrepared =
            true;


        _startupEntranceActive =
            false;


        _startupEntranceElapsed =
            0.0;


        _startupVisibility =
            0.0f;


        _startupCorePulse =
            0.0f;


        for (
            int index = 0;
            index < _particles.Length;
            index++)
        {
            ParticleRuntimeState particle =
                _particles[index];


            ParticleTarget target =
                _targets[index];


            float seed =
                (
                    particle.ColorSeed %
                    997
                )
                /
                997.0f;


            float angle =
                particle.Phase *
                    1.73f
                +
                seed *
                    9.4f;


            float vertical =
                -0.82f
                +
                seed *
                    1.64f;


            float horizontal =
                MathF.Sqrt(
                    MathF.Max(
                        0.04f,
                        1.0f -
                        vertical *
                            vertical));


            Vector3 direction =
                new(
                    MathF.Cos(
                        angle)
                    *
                    horizontal,

                    vertical,

                    MathF.Sin(
                        angle)
                    *
                    horizontal);


            if (direction.LengthSquared() >
                0.0001f)
            {
                direction =
                    Vector3.Normalize(
                        direction);
            }


            float organicSpread =
                0.62f
                +
                seed *
                    1.46f
                +
                MathF.Sin(
                    angle *
                        2.31f
                    +
                    particle.Phase)
                *
                0.13f;


            particle.Position =
                direction *
                organicSpread;


            Vector3 tangent =
                new(
                    -direction.Z,

                    MathF.Sin(
                        angle *
                            1.7f)
                    *
                    0.18f,

                    direction.X);


            if (tangent.LengthSquared() >
                0.0001f)
            {
                tangent =
                    Vector3.Normalize(
                        tangent);
            }


            particle.Velocity =
                tangent *
                (
                    0.72f
                    +
                    seed *
                        0.92f
                )
                -
                direction *
                (
                    0.08f
                    +
                    seed *
                        0.10f
                );


            particle.Size =
                target.Size *
                0.10f;


            particle.Brightness =
                target.Brightness *
                0.018f;


            particle.Role =
                target.Role;


            particle.Palette =
                target.Palette;


            _particles[index] =
                particle;
        }
    }


    // =========================================================
    // START STARTUP ENTRANCE
    // =========================================================

    public void StartStartupEntrance()
    {
        if (!_startupEntrancePrepared)
        {
            PrepareStartupEntrance();
        }


        _startupEntrancePrepared =
            false;


        _startupEntranceActive =
            true;


        _startupEntranceElapsed =
            0.0;
    }


    // =========================================================
    // UPDATE
    // =========================================================

    public void Update(
        double deltaSeconds)
    {
        deltaSeconds =
            Math.Clamp(
                deltaSeconds,
                0.001,
                0.05);


        _time +=
            deltaSeconds;


        if (
            _startupEntrancePrepared
            &&
            !_startupEntranceActive)
        {
            return;
        }


        UpdateStartupEntrance(
            deltaSeconds);


        _provider.BuildTargets(
            _targets,
            _intent,
            _time);


        float delta =
            (float)deltaSeconds;


        float cohesion =
            (float)_intent.Cohesion;


        float energy =
            (float)_intent.Energy;


        float tension =
            (float)_intent.Tension;


        float flow =
            (float)_intent.Flow;


        float focus =
            (float)_intent.Focus;


        // =====================================================
        // TARGET CONTROL
        //
        // Focus and cohesion tighten NIRA's body.
        // Tension slightly increases responsiveness without
        // turning the orb into uncontrolled noise.
        // =====================================================

        float stiffness =
            10.5f
            +
            cohesion *
                18.5f
            +
            focus *
                7.0f
            +
            tension *
                3.0f;


        float damping =
            5.8f
            +
            cohesion *
                4.3f
            +
            focus *
                2.2f;


        float entranceProgress =
            ResolveStartupEntranceProgress();


        float entranceControl =
            SmoothStep01(
                entranceProgress);


        if (_startupEntranceActive)
        {
            float formation =
                SmoothStep01(
                    Math.Clamp(
                        (
                            entranceProgress -
                            0.18f
                        )
                        /
                        0.66f,
                        0.0f,
                        1.0f));


            stiffness *=
                0.10f
                +
                formation *
                    0.90f;


            damping *=
                0.24f
                +
                formation *
                    0.76f;
        }


        // =====================================================
        // FREE SWARM LIFE
        //
        // This is intentionally microscopic.
        //
        // The form provider owns meaningful motion such as
        // breathing, circulation and tension ripples.
        //
        // This layer only prevents perfect mechanical movement.
        // =====================================================

        float driftAmplitude =
            (
                0.008f
                +
                energy *
                    0.018f
                +
                flow *
                    0.010f
                +
                tension *
                    0.006f
            )
            *
            (
                1.0f -
                cohesion *
                    0.50f
            )
            *
            (
                1.0f -
                focus *
                    0.68f
            );


        float driftSpeed =
            0.48f
            +
            energy *
                0.48f
            +
            flow *
                0.30f;


        float sizeSpeed =
            8.5f
            +
            focus *
                4.0f;


        float brightnessSpeed =
            7.0f
            +
            energy *
                3.5f;


        for (
            int index = 0;
            index < _particles.Length;
            index++)
        {
            ParticleRuntimeState particle =
                _particles[index];


            ParticleTarget target =
                _targets[index];


            Vector3 displacement =
                target.Position -
                particle.Position;


            Vector3 acceleration =
                displacement *
                    stiffness
                -
                particle.Velocity *
                    damping;


            float phase =
                particle.Phase;


            Vector3 drift =
                new(
                    MathF.Sin(
                        (float)_time *
                            0.73f *
                            driftSpeed
                        +
                        phase),

                    MathF.Cos(
                        (float)_time *
                            0.57f *
                            driftSpeed
                        +
                        phase *
                            1.31f),

                    MathF.Sin(
                        (float)_time *
                            0.49f *
                            driftSpeed
                        +
                        phase *
                            1.77f));


            acceleration +=
                drift *
                driftAmplitude;


            // =================================================
            // CINEMATIC STARTUP MATERIALIZATION
            // =================================================

            if (_startupEntranceActive)
            {
                float p =
                    entranceProgress;


                float swirl =
                    1.0f -
                    SmoothStep01(
                        Math.Clamp(
                            (
                                p -
                                0.48f
                            )
                            /
                            0.34f,
                            0.0f,
                            1.0f));


                float collapse =
                    SmoothStep01(
                        Math.Clamp(
                            (
                                p -
                                0.18f
                            )
                            /
                            0.58f,
                            0.0f,
                            1.0f));


                Vector3 radial =
                    particle.Position;


                if (radial.LengthSquared() >
                    0.0001f)
                {
                    radial =
                        Vector3.Normalize(
                            radial);
                }


                Vector3 tangent =
                    new(
                        -particle.Position.Z,

                        MathF.Sin(
                            phase +
                            (float)_time *
                                2.25f)
                        *
                        0.20f,

                        particle.Position.X);


                if (tangent.LengthSquared() >
                    0.0001f)
                {
                    tangent =
                        Vector3.Normalize(
                            tangent);
                }


                acceleration +=
                    tangent *
                    (
                        4.35f *
                        swirl *
                        swirl
                    );


                acceleration -=
                    radial *
                    (
                        1.20f *
                        swirl
                        +
                        1.55f *
                        collapse
                    );


                acceleration.Y +=
                    MathF.Sin(
                        phase *
                            1.37f
                        +
                        (float)_time *
                            3.0f)
                    *
                    0.46f
                    *
                    swirl;
            }


            particle.Velocity +=
                acceleration *
                delta;


            particle.Position +=
                particle.Velocity *
                delta;


            particle.Size =
                Smooth(
                    particle.Size,
                    target.Size,
                    delta,
                    sizeSpeed);


            particle.Brightness =
                Smooth(
                    particle.Brightness,
                    target.Brightness,
                    delta,
                    brightnessSpeed);


            particle.Role =
                target.Role;


            particle.Palette =
                target.Palette;


            _particles[index] =
                particle;
        }
    }


    // =========================================================
    // READ
    // =========================================================

    public ParticleRenderState Get(
        int index)
    {
        if (
            index <
                0
            ||
            index >=
                _particles.Length)
        {
            throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(
                nameof(index));
        }


        ParticleRuntimeState particle =
            _particles[index];


        float pulseInfluence =
            particle.Role switch
            {
                ParticleRole.Core =>
                    1.00f,

                ParticleRole.Accent =>
                    0.82f,

                ParticleRole.Surface =>
                    0.28f,

                ParticleRole.Halo =>
                    0.16f,

                _ =>
                    0.20f
            };


        float startupReveal =
            _startupVisibility;


        if (_startupEntranceActive)
        {
            float progress =
                ResolveStartupEntranceProgress();


            float seed =
                (
                    Math.Abs(
                        particle.ColorSeed)
                    %
                    997
                )
                /
                997.0f;


            float roleDelay =
                particle.Role switch
                {
                    ParticleRole.Halo =>
                        0.00f,

                    ParticleRole.Surface =>
                        0.025f,

                    ParticleRole.Core =>
                        0.10f,

                    ParticleRole.Accent =>
                        0.15f,

                    _ =>
                        0.04f
                };


            float stagger =
                seed *
                0.13f;


            float localReveal =
                SmoothStep01(
                    Math.Clamp(
                        (
                            progress -
                            roleDelay -
                            stagger
                        )
                        /
                        0.32f,
                        0.0f,
                        1.0f));


            startupReveal *=
                localReveal;
        }


        float size =
            particle.Size
            *
            (
                0.20f
                +
                startupReveal *
                    0.80f
            )
            *
            (
                1.0f
                +
                _startupCorePulse *
                    pulseInfluence *
                    0.18f
            );


        float brightness =
            particle.Brightness
            *
            startupReveal
            *
            (
                1.0f
                +
                _startupCorePulse *
                    pulseInfluence *
                    1.35f
            );


        return new ParticleRenderState(
            particle.Position,
            size,
            brightness,
            particle.Role,
            particle.Palette,
            particle.ColorSeed);
    }


    // =========================================================
    // INITIALIZE
    // =========================================================

    private void InitializeParticles()
    {
        Random random =
            new(
                731927);


        _provider.BuildTargets(
            _targets,
            _intent,
            0.0);


        for (
            int index = 0;
            index < _particles.Length;
            index++)
        {
            ParticleTarget target =
                _targets[index];


            Vector3 offset =
                new(
                    (float)(
                        random.NextDouble() *
                            0.20
                        -
                        0.10),

                    (float)(
                        random.NextDouble() *
                            0.20
                        -
                        0.10),

                    (float)(
                        random.NextDouble() *
                            0.20
                        -
                        0.10));


            _particles[index] =
                new ParticleRuntimeState
                {
                    Position =
                        target.Position +
                        offset,

                    Velocity =
                        Vector3.Zero,

                    Size =
                        target.Size,

                    Brightness =
                        target.Brightness,

                    Role =
                        target.Role,

                    Palette =
                        target.Palette,

                    Phase =
                        (float)(
                            random.NextDouble() *
                            Math.PI *
                            2.0),

                    ColorSeed =
                        random.Next(
                            0,
                            1000)
                };
        }
    }


    // =========================================================
    // REBUILD
    // =========================================================

    private void RebuildTargets()
    {
        _provider.BuildTargets(
            _targets,
            _intent,
            _time);
    }


    // =========================================================
    // UPDATE STARTUP ENTRANCE
    // =========================================================

    private void UpdateStartupEntrance(
        double deltaSeconds)
    {
        if (!_startupEntranceActive)
        {
            return;
        }


        _startupEntranceElapsed +=
            deltaSeconds;


        double progress =
            Math.Clamp(
                _startupEntranceElapsed /
                    StartupEntranceDurationSeconds,
                0.0,
                1.0);


        double reveal =
            Math.Clamp(
                (
                    progress -
                    0.01
                )
                /
                0.47,
                0.0,
                1.0);


        _startupVisibility =
            SmoothStep01(
                (float)reveal);


        double ignitionPosition =
            (
                progress -
                0.20
            )
            /
            0.075;


        double lockPosition =
            (
                progress -
                0.82
            )
            /
            0.060;


        double settlePosition =
            (
                progress -
                0.94
            )
            /
            0.045;


        double ignitionPulse =
            Math.Exp(
                -ignitionPosition *
                ignitionPosition)
            *
            0.16;


        double lockPulse =
            Math.Exp(
                -lockPosition *
                lockPosition)
            *
            0.62;


        double settlePulse =
            Math.Exp(
                -settlePosition *
                settlePosition)
            *
            0.12;


        _startupCorePulse =
            (float)(
                ignitionPulse +
                lockPulse +
                settlePulse);


        if (progress <
            1.0)
        {
            return;
        }


        _startupEntranceActive =
            false;


        _startupVisibility =
            1.0f;


        _startupCorePulse =
            0.0f;
    }


    // =========================================================
    // STARTUP PROGRESS
    // =========================================================

    private float ResolveStartupEntranceProgress()
    {
        if (_startupEntrancePrepared)
        {
            return 0.0f;
        }


        if (!_startupEntranceActive)
        {
            return 1.0f;
        }


        return (float)Math.Clamp(
            _startupEntranceElapsed /
                StartupEntranceDurationSeconds,
            0.0,
            1.0);
    }


    // =========================================================
    // SMOOTH STEP
    // =========================================================

    private static float SmoothStep01(
        float value)
    {
        value =
            Math.Clamp(
                value,
                0.0f,
                1.0f);


        return
            value *
            value *
            (
                3.0f -
                2.0f *
                value
            );
    }


    // =========================================================
    // SMOOTH
    // =========================================================

    private static float Smooth(
        float current,
        float target,
        float deltaSeconds,
        float speed)
    {
        float amount =
            1.0f -
            MathF.Exp(
                -deltaSeconds *
                speed);


        return
            current +
            (
                target -
                current
            )
            *
            amount;
    }


    // =========================================================
    // INTERNAL PARTICLE
    // =========================================================

    private struct ParticleRuntimeState
    {
        public Vector3 Position;

        public Vector3 Velocity;

        public float Size;

        public float Brightness;

        public ParticleRole Role;

        public ParticlePalette Palette;

        public float Phase;

        public int ColorSeed;
    }
}


// =============================================================
// RENDER STATE
// =============================================================

public readonly record struct ParticleRenderState(
    Vector3 Position,
    float Size,
    float Brightness,
    ParticleRole Role,
    ParticlePalette Palette,
    int ColorSeed);
```

**File:** `NIRAAgent.UI\CredentialPromptWindow.xaml.cs`

```csharp
using System.Windows;

using NIRAAgent.Authorization;

namespace NIRAAgent.UI;

public partial class CredentialPromptWindow : Window
{
    private readonly NIRACredentialPromptRequest _request;

    public NIRACredentialPromptResponse? Resolution { get; private set; }

    public CredentialPromptWindow(NIRACredentialPromptRequest request)
    {
        InitializeComponent();

        _request = request ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(request));

        OriginText.Text = $"Website: {_request.Origin}";
        ReasonText.Text = string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(_request.Reason)
            ? "NIRA reached an authenticated step that requires an account credential."
            : _request.Reason;

        ExistingCredentialCombo.ItemsSource = _request.ExistingCredentials;
        ExistingCredentialCombo.SelectedItem =
            ResolvePreferredStoredCredential();

        UseStoredButton.IsEnabled =
            !_request.ForceReplacement && _request.ExistingCredentials.Count > 0;
        if (_request.ForceReplacement)
        {
            ReasonText.Text = "The last saved credential was not accepted. Enter the corrected login below and choose Save & use to replace it for future requests. The existing secret will not be tried again.";
            UseStoredButton.Content = "Previous saved login unavailable";
        }

        NIRACredentialMetadata? preferred = ResolvePreferredStoredCredential();
        AccountLabelBox.Text = !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(_request.RequestedAccountLabel)
            ? _request.RequestedAccountLabel
            : _request.ForceReplacement ? preferred?.AccountLabel ?? string.Empty : string.Empty;
        if (_request.ForceReplacement && preferred != null)
            UsernameBox.Text = preferred.Username;
    }

    private NIRACredentialMetadata? ResolvePreferredStoredCredential()
    {
        if (_request.ExistingCredentials.Count == 0)
        {
            return null;
        }

        if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(_request.RequestedAccountLabel))
        {
            NIRACredentialMetadata? exact =
                _request.ExistingCredentials.FirstOrDefault(
                    value =>
                        string.Equals(
                            value.AccountLabel,
                            _request.RequestedAccountLabel,
                            StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase));

            if (exact != null)
            {
                return exact;
            }
        }

        return _request.ExistingCredentials[0];
    }

    private void UseStored_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
    {
        if (_request.ForceReplacement) return;
        if (ExistingCredentialCombo.SelectedItem is not NIRACredentialMetadata selected)
        {
            MessageBox.Show(
                this,
                "Choose a saved login first.",
                "NIRA Secure Login",
                MessageBoxButton.OK,
                MessageBoxImage.Information);
            return;
        }

        Resolution = new NIRACredentialPromptResponse
        {
            Choice = NIRACredentialPromptChoice.UseStored,
            CredentialId = selected.Id
        };

        DialogResult = true;
        Close();
    }

    private void UseOnce_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
    {
        if (!TryReadNewCredential(out string label, out string username, out string secret))
        {
            return;
        }

        Resolution = new NIRACredentialPromptResponse
        {
            Choice = NIRACredentialPromptChoice.UseOnce,
            AccountLabel = label,
            Username = username,
            Secret = secret
        };

        DialogResult = true;
        Close();
    }

    private void SaveAndUse_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
    {
        if (!TryReadNewCredential(out string label, out string username, out string secret))
        {
            return;
        }

        Resolution = new NIRACredentialPromptResponse
        {
            Choice = NIRACredentialPromptChoice.SaveAndUse,
            AccountLabel = label,
            Username = username,
            Secret = secret
        };

        DialogResult = true;
        Close();
    }

    private bool TryReadNewCredential(
        out string label,
        out string username,
        out string secret)
    {
        label = AccountLabelBox.Text.Trim();
        username = UsernameBox.Text.Trim();
        secret = SecretBox.Password;

        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(username) &&
            string.IsNullOrEmpty(secret))
        {
            MessageBox.Show(
                this,
                "Enter the account username/email and password/secret, or choose a saved login.",
                "NIRA Secure Login",
                MessageBoxButton.OK,
                MessageBoxImage.Information);
            return false;
        }

        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(label))
        {
            label = string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(username)
                ? "default"
                : username;
        }

        return true;
    }

    private void Cancel_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
    {
        Resolution = new NIRACredentialPromptResponse
        {
            Choice = NIRACredentialPromptChoice.Cancel
        };

        DialogResult = false;
        Close();
    }
}
```

```xml
                    <DockPanel LastChildFill="True">
                        <StackPanel DockPanel.Dock="Left">
                            <TextBlock x:Name="SectionTitle" Text="Uploaded images" FontSize="23" FontWeight="SemiBold"/>
                            <TextBlock x:Name="SectionSummary" Text="Images you share with NIRA" FontSize="11" Margin="0,5,0,0"
                                       Foreground="{DynamicResource NIRASecondaryBrush}"/>
                        </StackPanel>
                        <StackPanel Orientation="Horizontal" HorizontalAlignment="Right">
                            <Button x:Name="AddButton" Content="+ Add photos" Style="{StaticResource GalleryActionStyle}"
                                    Margin="0,0,8,0" Click="Add_Click"/>
                            <Button Content="⟳ Refresh" Style="{StaticResource GalleryActionStyle}" Click="Refresh_Click"/>
                        </StackPanel>
                    </DockPanel>
                    <TextBlock Text="GALLERY FOLDER" FontSize="9.5" FontWeight="SemiBold" Margin="0,22,0,7"
                               Foreground="{DynamicResource NIRACyanBrush}"/>
                    <Grid>
                        <Grid.ColumnDefinitions><ColumnDefinition Width="*"/><ColumnDefinition Width="Auto"/><ColumnDefinition Width="Auto"/></Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                        <Border Grid.Column="0" BorderThickness="1" CornerRadius="10" Padding="11,9" MinHeight="39"
                                Background="{DynamicResource NIRAChipBrush}" BorderBrush="{DynamicResource NIRAGlassBorderBrush}">
                            <TextBlock x:Name="StoragePathText" FontSize="11.5" TextTrimming="CharacterEllipsis"/>
                        </Border>
                        <Button Grid.Column="1" Content="Change folder" Margin="8,0,0,0"
                                Style="{StaticResource GalleryActionStyle}" Click="ChangeFolder_Click"/>
                        <Button Grid.Column="2" Content="Open" Margin="8,0,0,0"
                                Style="{StaticResource GalleryActionStyle}" Click="OpenFolder_Click"/>
                    </Grid>
                </StackPanel>
                <Grid Grid.Row="1" Margin="0,16,0,12">
                    <Grid.ColumnDefinitions><ColumnDefinition Width="*"/><ColumnDefinition Width="Auto"/></Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                    <TextBlock x:Name="StatusText" Text="Ready" FontSize="11" TextWrapping="Wrap"
                               Foreground="{DynamicResource NIRASecondaryBrush}"/>
                    <TextBlock x:Name="CountText" Grid.Column="1" Text="0 photos" FontSize="11"
                               Foreground="{DynamicResource NIRACyanBrush}"/>
                </Grid>
                <Grid Grid.Row="2">
                    <ScrollViewer x:Name="GalleryScrollViewer" VerticalScrollBarVisibility="Auto"
                                  HorizontalScrollBarVisibility="Disabled" CanContentScroll="False">
                        <ItemsControl x:Name="ImageTiles" ItemsSource="{Binding Tiles}"
                                      HorizontalAlignment="Stretch">
                            <!-- Responsive masonry: each column scales to available space;
                                 every photo determines its OWN height from its aspect ratio. -->
                            <ItemsControl.ItemsPanel>
                                <ItemsPanelTemplate>
                                    <gallery:NIRAMasonryPanel PreferredColumnWidth="235"
                                                             ColumnSpacing="14" RowSpacing="15"/>
                                </ItemsPanelTemplate>
                            </ItemsControl.ItemsPanel>
                            <ItemsControl.ItemContainerStyle>
                                <Style TargetType="ContentPresenter">
                                    <Setter Property="HorizontalAlignment" Value="Stretch"/>
                                </Style>
                            </ItemsControl.ItemContainerStyle>
                            <ItemsControl.ItemTemplate>
                                <DataTemplate>
                                    <Button Tag="{Binding}" Click="Image_Click" ToolTip="Open full image"
                                            Style="{StaticResource GalleryPhotoButtonStyle}">
                                        <StackPanel>
                                            <!-- No fixed width, no fixed image height and no cropping. -->
                                            <Image Source="{Binding Preview}" Stretch="Uniform"
                                                   HorizontalAlignment="Stretch"
                                                   RenderOptions.BitmapScalingMode="HighQuality"/>
                                            <StackPanel Margin="12,10,12,12">
                                                <TextBlock Text="{Binding Title}" FontSize="12" FontWeight="SemiBold"
                                                           TextWrapping="Wrap"/>
                                                <TextBlock Text="{Binding Credit}" FontSize="10.5" Margin="0,5,0,0"
                                                           TextWrapping="Wrap"
                                                           Foreground="{DynamicResource NIRASecondaryBrush}"/>
                                            </StackPanel>
                                        </StackPanel>
                                    </Button>
                                </DataTemplate>
                            </ItemsControl.ItemTemplate>
                        </ItemsControl>
                    </ScrollViewer>
                    <StackPanel x:Name="EmptyState" Visibility="Collapsed" HorizontalAlignment="Center" VerticalAlignment="Center"
                                MaxWidth="410">
                        <TextBlock Text="✧" FontSize="40" Foreground="{DynamicResource NIRABlueBrush}" HorizontalAlignment="Center"/>
                        <TextBlock x:Name="EmptyTitle" Text="No images yet" Margin="0,12,0,0" FontSize="19"
                                   HorizontalAlignment="Center" FontWeight="SemiBold"/>
                        <TextBlock x:Name="EmptyDescription" Text="Images will appear here as they are added."
                                   Margin="0,9,0,0" TextWrapping="Wrap" TextAlignment="Center" FontSize="11.5"
                                   Foreground="{DynamicResource NIRASecondaryBrush}"/>
                    </StackPanel>
                </Grid>
            </Grid>
        </Border>
    </Grid>
</UserControl>
```

```csharp
using System.IO;
using System.Collections.ObjectModel;
using System.Diagnostics;
using System.Windows;
using System.Windows.Controls;
using System.Windows.Media;
using NIRAAgent.Artifacts;
using NIRAAgent.Gallery;
using NIRAAgent.UI.ViewModels;
using NIRAAgent.UI.Visuals;
using Microsoft.Win32;

namespace NIRAAgent.UI.Gallery;

public partial class NIRAGalleryPage : UserControl
{
    private NIRAGalleryLibraryService? _library;
    private NIRAGalleryCategory _category = NIRAGalleryCategory.Uploaded;
    public ObservableCollection<NIRAGalleryTile> Tiles { get; } = new();
    public NIRAGalleryPage()
    {
        InitializeComponent();
        DataContext = this;
    }

    public void Initialize(NIRAGalleryLibraryService library)
    {
        _library = library;
        RefreshGallery();
    }

    public void RefreshGallery()
    {
        if (_library == null) return;
        StoragePathText.Text = _library.RootFolder;
        Tiles.Clear();
        var all = _library.Items.Where(x => x.Category == _category).ToArray();
        int previewPixels = all.Length > 72 ? 520 : all.Length > 12 ? 720 : 1200;
        foreach (var item in all.Take(240))
        {
            string path = _library.ResolvePath(item);
            if (File.Exists(path)) Tiles.Add(new NIRAGalleryTile(item, path, previewPixels));
        }
        CountText.Text = $"{all.Length} photo{(all.Length == 1 ? "" : "s")}";
        StatusText.Text = all.Length > 240 ? "Showing 240 newest images. Older files remain safely stored." : "Local library • Images kept on your PC";
        EmptyState.Visibility = Tiles.Count == 0 ? Visibility.Visible : Visibility.Collapsed;
        EmptyTitle.Text = _category == NIRAGalleryCategory.AiGenerated ? "AI image generation is not connected yet" : "No images yet";
        EmptyDescription.Text = _category switch
        {
            NIRAGalleryCategory.Uploaded => "Photos you send to NIRA are copied here automatically. You can also add photos yourself.",
            NIRAGalleryCategory.WebFound => "Verified web images NIRA retrieves will appear here with their original source.",
            _ => "This section is ready for NIRA's future image-generation capability. No invented or placeholder pictures."
        };
        AddButton.Visibility = _category == NIRAGalleryCategory.Uploaded ? Visibility.Visible : Visibility.Collapsed;
    }

    private void SetCategory(NIRAGalleryCategory category)
    {
        _category = category;
        UploadedButton.Tag = category == NIRAGalleryCategory.Uploaded ? "ACTIVE" : null;
        WebButton.Tag = category == NIRAGalleryCategory.WebFound ? "ACTIVE" : null;
        GeneratedButton.Tag = category == NIRAGalleryCategory.AiGenerated ? "ACTIVE" : null;
        SectionTitle.Text = category switch
        {
            NIRAGalleryCategory.Uploaded => "Uploaded images",
            NIRAGalleryCategory.WebFound => "Found on the web",
            _ => "AI generated images"
        };
        SectionSummary.Text = category switch
        {
            NIRAGalleryCategory.Uploaded => "Images you share with NIRA",
            NIRAGalleryCategory.WebFound => "Verified pictures NIRA has discovered",
            _ => "Images NIRA creates in the future"
        };
        RefreshGallery();
        GalleryScrollViewer.ScrollToTop();
    }
    private void Uploaded_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e) => SetCategory(NIRAGalleryCategory.Uploaded);
    private void Web_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e) => SetCategory(NIRAGalleryCategory.WebFound);
    private void Generated_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e) => SetCategory(NIRAGalleryCategory.AiGenerated);
    private void Refresh_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e) => RefreshGallery();

    private async void Add_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
    {
        if (_library == null) return;
        OpenFileDialog dialog = new()
        {
            Title = "Add photos to NIRA Gallery", Multiselect = true,
            Filter = "Pictures|*.jpg;*.jpeg;*.png;*.gif;*.bmp"
        };
        if (dialog.ShowDialog(Window.GetWindow(this)) != true) return;
        AddButton.IsEnabled = false;
        try
        {
            int count = await Task.Run(() => dialog.FileNames.Count(path =>
                _library.Import(path, NIRAGalleryCategory.Uploaded) != null));
            RefreshGallery();
            StatusText.Text = $"{count} image(s) added or already in the library.";
        }
        catch (Exception ex) { MessageBox.Show(Window.GetWindow(this), ex.Message, "Gallery import", MessageBoxButton.OK, MessageBoxImage.Warning); }
        finally { AddButton.IsEnabled = true; }
    }

    private async void ChangeFolder_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
    {
        if (_library == null) return;
        OpenFolderDialog dialog = new()
        {
            Title = "Choose an empty folder for NIRA Gallery",
            Multiselect = false
        };
        if (dialog.ShowDialog(Window.GetWindow(this)) != true) return;
        string target = dialog.FolderName;
        var confirmation = MessageBox.Show(Window.GetWindow(this),
            "Move all images managed by NIRA Gallery to this folder?\n\n" + target +
            "\n\nNIRA will copy and verify the files before changing the saved location. Original user uploads and past chat caches will not be moved.",
            "Move gallery storage", MessageBoxButton.YesNo, MessageBoxImage.Question);
        if (confirmation != MessageBoxResult.Yes) return;
        IsEnabled = false;
        try
        {
            await Task.Run(() => _library.MoveLibrary(target));
            RefreshGallery();
            StatusText.Text = "Gallery library moved and verified successfully.";
        }
        catch (Exception ex) { MessageBox.Show(Window.GetWindow(this), ex.Message, "Gallery storage unchanged", MessageBoxButton.OK, MessageBoxImage.Warning); }
        finally { IsEnabled = true; }
    }
    private void OpenFolder_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
    {
        if (_library == null) return;
        try { Process.Start(new ProcessStartInfo("explorer.exe", $"\"{_library.RootFolder}\"") { UseShellExecute = true }); }
        catch (Exception ex) { StatusText.Text = ex.Message; }
    }

    private void Image_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
    {
        if (sender is not Button { Tag: NIRAGalleryTile selected }) return;
        var gallery = Tiles.ToArray();
        int index = Array.IndexOf(gallery, selected);
        if (index < 0) return;
        int start = Math.Max(0, index - 12);
        int end = Math.Min(gallery.Length, index + 13);
        var images = gallery[start..end].Select(t => new VisualArtifactViewModel(new NIRAVisualArtifact
        {
            ArtifactId = t.Record.Id,
            LocalPath = t.FullPath,
            Title = t.Record.Title,
            Caption = t.Record.Credit,
            SourceUri = t.Record.SourceUri,
            SourceKind = NIRAVisualArtifactSourceKind.LocalImage
        })).ToArray();
        var window = new NIRAUserAttachmentGalleryWindow(images, index - start) { Owner = Window.GetWindow(this) };
        window.ShowDialog();
    }
}

public sealed record NIRAGalleryTile(NIRAGalleryItem Record, string FullPath, int PreviewPixelWidth)
{
    public string Title => Record.Title;
    public string Credit => Record.Credit.Length > 0 ? Record.Credit : Record.Category switch
    {
        NIRAGalleryCategory.Uploaded => "Your uploaded photo",
        NIRAGalleryCategory.WebFound => "Web reference photo",
        _ => "Generated image"
    };
    public ImageSource? Preview { get; } = VisualArtifactViewModel.TryLoadPreview(FullPath, PreviewPixelWidth);
}
```

## 40. `NIRAAgent.UI\Gallery\NIRAMasonryPanel.cs`

**File:** `NIRAAgent.UI\Gallery\NIRAMasonryPanel.cs`

```csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Windows;
using System.Windows.Controls;

namespace NIRAAgent.UI.Gallery;

/// <summary>
/// A responsive masonry panel for the media library. Children are measured at
/// the *current viewport's* column width with unbounded height, so an image's
/// own aspect ratio, not a fixed tile height, determines its dimensions.
/// Tiles are placed in the shortest column, avoiding WrapPanel row gaps.
/// All layout is local WPF work; no image queries or model calls are made.
/// </summary>
public sealed class NIRAMasonryPanel : Panel
{
    public static readonly DependencyProperty PreferredColumnWidthProperty =
        DependencyProperty.Register(nameof(PreferredColumnWidth), typeof(double),
            typeof(NIRAMasonryPanel), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(235.0,
                FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.AffectsMeasure));

    public static readonly DependencyProperty ColumnSpacingProperty =
        DependencyProperty.Register(nameof(ColumnSpacing), typeof(double),
            typeof(NIRAMasonryPanel), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(14.0,
                FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.AffectsMeasure));

    public static readonly DependencyProperty RowSpacingProperty =
        DependencyProperty.Register(nameof(RowSpacing), typeof(double),
            typeof(NIRAMasonryPanel), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(15.0,
                FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.AffectsMeasure));

    public double PreferredColumnWidth
    {
        get => (double)GetValue(PreferredColumnWidthProperty);
        set => SetValue(PreferredColumnWidthProperty, value);
    }

    public double ColumnSpacing
    {
        get => (double)GetValue(ColumnSpacingProperty);
        set => SetValue(ColumnSpacingProperty, value);
    }

    public double RowSpacing
    {
        get => (double)GetValue(RowSpacingProperty);
        set => SetValue(RowSpacingProperty, value);
    }

    private readonly List<Rect> _placements = new();
    private double _measuredWidth;

    protected override Size MeasureOverride(Size availableSize)
    {
        double width = double.IsFinite(availableSize.Width)
            ? Math.Max(0, availableSize.Width)
            : Math.Max(300, ActualWidth);
        _measuredWidth = width;
        _placements.Clear();

        int count = InternalChildren.Count;
        if (width <= 0 || count == 0)
            return new Size(width, 0);

        double gap = Math.Max(0, ColumnSpacing);
        double rowGap = Math.Max(0, RowSpacing);
        double ideal = Math.Max(160, PreferredColumnWidth);
        int fittingColumns = Math.Max(1, (int)Math.Floor((width + gap) / (ideal + gap)));
        int columns = Math.Min(count, fittingColumns);
        // One picture should be comfortably sized, not enlarged to fill an
        // entire ultrawide workspace. The bound is viewport-relative, not fixed.
        double columnWidth = columns == 1 && width > ideal * 2.5
            ? width * 0.66
            : (width - (columns - 1) * gap) / columns;
        columnWidth = Math.Max(1, columnWidth);

        double[] bottoms = new double[columns];
        for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
        {
            UIElement child = InternalChildren[i];
            child.Measure(new Size(columnWidth, double.PositiveInfinity));
            int shortest = 0;
            for (int j = 1; j < bottoms.Length; j++)
                if (bottoms[j] < bottoms[shortest]) shortest = j;

            double tileHeight = Math.Max(0, child.DesiredSize.Height);
            double left = shortest * (columnWidth + gap);
            double top = bottoms[shortest];
            _placements.Add(new Rect(left, top, columnWidth, tileHeight));
            bottoms[shortest] += tileHeight + rowGap;
        }

        double totalHeight = Math.Max(0, Max(bottoms) - rowGap);
        return new Size(width, totalHeight);
    }

    protected override Size ArrangeOverride(Size finalSize)
    {
        if (Math.Abs(finalSize.Width - _measuredWidth) > 1)
            InvalidateMeasure(); // Reflow on viewport/window size changes.

        for (int i = 0; i < InternalChildren.Count && i < _placements.Count; i++)
            InternalChildren[i].Arrange(_placements[i]);
        return finalSize;
    }

    private static double Max(double[] values)
    {
        double max = 0;
        foreach (double value in values) max = Math.Max(max, value);
        return max;
    }
}
```

```xml
<Window x:Class="NIRAAgent.UI.MainWindow"
        xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"
        xmlns:x="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml"
        xmlns:shell="clr-namespace:System.Windows.Shell;assembly=PresentationFramework"
        xmlns:local="clr-namespace:NIRAAgent.UI.ViewModels"
        xmlns:ui="clr-namespace:NIRAAgent.UI"
        xmlns:present="clr-namespace:NIRAAgent.UI.Presentation"
        xmlns:typing="clr-namespace:NIRAAgent.UI.Typing"
        xmlns:gallery="clr-namespace:NIRAAgent.UI.Gallery"
        Title="NIRA by ELVARA"
        Icon="Assets/Nira-Icon.ico"
        Width="1440"
        Height="900"
        MinWidth="1160"
        MinHeight="720"
        WindowStartupLocation="CenterScreen"
        WindowStyle="None"
        ResizeMode="CanResize"
        Background="{DynamicResource NIRABackgroundBrush}"
        Foreground="{DynamicResource NIRATextBrush}"
        FontFamily="Segoe UI Variable Text, Segoe UI"
        SnapsToDevicePixels="True"
        UseLayoutRounding="True"
        TextOptions.TextFormattingMode="Display">

    <WindowChrome.WindowChrome>
        <shell:WindowChrome CaptionHeight="0"
                            ResizeBorderThickness="7"
                            CornerRadius="0"
                            GlassFrameThickness="0"
                            UseAeroCaptionButtons="False"/>
    </WindowChrome.WindowChrome>

    <Window.Resources>
        <!-- One motion vocabulary: soft, non-elastic easing. -->
        <CubicEase x:Key="NIRAMotionEase" EasingMode="EaseOut"/>
        <SineEase x:Key="NIRAMotionPressEase" EasingMode="EaseInOut"/>
        <LinearGradientBrush x:Key="SidebarGradient" StartPoint="0,0" EndPoint="1,1">
            <GradientStop Color="#08060915" Offset="0"/>
            <GradientStop Color="#12091230" Offset="1"/>
        </LinearGradientBrush>

        <!-- Thin, low-distraction scrollbars for chat, activity lists and inputs. -->
        <Style x:Key="ThinScrollThumbStyle" TargetType="Thumb">
            <Setter Property="Background" Value="#7B5A8AC6"/>
            <Setter Property="Template">
                <Setter.Value>
                    <ControlTemplate TargetType="Thumb">
                        <Border x:Name="ThumbRoot"
                                Margin="0"
                                Background="{TemplateBinding Background}"
                                CornerRadius="2"
                                Opacity="0.52"/>
                        <ControlTemplate.Triggers>
                            <Trigger Property="IsMouseOver" Value="True">
                                <Setter TargetName="ThumbRoot" Property="Opacity" Value="0.88"/>
                                <Setter TargetName="ThumbRoot" Property="Background" Value="#A070A9E6"/>
                            </Trigger>
                            <Trigger Property="IsDragging" Value="True">
                                <Setter TargetName="ThumbRoot" Property="Opacity" Value="1"/>
                                <Setter TargetName="ThumbRoot" Property="Background" Value="#C178DBFF"/>
                            </Trigger>
                        </ControlTemplate.Triggers>
                    </ControlTemplate>
                </Setter.Value>
            </Setter>
        </Style>

        <Style TargetType="ScrollBar">
            <Setter Property="Background" Value="Transparent"/>
            <Setter Property="Opacity" Value="0.76"/>
            <Setter Property="Template">
                <Setter.Value>
                    <ControlTemplate TargetType="ScrollBar">
                        <Grid x:Name="ScrollRoot"
                              Background="Transparent">
                            <Track x:Name="PART_Track"
                                   Focusable="False"
                                   IsDirectionReversed="True">
                                <Track.Thumb>
                                    <Thumb Style="{StaticResource ThinScrollThumbStyle}"/>
                                </Track.Thumb>
                            </Track>
                        </Grid>
                        <ControlTemplate.Triggers>
                            <Trigger Property="Orientation" Value="Horizontal">
                                <Setter TargetName="PART_Track" Property="Orientation" Value="Horizontal"/>
                                <Setter TargetName="PART_Track" Property="IsDirectionReversed" Value="False"/>
                            </Trigger>
                            <Trigger Property="Orientation" Value="Vertical">
                                <Setter TargetName="PART_Track" Property="Orientation" Value="Vertical"/>
                                <Setter TargetName="PART_Track" Property="IsDirectionReversed" Value="True"/>
                            </Trigger>
                        </ControlTemplate.Triggers>
                    </ControlTemplate>
                </Setter.Value>
            </Setter>
            <Style.Triggers>
                <Trigger Property="Orientation" Value="Vertical">
                    <Setter Property="Width" Value="5"/>
                    <Setter Property="MinWidth" Value="0"/>
                </Trigger>
                <Trigger Property="Orientation" Value="Horizontal">
                    <Setter Property="Height" Value="5"/>
                    <Setter Property="MinHeight" Value="0"/>
                </Trigger>
            </Style.Triggers>
        </Style>

        <!-- Native-inspired window controls: flat, quiet, and familiar,
             while keeping NIRA's dark blue interface language. -->
        <Style x:Key="WindowControlButton" TargetType="Button">
            <Setter Property="Width" Value="46"/>
            <Setter Property="Height" Value="36"/>
            <Setter Property="Padding" Value="0"/>
            <Setter Property="Margin" Value="0"/>
            <Setter Property="Background" Value="Transparent"/>
            <Setter Property="BorderThickness" Value="0"/>
            <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="#91A8BE"/>
            <Setter Property="Cursor" Value="Arrow"/>
            <Setter Property="Template">
                <Setter.Value>
                    <ControlTemplate TargetType="Button">
                        <Border x:Name="Root"
                                Background="{TemplateBinding Background}">
                            <ContentPresenter HorizontalAlignment="Center"
                                              VerticalAlignment="Center"/>
                        </Border>
                        <ControlTemplate.Triggers>
                            <Trigger Property="IsMouseOver" Value="True">
                                <Setter TargetName="Root" Property="Background" Value="#25213144"/>
                                <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="#E8F5FF"/>
                            </Trigger>
                            <Trigger Property="IsPressed" Value="True">
                                <Setter TargetName="Root" Property="Background" Value="#34314A63"/>
                                <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="White"/>
                            </Trigger>
                            <Trigger Property="IsEnabled" Value="False">
                                <Setter Property="Opacity" Value="0.38"/>
                            </Trigger>
                        </ControlTemplate.Triggers>
                    </ControlTemplate>
                </Setter.Value>
            </Setter>
        </Style>

        <Style x:Key="CloseButtonStyle" TargetType="Button" BasedOn="{StaticResource WindowControlButton}">
            <Style.Triggers>
                <Trigger Property="IsMouseOver" Value="True">
                    <Setter Property="Background" Value="#8C3B3045"/>
                    <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="#FFF3F6"/>
                </Trigger>
                <Trigger Property="IsPressed" Value="True">
                    <Setter Property="Background" Value="#B64A3148"/>
                    <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="White"/>
                </Trigger>
            </Style.Triggers>
        </Style>

        <Style x:Key="HeaderActionButtonStyle" TargetType="Button">
            <Setter Property="Width" Value="124"/>
            <Setter Property="Height" Value="34"/>
            <Setter Property="Padding" Value="0"/>
            <Setter Property="Margin" Value="0,0,8,0"/>
            <Setter Property="Background" Value="#15111F3E"/>
            <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="#D9F5FF"/>
            <Setter Property="BorderBrush" Value="#4C5E7CFF"/>
            <Setter Property="BorderThickness" Value="1"/>
            <Setter Property="FontSize" Value="11"/>
            <Setter Property="FontWeight" Value="SemiBold"/>
            <Setter Property="Cursor" Value="Hand"/>
            <Setter Property="Template">
                <Setter.Value>
                    <ControlTemplate TargetType="Button">
                        <Grid SnapsToDevicePixels="True">
                            <Border x:Name="Glow"
                                    CornerRadius="9"
                                    Background="#1A558CFF"
                                    Opacity="0.24"/>
                            <Border x:Name="Core"
                                    Margin="1"
                                    CornerRadius="8"
                                    Background="{TemplateBinding Background}"
                                    BorderBrush="{TemplateBinding BorderBrush}"
                                    BorderThickness="{TemplateBinding BorderThickness}">
                                <ContentPresenter HorizontalAlignment="Center"
                                                  VerticalAlignment="Center"
                                                  Margin="0"/>
                            </Border>
                        </Grid>
                        <ControlTemplate.Triggers>
                            <Trigger Property="IsMouseOver" Value="True">
                                <Setter TargetName="Glow" Property="Opacity" Value="0.82"/>
                                <Setter TargetName="Core" Property="Background" Value="#2920496A"/>
                                <Setter TargetName="Core" Property="BorderBrush" Value="#AA82FFFF"/>
                                <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="#F6FDFF"/>
                            </Trigger>
                        </ControlTemplate.Triggers>
                    </ControlTemplate>
                </Setter.Value>
            </Setter>
        </Style>

        <Style x:Key="SendButtonStyle" TargetType="Button" BasedOn="{StaticResource NIRAPrimaryButtonStyle}">
            <Setter Property="Width" Value="46"/>
            <Setter Property="Height" Value="46"/>
            <Setter Property="Padding" Value="0"/>
            <Setter Property="Template">
                <Setter.Value>
                    <ControlTemplate TargetType="Button">
                        <Grid>
                            <Ellipse x:Name="Glow"
                                     Width="38"
                                     Height="38"
                                     Fill="#1E4578FF"
                                     Opacity="0.46"/>
                            <Border x:Name="Core"
                                    Margin="2"
                                    CornerRadius="11"
                                    Background="{DynamicResource NIRAPrimaryButtonFill}"
                                    BorderBrush="#B6C8FAFF"
                                    BorderThickness="1" RenderTransformOrigin="0.5,0.5">
                                <Border.RenderTransform><ScaleTransform ScaleX="1" ScaleY="1"/></Border.RenderTransform>
                                <ContentPresenter x:Name="SendGlyphHost" HorizontalAlignment="Center" VerticalAlignment="Center" RenderTransformOrigin="0.5,0.5">
                                    <ContentPresenter.RenderTransform><ScaleTransform ScaleX="1" ScaleY="1"/></ContentPresenter.RenderTransform>
                                </ContentPresenter>
                            </Border>
                        </Grid>
                        <ControlTemplate.Triggers>
                            <Trigger Property="IsMouseOver" Value="True">
                                <Trigger.EnterActions><BeginStoryboard HandoffBehavior="SnapshotAndReplace"><Storyboard>
                                    <DoubleAnimation Storyboard.TargetName="SendGlyphHost" Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.RenderTransform).(ScaleTransform.ScaleX)" To="1.065" Duration="0:0:0.24" EasingFunction="{StaticResource NIRAMotionEase}"/>
                                    <DoubleAnimation Storyboard.TargetName="SendGlyphHost" Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.RenderTransform).(ScaleTransform.ScaleY)" To="1.065" Duration="0:0:0.24" EasingFunction="{StaticResource NIRAMotionEase}"/>
                                </Storyboard></BeginStoryboard></Trigger.EnterActions>
                                <Trigger.ExitActions><BeginStoryboard HandoffBehavior="SnapshotAndReplace"><Storyboard>
                                    <DoubleAnimation Storyboard.TargetName="SendGlyphHost" Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.RenderTransform).(ScaleTransform.ScaleX)" To="1" Duration="0:0:0.26" EasingFunction="{StaticResource NIRAMotionEase}"/>
                                    <DoubleAnimation Storyboard.TargetName="SendGlyphHost" Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.RenderTransform).(ScaleTransform.ScaleY)" To="1" Duration="0:0:0.26" EasingFunction="{StaticResource NIRAMotionEase}"/>
                                </Storyboard></BeginStoryboard></Trigger.ExitActions>
                                <Setter TargetName="Glow" Property="Opacity" Value="1"/>
                                <Setter TargetName="Core" Property="BorderBrush" Value="#F0E8FFFF"/>
                            </Trigger>
                            <Trigger Property="IsEnabled" Value="False">
                                <Setter Property="Opacity" Value="0.35"/>
                            </Trigger>
                                                    <EventTrigger RoutedEvent="Button.Click">
                                <BeginStoryboard HandoffBehavior="SnapshotAndReplace">
                                    <Storyboard>
                                        <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetName="Core" Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.RenderTransform).(ScaleTransform.ScaleX)">
                                            <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0" Value="0.955" EasingFunction="{StaticResource NIRAMotionPressEase}"/>
                                            <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.12" Value="1.022" EasingFunction="{StaticResource NIRAMotionEase}"/>
                                            <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.28" Value="1" EasingFunction="{StaticResource NIRAMotionEase}"/>
                                        </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                                        <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetName="Core" Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.RenderTransform).(ScaleTransform.ScaleY)">
                                            <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0" Value="0.955" EasingFunction="{StaticResource NIRAMotionPressEase}"/>
                                            <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.12" Value="1.022" EasingFunction="{StaticResource NIRAMotionEase}"/>
                                            <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.28" Value="1" EasingFunction="{StaticResource NIRAMotionEase}"/>
                                        </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                                    </Storyboard>
                                </BeginStoryboard>
                            </EventTrigger>
                        </ControlTemplate.Triggers>
                    </ControlTemplate>
                </Setter.Value>
            </Setter>
        </Style>

        <DataTemplate x:Key="UserMessageTemplate">
            <StackPanel x:Name="UserMessageRoot"
                        HorizontalAlignment="Right"
                        Margin="96,0,0,20"
                        Opacity="0">
                <StackPanel.RenderTransform>
                    <TranslateTransform x:Name="UserMessageTranslate" X="4"/>
                </StackPanel.RenderTransform>
                <StackPanel.Triggers>
                    <EventTrigger RoutedEvent="FrameworkElement.Loaded">
                        <BeginStoryboard>
                            <Storyboard>
                                <DoubleAnimation Storyboard.TargetName="UserMessageRoot"
                                                 Storyboard.TargetProperty="Opacity"
                                                 From="0" To="1" Duration="0:0:0.18"/>
                                <DoubleAnimation Storyboard.TargetName="UserMessageTranslate"
                                                 Storyboard.TargetProperty="X"
                                                 From="4" To="0" Duration="0:0:0.18">
                                    <DoubleAnimation.EasingFunction>
                                        <CubicEase EasingMode="EaseOut"/>
                                    </DoubleAnimation.EasingFunction>
                                </DoubleAnimation>
                            </Storyboard>
                        </BeginStoryboard>
                    </EventTrigger>
                </StackPanel.Triggers>
                <TextBlock Text="YOU"
                           HorizontalAlignment="Right"
                           Margin="0,0,9,5"
                           FontSize="10"
                           FontWeight="SemiBold"
                           Foreground="{DynamicResource NIRASecondaryBrush}"/>
                <Grid MaxWidth="760">
                    <Border Margin="0,2,-2,-2"
                            CornerRadius="17,17,5,17"
                            Background="{DynamicResource NIRAUserBubbleGlowBrush}"/>
                    <Border Padding="17,12"
                            Background="{DynamicResource NIRAUserBubbleFillBrush}"
                            BorderBrush="{DynamicResource NIRAUserBubbleEdgeBrush}"
                            BorderThickness="1"
                            CornerRadius="17,17,5,17"
                            SnapsToDevicePixels="True">
                        <StackPanel>
                            <!-- One-image message: picture and optional message live
                                 in a single compact, horizontally balanced bubble. -->
                            <Grid x:Name="UserSingleImageRow" Visibility="Collapsed">
                                <Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                                    <ColumnDefinition Width="Auto"/>
                                    <ColumnDefinition Width="Auto"/>
                                </Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                                <ItemsControl Grid.Column="0" ItemsSource="{Binding UserImageGalleryTiles}">
                                    <ItemsControl.ItemTemplate>
                                        <DataTemplate>
                                            <Border Width="148" Height="100" CornerRadius="11"
                                                    ClipToBounds="True" Cursor="Hand"
                                                    Background="{DynamicResource NIRAComposerBadgeBrush}"
                                                    BorderBrush="{DynamicResource NIRAComposerEdgeBrush}" BorderThickness="1"
                                                    MouseLeftButtonUp="UserImageGalleryTile_MouseLeftButtonUp">
                                                <Image Source="{Binding PreviewImage}" Stretch="UniformToFill"
                                                       SnapsToDevicePixels="True"/>
                                            </Border>
                                        </DataTemplate>
                                    </ItemsControl.ItemTemplate>
                                </ItemsControl>
                                <TextBlock Grid.Column="1" Text="{Binding Content}"
                                           MaxWidth="330" Margin="13,5,1,3"
                                           VerticalAlignment="Center" TextWrapping="Wrap"
                                           FontSize="13" LineHeight="19"
                                           Foreground="{DynamicResource NIRATextBrush}"/>
                            </Grid>
                            <!-- User words and attached visuals are separate: no
                                 filename line is added for an image. -->
                            <TextBlock x:Name="UserMessageBody"
                                       Text="{Binding Content}"
                                       MaxWidth="620"
                                       Foreground="{DynamicResource NIRATextBrush}"
                                       FontSize="14"
                                       LineHeight="21"
                                       TextWrapping="Wrap"/>

                            <ItemsControl x:Name="UserMessageImages"
                                          ItemsSource="{Binding UserImageGalleryTiles}"
                                          Margin="0,10,0,0">
                                <ItemsControl.ItemsPanel>
                                    <ItemsPanelTemplate>
                                        <StackPanel Orientation="Horizontal"/>
                                    </ItemsPanelTemplate>
                                </ItemsControl.ItemsPanel>
                                <ItemsControl.ItemContainerStyle>
                                    <Style TargetType="ContentPresenter">
                                        <Setter Property="Margin" Value="0,0,8,0"/>
                                    </Style>
                                </ItemsControl.ItemContainerStyle>
                                <ItemsControl.ItemTemplate>
                                    <DataTemplate>
                                        <Border x:Name="GalleryTileCard"
                                                Width="162"
                                                Height="108"
                                                CornerRadius="12"
                                                ClipToBounds="True"
                                                Cursor="Hand"
                                                Background="{DynamicResource NIRAGlassStrongTintBrush}"
                                                BorderBrush="{DynamicResource NIRAComposerEdgeBrush}"
                                                BorderThickness="1"
                                                MouseLeftButtonUp="UserImageGalleryTile_MouseLeftButtonUp"
                                                RenderTransformOrigin="0.5,0.5">
                                            <Border.RenderTransform><ScaleTransform ScaleX="1" ScaleY="1"/></Border.RenderTransform>
                                            <Border.Triggers>
                                                <EventTrigger RoutedEvent="MouseEnter">
                                                    <BeginStoryboard><Storyboard>
                                                        <DoubleAnimation Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.RenderTransform).(ScaleTransform.ScaleX)" To="1.018" Duration="0:0:0.16"/>
                                                        <DoubleAnimation Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.RenderTransform).(ScaleTransform.ScaleY)" To="1.018" Duration="0:0:0.16"/>
                                                    </Storyboard></BeginStoryboard>
                                                </EventTrigger>
                                                <EventTrigger RoutedEvent="MouseLeave">
                                                    <BeginStoryboard><Storyboard>
                                                        <DoubleAnimation Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.RenderTransform).(ScaleTransform.ScaleX)" To="1" Duration="0:0:0.20"/>
                                                        <DoubleAnimation Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.RenderTransform).(ScaleTransform.ScaleY)" To="1" Duration="0:0:0.20"/>
                                                    </Storyboard></BeginStoryboard>
                                                </EventTrigger>
                                            </Border.Triggers>
                                            <Grid>
                                                <Image x:Name="GalleryTileImage"
                                                       Source="{Binding PreviewImage}"
                                                       Stretch="UniformToFill"
                                                       SnapsToDevicePixels="True"/>
                                                <Border x:Name="GalleryTileShade"
                                                        Background="#00000000"/>
                                                <StackPanel x:Name="OverflowBadge"
                                                            Visibility="Collapsed"
                                                            HorizontalAlignment="Center"
                                                            VerticalAlignment="Center">
                                                    <TextBlock Text="{Binding OverflowLabel}"
                                                               HorizontalAlignment="Center"
                                                               FontSize="28"
                                                               FontWeight="SemiBold"
                                                               Foreground="White"/>
                                                    <TextBlock Text="more"
                                                               HorizontalAlignment="Center"
                                                               Margin="0,2,0,0"
                                                               FontSize="11"
                                                               Foreground="#F2F8FF"/>
                                                </StackPanel>
                                                <TextBlock x:Name="UserImageUnavailable"
                                                           Text="Image preview unavailable"
                                                           Foreground="{DynamicResource NIRASecondaryBrush}"
                                                           Margin="12"
                                                           FontSize="11"
                                                           Visibility="Collapsed"
                                                           HorizontalAlignment="Center"
                                                           VerticalAlignment="Center"
                                                           TextWrapping="Wrap"/>
                                            </Grid>
                                        </Border>
                                        <DataTemplate.Triggers>
                                            <DataTrigger Binding="{Binding HasPreview}" Value="False">
                                                <Setter TargetName="UserImageUnavailable" Property="Visibility" Value="Visible"/>
                                            </DataTrigger>
                                            <DataTrigger Binding="{Binding IsSingleImage}" Value="True">
                                                <Setter TargetName="GalleryTileCard" Property="Width" Value="190"/>
                                                <Setter TargetName="GalleryTileCard" Property="Height" Value="116"/>
                                            </DataTrigger>
                                            <DataTrigger Binding="{Binding IsOverflowTile}" Value="True">
                                                <Setter TargetName="GalleryTileShade" Property="Background" Value="#A20A1225"/>
                                                <Setter TargetName="OverflowBadge" Property="Visibility" Value="Visible"/>
                                                <Setter TargetName="GalleryTileImage" Property="Effect">
                                                    <Setter.Value>
                                                        <BlurEffect Radius="8"/>
                                                    </Setter.Value>
                                                </Setter>
                                            </DataTrigger>
```
