                                        </DataTemplate.Triggers>
                                    </DataTemplate>
                                </ItemsControl.ItemTemplate>
                            </ItemsControl>

                            <!-- Non-image attachments remain compact identifiable
                                 local-file references; content is NOT inferred. -->
                            <ItemsControl x:Name="UserMessageFiles"
                                          ItemsSource="{Binding UserFileAttachments}">
                                <ItemsControl.ItemsPanel>
                                    <ItemsPanelTemplate><WrapPanel Orientation="Horizontal"/></ItemsPanelTemplate>
                                </ItemsControl.ItemsPanel>
                                <ItemsControl.ItemTemplate>
                                    <DataTemplate>
                                        <Border MaxWidth="300" MinHeight="42"
                                                Margin="0,5,8,2" Padding="10,6"
                                                CornerRadius="9"
                                                BorderBrush="{DynamicResource NIRAComposerEdgeBrush}"
                                                BorderThickness="1"
                                                Background="{DynamicResource NIRAGlassStrongTintBrush}"
                                                ToolTip="{Binding FullPath}">
                                            <StackPanel Orientation="Horizontal">
                                                <TextBlock Text="{Binding TypeGlyph}"
                                                           VerticalAlignment="Center"
                                                           FontFamily="Segoe UI Symbol"
                                                           FontSize="18"
                                                           Foreground="{DynamicResource NIRABlueBrush}"
                                                           Margin="0,0,9,0"/>
                                                <StackPanel VerticalAlignment="Center">
                                                    <TextBlock Text="{Binding FileName}" MaxWidth="235"
                                                               TextTrimming="CharacterEllipsis"
                                                               FontWeight="SemiBold" FontSize="11"/>
                                                    <TextBlock Text="{Binding TypeLabel}" MaxWidth="235"
                                                               TextTrimming="CharacterEllipsis"
                                                               FontSize="9"
                                                               Foreground="{DynamicResource NIRASecondaryBrush}"/>
                                                </StackPanel>
                                            </StackPanel>
                                        </Border>
                                    </DataTemplate>
                                </ItemsControl.ItemTemplate>
                            </ItemsControl>
                        </StackPanel>
                    </Border>
                </Grid>
            </StackPanel>
            <DataTemplate.Triggers>
                <DataTrigger Binding="{Binding HasSingleUserImage}" Value="True">
                    <Setter TargetName="UserSingleImageRow" Property="Visibility" Value="Visible"/>
                    <Setter TargetName="UserMessageBody" Property="Visibility" Value="Collapsed"/>
                    <Setter TargetName="UserMessageImages" Property="Visibility" Value="Collapsed"/>
                </DataTrigger>
                <DataTrigger Binding="{Binding HasContent}" Value="False">
                    <Setter TargetName="UserMessageBody" Property="Visibility" Value="Collapsed"/>
                    <Setter TargetName="UserMessageImages" Property="Margin" Value="0"/>
                </DataTrigger>
                <DataTrigger Binding="{Binding HasUserImages}" Value="False">
                    <Setter TargetName="UserMessageImages" Property="Visibility" Value="Collapsed"/>
                </DataTrigger>
                <DataTrigger Binding="{Binding HasUserFiles}" Value="False">
                    <Setter TargetName="UserMessageFiles" Property="Visibility" Value="Collapsed"/>
                </DataTrigger>
            </DataTemplate.Triggers>
        </DataTemplate>

        <DataTemplate x:Key="AssistantMessageTemplate">
            <StackPanel x:Name="AssistantMessageRoot"
                        HorizontalAlignment="Stretch"
                        Margin="0,0,0,25"
                        Opacity="0">
                <StackPanel.RenderTransform>
                    <TranslateTransform x:Name="AssistantMessageTranslate" X="-4"/>
                </StackPanel.RenderTransform>
                <StackPanel.Triggers>
                    <EventTrigger RoutedEvent="FrameworkElement.Loaded">
                        <BeginStoryboard>
                            <Storyboard>
                                <DoubleAnimation Storyboard.TargetName="AssistantMessageRoot"
                                                 Storyboard.TargetProperty="Opacity"
                                                 From="0" To="1" Duration="0:0:0.18"/>
                                <DoubleAnimation Storyboard.TargetName="AssistantMessageTranslate"
                                                 Storyboard.TargetProperty="X"
                                                 From="-4" To="0" Duration="0:0:0.18">
                                    <DoubleAnimation.EasingFunction>
                                        <CubicEase EasingMode="EaseOut"/>
                                    </DoubleAnimation.EasingFunction>
                                </DoubleAnimation>
                            </Storyboard>
                        </BeginStoryboard>
                    </EventTrigger>
                </StackPanel.Triggers>

                <!-- A stable, runtime-owned reply source remains visible even
                     when concurrent turns finish in a different order. -->
                <TextBlock x:Name="ReplySourceText" Text="{Binding ReplyToText}"
                           Visibility="Collapsed" FontSize="11"
                           Margin="8,0,8,5" TextTrimming="CharacterEllipsis"
                           Foreground="{DynamicResource NIRASecondaryBrush}"
                           Opacity="0.84"/>

                <!-- Assistant prose is full-width and borderless. Actual rich
                     visuals retain their own themed surfaces where helpful. -->
                <Grid HorizontalAlignment="Stretch">
                    <Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                        <ColumnDefinition Width="34"/>
                        <ColumnDefinition Width="*"/>
                    </Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                    <Border Grid.Column="0" Width="27" Height="27"
                            CornerRadius="14" VerticalAlignment="Top"
                            Background="{DynamicResource NIRAComposerBadgeBrush}"
                            BorderBrush="{DynamicResource NIRAComposerEdgeBrush}" BorderThickness="1">
                        <Image Source="Assets/Nira-Icon.png" Width="23" Height="23"
                               Stretch="Uniform" VerticalAlignment="Center" HorizontalAlignment="Center"/>
                    </Border>
                    <Border Grid.Column="1" x:Name="AssistantBubble"
                            HorizontalAlignment="Stretch"
                            Padding="0,1,18,2"
                            MinWidth="0"
                            Background="Transparent"
                            BorderThickness="0">
                        <Grid>
                            <Grid.RowDefinitions>
                                <RowDefinition Height="Auto"/>
                                <RowDefinition Height="Auto"/>
                                <RowDefinition Height="Auto"/>
                            </Grid.RowDefinitions>

                            <!-- Structured prose stays on the background itself. Each
                                 paragraph, title, bullet, link and code passage gets
                                 its own readable spacing without a white chat box. -->
                            <StackPanel x:Name="AssistantContentText"
                                        Grid.Row="0" HorizontalAlignment="Stretch"
                                        present:NIRAChatDocument.Text="{Binding Content}"/>

                            <ItemsControl x:Name="AssistantRichBlocks" Grid.Row="1"
                                          ItemsSource="{Binding RichElements}" Visibility="Collapsed"
                                          Margin="0,5,0,5"/>

                            <!-- NIRA's OWN evidence-grounded image results. One sourced
                                 image is a rich horizontal card; multiple images become
                                 the same bounded, one-row gallery as user attachments. -->
                            <ItemsControl x:Name="AssistantVisualArtifacts"
                                          Grid.Row="2"
                                          ItemsSource="{Binding AssistantImageGalleryTiles}"
                                          Visibility="Collapsed"
                                          Margin="0,12,0,2">
                                <ItemsControl.ItemsPanel>
                                    <ItemsPanelTemplate><StackPanel Orientation="Horizontal"/></ItemsPanelTemplate>
                                </ItemsControl.ItemsPanel>
                                <ItemsControl.ItemContainerStyle>
                                    <Style TargetType="ContentPresenter">
                                        <Setter Property="Margin" Value="0,0,9,0"/>
                                    </Style>
                                </ItemsControl.ItemContainerStyle>
                                <ItemsControl.ItemTemplate>
                                    <DataTemplate>
                                        <Grid>
                                            <!-- Source-grounded photo display. The media is the
                                                 focal point; metadata lives in a readable footer.
                                                 Width follows the chat column up to 760px. -->
                                            <Border x:Name="AssistantSingleImageCard"
                                                    CornerRadius="20"
                                                    Background="{DynamicResource NIRAGlassStrongTintBrush}"
                                                    BorderBrush="{DynamicResource NIRAComposerEdgeBrush}"
                                                    BorderThickness="1" Visibility="Collapsed">
                                                <Grid Width="{Binding ActualWidth, RelativeSource={RelativeSource AncestorType={x:Type ItemsControl}}}"
                                                      MaxWidth="680">
                                                    <Grid.RowDefinitions>
                                                        <RowDefinition Height="Auto"/>
                                                        <RowDefinition Height="Auto"/>
                                                    </Grid.RowDefinitions>

                                                    <Border Grid.Row="0"
                                                            Margin="14,14,14,0"
                                                            Padding="0"
                                                            CornerRadius="16"
                                                            Background="#14091A33"
                                                            BorderBrush="#21000000"
                                                            BorderThickness="1"
                                                            ClipToBounds="True"
                                                            Cursor="Hand"
                                                            ToolTip="Open image at full size"
                                                            MouseLeftButtonUp="UserImageGalleryTile_MouseLeftButtonUp">
                                                        <Grid>
                                                            <Image Source="{Binding PreviewImage}"
                                                                   Stretch="Uniform"
                                                                   MaxHeight="470"
                                                                   HorizontalAlignment="Center"
                                                                   VerticalAlignment="Center"
                                                                   RenderOptions.BitmapScalingMode="HighQuality"
                                                                   SnapsToDevicePixels="True"/>
                                                            <Border Background="#A5081730"
                                                                    HorizontalAlignment="Left"
                                                                    VerticalAlignment="Top"
                                                                    Margin="14"
                                                                    Padding="11,6"
                                                                    CornerRadius="9"
                                                                    IsHitTestVisible="False">
                                                                <StackPanel Orientation="Horizontal">
                                                                    <TextBlock Text="✦" FontSize="12" Margin="0,0,7,0"
                                                                               Foreground="#FF7EE3FF"/>
                                                                    <TextBlock x:Name="AssistantHeroBadgeText"
                                                                               Text="{Binding CardBadgeText}"
                                                                               FontSize="10"
                                                                               FontWeight="SemiBold"
                                                                               Foreground="White"/>
                                                                </StackPanel>
                                                            </Border>
                                                            <Border HorizontalAlignment="Right"
                                                                    VerticalAlignment="Bottom"
                                                                    Margin="0,0,14,14"
                                                                    Padding="10,6"
                                                                    Background="#B1081730"
                                                                    CornerRadius="9"
                                                                    IsHitTestVisible="False">
                                                                <TextBlock Text="↗  OPEN FULL IMAGE"
                                                                           FontSize="10"
                                                                           FontWeight="SemiBold"
                                                                           Foreground="White"/>
                                                            </Border>
                                                        </Grid>
                                                    </Border>

                                                    <StackPanel Grid.Row="1" Margin="20,16,20,18">
                                                        <TextBlock x:Name="AssistantCreditProviderText"
                                                                   Text="{Binding CreditProvider}" FontSize="10"
                                                                   FontWeight="SemiBold" Foreground="{DynamicResource NIRACyanBrush}"
                                                                   Margin="0,0,0,6">
                                                            <TextBlock.Style>
                                                                <Style TargetType="TextBlock">
                                                                    <Setter Property="Visibility" Value="Visible"/>
                                                                    <Style.Triggers>
                                                                        <DataTrigger Binding="{Binding HasStructuredCredit}" Value="False">
                                                                            <Setter Property="Visibility" Value="Collapsed"/>
                                                                        </DataTrigger>
                                                                    </Style.Triggers>
                                                                </Style>
                                                            </TextBlock.Style>
                                                        </TextBlock>

                                                        <TextBlock Text="{Binding Title}" FontSize="18"
                                                                   FontWeight="SemiBold" TextWrapping="Wrap"
                                                                   Foreground="{DynamicResource NIRATextBrush}"/>

                                                        <Border x:Name="AssistantGeneratedMetaCard"
                                                                Margin="0,11,0,0"
                                                                Padding="12,9"
                                                                CornerRadius="10"
                                                                Background="#120B1D38"
                                                                BorderBrush="{DynamicResource NIRAComposerEdgeBrush}"
                                                                BorderThickness="1"
                                                                Visibility="Collapsed">
                                                            <StackPanel>
                                                                <TextBlock Text="GENERATED WITH"
                                                                           FontSize="10"
                                                                           FontWeight="SemiBold"
                                                                           Foreground="{DynamicResource NIRACyanBrush}"/>
                                                                <TextBlock Text="{Binding GeneratedMetaText}"
                                                                           Margin="0,4,0,0"
                                                                           FontSize="11.5"
                                                                           TextWrapping="Wrap"
                                                                           Foreground="{DynamicResource NIRASecondaryBrush}"/>
                                                            </StackPanel>
                                                        </Border>

                                                        <WrapPanel x:Name="AssistantReferenceMetaPanel" Margin="0,9,0,0">
                                                            <WrapPanel.Style>
                                                                <Style TargetType="WrapPanel">
                                                                    <Setter Property="Visibility" Value="Visible"/>
                                                                    <Style.Triggers>
                                                                        <DataTrigger Binding="{Binding HasStructuredCredit}" Value="False">
                                                                            <Setter Property="Visibility" Value="Collapsed"/>
                                                                        </DataTrigger>
                                                                    </Style.Triggers>
                                                                </Style>
                                                            </WrapPanel.Style>
                                                            <TextBlock Text="PHOTO BY  " FontSize="10.5"
                                                                       Foreground="{DynamicResource NIRASecondaryBrush}"
                                                                       VerticalAlignment="Center">
                                                                <TextBlock.Style>
                                                                    <Style TargetType="TextBlock">
                                                                        <Setter Property="Visibility" Value="Visible"/>
                                                                        <Style.Triggers>
                                                                            <DataTrigger Binding="{Binding HasCreditCreator}" Value="False">
                                                                                <Setter Property="Visibility" Value="Collapsed"/>
                                                                            </DataTrigger>
                                                                        </Style.Triggers>
                                                                    </Style>
                                                                </TextBlock.Style>
                                                            </TextBlock>
                                                            <TextBlock Text="{Binding CreditCreator}" FontSize="11.5"
                                                                       FontWeight="SemiBold" Margin="0,0,15,0"
                                                                       Foreground="{DynamicResource NIRATextBrush}"/>
                                                            <TextBlock Text="{Binding CreditLicense}" FontSize="10.5"
                                                                       VerticalAlignment="Center"
                                                                       Foreground="{DynamicResource NIRASecondaryBrush}"/>
                                                        </WrapPanel>

                                                        <TextBlock x:Name="AssistantReferenceCaptionText"
                                                                   Text="{Binding ReferenceCaption}" FontSize="11.5"
                                                                   Margin="0,8,0,0" TextWrapping="Wrap"
                                                                   Foreground="{DynamicResource NIRASecondaryBrush}">
                                                            <TextBlock.Style>
                                                                <Style TargetType="TextBlock">
                                                                    <Setter Property="Visibility" Value="Visible"/>
                                                                    <Style.Triggers>
                                                                        <DataTrigger Binding="{Binding HasReferenceCaption}" Value="False">
                                                                            <Setter Property="Visibility" Value="Collapsed"/>
                                                                        </DataTrigger>
                                                                    </Style.Triggers>
                                                                </Style>
                                                            </TextBlock.Style>
                                                        </TextBlock>

                                                        <Button x:Name="AssistantImageSourceButton"
                                                                Content="{Binding SourceActionLabel}"
                                                                Tag="{Binding SourceUri}"
                                                                ToolTip="Open the original credited source page"
                                                                Margin="0,13,0,0" Padding="12,8"
                                                                HorizontalAlignment="Left" Cursor="Hand"
                                                                FontSize="11.5" FontWeight="SemiBold"
                                                                Foreground="{DynamicResource NIRABlueBrush}"
                                                                Click="VisualArtifactOpenSource_Click">
                                                            <Button.Template>
                                                                <ControlTemplate TargetType="Button">
                                                                    <Border x:Name="SourcePill"
                                                                            Background="{DynamicResource NIRAGlassStrongTintBrush}"
                                                                            BorderBrush="{DynamicResource NIRAComposerEdgeBrush}"
                                                                            BorderThickness="1" CornerRadius="9"
                                                                            Padding="{TemplateBinding Padding}">
                                                                        <ContentPresenter HorizontalAlignment="Center"
                                                                                          VerticalAlignment="Center"/>
                                                                    </Border>
                                                                    <ControlTemplate.Triggers>
                                                                        <Trigger Property="IsMouseOver" Value="True">
                                                                            <Setter TargetName="SourcePill" Property="BorderBrush"
                                                                                    Value="{DynamicResource NIRACyanBrush}"/>
                                                                        </Trigger>
                                                                    </ControlTemplate.Triggers>
                                                                </ControlTemplate>
                                                            </Button.Template>
                                                        </Button>
                                                    </StackPanel>
                                                </Grid>
                                            </Border>
                                            <Border x:Name="AssistantStripTile" Width="192" Height="144"
                                                    CornerRadius="11" ClipToBounds="True"
                                                    Background="{DynamicResource NIRAComposerBadgeBrush}"
                                                    BorderBrush="{DynamicResource NIRAComposerEdgeBrush}"
                                                    BorderThickness="1" Cursor="Hand"
                                                    ToolTip="Open NIRA image gallery"
                                                    MouseLeftButtonUp="UserImageGalleryTile_MouseLeftButtonUp"
                                                    RenderTransformOrigin="0.5,0.5">
                                                <Border.RenderTransform><ScaleTransform ScaleX="1" ScaleY="1"/></Border.RenderTransform>
                                                <Border.Triggers>
                                                    <EventTrigger RoutedEvent="MouseEnter">
                                                        <BeginStoryboard><Storyboard>
                                                            <DoubleAnimation Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.RenderTransform).(ScaleTransform.ScaleX)" To="1.018" Duration="0:0:0.16"/>
                                                            <DoubleAnimation Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.RenderTransform).(ScaleTransform.ScaleY)" To="1.018" Duration="0:0:0.16"/>
                                                        </Storyboard></BeginStoryboard>
                                                    </EventTrigger>
                                                    <EventTrigger RoutedEvent="MouseLeave">
                                                        <BeginStoryboard><Storyboard>
                                                            <DoubleAnimation Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.RenderTransform).(ScaleTransform.ScaleX)" To="1" Duration="0:0:0.20"/>
                                                            <DoubleAnimation Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.RenderTransform).(ScaleTransform.ScaleY)" To="1" Duration="0:0:0.20"/>
                                                        </Storyboard></BeginStoryboard>
                                                    </EventTrigger>
                                                </Border.Triggers>
                                                <Grid>
                                                    <Image x:Name="AssistantStripImage" Source="{Binding PreviewImage}"
                                                           Stretch="UniformToFill" SnapsToDevicePixels="True"/>
                                                    <Border x:Name="AssistantOverflowShade" Background="#00000000"/>
                                                    <Border x:Name="AssistantStripLabelShade" Height="51"
                                                            VerticalAlignment="Bottom" IsHitTestVisible="False">
                                                        <Border.Background>
                                                            <LinearGradientBrush StartPoint="0,0" EndPoint="0,1">
                                                                <GradientStop Color="#0709152B" Offset="0"/>
                                                                <GradientStop Color="#DB081426" Offset="1"/>
                                                            </LinearGradientBrush>
                                                        </Border.Background>
                                                        <StackPanel Margin="10,6,10,6" VerticalAlignment="Bottom">
                                                            <TextBlock Text="{Binding Title}" FontSize="11"
                                                                       FontWeight="SemiBold" Foreground="White"
                                                                       TextTrimming="CharacterEllipsis"/>
                                                            <TextBlock Text="{Binding CreditProvider}" FontSize="9"
                                                                       Foreground="#FFD5EDFF" Margin="0,2,0,0"/>
                                                        </StackPanel>
                                                    </Border>
                                                    <TextBlock x:Name="AssistantOverflowBadge" Visibility="Collapsed"
                                                               Text="{Binding OverflowLabel}" Foreground="White"
                                                               FontWeight="SemiBold" FontSize="20"
                                                               HorizontalAlignment="Center" VerticalAlignment="Center"/>
                                                </Grid>
                                            </Border>
                                        </Grid>
                                        <DataTemplate.Triggers>
                                            <DataTrigger Binding="{Binding IsSingleImage}" Value="True">
                                                <Setter TargetName="AssistantSingleImageCard" Property="Visibility" Value="Visible"/>
                                                <Setter TargetName="AssistantStripTile" Property="Visibility" Value="Collapsed"/>
                                            </DataTrigger>
                                            <DataTrigger Binding="{Binding HasSourceUri}" Value="False">
                                                <Setter TargetName="AssistantImageSourceButton" Property="Visibility" Value="Collapsed"/>
                                            </DataTrigger>
                                            <DataTrigger Binding="{Binding HasCaption}" Value="False">
                                                <Setter TargetName="AssistantImageSourceButton" Property="Margin" Value="0,4,0,0"/>
                                            </DataTrigger>
                                            <DataTrigger Binding="{Binding IsGeneratedImage}" Value="True">
                                                <Setter TargetName="AssistantGeneratedMetaCard" Property="Visibility" Value="Visible"/>
                                                <Setter TargetName="AssistantCreditProviderText" Property="Visibility" Value="Collapsed"/>
                                                <Setter TargetName="AssistantReferenceMetaPanel" Property="Visibility" Value="Collapsed"/>
                                                <Setter TargetName="AssistantReferenceCaptionText" Property="Visibility" Value="Collapsed"/>
                                                <Setter TargetName="AssistantImageSourceButton" Property="Visibility" Value="Collapsed"/>
                                            </DataTrigger>
                                            <DataTrigger Binding="{Binding IsOverflowTile}" Value="True">
                                                <Setter TargetName="AssistantOverflowShade" Property="Background" Value="#B2091832"/>
                                                <Setter TargetName="AssistantOverflowBadge" Property="Visibility" Value="Visible"/>
                                                <Setter TargetName="AssistantStripLabelShade" Property="Visibility" Value="Collapsed"/>
                                                <Setter TargetName="AssistantStripImage" Property="Effect">
                                                    <Setter.Value><BlurEffect Radius="7"/></Setter.Value>
                                                </Setter>
                                            </DataTrigger>
                                        </DataTemplate.Triggers>
                                    </DataTemplate>
                                </ItemsControl.ItemTemplate>
                            </ItemsControl>

                            <!-- Quiet inline journey state:
                                 only NIRA's living three-dot motion plus the current
                                 grounded progress line. No card, border, badge or label. -->
                            <Grid x:Name="JourneyIndicator"
                                  Grid.Row="0" Grid.RowSpan="3"
                                  Margin="6,1,8,0"
                                  HorizontalAlignment="Left"
                                  Visibility="Collapsed"
                                  Opacity="1"
                                  RenderTransformOrigin="0.5,0.5">
                                <Grid.RenderTransform>
                                    <TranslateTransform x:Name="JourneyIndicatorTranslate"/>
                                </Grid.RenderTransform>
                                <StackPanel>
                                    <StackPanel x:Name="JourneyTypingRow" Orientation="Horizontal" HorizontalAlignment="Left">
                                        <typing:NIRATypingIndicator Width="42" Height="18"
                                            IndicatorStyle="FinalDepthDrift"
                                            SpeedMultiplier="0.85"
                                            IsHitTestVisible="False"/>
                                    </StackPanel>
                                    <TextBlock x:Name="JourneyProgressText"
                                               Text="{Binding ProgressText}"
                                               Margin="1,5,0,0"
                                               MaxWidth="560"
                                               FontSize="10.5"
                                               LineHeight="16"
                                               TextWrapping="Wrap"
                                               Foreground="{DynamicResource NIRASecondaryBrush}"
                                               Opacity="0.82"
                                               Visibility="Collapsed"/>

                                    <!-- Shared production/offline preview of the selected D4 animation. -->
                                    <typing:NIRAImageCreationPlaceholder x:Name="ImageCreationPlaceholder"
                                                                          Visibility="Collapsed"
                                                                          Margin="0,6,0,0"/>
                                </StackPanel>
                            </Grid>
                        </Grid>
                    </Border>
                </Grid>
            </StackPanel>

            <DataTemplate.Triggers>
                <DataTrigger Binding="{Binding HasReplySource}" Value="True">
                    <Setter TargetName="ReplySourceText" Property="Visibility" Value="Visible"/>
                </DataTrigger>
                <DataTrigger Binding="{Binding HasRichElements}" Value="True">
                    <Setter TargetName="AssistantRichBlocks" Property="Visibility" Value="Visible"/>
                </DataTrigger>
                <DataTrigger Binding="{Binding HasVisualArtifacts}" Value="True">
                    <Setter TargetName="AssistantVisualArtifacts" Property="Visibility" Value="Visible"/>
                </DataTrigger>

                <DataTrigger Binding="{Binding HasContent}" Value="False">
                    <Setter TargetName="AssistantContentText" Property="Visibility" Value="Collapsed"/>
                </DataTrigger>

                <DataTrigger Binding="{Binding IsJourneyActive}" Value="True">
                    <Setter TargetName="JourneyIndicator" Property="Visibility" Value="Visible"/>
                    <Setter TargetName="AssistantBubble" Property="Padding" Value="6,1,8,0"/>
                    <Setter TargetName="AssistantBubble" Property="Background" Value="Transparent"/>
                    <Setter TargetName="AssistantBubble" Property="BorderThickness" Value="0"/>
                    <Setter TargetName="AssistantBubble" Property="MinWidth" Value="0"/>
                </DataTrigger>

                <DataTrigger Binding="{Binding HasProgress}" Value="True">
                    <Setter TargetName="JourneyProgressText" Property="Visibility" Value="Visible"/>
                </DataTrigger>
                <DataTrigger Binding="{Binding IsImageGenerationActive}" Value="True">
                    <Setter TargetName="JourneyTypingRow" Property="Visibility" Value="Collapsed"/>
                    <Setter TargetName="JourneyProgressText" Property="Visibility" Value="Collapsed"/>
                    <Setter TargetName="ImageCreationPlaceholder" Property="Visibility" Value="Visible"/>
                </DataTrigger>

                <DataTrigger Binding="{Binding IsJourneyFading}" Value="True">
                    <DataTrigger.EnterActions>
                        <BeginStoryboard>
                            <Storyboard>
                                <DoubleAnimation Storyboard.TargetName="JourneyIndicator"
                                                 Storyboard.TargetProperty="Opacity"
                                                 To="0"
                                                 Duration="0:0:0.18"/>
                                <DoubleAnimation Storyboard.TargetName="JourneyIndicatorTranslate"
                                                 Storyboard.TargetProperty="Y"
                                                 To="-4"
                                                 Duration="0:0:0.18">
                                    <DoubleAnimation.EasingFunction>
                                        <CubicEase EasingMode="EaseOut"/>
                                    </DoubleAnimation.EasingFunction>
                                </DoubleAnimation>
                            </Storyboard>
                        </BeginStoryboard>
                    </DataTrigger.EnterActions>
                </DataTrigger>
            </DataTemplate.Triggers>
        </DataTemplate>

        <local:ChatMessageTemplateSelector x:Key="ChatMessageTemplateSelector"
                                           UserTemplate="{StaticResource UserMessageTemplate}"
                                           AssistantTemplate="{StaticResource AssistantMessageTemplate}"/>
    

        <!-- =========================================================
             NIRA NEXT-LEVEL GLASS SYSTEM
             Real local background crop + blur is provided by
             NIRABackdropBorder; tint layers stay deliberately quiet.
             ========================================================= -->

        <Style x:Key="GlassPanelStyle" TargetType="ContentControl">
            <Setter Property="HorizontalContentAlignment" Value="Stretch"/>
            <Setter Property="VerticalContentAlignment" Value="Stretch"/>
            <Setter Property="Template">
                <Setter.Value>
                    <ControlTemplate TargetType="ContentControl">
                        <Grid ClipToBounds="True">
                            <ui:NIRABackdropBorder Margin="-18"
                                                    BlurRadius="16"
                                                    BackdropOpacity="0.68"/>
                            <Border Background="{DynamicResource NIRAGlassTintBrush}"
                                    BorderBrush="{DynamicResource NIRAGlassBorderBrush}"
                                    BorderThickness="1"
                                    CornerRadius="20"
                                    SnapsToDevicePixels="True">
                                <ContentPresenter Margin="{TemplateBinding Padding}"
                                                  HorizontalAlignment="{TemplateBinding HorizontalContentAlignment}"
                                                  VerticalAlignment="{TemplateBinding VerticalContentAlignment}"/>
                            </Border>
                        </Grid>
                    </ControlTemplate>
                </Setter.Value>
            </Setter>
        </Style>

        <Style x:Key="GlassPanelStrongStyle" TargetType="ContentControl" BasedOn="{StaticResource GlassPanelStyle}">
            <Setter Property="Template">
                <Setter.Value>
                    <ControlTemplate TargetType="ContentControl">
                        <Grid ClipToBounds="True">
                            <ui:NIRABackdropBorder Margin="-20"
                                                    BlurRadius="18"
                                                    BackdropOpacity="0.72"/>
                            <Border Background="{DynamicResource NIRAGlassStrongTintBrush}"
                                    BorderBrush="{DynamicResource NIRAGlassBorderStrongBrush}"
                                    BorderThickness="1"
                                    CornerRadius="21"
                                    SnapsToDevicePixels="True">
                                <ContentPresenter Margin="{TemplateBinding Padding}"
                                                  HorizontalAlignment="{TemplateBinding HorizontalContentAlignment}"
                                                  VerticalAlignment="{TemplateBinding VerticalContentAlignment}"/>
                            </Border>
                        </Grid>
                    </ControlTemplate>
                </Setter.Value>
            </Setter>
        </Style>

        <Style x:Key="GlassActionButtonStyle" TargetType="Button">
            <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="{DynamicResource NIRATextBrush}"/>
            <Setter Property="Background" Value="{DynamicResource NIRAActivityCardBrush}"/>
            <Setter Property="BorderBrush" Value="{DynamicResource NIRAGlassBorderBrush}"/>
            <Setter Property="BorderThickness" Value="1"/>
            <Setter Property="Cursor" Value="Hand"/>
            <Setter Property="Padding" Value="0"/>
            <Setter Property="HorizontalContentAlignment" Value="Stretch"/>
            <Setter Property="VerticalContentAlignment" Value="Stretch"/>
            <Setter Property="Template">
                <Setter.Value>
                    <ControlTemplate TargetType="Button">
                        <Grid x:Name="ActionRoot" ClipToBounds="True">
                            <ui:NIRABackdropBorder x:Name="ActionBackdrop"
                                                  Margin="-14"
                                                  BlurRadius="14"
                                                  BackdropOpacity="0.82"/>
                            <Border x:Name="ActionGlass"
                                    Background="{TemplateBinding Background}"
                                    BorderBrush="{TemplateBinding BorderBrush}"
                                    BorderThickness="{TemplateBinding BorderThickness}"
                                    CornerRadius="18"
                                    SnapsToDevicePixels="True"/>
                            <Border x:Name="ActionHover"
                                    Background="{DynamicResource NIRACardHoverBrush}"
                                    CornerRadius="18"
                                    Opacity="0"/>
                            <ContentPresenter Margin="22,18,22,18"
                                              HorizontalAlignment="Stretch"
                                              VerticalAlignment="Stretch"/>
                        </Grid>
                        <ControlTemplate.Triggers>
                            <Trigger Property="IsMouseOver" Value="True">
                                <Setter TargetName="ActionHover" Property="Opacity" Value="1"/>
                                <Setter TargetName="ActionGlass" Property="BorderBrush" Value="{DynamicResource NIRAFocusBorderBrush}"/>
                            </Trigger>
                            <Trigger Property="IsPressed" Value="True">
                                <Setter TargetName="ActionRoot" Property="Opacity" Value="0.82"/>
                            </Trigger>
                        </ControlTemplate.Triggers>
                    </ControlTemplate>
                </Setter.Value>
            </Setter>
        </Style>

        <Style x:Key="GlassQuickButtonStyle" TargetType="Button" BasedOn="{StaticResource GlassActionButtonStyle}">
            <Setter Property="Height" Value="52"/>
            <Setter Property="Margin" Value="0,0,0,9"/>
            <Setter Property="Background" Value="{DynamicResource NIRAPanelBrush}"/>
            <Setter Property="Template">
                <Setter.Value>
                    <ControlTemplate TargetType="Button">
                        <Grid x:Name="QuickRoot" ClipToBounds="True">
                            <ui:NIRABackdropBorder Margin="-10" BlurRadius="10" BackdropOpacity="0.55"/>
                            <Border x:Name="QuickGlass"
                                    Background="{TemplateBinding Background}"
                                    BorderBrush="{TemplateBinding BorderBrush}"
                                    BorderThickness="{TemplateBinding BorderThickness}"
                                    CornerRadius="14"
                                    SnapsToDevicePixels="True" RenderTransformOrigin="0.5,0.5">
                                <Border.RenderTransform><ScaleTransform ScaleX="1" ScaleY="1"/></Border.RenderTransform>
                            </Border>
                            <Border x:Name="QuickHover"
                                    Background="{DynamicResource NIRACardHoverBrush}"
                                    CornerRadius="14"
                                    Opacity="0"/>
                            <ContentPresenter Margin="12,7"/>
                        </Grid>
                        <ControlTemplate.Triggers>
                            <Trigger Property="IsMouseOver" Value="True">
                                <Trigger.EnterActions><BeginStoryboard HandoffBehavior="SnapshotAndReplace"><Storyboard>
                                <DoubleAnimation Storyboard.TargetName="QuickHover" Storyboard.TargetProperty="Opacity" To="1" Duration="0:0:0.24" EasingFunction="{StaticResource NIRAMotionEase}"/>
                                </Storyboard></BeginStoryboard></Trigger.EnterActions>
                                <Trigger.ExitActions><BeginStoryboard HandoffBehavior="SnapshotAndReplace"><Storyboard>
                                <DoubleAnimation Storyboard.TargetName="QuickHover" Storyboard.TargetProperty="Opacity" To="0" Duration="0:0:0.27" EasingFunction="{StaticResource NIRAMotionEase}"/>
                                </Storyboard></BeginStoryboard></Trigger.ExitActions>
                                
                                <Setter TargetName="QuickGlass" Property="BorderBrush" Value="{DynamicResource NIRAFocusBorderBrush}"/>
                            </Trigger>
                                                    <EventTrigger RoutedEvent="Button.Click">
                                <BeginStoryboard HandoffBehavior="SnapshotAndReplace">
                                    <Storyboard>
                                        <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetName="QuickGlass" Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.RenderTransform).(ScaleTransform.ScaleX)">
                                            <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0" Value="0.955" EasingFunction="{StaticResource NIRAMotionPressEase}"/>
                                            <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.12" Value="1.022" EasingFunction="{StaticResource NIRAMotionEase}"/>
                                            <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.28" Value="1" EasingFunction="{StaticResource NIRAMotionEase}"/>
                                        </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                                        <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetName="QuickGlass" Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.RenderTransform).(ScaleTransform.ScaleY)">
                                            <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0" Value="0.955" EasingFunction="{StaticResource NIRAMotionPressEase}"/>
                                            <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.12" Value="1.022" EasingFunction="{StaticResource NIRAMotionEase}"/>
                                            <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.28" Value="1" EasingFunction="{StaticResource NIRAMotionEase}"/>
                                        </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                                    </Storyboard>
                                </BeginStoryboard>
                            </EventTrigger>
                        </ControlTemplate.Triggers>
                    </ControlTemplate>
                </Setter.Value>
            </Setter>
        </Style>

        <Style x:Key="TopActionButtonStyle" TargetType="Button">
            <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="{DynamicResource NIRATextBrush}"/>
            <Setter Property="Background" Value="{DynamicResource NIRAChipBrush}"/>
            <Setter Property="BorderBrush" Value="{DynamicResource NIRAGlassBorderBrush}"/>
            <Setter Property="BorderThickness" Value="1"/>
            <Setter Property="Height" Value="38"/>
            <Setter Property="MinWidth" Value="68"/>
            <Setter Property="Padding" Value="11,0"/>
            <Setter Property="Margin" Value="0,0,8,0"/>
            <Setter Property="FontSize" Value="10.8"/>
            <Setter Property="FontWeight" Value="SemiBold"/>
            <Setter Property="Cursor" Value="Hand"/>
            <Setter Property="Template">
                <Setter.Value>
                    <ControlTemplate TargetType="Button">
                        <Border x:Name="TopChrome"
                                Background="{TemplateBinding Background}"
                                BorderBrush="{TemplateBinding BorderBrush}"
                                BorderThickness="{TemplateBinding BorderThickness}"
                                CornerRadius="13"
                                SnapsToDevicePixels="True" RenderTransformOrigin="0.5,0.5">
                                <Border.RenderTransform><ScaleTransform ScaleX="1" ScaleY="1"/></Border.RenderTransform>
                            <ContentPresenter HorizontalAlignment="Center" VerticalAlignment="Center" Margin="2,0"/>
                        </Border>
                        <ControlTemplate.Triggers>
                            <Trigger Property="IsMouseOver" Value="True">
                                <Setter TargetName="TopChrome" Property="BorderBrush" Value="{DynamicResource NIRAFocusBorderBrush}"/>
                                <Setter TargetName="TopChrome" Property="Background" Value="{DynamicResource NIRACardHoverBrush}"/>
                            </Trigger>
                                                    <EventTrigger RoutedEvent="Button.Click">
                                <BeginStoryboard HandoffBehavior="SnapshotAndReplace">
                                    <Storyboard>
                                        <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetName="TopChrome" Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.RenderTransform).(ScaleTransform.ScaleX)">
                                            <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0" Value="0.955" EasingFunction="{StaticResource NIRAMotionPressEase}"/>
                                            <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.12" Value="1.022" EasingFunction="{StaticResource NIRAMotionEase}"/>
                                            <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.28" Value="1" EasingFunction="{StaticResource NIRAMotionEase}"/>
                                        </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                                        <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetName="TopChrome" Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.RenderTransform).(ScaleTransform.ScaleY)">
                                            <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0" Value="0.955" EasingFunction="{StaticResource NIRAMotionPressEase}"/>
                                            <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.12" Value="1.022" EasingFunction="{StaticResource NIRAMotionEase}"/>
                                            <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.28" Value="1" EasingFunction="{StaticResource NIRAMotionEase}"/>
                                        </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                                    </Storyboard>
                                </BeginStoryboard>
                            </EventTrigger>
                        </ControlTemplate.Triggers>
                    </ControlTemplate>
                </Setter.Value>
            </Setter>
        </Style>

        <Style x:Key="NavButtonStyle" TargetType="Button">
            <Setter Property="Background" Value="Transparent"/>
            <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="{DynamicResource NIRASecondaryBrush}"/>
            <Setter Property="BorderThickness" Value="0"/>
            <Setter Property="Padding" Value="11,0"/>
            <Setter Property="Margin" Value="3,0"/>
            <Setter Property="MinWidth" Value="68"/>
            <Setter Property="Height" Value="40"/>
            <Setter Property="FontSize" Value="12.5"/>
            <Setter Property="FontWeight" Value="SemiBold"/>
            <Setter Property="Cursor" Value="Hand"/>
            <Setter Property="Template">
                <Setter.Value>
                    <ControlTemplate TargetType="Button">
                        <Grid>
                            <Border x:Name="NavHover"
                                    Background="{DynamicResource NIRACardHoverBrush}"
                                    CornerRadius="13"
                                    Margin="2,6"
                                    Opacity="0"/>
                            <ContentPresenter HorizontalAlignment="Center" VerticalAlignment="Center" Margin="2,0"/>
                            <Border x:Name="NavLine"
                                    Height="2"
                                    Background="{DynamicResource NIRABlueBrush}"
                                    VerticalAlignment="Bottom"
                                    Margin="16,0"
                                    Opacity="0"/>
                        </Grid>
                        <ControlTemplate.Triggers>
                            <Trigger Property="IsMouseOver" Value="True">
                                <Trigger.EnterActions><BeginStoryboard HandoffBehavior="SnapshotAndReplace"><Storyboard>
                                <DoubleAnimation Storyboard.TargetName="NavHover" Storyboard.TargetProperty="Opacity" To="1" Duration="0:0:0.24" EasingFunction="{StaticResource NIRAMotionEase}"/>
                                </Storyboard></BeginStoryboard></Trigger.EnterActions>
                                <Trigger.ExitActions><BeginStoryboard HandoffBehavior="SnapshotAndReplace"><Storyboard>
                                <DoubleAnimation Storyboard.TargetName="NavHover" Storyboard.TargetProperty="Opacity" To="0" Duration="0:0:0.27" EasingFunction="{StaticResource NIRAMotionEase}"/>
                                </Storyboard></BeginStoryboard></Trigger.ExitActions>
                                
                                <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="{DynamicResource NIRATextBrush}"/>
                            </Trigger>
                            <Trigger Property="Tag" Value="ACTIVE">
                                <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="{DynamicResource NIRATextBrush}"/>
                                <Setter TargetName="NavLine" Property="Opacity" Value="1"/>
                                <Setter TargetName="NavHover" Property="Opacity" Value="1"/>
                            </Trigger>
                        </ControlTemplate.Triggers>
                    </ControlTemplate>
                </Setter.Value>
            </Setter>
        </Style>

        <Style x:Key="ThemeModeToggleStyle" TargetType="Button">
            <Setter Property="Width" Value="140"/>
            <Setter Property="Height" Value="38"/>
            <Setter Property="Margin" Value="0,0,8,0"/>
            <Setter Property="Background" Value="{DynamicResource NIRAChipBrush}"/>
            <Setter Property="BorderBrush" Value="{DynamicResource NIRAGlassBorderBrush}"/>
            <Setter Property="BorderThickness" Value="1"/>
            <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="{DynamicResource NIRATextBrush}"/>
            <Setter Property="Cursor" Value="Hand"/>
            <Setter Property="Template">
                <Setter.Value>
                    <ControlTemplate TargetType="Button">
                        <Grid>
                            <Border x:Name="ThemeChrome"
                                    Background="{TemplateBinding Background}"
                                    BorderBrush="{TemplateBinding BorderBrush}"
                                    BorderThickness="{TemplateBinding BorderThickness}"
                                    CornerRadius="14" RenderTransformOrigin="0.5,0.5">
                                <Border.RenderTransform><ScaleTransform ScaleX="1" ScaleY="1"/></Border.RenderTransform>
                            </Border>
                            <Border x:Name="ThemeGlow"
                                    Margin="1"
                                    CornerRadius="13"
                                    BorderBrush="{DynamicResource NIRAFocusBorderBrush}"
                                    BorderThickness="1"
                                    Opacity="0"/>
                            <ContentPresenter HorizontalAlignment="Stretch"
                                              VerticalAlignment="Stretch"/>
                        </Grid>
                        <ControlTemplate.Triggers>
                            <Trigger Property="IsMouseOver" Value="True">
                                <Setter TargetName="ThemeGlow" Property="Opacity" Value="0.8"/>
                                <Setter TargetName="ThemeChrome" Property="Background" Value="{DynamicResource NIRACardHoverBrush}"/>
                            </Trigger>
                            <Trigger Property="IsPressed" Value="True">
                                <Setter TargetName="ThemeChrome" Property="Opacity" Value="0.8"/>
                            </Trigger>
                                                    <EventTrigger RoutedEvent="Button.Click">
                                <BeginStoryboard HandoffBehavior="SnapshotAndReplace">
                                    <Storyboard>
                                        <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetName="ThemeChrome" Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.RenderTransform).(ScaleTransform.ScaleX)">
                                            <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0" Value="0.955" EasingFunction="{StaticResource NIRAMotionPressEase}"/>
                                            <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.12" Value="1.022" EasingFunction="{StaticResource NIRAMotionEase}"/>
                                            <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.28" Value="1" EasingFunction="{StaticResource NIRAMotionEase}"/>
                                        </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                                        <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetName="ThemeChrome" Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.RenderTransform).(ScaleTransform.ScaleY)">
                                            <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0" Value="0.955" EasingFunction="{StaticResource NIRAMotionPressEase}"/>
                                            <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.12" Value="1.022" EasingFunction="{StaticResource NIRAMotionEase}"/>
                                            <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.28" Value="1" EasingFunction="{StaticResource NIRAMotionEase}"/>
                                        </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                                    </Storyboard>
                                </BeginStoryboard>
                            </EventTrigger>
                        </ControlTemplate.Triggers>
                    </ControlTemplate>
                </Setter.Value>
            </Setter>
        </Style>

        <!-- =====================================================
             CHAT FOCUS / EDGE HANDLES

             These are intentionally not ordinary buttons. They behave like
             small pieces of NIRA's glass shell: thin, quiet edge handles that
             only brighten when the pointer approaches them.
             ===================================================== -->
        <Style x:Key="SidebarEdgeHandleBaseStyle" TargetType="Button">
            <Setter Property="Width" Value="22"/>
            <Setter Property="Height" Value="88"/>
            <Setter Property="Background" Value="#52071120"/>
            <Setter Property="BorderBrush" Value="#3B6E9CC7"/>
            <Setter Property="BorderThickness" Value="1"/>
            <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="{DynamicResource NIRASecondaryBrush}"/>
            <Setter Property="Cursor" Value="Hand"/>
            <Setter Property="HorizontalAlignment" Value="Center"/>
            <Setter Property="VerticalAlignment" Value="Center"/>
            <Setter Property="Panel.ZIndex" Value="30"/>
            <Setter Property="FocusVisualStyle" Value="{x:Null}"/>
            <Setter Property="Template">
                <Setter.Value>
                    <ControlTemplate TargetType="Button">
                        <Grid Width="{TemplateBinding Width}"
                              Height="{TemplateBinding Height}"
                              SnapsToDevicePixels="True">
                            <ui:NIRABackdropBorder Margin="-8"
                                                   BlurRadius="12"
                                                   BackdropOpacity="0.72"/>

                            <!-- soft outer bloom -->
                            <Border x:Name="HandleBloom"
                                    Margin="-2"
                                    CornerRadius="12"
                                    BorderBrush="#3672D9FF"
                                    BorderThickness="1"
                                    Opacity="0.10"/>

                            <!-- main glass capsule -->
                            <Border x:Name="HandleChrome"
                                    Margin="2,5"
                                    CornerRadius="9"
                                    Background="{TemplateBinding Background}"
                                    BorderBrush="{TemplateBinding BorderBrush}"
                                    BorderThickness="{TemplateBinding BorderThickness}" RenderTransformOrigin="0.5,0.5">
                                <Border.RenderTransform><ScaleTransform ScaleX="1" ScaleY="1"/></Border.RenderTransform>
                                <Grid>
                                    <!-- quiet cyan energy line -->
                                    <Border x:Name="EnergyLine"
                                            Width="1"
                                            Height="30"
                                            CornerRadius="1"
                                            HorizontalAlignment="Center"
                                            VerticalAlignment="Center"
                                            Background="#75A9EEFF"
                                            Opacity="0.34"/>

                                    <!-- tiny center node gives it a NIRA-instrument feel -->
                                    <Ellipse x:Name="CenterNode"
                                             Width="3.5"
                                             Height="3.5"
                                             Fill="{DynamicResource NIRACyanBrush}"
                                             HorizontalAlignment="Center"
                                             VerticalAlignment="Center"
                                             Opacity="0.72"/>

                                    <ContentPresenter HorizontalAlignment="Center"
                                                      VerticalAlignment="Center"/>
                                </Grid>
                            </Border>
                        </Grid>
                        <ControlTemplate.Triggers>
                            <Trigger Property="IsMouseOver" Value="True">
                                <Trigger.EnterActions><BeginStoryboard HandoffBehavior="SnapshotAndReplace"><Storyboard>
                                <DoubleAnimation Storyboard.TargetName="HandleBloom" Storyboard.TargetProperty="Opacity" To="0.72" Duration="0:0:0.24" EasingFunction="{StaticResource NIRAMotionEase}"/>
                                </Storyboard></BeginStoryboard></Trigger.EnterActions>
                                <Trigger.ExitActions><BeginStoryboard HandoffBehavior="SnapshotAndReplace"><Storyboard>
                                <DoubleAnimation Storyboard.TargetName="HandleBloom" Storyboard.TargetProperty="Opacity" To="0" Duration="0:0:0.27" EasingFunction="{StaticResource NIRAMotionEase}"/>
                                </Storyboard></BeginStoryboard></Trigger.ExitActions>
                                
                                <Setter TargetName="HandleChrome" Property="Background" Value="#9A0A1B30"/>
                                <Setter TargetName="HandleChrome" Property="BorderBrush" Value="{DynamicResource NIRAFocusBorderBrush}"/>
                                <Setter TargetName="EnergyLine" Property="Opacity" Value="0.74"/>
                                <Setter TargetName="CenterNode" Property="Opacity" Value="1"/>
                            </Trigger>
                            <Trigger Property="IsPressed" Value="True">
                                <Setter TargetName="HandleBloom" Property="Opacity" Value="0.35"/>
                            </Trigger>
                                                    <EventTrigger RoutedEvent="Button.Click">
                                <BeginStoryboard HandoffBehavior="SnapshotAndReplace"><Storyboard>
                                    <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetName="HandleChrome" Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.RenderTransform).(ScaleTransform.ScaleX)">
                                        <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0" Value="0.955" EasingFunction="{StaticResource NIRAMotionPressEase}"/>
                                        <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.12" Value="1.02" EasingFunction="{StaticResource NIRAMotionEase}"/>
                                        <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.28" Value="1" EasingFunction="{StaticResource NIRAMotionEase}"/>
                                    </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                                    <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetName="HandleChrome" Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.RenderTransform).(ScaleTransform.ScaleY)">
                                        <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0" Value="0.955" EasingFunction="{StaticResource NIRAMotionPressEase}"/>
                                        <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.12" Value="1.02" EasingFunction="{StaticResource NIRAMotionEase}"/>
                                        <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.28" Value="1" EasingFunction="{StaticResource NIRAMotionEase}"/>
                                    </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                                </Storyboard></BeginStoryboard>
                            </EventTrigger>
</ControlTemplate.Triggers>
                    </ControlTemplate>
                </Setter.Value>
            </Setter>
        </Style>

        <!-- Left edge: expanded points outward, collapsed points inward. -->
        <Style x:Key="LeftSidebarEdgeHandleStyle"
               TargetType="Button"
               BasedOn="{StaticResource SidebarEdgeHandleBaseStyle}">
            <Setter Property="Template">
                <Setter.Value>
                    <ControlTemplate TargetType="Button">
                        <Grid Width="{TemplateBinding Width}"
                              Height="{TemplateBinding Height}"
                              SnapsToDevicePixels="True">
                            <ui:NIRABackdropBorder Margin="-8"
                                                   BlurRadius="12"
                                                   BackdropOpacity="0.72"/>
                            <Border x:Name="HandleBloom"
                                    Margin="-2"
                                    CornerRadius="12"
                                    BorderBrush="#3672D9FF"
                                    BorderThickness="1"
                                    Opacity="0.10"/>
                            <Border x:Name="HandleChrome"
                                    Margin="2,5"
                                    CornerRadius="9"
                                    Background="{TemplateBinding Background}"
                                    BorderBrush="{TemplateBinding BorderBrush}"
                                    BorderThickness="{TemplateBinding BorderThickness}" RenderTransformOrigin="0.5,0.5">
                                <Border.RenderTransform><ScaleTransform ScaleX="1" ScaleY="1"/></Border.RenderTransform>
                                <Grid>
                                    <Border x:Name="EnergyLine"
                                            Width="1"
                                            Height="30"
                                            CornerRadius="1"
                                            HorizontalAlignment="Center"
                                            VerticalAlignment="Center"
                                            Background="#75A9EEFF"
                                            Opacity="0.34"/>
                                    <Ellipse x:Name="CenterNode"
                                             Width="3.5"
                                             Height="3.5"
                                             Fill="{DynamicResource NIRACyanBrush}"
                                             HorizontalAlignment="Center"
                                             VerticalAlignment="Center"
                                             Opacity="0.72"/>

                                    <Path x:Name="ChevronExpanded"
                                          Width="7"
                                          Height="12"
                                          Data="M 6,1 L 1,6 L 6,11"
                                          Stretch="Fill"
                                          Stroke="#BFD8F8"
                                          StrokeThickness="1.35"
                                          StrokeStartLineCap="Round"
                                          StrokeEndLineCap="Round"
                                          StrokeLineJoin="Round"
                                          Opacity="0.86"/>

                                    <Path x:Name="ChevronCollapsed"
                                          Width="7"
                                          Height="12"
                                          Data="M 1,1 L 6,6 L 1,11"
                                          Stretch="Fill"
                                          Stroke="#DDF7FF"
                                          StrokeThickness="1.35"
                                          StrokeStartLineCap="Round"
                                          StrokeEndLineCap="Round"
                                          StrokeLineJoin="Round"
                                          Visibility="Collapsed"
                                          Opacity="0.96"/>
                                </Grid>
                            </Border>
                        </Grid>
                        <ControlTemplate.Triggers>
                            <Trigger Property="Tag" Value="Collapsed">
                                <Setter TargetName="ChevronExpanded" Property="Visibility" Value="Collapsed"/>
                                <Setter TargetName="ChevronCollapsed" Property="Visibility" Value="Visible"/>
                                <Setter TargetName="HandleChrome" Property="Background" Value="#6808172A"/>
                                <Setter TargetName="HandleBloom" Property="Opacity" Value="0.28"/>
                                <Setter TargetName="CenterNode" Property="Opacity" Value="0.95"/>
                            </Trigger>
                            <Trigger Property="IsMouseOver" Value="True">
                                <Trigger.EnterActions><BeginStoryboard HandoffBehavior="SnapshotAndReplace"><Storyboard>
                                <DoubleAnimation Storyboard.TargetName="HandleBloom" Storyboard.TargetProperty="Opacity" To="0.78" Duration="0:0:0.24" EasingFunction="{StaticResource NIRAMotionEase}"/>
                                </Storyboard></BeginStoryboard></Trigger.EnterActions>
                                <Trigger.ExitActions><BeginStoryboard HandoffBehavior="SnapshotAndReplace"><Storyboard>
                                <DoubleAnimation Storyboard.TargetName="HandleBloom" Storyboard.TargetProperty="Opacity" To="0" Duration="0:0:0.27" EasingFunction="{StaticResource NIRAMotionEase}"/>
                                </Storyboard></BeginStoryboard></Trigger.ExitActions>
                                
                                <Setter TargetName="HandleChrome" Property="Background" Value="#9A0A1B30"/>
                                <Setter TargetName="HandleChrome" Property="BorderBrush" Value="{DynamicResource NIRAFocusBorderBrush}"/>
                                <Setter TargetName="EnergyLine" Property="Opacity" Value="0.76"/>
                                <Setter TargetName="CenterNode" Property="Opacity" Value="1"/>
                            </Trigger>
                                                    <EventTrigger RoutedEvent="Button.Click">
                                <BeginStoryboard HandoffBehavior="SnapshotAndReplace"><Storyboard>
                                    <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetName="HandleChrome" Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.RenderTransform).(ScaleTransform.ScaleX)">
                                        <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0" Value="0.955" EasingFunction="{StaticResource NIRAMotionPressEase}"/>
                                        <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.12" Value="1.02" EasingFunction="{StaticResource NIRAMotionEase}"/>
                                        <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.28" Value="1" EasingFunction="{StaticResource NIRAMotionEase}"/>
                                    </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                                    <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetName="HandleChrome" Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.RenderTransform).(ScaleTransform.ScaleY)">
                                        <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0" Value="0.955" EasingFunction="{StaticResource NIRAMotionPressEase}"/>
                                        <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.12" Value="1.02" EasingFunction="{StaticResource NIRAMotionEase}"/>
                                        <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.28" Value="1" EasingFunction="{StaticResource NIRAMotionEase}"/>
                                    </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                                </Storyboard></BeginStoryboard>
                            </EventTrigger>
</ControlTemplate.Triggers>
                    </ControlTemplate>
                </Setter.Value>
