```xml
<Window x:Class="NIRAAgent.UI.SettingsWindow"
        xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"
        xmlns:x="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml"
        xmlns:shell="clr-namespace:System.Windows.Shell;assembly=PresentationFramework"
        xmlns:ui="clr-namespace:NIRAAgent.UI"
        Title="NIRA Settings"
        Width="1080"
        Height="760"
        MinWidth="660"
        MinHeight="430"
        WindowStartupLocation="CenterOwner"
        WindowStyle="None"
        ResizeMode="CanResize"
        Background="{DynamicResource NIRABackgroundBrush}"
        Foreground="{DynamicResource NIRATextBrush}"
        FontFamily="Segoe UI Variable Text, Segoe UI"
        FontSize="13"
        SnapsToDevicePixels="True"
        UseLayoutRounding="True">

    <WindowChrome.WindowChrome>
        <shell:WindowChrome CaptionHeight="0"
                            ResizeBorderThickness="7"
                            CornerRadius="0"
                            GlassFrameThickness="0"
                            UseAeroCaptionButtons="False"/>
    </WindowChrome.WindowChrome>

    <Window.Resources>
        <Style x:Key="UtilityGlassCard" TargetType="ContentControl">
            <Setter Property="HorizontalContentAlignment" Value="Stretch"/>
            <Setter Property="VerticalContentAlignment" Value="Stretch"/>
            <Setter Property="Template">
                <Setter.Value>
                    <ControlTemplate TargetType="ContentControl">
                        <Grid ClipToBounds="True">
                            <ui:NIRAUtilityBackdropBorder Margin="-18" BlurRadius="14" BackdropOpacity="0.72"/>
                            <Border Background="{DynamicResource NIRAGlassTintBrush}"
                                    BorderBrush="{DynamicResource NIRAGlassBorderStrongBrush}"
                                    BorderThickness="1.4"
                                    CornerRadius="18">
                                <ContentPresenter Margin="{TemplateBinding Padding}"/>
                            </Border>
                        </Grid>
                    </ControlTemplate>
                </Setter.Value>
            </Setter>
        </Style>

        <Style x:Key="UtilityGlassCardStrong" TargetType="ContentControl" BasedOn="{StaticResource UtilityGlassCard}">
            <Setter Property="Template">
                <Setter.Value>
                    <ControlTemplate TargetType="ContentControl">
                        <Grid ClipToBounds="True">
                            <ui:NIRAUtilityBackdropBorder Margin="-20" BlurRadius="16" BackdropOpacity="0.78"/>
                            <Border Background="{DynamicResource NIRAGlassStrongTintBrush}"
                                    BorderBrush="{DynamicResource NIRAFocusBorderBrush}"
                                    BorderThickness="1.5"
                                    CornerRadius="19">
                                <ContentPresenter Margin="{TemplateBinding Padding}"/>
                            </Border>
                        </Grid>
                    </ControlTemplate>
                </Setter.Value>
            </Setter>
        </Style>

        <Style x:Key="SettingsSectionTitle" TargetType="TextBlock">
            <Setter Property="FontSize" Value="16"/>
            <Setter Property="FontWeight" Value="SemiBold"/>
            <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="{DynamicResource NIRATextBrush}"/>
        </Style>

        <Style x:Key="SettingsDescription" TargetType="TextBlock">
            <Setter Property="Margin" Value="0,4,0,0"/>
            <Setter Property="FontSize" Value="11"/>
            <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="{DynamicResource NIRASecondaryBrush}"/>
            <Setter Property="TextWrapping" Value="Wrap"/>
        </Style>

        <Style x:Key="WindowControl" TargetType="Button">
            <Setter Property="Width" Value="38"/>
            <Setter Property="Height" Value="38"/>
            <Setter Property="Margin" Value="3,0,0,0"/>
            <Setter Property="Background" Value="Transparent"/>
            <Setter Property="BorderBrush" Value="{DynamicResource NIRAGlassBorderBrush}"/>
            <Setter Property="BorderThickness" Value="1"/>
            <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="{DynamicResource NIRASecondaryBrush}"/>
            <Setter Property="Cursor" Value="Hand"/>
            <Setter Property="Template">
                <Setter.Value>
                    <ControlTemplate TargetType="Button">
                        <Border x:Name="Chrome" Background="{TemplateBinding Background}"
                                BorderBrush="{TemplateBinding BorderBrush}"
                                BorderThickness="{TemplateBinding BorderThickness}"
                                CornerRadius="11" RenderTransformOrigin="0.5,0.5">
                            <Border.RenderTransform><ScaleTransform ScaleX="1" ScaleY="1"/></Border.RenderTransform>
                            <ContentPresenter HorizontalAlignment="Center" VerticalAlignment="Center"/>
                        </Border>
                        <ControlTemplate.Triggers>
                            <Trigger Property="IsMouseOver" Value="True">
                                <Trigger.EnterActions><BeginStoryboard HandoffBehavior="SnapshotAndReplace"><Storyboard>
                                    <DoubleAnimation Storyboard.TargetName="Chrome" Storyboard.TargetProperty="Opacity" To="0.88" Duration="0:0:0.22">
                                        <DoubleAnimation.EasingFunction><CubicEase EasingMode="EaseOut"/></DoubleAnimation.EasingFunction>
                                    </DoubleAnimation>
                                </Storyboard></BeginStoryboard></Trigger.EnterActions>
                                <Trigger.ExitActions><BeginStoryboard HandoffBehavior="SnapshotAndReplace"><Storyboard>
                                    <DoubleAnimation Storyboard.TargetName="Chrome" Storyboard.TargetProperty="Opacity" To="1" Duration="0:0:0.26">
                                        <DoubleAnimation.EasingFunction><CubicEase EasingMode="EaseOut"/></DoubleAnimation.EasingFunction>
                                    </DoubleAnimation>
                                </Storyboard></BeginStoryboard></Trigger.ExitActions>
                                <Setter TargetName="Chrome" Property="Background" Value="{DynamicResource NIRACardHoverBrush}"/>
                                <Setter TargetName="Chrome" Property="BorderBrush" Value="{DynamicResource NIRAFocusBorderBrush}"/>
                                <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="{DynamicResource NIRATextBrush}"/>
                            </Trigger>
                            <EventTrigger RoutedEvent="Button.Click">
                                <BeginStoryboard HandoffBehavior="SnapshotAndReplace"><Storyboard>
                                    <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetName="Chrome" Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.RenderTransform).(ScaleTransform.ScaleX)">
                                        <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0" Value="0.955"/>
                                        <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.12" Value="1.022"/>
                                        <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.28" Value="1"/>
                                    </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                                    <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetName="Chrome" Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.RenderTransform).(ScaleTransform.ScaleY)">
                                        <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0" Value="0.955"/>
                                        <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.12" Value="1.022"/>
                                        <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.28" Value="1"/>
                                    </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                                </Storyboard></BeginStoryboard>
                            </EventTrigger>
                        </ControlTemplate.Triggers>
                    </ControlTemplate>
                </Setter.Value>
            </Setter>
        </Style>

        <!-- Actual navigation buttons: selected section is driven by SettingsNavigation_Click. -->
        <Style x:Key="SettingsNavigationButton" TargetType="Button">
            <Setter Property="Padding" Value="12,10"/>
            <Setter Property="Margin" Value="0,0,0,5"/>
            <Setter Property="MinHeight" Value="42"/>
            <Setter Property="HorizontalContentAlignment" Value="Stretch"/>
            <Setter Property="Background" Value="{DynamicResource NIRAChipBrush}"/>
            <Setter Property="BorderBrush" Value="{DynamicResource NIRAGlassBorderBrush}"/>
            <Setter Property="BorderThickness" Value="1"/>
            <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="{DynamicResource NIRATextBrush}"/>
            <Setter Property="Cursor" Value="Hand"/>
            <Setter Property="Template">
                <Setter.Value>
                    <ControlTemplate TargetType="Button">
                        <Border x:Name="NavChrome" CornerRadius="11"
                                Background="{TemplateBinding Background}"
                                BorderBrush="{TemplateBinding BorderBrush}"
                                BorderThickness="{TemplateBinding BorderThickness}"
                                Padding="{TemplateBinding Padding}"
                                RenderTransformOrigin="0.5,0.5">
                            <Border.RenderTransform><ScaleTransform/></Border.RenderTransform>
                            <ContentPresenter VerticalAlignment="Center"
                                              HorizontalAlignment="{TemplateBinding HorizontalContentAlignment}"/>
                        </Border>
                        <ControlTemplate.Triggers>
                            <Trigger Property="IsMouseOver" Value="True">
                                <Setter TargetName="NavChrome" Property="BorderBrush" Value="{DynamicResource NIRAFocusBorderBrush}"/>
                            </Trigger>
                            <Trigger Property="IsPressed" Value="True">
                                <Setter TargetName="NavChrome" Property="Opacity" Value="0.83"/>
                            </Trigger>
                            <EventTrigger RoutedEvent="Button.Click">
                                <BeginStoryboard><Storyboard>
                                    <DoubleAnimation Storyboard.TargetName="NavChrome" Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.RenderTransform).(ScaleTransform.ScaleX)" From="0.975" To="1" Duration="0:0:0.2"/>
                                    <DoubleAnimation Storyboard.TargetName="NavChrome" Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.RenderTransform).(ScaleTransform.ScaleY)" From="0.975" To="1" Duration="0:0:0.2"/>
                                </Storyboard></BeginStoryboard>
                            </EventTrigger>
                        </ControlTemplate.Triggers>
                    </ControlTemplate>
                </Setter.Value>
            </Setter>
        </Style>
    </Window.Resources>

    <Grid x:Name="RootShell">
        <Image x:Name="UtilityBackgroundEclipse"
               Source="Assets/nira-utility-eclipse.png"
               Stretch="UniformToFill"
               Opacity="1"
               IsHitTestVisible="False"/>
        <Image x:Name="UtilityBackgroundHalo"
               Source="Assets/nira-utility-halo.png"
               Stretch="UniformToFill"
               Opacity="0"
               IsHitTestVisible="False"/>
        <Rectangle Fill="{DynamicResource NIRABackdropVeilBrush}" Opacity="0.58" IsHitTestVisible="False"/>

        <Grid>
            <Grid.RowDefinitions>
                <RowDefinition Height="66"/>
                <RowDefinition Height="*"/>
                <RowDefinition Height="42"/>
            </Grid.RowDefinitions>

            <!-- TOP BAR -->
            <Grid Grid.Row="0" MouseLeftButtonDown="TitleBar_MouseLeftButtonDown">
                <ui:NIRAUtilityBackdropBorder Margin="0,-10,0,-6" BlurRadius="12" BackdropOpacity="0.60"/>
                <Border Background="{DynamicResource NIRATopBarTintBrush}"
                        BorderBrush="{DynamicResource NIRAGlassBorderBrush}"
                        BorderThickness="0,0,0,1"/>
                <Grid Margin="18,0,12,0">
                    <Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                        <ColumnDefinition Width="*"/>
                        <ColumnDefinition Width="Auto"/>
                    </Grid.ColumnDefinitions>

                    <StackPanel Orientation="Horizontal" VerticalAlignment="Center">
                        <Image Width="40" Height="40" Margin="0,0,13,0"
                               Source="Assets/Nira-Icon.png" Stretch="Uniform"
                               RenderOptions.BitmapScalingMode="HighQuality"/>
                        <StackPanel VerticalAlignment="Center">
                            <StackPanel Orientation="Horizontal">
                                <TextBlock Text="NIRA" FontFamily="Segoe UI Variable Display, Segoe UI" FontSize="22" FontWeight="SemiBold"/>

                    <StackPanel Grid.Column="1" Orientation="Horizontal" VerticalAlignment="Center">
                        <Button x:Name="ThemeToggleButton"

                                BorderBrush="{DynamicResource NIRAGlassBorderBrush}"
                                BorderThickness="1"
                                Foreground="{DynamicResource NIRATextBrush}"
                                Cursor="Hand"
                                Click="ThemeToggleButton_Click"
                                shell:WindowChrome.IsHitTestVisibleInChrome="True">
                            <Button.Template>
                                <ControlTemplate TargetType="Button">
                                    <Border x:Name="ThemeChrome" Background="{TemplateBinding Background}"
                                            BorderBrush="{TemplateBinding BorderBrush}"
                                            BorderThickness="{TemplateBinding BorderThickness}"
                                            CornerRadius="12">
                                        <Grid Margin="12,0">
                                            <Grid.ColumnDefinitions><ColumnDefinition Width="Auto"/><ColumnDefinition Width="*"/></Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                                            <Grid Width="27" Height="27" VerticalAlignment="Center">
                                                <Ellipse Width="25" Height="25" Stroke="{DynamicResource NIRASecondaryBrush}"
                                                         StrokeThickness="0.9" Opacity="0.50"/>
                                                <Path Width="27" Height="27" Stretch="Uniform"
                                                      Data="M2,17 C3,8 18,3 25,11 M2,17 C9,25 23,18 25,11"
                                                      Stroke="{DynamicResource NIRACyanBrush}" StrokeThickness="1.15"
                                                      Fill="Transparent" Opacity="0.9"/>
                                                <Ellipse Width="5" Height="5" Fill="{DynamicResource NIRACyanBrush}"/>
                                                <Path x:Name="SettingsThemeVector" Width="23" Height="23"
                                                      VerticalAlignment="Center" HorizontalAlignment="Center"
                                                      Stroke="{DynamicResource NIRABlueBrush}" StrokeThickness="1.8"
                                                      StrokeStartLineCap="Round" StrokeEndLineCap="Round"
                                                      StrokeLineJoin="Round" Fill="Transparent"
                                                      Data="M12,2.2 C17.6,2.2 21.8,6.5 21.8,12"/>
                                            </Grid>
                                            <StackPanel Grid.Column="1" Margin="8,0,0,0" VerticalAlignment="Center">
                                                <TextBlock Text="{Binding Content, RelativeSource={RelativeSource TemplatedParent}}" FontSize="9.5" FontWeight="SemiBold"/>
                                                <TextBlock Text="APPEARANCE" FontSize="7.5" Foreground="{DynamicResource NIRAMutedBrush}"/>
                                            </StackPanel>
                                        </Grid>
                                    </Border>
                                    <ControlTemplate.Triggers>
                                        <Trigger Property="IsMouseOver" Value="True">
                                            <Setter TargetName="ThemeChrome" Property="BorderBrush" Value="{DynamicResource NIRAFocusBorderBrush}"/>
                                            <Setter TargetName="ThemeChrome" Property="Background" Value="{DynamicResource NIRACardHoverBrush}"/>
                                        </Trigger>
                                    </ControlTemplate.Triggers>
                                </ControlTemplate>
                            </Button.Template>
                        </Button>

                        <Button Style="{StaticResource WindowControl}" Click="Minimize_Click" shell:WindowChrome.IsHitTestVisibleInChrome="True">
                            <Path Width="12" Height="1" Stroke="{Binding Foreground, RelativeSource={RelativeSource AncestorType=Button}}" StrokeThickness="1.4" Data="M0,0 L12,0"/>
                        </Button>
                        <Button Style="{StaticResource WindowControl}" Click="Close_Click" shell:WindowChrome.IsHitTestVisibleInChrome="True">
                            <Path Width="11" Height="11" Stroke="{Binding Foreground, RelativeSource={RelativeSource AncestorType=Button}}" StrokeThickness="1.4" Data="M1,1 L10,10 M10,1 L1,10"/>
                        </Button>
                    </StackPanel>
                </Grid>
            </Grid>

            <!-- BODY -->
            <Grid Grid.Row="1" Margin="20,18,20,16">
                <Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                    <ColumnDefinition Width="220"/>
                    <ColumnDefinition Width="18"/>
                    <ColumnDefinition Width="*"/>
                </Grid.ColumnDefinitions>

                <ContentControl Grid.Column="0" Style="{StaticResource UtilityGlassCardStrong}">
                    <Grid Margin="16">
                        <Grid.RowDefinitions><RowDefinition Height="Auto"/><RowDefinition Height="*"/><RowDefinition Height="Auto"/></Grid.RowDefinitions>
                        <StackPanel>
                            <TextBlock Text="CONTROL CENTER" FontSize="9" FontWeight="SemiBold" Foreground="{DynamicResource NIRACyanBrush}"/>
                            <TextBlock Text="Settings" Margin="0,5,0,0" FontSize="24" FontWeight="SemiBold"/>
                            <TextBlock Text="Everything here saves immediately."
                                       Margin="0,5,0,18" FontSize="10.5" TextWrapping="Wrap" Foreground="{DynamicResource NIRASecondaryBrush}"/>
                        </StackPanel>

                        <StackPanel Grid.Row="1">
                            <Button x:Name="AppearanceNavButton" Tag="Appearance" Style="{StaticResource SettingsNavigationButton}" Click="SettingsNavigation_Click">
                                <StackPanel Orientation="Horizontal" VerticalAlignment="Center">
                                <Path Width="16" Height="16" Stretch="Uniform" Data="M3,17 L9,3 L15,17 Z M17,4 L19,4 M17,8 L22,8 M17,12 L21,12"
                                      Stroke="{DynamicResource NIRABlueBrush}" StrokeThickness="1.5" Fill="Transparent"
                                      StrokeStartLineCap="Round" StrokeLineJoin="Round"/>
                                <TextBlock Text="Appearance" Margin="12,0,0,0" VerticalAlignment="Center" FontWeight="SemiBold"/>
                            </StackPanel>
                            </Button>
                            <Button x:Name="VoiceNavButton" Tag="Voice" Style="{StaticResource SettingsNavigationButton}" Click="SettingsNavigation_Click">
                                <StackPanel Orientation="Horizontal" VerticalAlignment="Center">
                                <Path Width="16" Height="16" Stretch="Uniform" Data="M9,3 A3,3 0 0 1 15,3 V12 A3,3 0 0 1 9,12 Z M5,10 V12 A7,7 0 0 0 19,12 V10 M12,19 V23 M8,23 H16"
                                      Stroke="{DynamicResource NIRABlueBrush}" StrokeThickness="1.5" Fill="Transparent"
                                      StrokeStartLineCap="Round" StrokeLineJoin="Round"/>

                        <Button Content="Reset to defaults" Width="150" HorizontalAlignment="Left" Style="{StaticResource NIRAButtonBaseStyle}" Click="Reset_Click"/>
                    </StackPanel>
                </ScrollViewer>

            <!-- STATUS -->
            <Grid Grid.Row="2">

                <Border Background="{DynamicResource NIRATopBarTintBrush}" BorderBrush="{DynamicResource NIRAGlassBorderBrush}" BorderThickness="0,1,0,0"/>

            </Grid>
        </Grid>

    </Grid>
</Window>
```

**File:** `NIRAAgent.UI\SettingsWindow.xaml.cs`

```csharp
using System.Windows;
using System.Windows.Controls;
using System.Windows.Input;
using System.Windows.Shapes;

using NIRAAgent.Settings;
using NIRAAgent.UI.Theming;

namespace NIRAAgent.UI;

public partial class SettingsWindow : Window
{
    private readonly NIRARuntimeSettingsService _settings;
    private readonly NIRAWorkAreaWindowGuard _workAreaGuard;
    private bool _loading;
    private bool _closed;
    private bool? _lastThemeGlyphWasHalo;
    private bool? _lastBackgroundWasHalo;

    public SettingsWindow(NIRARuntimeSettingsService settings)
    {
        InitializeComponent();

        _settings = settings ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(settings));
        _workAreaGuard = new NIRAWorkAreaWindowGuard(this, fitNormalWindow: true);

        VoiceEngineBox.ItemsSource = Enum.GetValues<NIRAVoiceEngineMode>();

        _settings.Changed += Settings_Changed;
        Closed += SettingsWindow_Closed;
        Loaded += SettingsWindow_Loaded;
        NIRAThemeManager.ThemeChanged += NIRAThemeManager_ThemeChanged;

        RefreshFromSettings();
        UpdateThemePresentation();
    }

    private void SettingsWindow_Loaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
    {
        NIRAMotion.AnimateEntrance(RootShell, distance: 12.0, durationMs: 300);
        UpdateThemePresentation();
    }

    private void NIRAThemeManager_ThemeChanged(NIRAThemeMode mode)
    {
        if (_closed || Dispatcher.HasShutdownStarted)
        {
            return;
        }

        if (!Dispatcher.CheckAccess())
        {
            Dispatcher.BeginInvoke(new Action(UpdateThemePresentation));
            return;
        }

        UpdateThemePresentation();
    }

    private void UpdateThemePresentation()
    {
        bool halo = NIRAThemeManager.CurrentMode == NIRAThemeMode.Halo;
        bool transition = _lastBackgroundWasHalo.HasValue &&
                          _lastBackgroundWasHalo.Value != halo;
        NIRAThemeGlyph.ApplyBackdrop(UtilityBackgroundEclipse, UtilityBackgroundHalo,
            halo, transition);
        _lastBackgroundWasHalo = halo;
        ThemeToggleButton.Content = halo ? "HALO" : "ECLIPSE";
        CurrentThemeText.Text = halo ? "HALO" : "ECLIPSE";

        ThemeToggleButton.ApplyTemplate();
        if (ThemeToggleButton.Template.FindName("SettingsThemeVector", ThemeToggleButton) is Path icon)
        {
            bool changed = _lastThemeGlyphWasHalo.HasValue &&
                           _lastThemeGlyphWasHalo.Value != halo;
            NIRAThemeGlyph.Apply(icon, halo, changed);
        }
        _lastThemeGlyphWasHalo = halo;
    }

    private void ThemeToggleButton_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
    {
        NIRAThemeManager.ApplyTheme(
            NIRAThemeManager.CurrentMode == NIRAThemeMode.Halo
                ? NIRAThemeMode.Eclipse
                : NIRAThemeMode.Halo);
    }

    private void Settings_Changed(NIRARuntimeSettings before, NIRARuntimeSettings after)
    {
        if (_closed || Dispatcher.HasShutdownStarted)
        {
            return;
        }

        if (!Dispatcher.CheckAccess())
        {
            Dispatcher.BeginInvoke(new Action(RefreshFromSettings));
            return;
        }

        RefreshFromSettings();
    }

    private void RefreshFromSettings()
    {
        _loading = true;

        try
        {
            NIRARuntimeSettings current = _settings.Current;

            VoiceEnabledCheck.IsChecked = current.VoiceEnabled;
            BackgroundVoiceCheck.IsChecked = current.SpeakBackgroundUpdates;
            BackgroundVoiceCheck.IsEnabled = current.VoiceEnabled;
            VoiceEngineBox.SelectedItem = current.VoiceEngine;
            VoiceEngineBox.IsEnabled = current.VoiceEnabled;
            VoiceVolumeSlider.Value = current.VoiceVolume * 100.0;
            VoiceVolumeSlider.IsEnabled = current.VoiceEnabled;
            VoiceVolumeText.Text = $"{Math.Round(current.VoiceVolume * 100.0):0}%";

            DesktopPresenceCheck.IsChecked = current.DesktopPresenceEnabled;
            IdleBehaviorCheck.IsChecked = current.IdleBehaviorEnabled;
            IdleAwarenessCheck.IsChecked = current.UserIdleAwarenessEnabled;
            IdleFadeCheck.IsChecked = current.FadeDesktopPresenceWhenIdle;

            bool idleControlsEnabled = current.IdleBehaviorEnabled;
            IdleAwarenessCheck.IsEnabled = idleControlsEnabled;
            IdleFadeCheck.IsEnabled = idleControlsEnabled && current.DesktopPresenceEnabled;
            IdleFadeDelayBox.IsEnabled = idleControlsEnabled
                && current.DesktopPresenceEnabled
                && current.FadeDesktopPresenceWhenIdle;

            SelectIdleFadeDelay(current.IdleFadeDelaySeconds);

            ProactiveCompanionCheck.IsChecked = current.ProactiveCompanionEnabled;
            PcContextReactionsCheck.IsChecked = current.PcContextReactionsEnabled;
            PermissionNotificationsCheck.IsChecked = current.PermissionNotificationsEnabled;
            CardParticlesCheck.IsChecked = current.WorkCardParticleTransitionsEnabled;
            ShowBranchesCheck.IsChecked = current.ShowBranchActivityInSidebar;
            ShowCommitmentsCheck.IsChecked = current.ShowCommitmentActivityInSidebar;

            StatusText.Text = "Changes are saved automatically";
        }
        finally
        {
            _loading = false;
        }
    }

    private void SelectIdleFadeDelay(int seconds)
    {
        ComboBoxItem? closest = null;
        int smallestDifference = int.MaxValue;

        foreach (object item in IdleFadeDelayBox.Items)
        {
            if (item is not ComboBoxItem comboItem ||
                !int.TryParse(comboItem.Tag?.ToString(), out int candidate))
            {
                continue;
            }

            int difference = Math.Abs(candidate - seconds);

            if (difference < smallestDifference)
            {
                smallestDifference = difference;
                closest = comboItem;
            }
        }

        IdleFadeDelayBox.SelectedItem = closest;
    }

    private void VoiceEnabled_Changed(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
    {
        if (_loading) return;
        _settings.SetVoiceEnabled(VoiceEnabledCheck.IsChecked == true);
    }

    private void BackgroundVoice_Changed(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
    {
        if (_loading) return;
        _settings.SetSpeakBackgroundUpdates(BackgroundVoiceCheck.IsChecked == true);
    }

    private void VoiceEngine_Changed(object sender, SelectionChangedEventArgs e)
    {
        if (_loading || VoiceEngineBox.SelectedItem is not NIRAVoiceEngineMode mode) return;
        _settings.SetVoiceEngine(mode);
    }

    private void VoiceVolume_Changed(object sender, RoutedPropertyChangedEventArgs<double> e)
    {
        if (_loading) return;

        double normalized = Math.Clamp(VoiceVolumeSlider.Value / 100.0, 0.0, 1.0);
        VoiceVolumeText.Text = $"{Math.Round(normalized * 100.0):0}%";
        _settings.SetVoiceVolume(normalized);
    }

    private void DesktopPresence_Changed(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
    {
        if (_loading) return;
        _settings.SetDesktopPresenceEnabled(DesktopPresenceCheck.IsChecked == true);
    }

    private void IdleBehavior_Changed(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
    {
        if (_loading) return;
        _settings.SetIdleBehaviorEnabled(IdleBehaviorCheck.IsChecked == true);
    }

    private void IdleAwareness_Changed(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
    {
        if (_loading) return;
        _settings.SetUserIdleAwarenessEnabled(IdleAwarenessCheck.IsChecked == true);
    }

    private void IdleFade_Changed(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
    {
        if (_loading) return;
        _settings.SetFadeDesktopPresenceWhenIdle(IdleFadeCheck.IsChecked == true);
    }

    private void IdleFadeDelay_Changed(object sender, SelectionChangedEventArgs e)
    {
        if (_loading || IdleFadeDelayBox.SelectedItem is not ComboBoxItem item) return;

        if (int.TryParse(item.Tag?.ToString(), out int seconds))
        {
            _settings.SetIdleFadeDelaySeconds(seconds);
        }
    }

    private void ProactiveCompanion_Changed(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
    {
        if (_loading) return;
        _settings.SetProactiveCompanionEnabled(ProactiveCompanionCheck.IsChecked == true);
    }

    private void PcContextReactions_Changed(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
    {
        if (_loading) return;
        _settings.SetPcContextReactionsEnabled(PcContextReactionsCheck.IsChecked == true);
    }

    private void PermissionNotifications_Changed(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
    {
        if (_loading) return;
        _settings.SetPermissionNotificationsEnabled(PermissionNotificationsCheck.IsChecked == true);
    }

    private void CardParticles_Changed(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
    {
        if (_loading) return;
        _settings.SetWorkCardParticleTransitionsEnabled(CardParticlesCheck.IsChecked == true);
    }

    private void ShowBranches_Changed(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
    {
        if (_loading) return;
        _settings.SetShowBranchActivityInSidebar(ShowBranchesCheck.IsChecked == true);
    }

    private void ShowCommitments_Changed(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
    {
        if (_loading) return;
        _settings.SetShowCommitmentActivityInSidebar(ShowCommitmentsCheck.IsChecked == true);
    }

    private void Reset_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
    {
        _settings.ResetToDefaults();
        StatusText.Text = "Settings reset to defaults";
    }

    private void TitleBar_MouseLeftButtonDown(object sender, MouseButtonEventArgs e)
    {
        if (e.LeftButton == MouseButtonState.Pressed)
        {
            DragMove();
        }
    }

    private void Minimize_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e) =>
        WindowState = WindowState.Minimized;

    private void Close_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e) =>
        Close();

    // The sidebar is real section navigation (not passive decorative Borders).
    // All headings are in the one live settings scroll viewer: no duplicate settings state.
    private void SettingsNavigation_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
    {
        if (sender is not Button button || button.Tag is not string section)
            return;

        FrameworkElement target = section switch
        {
            "Appearance" => AppearanceSection,
            "Voice" => VoiceSection,
            "Presence" => PresenceSection,
            "Attention" => AttentionSection,
            "Notifications" => NotificationsSection,
            "Interface" => InterfaceSection,
            _ => AppearanceSection
        };

        if (SettingsContentPanel.IsLoaded && target.IsLoaded)
        {
            double offset = target.TransformToAncestor(SettingsContentPanel)
                .Transform(new Point(0, 0)).Y;
            SettingsContentScroll.ScrollToVerticalOffset(
                Math.Clamp(offset - 6, 0, SettingsContentScroll.ScrollableHeight));
        }
        else
        {
            target.BringIntoView();
        }

        foreach (Button nav in new[] { AppearanceNavButton, VoiceNavButton,
            PresenceNavButton, AttentionNavButton, NotificationsNavButton, InterfaceNavButton })
        {
            bool selected = ReferenceEquals(nav, button);
            nav.SetResourceReference(Control.BackgroundProperty,
                selected ? "NIRACardHoverBrush" : "NIRAChipBrush");
            nav.SetResourceReference(Control.BorderBrushProperty,
                selected ? "NIRAFocusBorderBrush" : "NIRAGlassBorderBrush");
            nav.FontWeight = selected ? FontWeights.SemiBold : FontWeights.Normal;
        }
    }

    private void SettingsWindow_Closed(object? sender, EventArgs e)
    {
        _closed = true;
        _settings.Changed -= Settings_Changed;
        NIRAThemeManager.ThemeChanged -= NIRAThemeManager_ThemeChanged;
        Loaded -= SettingsWindow_Loaded;
        _workAreaGuard.Dispose();
        Closed -= SettingsWindow_Closed;
    }
}
```

```xml
<ResourceDictionary xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"
                    xmlns:x="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml">

    <!-- =========================================================
         ELVARA / VEIL CORE PALETTE
         Default mode: ECLIPSE (dark)
         Updated at runtime by NIRAThemeManager for HALO/ECLIPSE.
         ========================================================= -->

    <Color x:Key="NIRABg0">#050817</Color>
    <Color x:Key="NIRABg1">#0B1230</Color>
    <Color x:Key="NIRAPanel">#E00A132F</Color>
    <Color x:Key="NIRAPanelStrong">#F0101D43</Color>
    <Color x:Key="NIRAText">#EAF2FF</Color>
    <Color x:Key="NIRATextSecondary">#9AA7C4</Color>
    <Color x:Key="NIRATextMuted">#6B7896</Color>
    <Color x:Key="NIRACyan">#00E5FF</Color>
    <Color x:Key="NIRABlue">#1468FF</Color>
    <Color x:Key="NIRAViolet">#8B5CFF</Color>
    <Color x:Key="NIRAGreen">#31D39A</Color>
    <Color x:Key="NIRARed">#FF5B6E</Color>

    <SolidColorBrush x:Key="NIRABackgroundBrush" Color="#050817"/>
    <SolidColorBrush x:Key="NIRAShellBackgroundBrush" Color="#081022"/>
    <SolidColorBrush x:Key="NIRAPanelBrush" Color="#C20B1226"/>
    <SolidColorBrush x:Key="NIRAPanelStrongBrush" Color="#D6111D38"/>
    <SolidColorBrush x:Key="NIRASurfaceBrush" Color="#CC0C1738"/>
    <SolidColorBrush x:Key="NIRASurfaceAltBrush" Color="#A0112149"/>
    <SolidColorBrush x:Key="NIRAElevatedBrush" Color="#F0132756"/>
    <SolidColorBrush x:Key="NIRABorderBrush" Color="#345A86C2"/>
    <SolidColorBrush x:Key="NIRABorderStrongBrush" Color="#6086B6FF"/>
    <SolidColorBrush x:Key="NIRAFocusBorderBrush" Color="#7DD7FFFF"/>
    <SolidColorBrush x:Key="NIRATextBrush" Color="#EAF2FF"/>
    <SolidColorBrush x:Key="NIRASecondaryBrush" Color="#9AA7C4"/>
    <SolidColorBrush x:Key="NIRAMutedBrush" Color="#6B7896"/>
    <SolidColorBrush x:Key="NIRACyanBrush" Color="#00E5FF"/>
    <SolidColorBrush x:Key="NIRABlueBrush" Color="#1468FF"/>
    <SolidColorBrush x:Key="NIRAVioletBrush" Color="#8B5CFF"/>
    <SolidColorBrush x:Key="NIRAGreenBrush" Color="#31D39A"/>
    <SolidColorBrush x:Key="NIRARedBrush" Color="#FF5B6E"/>
    <SolidColorBrush x:Key="NIRASelectionBrush" Color="#402C74FF"/>
    <SolidColorBrush x:Key="NIRAIconBrush" Color="#BFD7FF"/>
```

## 63. `NIRAAgent.UI\Theming\NIRAMotion.cs`

**File:** `NIRAAgent.UI\Theming\NIRAMotion.cs`

```csharp
using System.Windows;
using System.Windows.Media;
using System.Windows.Media.Animation;

namespace NIRAAgent.UI.Theming;

public static class NIRAMotion
{
    public static void AnimateEntrance(
        FrameworkElement element,
        double distance = 12.0,
        int durationMs = 280,
        int delayMs = 0)
    {
        if (element == null)
        {
            return;
        }

        element.Opacity = 0.0;

        TranslateTransform translate = element.RenderTransform as TranslateTransform
            ?? new TranslateTransform();

        element.RenderTransform = translate;

        translate.Y = distance;

        element.BeginAnimation(
            UIElement.OpacityProperty,
            new DoubleAnimation(
                0.0,
                1.0,
                TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(durationMs))
            {
                BeginTime = TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(delayMs),
                EasingFunction = new CubicEase { EasingMode = EasingMode.EaseOut }
            });

        translate.BeginAnimation(
            TranslateTransform.YProperty,
            new DoubleAnimation(
                distance,
                0.0,
                TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(durationMs))
            {
                BeginTime = TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(delayMs),
                EasingFunction = new CubicEase { EasingMode = EasingMode.EaseOut }
            });
    }

    public static void BeginPulseOpacity(
        UIElement element,
        double fromOpacity,
        double toOpacity,
        double seconds,
        int delayMs = 0)
    {
        if (element == null)
        {
            return;
        }

        element.BeginAnimation(
            UIElement.OpacityProperty,
            new DoubleAnimation(
                fromOpacity,
                toOpacity,
                TimeSpan.FromSeconds(seconds))
            {
                BeginTime = TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(delayMs),
                AutoReverse = true,
                RepeatBehavior = RepeatBehavior.Forever,
                EasingFunction = new SineEase { EasingMode = EasingMode.EaseInOut }
            });
    }

    public static void BeginBreathingScale(
        FrameworkElement element,
        double fromScale,
        double toScale,
        double seconds,
        int delayMs = 0)
    {
        if (element == null)
        {
            return;
        }

        element.RenderTransformOrigin = new Point(0.5, 0.5);

        ScaleTransform scale = element.RenderTransform as ScaleTransform
            ?? new ScaleTransform(1.0, 1.0);

        element.RenderTransform = scale;

        DoubleAnimation animation = new(
            fromScale,
            toScale,
            TimeSpan.FromSeconds(seconds))
        {
            BeginTime = TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(delayMs),
            AutoReverse = true,
            RepeatBehavior = RepeatBehavior.Forever,
            EasingFunction = new SineEase { EasingMode = EasingMode.EaseInOut }
        };

        scale.BeginAnimation(ScaleTransform.ScaleXProperty, animation);
        scale.BeginAnimation(ScaleTransform.ScaleYProperty, animation);
    }
}
```

## 64. `NIRAAgent.UI\Theming\NIRAThemeGlyph.cs`

**File:** `NIRAAgent.UI\Theming\NIRAThemeGlyph.cs`

```csharp
using System.Windows;
using System.Windows.Controls;
using System.Windows.Media;
using System.Windows.Media.Animation;
using System.Windows.Shapes;

namespace NIRAAgent.UI.Theming;

/// <summary>
/// The same crisp, font-independent Halo / Eclipse glyph is used in
/// the main window and Settings. Only appearance is changed here.
/// </summary>
internal static class NIRAThemeGlyph
{
    // Orbital phase marks. The matching concentric-ring housing is drawn by
    // the main-window and Settings XAML; these marks are the moving accents.
    // No sun rays, font icons, or generic crescent placeholder.
    private static readonly Geometry HaloGlyph = Geometry.Parse(
        "M12,2.2 C17.6,2.2 21.8,6.5 21.8,12 " +
        "C21.8,17.5 17.6,21.8 12,21.8 " +
        "M12,21.8 C6.5,21.8 2.2,17.5 2.2,12 " +
        "M7.2,12 L16.8,12 M12,7.2 L12,16.8");

    private static readonly Geometry EclipseGlyph = Geometry.Parse(
        "M12,2.2 C17.6,2.2 21.8,6.5 21.8,12 " +
        "C21.8,17.5 17.6,21.8 12,21.8 " +
        "M12,21.8 C6.5,21.8 2.2,17.5 2.2,12 " +
        "M7.1,8.4 C8.8,15.0 15.0,17.1 17.5,16.4 " +
        "M7.1,8.4 C10.2,8.8 15.8,8.3 17.5,16.4");

    public static void ApplyBackdrop(Image eclipse, Image haloLayer, bool halo, bool animate)
    {
        double eclipseTarget = halo ? 0.0 : 1.0;
        double haloTarget = halo ? 1.0 : 0.0;
        if (!animate)
        {
            eclipse.BeginAnimation(UIElement.OpacityProperty, null);
            haloLayer.BeginAnimation(UIElement.OpacityProperty, null);
            eclipse.Opacity = eclipseTarget;
            haloLayer.Opacity = haloTarget;
            return;
        }

        var easing = new SineEase { EasingMode = EasingMode.EaseInOut };
        var duration = TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(390);
        eclipse.BeginAnimation(UIElement.OpacityProperty,
            new DoubleAnimation(eclipse.Opacity, eclipseTarget, duration)
            {
                EasingFunction = easing
            }, HandoffBehavior.SnapshotAndReplace);
        haloLayer.BeginAnimation(UIElement.OpacityProperty,
            new DoubleAnimation(haloLayer.Opacity, haloTarget, duration)
            {
                EasingFunction = easing
            }, HandoffBehavior.SnapshotAndReplace);
    }

    public static void Apply(Path icon, bool halo, bool animate)
    {
        icon.BeginAnimation(UIElement.OpacityProperty, null);
        icon.Data = halo ? HaloGlyph : EclipseGlyph;
        icon.Opacity = 1.0;
        icon.RenderTransformOrigin = new Point(0.5, 0.5);

        RotateTransform rotation = icon.RenderTransform as RotateTransform
            ?? new RotateTransform();
        icon.RenderTransform = rotation;
        rotation.BeginAnimation(RotateTransform.AngleProperty, null);
        rotation.Angle = 0;
        if (!animate) return;

        var easing = new CubicEase { EasingMode = EasingMode.EaseOut };
        icon.BeginAnimation(UIElement.OpacityProperty,
            new DoubleAnimation(0.24, 1.0, TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(360))
            {
                EasingFunction = easing
            }, HandoffBehavior.SnapshotAndReplace);
        rotation.BeginAnimation(RotateTransform.AngleProperty,
            new DoubleAnimation(halo ? -60.0 : 60.0, 0.0,
                TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(490))
            {
                EasingFunction = easing
            }, HandoffBehavior.SnapshotAndReplace);
    }
}
```

## 65. `NIRAAgent.UI\Theming\NIRAThemeManager.cs`

**File:** `NIRAAgent.UI\Theming\NIRAThemeManager.cs`

```csharp
using System.IO;
using System.Windows;
using System.Windows.Media;

namespace NIRAAgent.UI.Theming;

public enum NIRAThemeMode
{
    Eclipse,
    Halo
}

public static class NIRAThemeManager
{
    private static readonly string ThemeFilePath = Path.Combine(
        Environment.GetFolderPath(Environment.SpecialFolder.LocalApplicationData),
        "NIRAAgent",
        "ui-theme.txt");

    public static NIRAThemeMode CurrentMode { get; private set; } = NIRAThemeMode.Eclipse;

    public static event Action<NIRAThemeMode>? ThemeChanged;

    public static void Initialize()
    {
        Directory.CreateDirectory(Path.GetDirectoryName(ThemeFilePath)!);
        ApplyTheme(LoadSavedMode(), persist: false);
    }

    public static void ApplyTheme(NIRAThemeMode mode, bool persist = true)
    {
        CurrentMode = mode;

        if (Application.Current is not null)
        {
            if (mode == NIRAThemeMode.Halo)
            {
                ApplyHalo();
            }
            else
            {
                ApplyEclipse();
            }
        }

        if (persist)
        {
            try
            {
                File.WriteAllText(ThemeFilePath, mode.ToString());
            }
            catch
            {
                // Theme persistence should never prevent NIRA from starting.
            }
        }

        ThemeChanged?.Invoke(mode);
    }

    private static NIRAThemeMode LoadSavedMode()
    {
        try
        {
            if (File.Exists(ThemeFilePath) &&
                Enum.TryParse(File.ReadAllText(ThemeFilePath).Trim(), true, out NIRAThemeMode mode))
            {
                return mode;
            }
        }
        catch
        {
            // Ignore theme persistence failures and fall back to default.
        }

        return NIRAThemeMode.Eclipse;
    }

    private static void ApplyEclipse()
    {
        SetBrush("NIRABackgroundBrush", "#050817");
        SetBrush("NIRAShellBackgroundBrush", "#081022");
        SetBrush("NIRAPanelBrush", "#C20B1226");
        SetBrush("NIRAPanelStrongBrush", "#D6111D38");
        SetBrush("NIRASurfaceBrush", "#CC0C1738");
        SetBrush("NIRASurfaceAltBrush", "#A0112149");
        SetBrush("NIRAElevatedBrush", "#F0132756");
        SetBrush("NIRABorderBrush", "#345A86C2");
        SetBrush("NIRABorderStrongBrush", "#6086B6FF");

    private static void SetBrush(string key, string colorHex)
    {
        ResourceDictionary? owner = FindOwningDictionary(key);

        if (owner is null)
        {
            return;
        }

        Color color = (Color)ColorConverter.ConvertFromString(colorHex);

        // WPF may freeze Freezable resources loaded from XAML. Never mutate the
        // existing brush in place. Replace the resource with a fresh instance.
        owner[key] = new SolidColorBrush(color);
    }

    private static void SetLinearGradient(string key, params string[] colors)
    {
        ResourceDictionary? owner = FindOwningDictionary(key);

        if (owner is null || owner[key] is not LinearGradientBrush current)
        {
            return;
        }

        LinearGradientBrush replacement = current.CloneCurrentValue();

        for (int i = 0; i < replacement.GradientStops.Count && i < colors.Length; i++)
        {
            replacement.GradientStops[i].Color =
                (Color)ColorConverter.ConvertFromString(colors[i]);
        }

        owner[key] = replacement;
    }

    private static void SetRadialGradient(string key, string centerColor, string midColor)
    {
        ResourceDictionary? owner = FindOwningDictionary(key);

        if (owner is null ||
            owner[key] is not RadialGradientBrush current ||
            current.GradientStops.Count < 2)
        {
            return;
        }

        RadialGradientBrush replacement = current.CloneCurrentValue();

        replacement.GradientStops[0].Color =
            (Color)ColorConverter.ConvertFromString(centerColor);

        replacement.GradientStops[1].Color =
            (Color)ColorConverter.ConvertFromString(midColor);

        owner[key] = replacement;
    }

    private static ResourceDictionary? FindOwningDictionary(string key)
    {
        ResourceDictionary? root = Application.Current?.Resources;

        if (root is null)
        {
            return null;
        }

        return FindOwningDictionary(root, key);
    }

    private static ResourceDictionary? FindOwningDictionary(
        ResourceDictionary dictionary,
        object key)
    {
        // Later merged dictionaries have higher lookup precedence in WPF.
        for (int i = dictionary.MergedDictionaries.Count - 1; i >= 0; i--)
        {
            ResourceDictionary? found =
                FindOwningDictionary(dictionary.MergedDictionaries[i], key);

            if (found is not null)
            {
                return found;
            }
        }

        return dictionary.Contains(key)
            ? dictionary
            : null;
    }
}
```

```csharp
using System;
using System.Diagnostics;
using System.Windows;
using System.Windows.Media;

namespace NIRAAgent.UI.Typing;

public enum NIRAImageTileSkin
{
    Original,
    AetherGlass,
    PrismVeil,
    LumenPanel,
    AuroraMatte
}

/// <summary>
/// NIRA D4 + D1: the original 7x5 pixel cascade and a traveling spectrum wave
/// are applied to the SAME tiles. Each tile has an independently staggered D4
/// cycle, so there is no synchronized full-grid disappearance or sudden reset.
/// This control is shared without modification by Chat and the offline Image UI Lab.
/// </summary>
public sealed class NIRAImageCreationIndicator : FrameworkElement
{
    private const int Columns = 7;
    private const int Rows = 5;
    private const double CascadeSeconds = 4.4; // D4 original reference
    private const double SpectrumSeconds = 2.3; // D1 original reference
    private const double FrameIntervalSeconds = 1.0 / 30.0;

    // Purely visual setting. The timing and sample motion stay identical for
    // all skins. Production now uses Prism Veil as the selected permanent tile skin.
    public static readonly DependencyProperty TileSkinProperty = DependencyProperty.Register(
        nameof(TileSkin), typeof(NIRAImageTileSkin), typeof(NIRAImageCreationIndicator),
        new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(NIRAImageTileSkin.PrismVeil,
            FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.AffectsRender));

    public NIRAImageTileSkin TileSkin
    {
        get => (NIRAImageTileSkin)GetValue(TileSkinProperty);
        set => SetValue(TileSkinProperty, value);
    }

    private static readonly (Color Start, Color End)[] Palette =
    {
        (Rgb(0x6D, 0xE0, 0xF7), Rgb(0x55, 0x9A, 0xEA)),
        (Rgb(0xAD, 0xBC, 0xF5), Rgb(0x80, 0x6E, 0xE7)),
        (Rgb(0xFF, 0xD8, 0xA2), Rgb(0xE8, 0xA0, 0xB9)),
        (Rgb(0x9B, 0xE7, 0xF8), Rgb(0x70, 0xBD, 0xDE)),
        (Rgb(0xA5, 0xAD, 0xEF), Rgb(0xCF, 0xBA, 0xF5)),
        (Rgb(0xE3, 0xC7, 0xFF), Rgb(0x93, 0xA4, 0xEE)),
        (Rgb(0x5F, 0xC2, 0xF2), Rgb(0x55, 0xA5, 0xDF)),
        (Rgb(0xFF, 0xD9, 0x9B), Rgb(0xFF, 0xB6, 0xBB)),
        (Rgb(0x86, 0xBD, 0xF2), Rgb(0x8E, 0x8C, 0xEA)),
        (Rgb(0x95, 0xEA, 0xDD), Rgb(0x76, 0xB3, 0xEC))
    };

    private static readonly Brush[] TilePaints = BuildTileBrushes();
    private static readonly Brush[] TileShadows = BuildTileShadows();
    private static readonly Brush[] WavePaints = BuildWaveBrushes();
    private static readonly Pen TileOutline = MakeOutline();
    private static readonly Brush TileShine = Freeze(Color.FromArgb(44, 255, 255, 255));

    // The four new skins are cached once; no per-frame brush creation and no
    // extra timers, compositor subscribers, Ollama calls or Cloudflare work.
    private static readonly TileVisual[][] SkinVisuals = BuildSkinVisuals();

    private readonly Stopwatch _clock = new();
    private bool _subscribed;
    private double _lastRenderSeconds = -1;

    public NIRAImageCreationIndicator()
    {
        IsHitTestVisible = false;
        Loaded += (_, _) => RefreshSubscription();
        Unloaded += (_, _) => StopRendering();
        IsVisibleChanged += (_, _) => RefreshSubscription();
    }

    private static Color Rgb(byte r, byte g, byte b) => Color.FromRgb(r, g, b);

    private static Brush Freeze(Color color)
    {
        SolidColorBrush brush = new(color);
        brush.Freeze();
        return brush;
    }

    private static Pen MakeOutline()
    {
        Pen pen = new(Freeze(Color.FromArgb(108, 255, 255, 255)), 0.7);
        pen.Freeze();
        return pen;
    }

    private static Brush[] BuildTileBrushes()
    {
        Brush[] result = new Brush[Rows * Columns];
        for (int r = 0; r < Rows; r++)
        {
            for (int c = 0; c < Columns; c++)
            {
                int k = (c * 3 + r * 2 + (c + r) / 3) % Palette.Length;
                var gradient = new LinearGradientBrush(Palette[k].Start,
                    Palette[(k + 3) % Palette.Length].End,
                    new Point(0, 0), new Point(1, 1));
                gradient.Freeze();
                result[r * Columns + c] = gradient;
            }
        }
        return result;
    }

    private static Brush[] BuildTileShadows()
    {
        Brush[] result = new Brush[Rows * Columns];
        for (int i = 0; i < result.Length; i++)
        {
            Color color = Palette[(i * 7) % Palette.Length].End;
            result[i] = Freeze(Color.FromArgb(34, color.R, color.G, color.B));
        }
        return result;
    }

    private static Brush[] BuildWaveBrushes()
    {
        Brush[] result = new Brush[Rows * Columns];
        for (int i = 0; i < result.Length; i++)
        {
            Color color = Palette[(i * 3 + 1) % Palette.Length].Start;
            result[i] = Freeze(Color.FromArgb(125, color.R, color.G, color.B));
        }
        return result;
    }

    private void RefreshSubscription()
    {
        if (!IsLoaded || !IsVisible)
        {
            StopRendering();
            return;
        }
        if (_subscribed)
            return;

        _clock.Restart();
        _lastRenderSeconds = -1;
        _subscribed = true;
        CompositionTarget.Rendering += OnRendering;
    }

    private void StopRendering()
    {
        if (!_subscribed)
            return;
        CompositionTarget.Rendering -= OnRendering;
        _subscribed = false;
        _clock.Stop();
    }

    private void OnRendering(object? sender, EventArgs e)
    {
        if (!IsVisible)
        {
            StopRendering();
            return;
        }
        double now = _clock.Elapsed.TotalSeconds;
        if (_lastRenderSeconds >= 0 && now - _lastRenderSeconds < FrameIntervalSeconds)
            return;
        _lastRenderSeconds = now;
        InvalidateVisual();
    }

    protected override void OnRender(DrawingContext dc)
    {
        base.OnRender(dc);
        double width = ActualWidth;
        double height = ActualHeight;
        if (width < 35 || height < 35)
            return;

        // Faithful 7x5 tile proportion, aspect-preserving and frameless.
        const double designTileSize = 22.0;
        const double gapRatio = 0.19;
        double tile = Math.Min(designTileSize,
            Math.Min((width - 14) / (Columns + (Columns - 1) * gapRatio),
                     (height - 14) / (Rows + (Rows - 1) * gapRatio)));
        if (tile < 3)
            return;

        double gap = tile * gapRatio;
        double gridW = Columns * tile + (Columns - 1) * gap;
        double gridH = Rows * tile + (Rows - 1) * gap;
        double x0 = (width - gridW) / 2;
        double y0 = (height - gridH) / 2;
        double seconds = _clock.Elapsed.TotalSeconds;

        // D4's light tilt, not D1's separate perspective stage.
        dc.PushTransform(new RotateTransform(3.0, width / 2, height / 2));
        for (int r = 0; r < Rows; r++)
        {
            for (int c = 0; c < Columns; c++)
            {
                int index = r * Columns + c;
                Motion motion = SampleMotion(seconds, r, c);
                if (motion.Opacity <= 0.003)
                    continue;

                double size = tile * motion.Scale;
                double x = x0 + c * (tile + gap) + (tile - size) / 2;
                double y = y0 + r * (tile + gap) + (tile - size) / 2 + motion.Y * tile;
                double rounding = Math.Max(1.5, size * 0.15);
                Rect square = new(x, y, size, size);

                dc.PushOpacity(motion.Opacity);
                dc.PushTransform(new RotateTransform(motion.Rotation, x + size / 2, y + size / 2));
                if (TileSkin == NIRAImageTileSkin.Original)
                {
                    // Exact R43 original drawing preserved for production.
                    dc.DrawRoundedRectangle(TileShadows[index], null,
                        new Rect(x, y + 1.5, size, size), rounding, rounding);
                    dc.DrawRoundedRectangle(TilePaints[index], TileOutline, square, rounding, rounding);
                    if (motion.Wave > 0.005)
                    {
                        dc.PushOpacity(motion.Wave * 0.45);
                        dc.DrawRoundedRectangle(WavePaints[index], null, square, rounding, rounding);
                        dc.Pop();
                    }
                    dc.DrawRoundedRectangle(TileShine, null,
                        new Rect(x + size * 0.12, y + size * 0.1,
                                 size * 0.72, Math.Max(1.0, size * 0.085)),
                        rounding * 0.42, rounding * 0.42);
                }
                else
                {
                    DrawSkinTile(dc, (int)TileSkin - 1, index, square, rounding, motion.Wave);
                }
                dc.Pop();
                dc.Pop();
            }
        }
        dc.Pop();
    }


    // Material rendering is intentionally separate from SampleMotion: the D4
    // staggered cascade and D1 spectrum wave are unchanged by tile selection.
    private static void DrawSkinTile(DrawingContext dc, int skinIndex, int index,
        Rect square, double rounding, double wave)
    {
        TileVisual v = SkinVisuals[skinIndex][index];
        double x = square.X;
        double y = square.Y;
        double size = square.Width;

        switch (skinIndex)
        {
            case 0: // Aether Glass: translucent faces, layered edge, fine highlight
                dc.DrawRoundedRectangle(v.Halo, null, Grow(square, size * 0.12),
                    rounding * 1.5, rounding * 1.5);
                dc.DrawRoundedRectangle(v.Shadow, null, new Rect(x, y + size * 0.07, size, size), rounding, rounding);
                dc.DrawRoundedRectangle(v.Fill, v.Border, square, rounding, rounding);
                dc.DrawRoundedRectangle(v.Gloss, null,
                    new Rect(x + size * 0.08, y + size * 0.09, size * 0.84, size * 0.19),
                    rounding * 0.8, rounding * 0.8);
                break;

            case 1: // Prism Veil: iridescent diagonal facets, refracted highlights
                dc.DrawRoundedRectangle(v.Halo, null, Grow(square, size * 0.09),
                    rounding * 1.4, rounding * 1.4);
                dc.DrawRoundedRectangle(v.Fill, v.Border, square, rounding, rounding);
                dc.PushClip(new RectangleGeometry(square, rounding, rounding));
                double bandWidth = size * 0.24;
                double bandX = x - size * 0.20 + wave * size * 0.90;
                dc.DrawRectangle(v.Gloss, null,
                    new Rect(bandX, y - size * 0.06, bandWidth, size * 1.18));
                dc.DrawLine(v.AccentPen, new Point(x + size * 0.10, y + size * 0.76),
                    new Point(x + size * 0.78, y + size * 0.12));
                dc.Pop();
                break;

            case 2: // Lumen Panel: flat luminous micro-panel, sharper geometry
                double crispRadius = Math.Max(1.4, rounding * 0.60);
                dc.DrawRoundedRectangle(v.Halo, null, Grow(square, size * 0.10),
                    crispRadius * 1.6, crispRadius * 1.6);
                dc.DrawRoundedRectangle(v.Fill, v.Border, square, crispRadius, crispRadius);
                dc.DrawRoundedRectangle(v.Gloss, null,
                    new Rect(x + size * 0.13, y + size * 0.13, size * 0.74,
                        Math.Max(1.0, size * 0.095)), size * 0.04, size * 0.04);
                dc.DrawLine(v.AccentPen,
                    new Point(x + size * 0.15, y + size * 0.85),
                    new Point(x + size * 0.50, y + size * 0.85));
                break;

            case 3: // Aurora Matte: diffuse, velvety pastel, no hard shine
                dc.DrawRoundedRectangle(v.Shadow, null,
                    new Rect(x, y + size * 0.05, size, size), rounding, rounding);
                dc.DrawRoundedRectangle(v.Fill, v.Border, square,
                    rounding * 1.25, rounding * 1.25);
                dc.DrawRoundedRectangle(v.Gloss, null,
                    new Rect(x + size * 0.08, y + size * 0.12, size * 0.84, size * 0.68),
                    rounding, rounding);
                break;
        }

        // All four retain R43's D1 traveling wave, changing only its material
        // treatment. No phase, duration, or motion value is altered.
        if (wave > 0.005)
        {
            dc.PushOpacity(wave * (skinIndex == 3 ? 0.23 : 0.40));
            dc.DrawRoundedRectangle(v.Wave, null, square, rounding, rounding);
            dc.Pop();
        }
    }

    private static Rect Grow(Rect r, double extra) =>
        new(r.X - extra / 2, r.Y - extra / 2, r.Width + extra, r.Height + extra);

    private static TileVisual[][] BuildSkinVisuals()
    {
        TileVisual[][] skins = new TileVisual[4][];
        for (int skin = 0; skin < skins.Length; skin++)
        {
            skins[skin] = new TileVisual[Rows * Columns];
            for (int index = 0; index < Rows * Columns; index++)
            {
                int r = index / Columns;
                int c = index % Columns;
                int pi = (c * 3 + r * 2 + (c + r) / 3) % Palette.Length;
                Color first = Palette[pi].Start;
                Color last = Palette[(pi + 3) % Palette.Length].End;
                Color secondary = Palette[(pi + 6) % Palette.Length].Start;

                Brush fill;
                Brush shadow;
                Brush gloss;
                Brush halo;
                Brush wave;
                Pen border;
                Pen accentPen;

                switch (skin)
                {
                    case 0: // Aether Glass
                        fill = Gradient(176, first, 146, last, 0.05, 0.95);
                        shadow = Freeze(From(40, last));
                        gloss = Gradient(112, Colors.White, 0, Colors.White, 0, 1);
                        halo = Freeze(From(26, first));
                        border = MakePen(From(176, Colors.White), 0.78);
                        accentPen = MakePen(From(110, Colors.White), 0.7);
                        wave = Gradient(140, first, 95, secondary, 0, 1);
                        break;
                    case 1: // Prism Veil
                        fill = PrismGradient(first, secondary, last);
                        shadow = Freeze(From(45, secondary));
                        gloss = Gradient(0, Colors.White, 116, Colors.White, 0, 1);
                        halo = Freeze(From(31, secondary));
                        border = MakePen(From(190, Colors.White), 0.80);
                        accentPen = MakePen(From(100, Colors.White), 0.65);
                        wave = Gradient(160, secondary, 128, first, 0, 1);
                        break;
                    case 2: // Lumen Panel
                        fill = Gradient(238, first, 222, last, 0, 1);
                        shadow = Freeze(From(35, last));
                        gloss = Freeze(From(175, Colors.White));
                        halo = Freeze(From(35, first));
                        border = MakePen(From(220, first), 1.05);
                        accentPen = MakePen(From(215, Colors.White), 0.82);
                        wave = Gradient(130, first, 125, secondary, 0, 1);
                        break;
                    default: // Aurora Matte
                        fill = AuroraGradient(first, secondary, last);
                        shadow = Freeze(From(22, last));
                        gloss = Freeze(From(15, Colors.White));
                        halo = Freeze(From(0, first));
                        border = MakePen(From(58, Colors.White), 0.55);
                        accentPen = MakePen(From(0, Colors.White), 0.50);
                        wave = Gradient(90, secondary, 70, first, 0, 1);
                        break;
                }

                skins[skin][index] = new TileVisual(fill, shadow, gloss, halo, wave, border, accentPen);
            }
        }
        return skins;
    }

    private static Color From(byte alpha, Color color) =>
        Color.FromArgb(alpha, color.R, color.G, color.B);

    private static Pen MakePen(Color color, double thickness)
    {
        Pen pen = new(Freeze(color), thickness);
        pen.Freeze();
        return pen;
    }

    private static Brush Gradient(byte alpha1, Color first, byte alpha2, Color last,
        double start, double end)
    {
        var brush = new LinearGradientBrush();
        brush.StartPoint = new Point(0, start);
        brush.EndPoint = new Point(1, end);
        brush.GradientStops.Add(new GradientStop(From(alpha1, first), 0));
        brush.GradientStops.Add(new GradientStop(From(alpha2, last), 1));
        brush.Freeze();
        return brush;
    }

    private static Brush PrismGradient(Color first, Color middle, Color last)
    {
        var brush = new LinearGradientBrush();
        brush.StartPoint = new Point(0, 0);
        brush.EndPoint = new Point(1, 1);
        brush.GradientStops.Add(new GradientStop(From(234, first), 0));
        brush.GradientStops.Add(new GradientStop(From(246, middle), 0.46));
        brush.GradientStops.Add(new GradientStop(From(232, last), 1));
        brush.Freeze();
        return brush;
    }

    private static Brush AuroraGradient(Color first, Color middle, Color last)
    {
        var brush = new RadialGradientBrush();
        brush.Center = new Point(0.23, 0.20);
        brush.GradientOrigin = new Point(0.15, 0.15);
        brush.RadiusX = 0.92;
        brush.RadiusY = 1.05;
        brush.GradientStops.Add(new GradientStop(From(223, first), 0));
        brush.GradientStops.Add(new GradientStop(From(222, middle), 0.54));
        brush.GradientStops.Add(new GradientStop(From(218, last), 1));
        brush.Freeze();
        return brush;
    }

    private sealed record TileVisual(Brush Fill, Brush Shadow, Brush Gloss, Brush Halo,
        Brush Wave, Pen Border, Pen AccentPen);

    // The HTML source uses staggered *negative* CSS animation delays.
    // Therefore each tile advances along its own 4.4-second cycle rather
    // than waiting for a global row-by-row exit and hard reset.
    internal static Motion SampleMotion(double timeSeconds, int row, int col)
    {
        double cascadeDelay = row * 0.30 + col * 0.095;
        double phase = PositiveModulo(timeSeconds + cascadeDelay, CascadeSeconds) / CascadeSeconds;

        double opacity;
        double y;
        double scale;
        double rotation;

        if (phase < 0.05)
        {
            opacity = 0;
            y = -1.85;
            scale = 0.68;
            rotation = -12;
        }
        else if (phase < 0.26)
        {
            double p = Smooth((phase - 0.05) / 0.21);
            opacity = p;
            y = Lerp(-1.85, 0, p);
            scale = Lerp(0.68, 1.0, p);
            rotation = Lerp(-12, 0, p);
        }
        else if (phase < 0.76)
        {
            opacity = 1.0;
            y = 0;
            scale = 1;
            rotation = 0;
        }
        else if (phase < 0.92)
        {
            double p = Smooth((phase - 0.76) / 0.16);
            opacity = 1.0 - p;
            y = Lerp(0, 0.40, p);
            scale = Lerp(1.0, 0.94, p);
            rotation = 0;
        }
        else
        {
            opacity = 0;
            y = 0.40;
            scale = 0.94;
            rotation = 0;
        }

        // D1 phase: sequential columns/rows; wave runs THROUGH already visible
        // pixels, lifting and brightening them without changing D4's fade cadence.
        double spectrumDelay = col * 0.15 + row * 0.055;
        double wavePhase = PositiveModulo(timeSeconds + spectrumDelay, SpectrumSeconds) / SpectrumSeconds;
        double wave;
        if (wavePhase <= 0.43)
            wave = Smooth(wavePhase / 0.43);
        else if (wavePhase <= 0.70)
            wave = Lerp(1.0, 0.26, Smooth((wavePhase - 0.43) / 0.27));
        else
            wave = Lerp(0.26, 0, Smooth((wavePhase - 0.70) / 0.30));

        // Blend D1 motion in at a restrained amplitude to preserve D4's falling pixels.
        // The extra lift is applied only after the tile has become visible.
        double visible = Smooth(opacity);
        y -= wave * visible * 0.16;
        scale *= 1.0 + wave * visible * 0.055;
        opacity *= 0.87 + 0.13 * wave;

        return new Motion(opacity, y, scale, rotation, wave * visible);
    }

    internal readonly record struct Motion(double Opacity, double Y, double Scale, double Rotation, double Wave);

    internal static bool VerifyMotionInvariants(out string reason)
    {
        // Verify the four keyframes, staggered tiles, and D1 wave. This is
        // deterministic: no UI, Ollama, Cloudflare, network or randomness.
        double d4s = 0.0;
        Motion hidden = SampleMotion(d4s, 0, 0);
        Motion entering = SampleMotion(CascadeSeconds * 0.155, 0, 0);
        Motion settled = SampleMotion(CascadeSeconds * 0.40, 0, 0);
        Motion exiting = SampleMotion(CascadeSeconds * 0.84, 0, 0);
        Motion end = SampleMotion(CascadeSeconds * 0.97, 0, 0);
        if (hidden.Opacity > 0.01 || entering.Opacity <= 0.01 ||
            settled.Opacity < 0.85 || exiting.Opacity >= 0.85 || end.Opacity > 0.01 ||
            entering.Y >= 0 || exiting.Y <= 0)
        {
            reason = "D4 keyframe or fall direction check failed";
            return false;
        }

        Motion staggerA = SampleMotion(0.0, 0, 0);
        Motion staggerB = SampleMotion(0.0, 4, 6);
        if (Math.Abs(staggerA.Opacity - staggerB.Opacity) < 0.08)
        {
            reason = "D4 stagger check failed";
            return false;
        }

        Motion waveA = SampleMotion(1.55, 0, 0);
        Motion waveB = SampleMotion(1.55, 0, 4);
        if (Math.Abs(waveA.Wave - waveB.Wave) < 0.06)
        {
            reason = "D1 traveling wave check failed";
            return false;
        }

        reason = "D4 staggered cascade, fade-out, and D1 spectrum wave: PASS";
        return true;
    }

    private static double PositiveModulo(double a, double b) => ((a % b) + b) % b;
    private static double Lerp(double a, double b, double t) => a + (b - a) * t;
    private static double Smooth(double p)
    {
        double t = Math.Clamp(p, 0, 1);
        return t * t * (3 - 2 * t);
    }
}
```

```csharp
using System.Windows;
using System.Windows.Controls;

namespace NIRAAgent.UI.Typing;

/// <summary>
/// Shared D4 Cascade + D1 Spectrum placeholder.
/// Production now uses the selected Prism Veil tile skin, while the Image UI Lab
/// can still preview other materials without changing the animation or spending quotas.
/// </summary>
public partial class NIRAImageCreationPlaceholder : UserControl
{
    public static readonly DependencyProperty TileSkinProperty = DependencyProperty.Register(
        nameof(TileSkin), typeof(NIRAImageTileSkin), typeof(NIRAImageCreationPlaceholder),
        new PropertyMetadata(NIRAImageTileSkin.PrismVeil, OnTileSkinChanged));

    public NIRAImageTileSkin TileSkin
    {
        get => (NIRAImageTileSkin)GetValue(TileSkinProperty);
        set => SetValue(TileSkinProperty, value);
    }

    public NIRAImageCreationPlaceholder()
    {
        InitializeComponent();
        ApplySkin();
    }

    private static void OnTileSkinChanged(DependencyObject target, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
    {
        if (target is NIRAImageCreationPlaceholder placeholder)
            placeholder.ApplySkin();
    }

    private void ApplySkin()
    {
        if (Indicator is not null)
            Indicator.TileSkin = TileSkin;
    }
}
```
