## 69. `NIRAAgent.UI\Typing\NIRATypingIndicator.cs`

**File:** `NIRAAgent.UI\Typing\NIRATypingIndicator.cs`

```csharp
using System.Diagnostics;
using System.Windows;
using System.Windows.Media;

namespace NIRAAgent.UI.Typing;

/// <summary>
/// Final NIRA three-dot typing indicator.
/// Built from the S3 direction: living drift + random slot exchange,
/// with front/back perception driven mostly by size, glow and opacity.
/// Added user-requested vertical cue:
/// - back-going dots rise slightly
/// - front-coming dots lower slightly
/// - only one dot may be back, one front, and one neutral per round
/// while keeping the rest of the movement calm and smooth.
/// </summary>
public sealed class NIRATypingIndicator : FrameworkElement
{
    // Match NIRA's original chat dots: 5px diameter, compact spacing.
    private const double DotSpacing = 13.5;
    private const double BaseRadius = 2.55;
    private const double FrameSeconds = 1.0 / 60.0;

    private static readonly DotMaterial[] Palette =
    {
        CreateMaterial(Color.FromRgb(91, 233, 255)),
        CreateMaterial(Color.FromRgb(102, 157, 255)),
        CreateMaterial(Color.FromRgb(189, 126, 255))
    };

    private readonly Stopwatch _clock = new();
    private readonly Random _random = new(Random.Shared.Next());
    private readonly int[] _startSlots = { 0, 1, 2 };
    private readonly int[] _endSlots = { 0, 1, 2 };
    private readonly int[] _previousSlots = { 0, 1, 2 };
    private readonly double[] _travelDepth = new double[3];
    private readonly double[] _laneDrift = new double[3];
    private bool _attached;
    private bool _planned;
    private double _stepTime;
    private double _runningTime;
    private double _lastClockTime;
    private double _lastRenderTime = -1;
    private int _lastPlanKind = -1;

    public TypingStyle IndicatorStyle { get; set; }
    public double SpeedMultiplier { get; set; } = 1.0;

    public NIRATypingIndicator()
    {
        IsHitTestVisible = false;
        Loaded += OnLoaded;
        Unloaded += OnUnloaded;
        IsVisibleChanged += OnVisibilityChanged;
    }

    private double CycleSeconds => 2.08;
    private double TravelFraction => 0.85;

    protected override void OnRender(DrawingContext dc)
    {
        base.OnRender(dc);

        if (ActualWidth <= 0 || ActualHeight <= 0)
            return;

        if (!_planned)
            PlanNextExchange();

        double cx = ActualWidth / 2.0;
        double cy = ActualHeight / 2.0;
        double travelDuration = CycleSeconds * TravelFraction;
        double u = Math.Clamp(_stepTime / travelDuration, 0.0, 1.0);
        double move = SmootherStep(u);
        double motionWave = Math.Sin(Math.PI * move);

        DrawState[] states = new DrawState[3];
        for (int dot = 0; dot < 3; dot++)
        {
            double source = _startSlots[dot] - 1.0;
            double destination = _endSlots[dot] - 1.0;
            double delta = destination - source;

            double x = cx + (source + delta * move) * DotSpacing;

            // Keep the living drift from S3.
            double idleDriftX = Math.Sin(_runningTime * 2.0 * Math.PI / 2.55 + dot * 1.97) * 0.85;
            double idleDriftY = Math.Sin(_runningTime * 2.0 * Math.PI / 2.82 + dot * 2.31) * 0.65;
            x += idleDriftX + _laneDrift[dot] * motionWave * 0.17;

            double depth = _travelDepth[dot] * motionWave;

            // User-requested small vertical cue:
            // back-going dot -> rise slightly, front-going dot -> lower slightly.
            // This stays subtle so the effect reads as depth rather than big hopping.
            double depthYOffset = depth * 1.85;
            double y = cy + idleDriftY + depthYOffset;

            double breathing = (1.0 + Math.Sin(_runningTime * 2.0 * Math.PI / 2.10 + dot * 1.72)) * 0.5;

            double radius = (BaseRadius + breathing * 0.11) * (1.0 + depth * 0.17);
            double opacity = Math.Clamp(0.77 + breathing * 0.10 + depth * 0.25, 0.50, 1.0);
            double haloBoost = Math.Max(0.0, depth) * 0.40;
            double highlightBoost = Math.Max(0.0, depth) * 0.16;

            states[dot] = new DrawState(
                dot,
                x,
                y,
                radius,
                opacity,
                haloBoost,
                highlightBoost,
                depth);
        }

        Array.Sort(states, (a, b) => a.Depth.CompareTo(b.Depth));
        foreach (DrawState state in states)
        {
            DrawDot(dc, state, Palette[state.DotIndex]);
        }
    }

    private void PlanNextExchange()
    {
        _planned = true;
        bool threeCycle = _random.NextDouble() < 0.58;

        for (int attempt = 0; attempt < 12; attempt++)
        {
            Array.Copy(_startSlots, _endSlots, 3);
            int kind;
            if (threeCycle)
            {
                int direction = _random.Next(2) == 0 ? 1 : -1;
                kind = direction == 1 ? 3 : 4;
                for (int dot = 0; dot < 3; dot++)
                    _endSlots[dot] = (_startSlots[dot] + direction + 3) % 3;
            }
            else
            {
                int a = _random.Next(3);
                int b = (a + 1 + _random.Next(2)) % 3;
                kind = a * 3 + b + 5;
                (_endSlots[a], _endSlots[b]) = (_endSlots[b], _endSlots[a]);
            }

            bool sameTarget = _endSlots.AsSpan().SequenceEqual(_previousSlots);
            if ((!sameTarget && kind != _lastPlanKind) || attempt == 11)
            {
                _lastPlanKind = kind;
                break;
            }
            threeCycle = _random.NextDouble() < 0.55;
        }

        Array.Copy(_endSlots, _previousSlots, 3);

        // Exactly one dot may go "back", exactly one may come "front",
        // and the remaining dot stays neutral for that round.
        // This avoids the bug where two dots felt like they were both going
        // back or both coming forward at the same time.
        Array.Fill(_travelDepth, 0.0);
        Array.Fill(_laneDrift, 0.0);

        List<int> movers = new();
        List<int> stationary = new();
        for (int dot = 0; dot < 3; dot++)
        {
            if (_endSlots[dot] == _startSlots[dot])
                stationary.Add(dot);
            else
                movers.Add(dot);
        }

        int frontDot;
        int backDot;
        int neutralDot;

        if (movers.Count == 2)
        {
            // Pair swap: the untouched dot is always the neutral one.
            neutralDot = stationary[0];
            if (_random.Next(2) == 0)
            {
                frontDot = movers[0];
                backDot = movers[1];
            }
            else
            {
                frontDot = movers[1];
                backDot = movers[0];
            }
        }
        else
        {
            // Three-way exchange: choose one front, one back, one neutral.
            List<int> order = new() { 0, 1, 2 };
            for (int i = order.Count - 1; i > 0; i--)
            {
                int swapIndex = _random.Next(i + 1);
                (order[i], order[swapIndex]) = (order[swapIndex], order[i]);
            }

            frontDot = order[0];
            backDot = order[1];
            neutralDot = order[2];
        }

        _travelDepth[frontDot] = 1.04;
        _travelDepth[backDot] = -1.04;
        _travelDepth[neutralDot] = 0.0;

        foreach (int dot in movers)
        {
            _laneDrift[dot] = (_random.NextDouble() - 0.5) * 2.8;
        }
    }

    // WPF keeps old chat bubbles in the visual tree. Subscribe to the
    // composition loop only while this particular empty-message indicator
    // is actually visible; once text arrives its visibility collapses.
    private void OnLoaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
    {
        UpdateRenderingSubscription();
    }

    private void OnUnloaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
    {
        StopRendering();
    }

    private void OnVisibilityChanged(object sender, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
    {
        UpdateRenderingSubscription();
    }

    private void UpdateRenderingSubscription()
    {
        if (!IsLoaded || !IsVisible)
        {
            StopRendering();
            return;
        }

        if (_attached)
            return;

        _attached = true;
        _lastClockTime = _clock.Elapsed.TotalSeconds;
        _clock.Start();
        _lastRenderTime = -1;
        CompositionTarget.Rendering += OnFrame;
        InvalidateVisual();
    }

    private void StopRendering()
    {
        if (!_attached)
            return;

        _attached = false;
        CompositionTarget.Rendering -= OnFrame;
        _clock.Stop();
    }

    private void OnFrame(object? sender, EventArgs e)
    {
        double now = _clock.Elapsed.TotalSeconds;
        double delta = Math.Clamp(now - _lastClockTime, 0.0, 0.10);
        _lastClockTime = now;

        if (_lastRenderTime >= 0 && now - _lastRenderTime < FrameSeconds * 0.85)
            return;
        _lastRenderTime = now;

        double advance = delta * Math.Clamp(SpeedMultiplier, 0.85, 1.20);
        _runningTime += advance;
        _stepTime += advance;

        while (_stepTime >= CycleSeconds)
        {
            _stepTime -= CycleSeconds;
            Array.Copy(_endSlots, _startSlots, 3);
            PlanNextExchange();
        }

        InvalidateVisual();
    }

    private static double SmootherStep(double t)
    {
        t = Math.Clamp(t, 0.0, 1.0);
        return t * t * t * (t * (t * 6.0 - 15.0) + 10.0);
    }

    private static void DrawDot(DrawingContext dc, DrawState state, DotMaterial material)
    {
        Point point = new(state.X, state.Y);

        // Unique NIRA energy ribbon so the typing state feels branded,
        // not like a stock three-dot loader.
        double ribbonWidth = state.Radius * 3.9;
        double ribbonHeight = state.Radius * 1.12;
        byte ribbonAlpha = (byte)(18 + state.Opacity * 26 + Math.Max(0.0, state.Depth) * 18);
        var ribbon = new LinearGradientBrush();
        ribbon.StartPoint = new Point(0, 0.5);
        ribbon.EndPoint = new Point(1, 0.5);
        ribbon.GradientStops.Add(new GradientStop(Color.FromArgb(0, 105, 205, 255), 0.0));
        ribbon.GradientStops.Add(new GradientStop(Color.FromArgb(ribbonAlpha, 107, 219, 255), 0.42));
        ribbon.GradientStops.Add(new GradientStop(Color.FromArgb(ribbonAlpha, 187, 126, 255), 0.68));
        ribbon.GradientStops.Add(new GradientStop(Color.FromArgb(0, 255, 255, 255), 1.0));
        dc.DrawRoundedRectangle(
            ribbon,
            null,
            new Rect(point.X - ribbonWidth / 2, point.Y - ribbonHeight / 2, ribbonWidth, ribbonHeight),
            ribbonHeight / 2,
            ribbonHeight / 2);

        double haloOpacity = (0.34 + state.HaloBoost) * state.Opacity;
        dc.PushOpacity(Math.Clamp(haloOpacity, 0.14, 0.92));
        dc.DrawEllipse(material.Halo, null, point, state.Radius * 2.55, state.Radius * 2.55);
        dc.Pop();

        dc.PushOpacity(Math.Clamp(state.Opacity, 0.46, 1.0));
        dc.DrawEllipse(material.Core, null, point, state.Radius, state.Radius);
        dc.DrawEllipse(
            material.Highlight,
            null,
            new Point(state.X - state.Radius * 0.21, state.Y - state.Radius * 0.23),
            state.Radius * (0.18 + state.HighlightBoost),
            state.Radius * (0.18 + state.HighlightBoost));
        dc.Pop();

        // Tiny satellite sparkle for a more distinctive NIRA feel.
        double satelliteRadius = Math.Max(0.65, state.Radius * 0.26);
        Point satellite = new(
            point.X + state.Radius * (1.15 + Math.Max(0.0, state.Depth) * 0.22),
            point.Y - state.Radius * 0.9);
        dc.DrawEllipse(
            new SolidColorBrush(Color.FromArgb((byte)(70 + state.Opacity * 80), 231, 246, 255)),
            null,
            satellite,
            satelliteRadius,
            satelliteRadius);
    }

    private static DotMaterial CreateMaterial(Color color)
    {
        SolidColorBrush core = new(color);
        core.Freeze();

        SolidColorBrush highlight = new(Color.FromArgb(155, 231, 245, 255));
        highlight.Freeze();

        RadialGradientBrush halo = new()
        {
            MappingMode = BrushMappingMode.RelativeToBoundingBox,
            Center = new Point(0.5, 0.5),
            GradientOrigin = new Point(0.5, 0.5),
            RadiusX = 0.5,
            RadiusY = 0.5
        };
        halo.GradientStops.Add(new GradientStop(Color.FromArgb(88, color.R, color.G, color.B), 0.0));
        halo.GradientStops.Add(new GradientStop(Color.FromArgb(26, color.R, color.G, color.B), 0.48));
        halo.GradientStops.Add(new GradientStop(Color.FromArgb(0, color.R, color.G, color.B), 1.0));
        halo.Freeze();
        return new DotMaterial(core, halo, highlight);
    }

    private readonly record struct DrawState(
        int DotIndex,
        double X,
        double Y,
        double Radius,
        double Opacity,
        double HaloBoost,
        double HighlightBoost,
        double Depth);

    private sealed record DotMaterial(Brush Core, Brush Halo, Brush Highlight);
}
```

```csharp
/*

using System.Windows.Input;

namespace NIRAAgent.UI.ViewModels;

public sealed class AsyncRelayCommand : ICommand
{
    private readonly Func<Task> _execute;

    private readonly Func<bool>? _canExecute;


    public AsyncRelayCommand(
        Func<Task> execute,
        Func<bool>? canExecute = null)
    {
        _execute = execute;
        _canExecute = canExecute;
    }


    public bool CanExecute(
        object? parameter)
    {
        return _canExecute?.Invoke() ?? true;
    }


    public async void Execute(
        object? parameter)
    {
        await _execute();
    }


    public event EventHandler?
        CanExecuteChanged;


    public void RaiseCanExecuteChanged()
    {
        CanExecuteChanged?.Invoke(
            this,
            EventArgs.Empty
        );
    }
}
```

```csharp
using System.Windows;
using System.Windows.Controls;

namespace NIRAAgent.UI.ViewModels;

public sealed class ChatMessageTemplateSelector : DataTemplateSelector
{
    public DataTemplate? UserTemplate { get; set; }

    public DataTemplate? AssistantTemplate { get; set; }

    public override DataTemplate? SelectTemplate(
        object item,
        DependencyObject container)
    {
        if (item is ChatMessageViewModel message)
        {
            if (message.IsUser)
                return UserTemplate;

            if (message.IsAssistant)
                return AssistantTemplate;
        }

        return base.SelectTemplate(item, container);
    }
}
```

## 73. `NIRAAgent.UI\ViewModels\ChatMessageViewModel.cs`

**File:** `NIRAAgent.UI\ViewModels\ChatMessageViewModel.cs`

```csharp
/*
 * filename: ChatMessageViewModel.cs
 */

using System.Collections.ObjectModel;
using System.ComponentModel;
using System.Linq;
using System.Runtime.CompilerServices;

using NIRAAgent.Artifacts;
using NIRAAgent.Presentation;
using NIRAAgent.UI.Presentation;
using NIRAAgent.Conversation;
using System.Diagnostics;
using System.Windows;
using System.Windows.Media;

namespace NIRAAgent.UI.ViewModels;

public sealed class ChatMessageViewModel : INotifyPropertyChanged
{
    private string
        _content;

    private string _progressText = string.Empty;
    private bool _isImageGenerationActive;
    public bool IsImageGenerationActive
    {
        get => _isImageGenerationActive;
        set { if (_isImageGenerationActive == value) return; _isImageGenerationActive = value; OnPropertyChanged(); }
    }
    private bool _isJourneyActive;
    private bool _isJourneyFading;
    private int _journeyVersion;

    public string ProgressText
    {
        get => _progressText;
        set
        {
            string normalized = value ?? string.Empty;
            if (_progressText == normalized) return;

            _progressText = normalized;

            // Only real runtime/model progress text appears here.
            // A new update also keeps the current journey indicator alive.
            if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(_progressText))
            {
                _journeyVersion++;
                IsJourneyActive = true;
                IsJourneyFading = false;
            }

            OnPropertyChanged();
            OnPropertyChanged(nameof(HasProgress));
            OnPropertyChanged(nameof(IsEmpty));
        }
    }

    public bool HasProgress =>
        !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(ProgressText);

    public bool IsJourneyActive
    {
        get => _isJourneyActive;
        private set
        {
            if (_isJourneyActive == value) return;
            _isJourneyActive = value;
            OnPropertyChanged();
            OnPropertyChanged(nameof(IsEmpty));
        }
    }

    public bool IsJourneyFading
    {
        get => _isJourneyFading;
        private set
        {
            if (_isJourneyFading == value) return;
            _isJourneyFading = value;
            OnPropertyChanged();
        }
    }

    // Start with ONLY the living three dots. No fake/default status text.
    public void BeginJourney()
    {
        IsImageGenerationActive = false;
        _journeyVersion++;
        _progressText = string.Empty;
        IsJourneyFading = false;
        IsJourneyActive = true;

        OnPropertyChanged(nameof(ProgressText));
        OnPropertyChanged(nameof(HasProgress));
        OnPropertyChanged(nameof(IsEmpty));
    }

    // Final content can render immediately while the dots/current real
    // progress line quietly fade out.
    public void BeginJourneyFadeOut()
    {
        if (!IsJourneyActive || IsJourneyFading)
            return;

        IsImageGenerationActive = false;
        int version = ++_journeyVersion;
        IsJourneyFading = true;
        _ = CompleteJourneyFadeOutAsync(version);
    }

    public void ClearJourneyImmediately()
    {
        IsImageGenerationActive = false;
        _journeyVersion++;
        _progressText = string.Empty;
        IsJourneyFading = false;
        IsJourneyActive = false;

        OnPropertyChanged(nameof(ProgressText));
        OnPropertyChanged(nameof(HasProgress));
        OnPropertyChanged(nameof(IsEmpty));
    }

    private async Task CompleteJourneyFadeOutAsync(int version)
    {
        await Task.Delay(190);

        if (version != _journeyVersion)
            return;

        _progressText = string.Empty;
        OnPropertyChanged(nameof(ProgressText));
        OnPropertyChanged(nameof(HasProgress));

        IsJourneyActive = false;
        IsJourneyFading = false;
        OnPropertyChanged(nameof(IsEmpty));
    }

    // Compatibility with the V4 call sites.
    public void BeginProgressFadeOut() =>
        BeginJourneyFadeOut();

    public void ClearProgressImmediately() =>
        ClearJourneyImmediately();

    {

        string text = request.Replace('\r', ' ').Replace('\n', ' ').Trim();
        if (text.Length > 120) text = text[..120].TrimEnd() + "…";
        string label = (background ? "Background work · " : "Reply to · ") + text;
        if (label == _replyToText) return;
        _replyToText = label;

    public void AddUserAttachments(IEnumerable<NIRAComposerAttachment> attachments)
    {
        foreach (NIRAComposerAttachment attachment in attachments)
        {
            if (attachment.IsImage)
            {
                UserImageAttachments.Add(new VisualArtifactViewModel(new NIRAVisualArtifact
                {
                    ArtifactId = Guid.NewGuid(),
                    SourceKind = NIRAVisualArtifactSourceKind.LocalImage,
                    LocalPath = attachment.FullPath,
                    Title = attachment.FileName,
                    Caption = string.Empty
                }));
            }
            else
            {
                UserFileAttachments.Add(attachment);
            }
        }

        RebuildUserImageGalleryTiles();

    // Both directions share one compact, bounded, one-row gallery contract.
    // Two actual previews and an overflow tile keep a large attachment set
    // from growing the chat into a very tall column. The gallery viewer
    // still receives ALL original artifacts in their original order.
    private void RebuildUserImageGalleryTiles()
    {
        BuildGalleryTiles(UserImageGalleryTiles, UserImageAttachments, assistant: false);
        OnPropertyChanged(nameof(UserImageCount));
        OnPropertyChanged(nameof(HasOverflowUserImages));
        OnPropertyChanged(nameof(OverflowUserImageCount));
    }

    private void RebuildAssistantImageGalleryTiles() =>
        BuildGalleryTiles(AssistantImageGalleryTiles, VisualArtifacts, assistant: true);

    private void BuildGalleryTiles(
        ObservableCollection<NIRAUserImageGalleryTileViewModel> target,
        IReadOnlyList<VisualArtifactViewModel> images,
        bool assistant)
    {
        target.Clear();
        int count = images.Count;
        if (count == 0) return;
        int visible = Math.Min(count, 3);
        for (int index = 0; index < visible; index++)
        {
            bool overflow = count > 3 && index == 2;
            target.Add(new NIRAUserImageGalleryTileViewModel(
                this, images[index], index,
                hiddenCount: overflow ? count - 2 : 0,
                isOverflowTile: overflow,
                isAssistantTile: assistant,
                isSingleImage: count == 1));
        }
    }

    public ObservableCollection<FrameworkElement> RichElements { get; } = new();
    private readonly List<(FrameworkElement View, NIRARichBlock Block)> _photoCreditFrames = new();
    public bool HasRichElements => RichElements.Count > 0;
    private bool HasRetrievedCreditedImage => VisualArtifacts.Any(image =>
        image.HasStructuredCredit && image.HasSourceUri);

    private void SuppressDuplicatePhotoCreditFrames()
    {
        if (!HasRetrievedCreditedImage) return;
        foreach (var entry in _photoCreditFrames.ToArray())
        {
            if (!NIRAImageCreditLayoutPolicy.IsDuplicatePhotoCredit(entry.Block, true)) continue;
            RichElements.Remove(entry.View);
            _photoCreditFrames.Remove(entry);
        }
    }

    public void AddRichBlocks(IReadOnlyList<NIRARichBlock> blocks,
        NIRAConversationArchiveStore? archive = null, Guid? messageId = null,
        Action<string>? followUp = null)
    {
        var normalized = NIRAPresentationPolicy.Normalize(blocks);
        IReadOnlyDictionary<int, NIRARichInteractionState> states =
            new Dictionary<int, NIRARichInteractionState>();
        if (archive is { Enabled: true } && messageId is Guid id)
        {
            try { states = archive.ReadInteractiveStates(id); }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Debug.WriteLine($"[RichInteraction] STATE_READ_FAILED | {ex.GetType().Name}");
            }
        }
        for (int index = 0; index < normalized.Count;)
        {
            if (normalized[index].Type is "card" or "metric")
            {
                string type = normalized[index].Type;
                var group = new List<NIRARichBlock>();
                while (index < normalized.Count && normalized[index].Type == type)
                {
                    // Credit-only cards must remain independent of other cards,
                    // so a later trusted image can suppress only the duplicate.
                    bool isCredit = NIRAImageCreditLayoutPolicy.IsDuplicatePhotoCredit(normalized[index], true);
                    if (isCredit && group.Count > 0) break;
                    group.Add(normalized[index++]);
                    if (isCredit) break;
                }
                if (group.Count == 1 && NIRAImageCreditLayoutPolicy.IsDuplicatePhotoCredit(
                        group[0], HasRetrievedCreditedImage)) continue;
                FrameworkElement rendered = type == "card"
                    ? NIRARichBlockRenderer.RenderCardGroup(group)
                    : NIRARichBlockRenderer.RenderMetricGroup(group);
                RichElements.Add(rendered);
                if (group.Count == 1 && NIRAImageCreditLayoutPolicy.IsDuplicatePhotoCredit(group[0], true))
                    _photoCreditFrames.Add((rendered, group[0]));
            }
            else
            {
                int blockIndex = index;
                var block = normalized[index++];
                states.TryGetValue(blockIndex, out var saved);
                Action<NIRARichInteractionState>? persist = null;
                if (archive is { Enabled: true } && messageId is Guid stateMessageId)
                    persist = state =>
                    {
                        try { archive.SaveInteractiveState(stateMessageId, blockIndex, state); }
                        catch (Exception ex)
                        {
                            Debug.WriteLine($"[RichInteraction] STATE_SAVE_FAILED | {ex.GetType().Name}");
                        }
                    };
                if (NIRAImageCreditLayoutPolicy.IsDuplicatePhotoCredit(block, HasRetrievedCreditedImage))
                    continue;
                FrameworkElement rendered = NIRARichBlockRenderer.Render(block, saved, persist, followUp);
                RichElements.Add(rendered);
                if (NIRAImageCreditLayoutPolicy.IsDuplicatePhotoCredit(block, true))
                    _photoCreditFrames.Add((rendered, block));
            }
        }
    }
```

```csharp
    // Presentation-only strip: never alters the authoritative attachment list
    // sent to cognition. Hide surplus images behind a +N thumbnail.
    public ObservableCollection<NIRAComposerGalleryTile> ComposerGalleryTiles { get; } = new();
    private void RebuildComposerGalleryTiles()
    {
        ComposerGalleryTiles.Clear();
        NIRAComposerAttachment[] images = ComposerAttachments.Where(a => a.IsImage).ToArray();
        foreach (var image in images.Take(2))
            ComposerGalleryTiles.Add(new NIRAComposerGalleryTile(image, false, 0));
        if (images.Length >= 3)
            ComposerGalleryTiles.Add(new NIRAComposerGalleryTile(images[2], true, images.Length - 2));
        foreach (var document in ComposerAttachments.Where(a => !a.IsImage))
            ComposerGalleryTiles.Add(new NIRAComposerGalleryTile(document, false, 0));
    }
    public bool HasComposerAttachments => ComposerAttachments.Count > 0;
    private const int MaximumComposerAttachments = 12;

    public int AddComposerAttachments(IEnumerable<string> paths)
    {
        int added = 0;
        foreach (string? raw in paths)
        {
            if (ComposerAttachments.Count >= MaximumComposerAttachments) break;
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(raw)) continue;
            string path;
            try { path = Path.GetFullPath(raw); }
            catch (Exception) { continue; }
            if (!File.Exists(path) || ComposerAttachments.Any(x =>
                string.Equals(x.FullPath, path, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))) continue;
            try
            {
                var info = new FileInfo(path);
                ComposerAttachments.Add(new NIRAComposerAttachment(path, info.Name));
                added++;
            }
            catch (Exception) { /* Unavailable file: never pretend it was attached. */ }
        }
        return added;
    }

    {

    }

    public MainWindowViewModel(
        NIRAMindRuntime mind,
        NIRAOutputDispatcher dispatcher,
        VoiceQueue voiceQueue,
        NIRARuntimeSettingsService settings)
    {

            mind
            ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(

            _sendCommand.RaiseCanExecuteChanged();
        };

        _settings.Changed +=
            Settings_Changed;


        _sendCommand =
            new AsyncRelayCommand(
                SendMessageAsync,
                () =>
                    CanSend);


        _backgroundResponseTask =
            ProcessBackgroundResponsesAsync();
    }


    private void SubmitFollowUp(string choice)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(choice)) return;
        // Clicked options become ordinary user messages, not permissioned actions.
        // Follow-ups are independent user turns even when an earlier task runs.
        MessageInput = "Regarding your previous answer: " + choice.Trim();
        if (CanSend) _ = SendMessageAsync();
    }

    private async Task SendMessageAsync()
    {
        string userText = MessageInput.Trim();
        NIRAComposerAttachment[] attachments = ComposerAttachments.ToArray();
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(userText) && attachments.Length == 0)
            return;

        // Images travel as real multimodal inputs; other file types remain
        // explicit local references requiring authorized file capabilities.
        string[] imagePaths;
        try
        {
            imagePaths = NIRAAgent.AI.Cognition.NIRAImageInput.Validate(
                attachments.Where(a => a.IsImage).Select(a => a.FullPath)).ToArray();
        }
        catch (Exception ex) when (ex is IOException or UnauthorizedAccessException or InvalidOperationException)
        {
            Messages.Add(new ChatMessageViewModel("assistant", "I couldn't attach those images: " + ex.Message));
            return;
        }
        var otherFiles = attachments.Where(a => !a.IsImage).ToArray();
        string input = string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(userText)
            ? "Please examine the attached image(s) or selected files."
            : userText;
        if (otherFiles.Length != 0)
            input += "\n\n[Selected file paths; contents not observed]\n" +
                string.Join("\n", otherFiles.Select(a => "- " + a.FullPath));
        if (imagePaths.Length != 0)
            input += "\n[Real image data accompanies this turn. Inspect the attached images directly; do not treat filenames as visual evidence.]";

        // A past chat is a one-turn explicit source, never merged into this transcript.
        Guid? attachedPastChatSessionId = _attachedPastChatSessionId;
        ClearPastChatAttachment();

        // Reserve a slot synchronously on the UI thread before the first await.
        // A long Ultra run should not disable the input for the next message.
        if (_activeUserTurns >= MaximumQueuedUserTurns ||
            _shutdown.IsCancellationRequested)
            return;

        _activeUserTurns++;
        IsProcessing = true;
        long turnSequence = Interlocked.Increment(ref _newestUserTurn);
        SpeechChunker speechChunker = new();
        SpeechResponseState speechState = new();
        _voiceQueue.Interrupt();

        MessageInput = string.Empty;
        ComposerAttachments.Clear();
        OnPropertyChanged(nameof(CanSend));
        _sendCommand.RaiseCanExecuteChanged();


        // Keep the user's actual words separate from selected sources.
        // An image is shown AS an image in the bubble, never as "📎 file.png".
        // The cognition path above still receives the real image bytes.
        ChatMessageViewModel userMessage = new("user", userText);
        userMessage.AddUserAttachments(attachments);

        Messages.Add(userMessage);


        ChatMessageViewModel assistantMessage =
            new(
                "assistant",
                string.Empty);


        // Keep every concurrent reply visually tied to its actual input.
        assistantMessage.SetReplySource(userText.Length > 0 ? userText : input);
        // Start with NIRA's living dots only.
        // Text appears later only when the runtime/model emits a real progress update.
        assistantMessage.BeginJourney();
        Messages.Add(
            assistantMessage);

        // Spoken journey checkpoints are sparse, not a running narration.
        // They share the current reply's queue generation, so a new user turn
        // still interrupts them as usual.
        DateTimeOffset lastSpokenProgress = DateTimeOffset.UtcNow;
        bool hasSpokenProgress = false;
        string lastSpokenProgressText = string.Empty;

        try
        {
            await foreach (
                NIRAOutputChunk chunk
                in _mind.ProcessUserMessageAsync(
                    input,
                    _shutdown.Token,
                    attachedPastChatSessionId,
                    imagePaths))
            {
                if (chunk.Type == NIRAOutputChunkType.Progress)
                {
                    if (chunk.IsImageGenerationProgress)
                        assistantMessage.IsImageGenerationActive = true;
                    // Progress is not a chat message, a capability result, or
                    // archival material; show only while the reply is pending.
                    if (!assistantMessage.HasContent &&
                        !assistantMessage.HasRichElements &&
                        !assistantMessage.HasVisualArtifacts)
                        assistantMessage.ProgressText = chunk.Content;
                    string spoken = chunk.SpeechContent.Trim();
                    TimeSpan gap = DateTimeOffset.UtcNow - lastSpokenProgress;
                    if (_settings.Current.VoiceEnabled &&
                        turnSequence == Interlocked.Read(ref _newestUserTurn) &&
                        !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(spoken) &&
                        !string.Equals(spoken, lastSpokenProgressText,
                            StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) &&
                        gap >= (!hasSpokenProgress
                            ? TimeSpan.FromSeconds(6)
                            : chunk.IsProgressCorrection
                                ? TimeSpan.FromSeconds(8)
                                : TimeSpan.FromSeconds(20)))
                    {
                        _voiceQueue.Enqueue(new VoiceUtterance(
                            Guid.NewGuid(), 1, spoken,
                            NIRAVoiceExpression.Neutral));
                        lastSpokenProgress = DateTimeOffset.UtcNow;
                        lastSpokenProgressText = spoken;
                        hasSpokenProgress = true;
                    }
                    continue;
                }
                if (chunk.Type == NIRAOutputChunkType.Text)
                    assistantMessage.BeginProgressFadeOut();
                HandleChunk(
                    assistantMessage,
                    chunk,
                    speechChunker,
                    speechState,
                    _settings.Current.VoiceEnabled &&
                    turnSequence == Interlocked.Read(ref _newestUserTurn));
            }


            FlushSpeech(
                speechChunker,
                speechState,
                _settings.Current.VoiceEnabled &&
                turnSequence == Interlocked.Read(ref _newestUserTurn));


            if (assistantMessage.HasContent ||
                assistantMessage.HasRichElements ||
                assistantMessage.HasVisualArtifacts)
            {
                assistantMessage.BeginProgressFadeOut();
            }
            else
            {
                assistantMessage.ClearProgressImmediately();
                if (assistantMessage.IsEmpty)
                {
                    Messages.Remove(
                        assistantMessage);
                }
            }
        }
        catch (OperationCanceledException)
            when (_shutdown.IsCancellationRequested)
        {
            speechChunker.Clear();
            speechState.Reset();
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            speechChunker.Clear();
            speechState.Reset();


            assistantMessage.Content =
                $"Sorry, something went wrong.\n\n{ex.Message}";
            assistantMessage.BeginProgressFadeOut();
        }
        finally
        {
            if (assistantMessage.HasContent ||
                assistantMessage.HasRichElements ||
                assistantMessage.HasVisualArtifacts)
            {
                assistantMessage.BeginProgressFadeOut();
            }
            else
            {
                assistantMessage.ClearProgressImmediately();
                if (assistantMessage.IsEmpty)
                    Messages.Remove(assistantMessage);
            }

            speechChunker.Clear();
            speechState.Reset();
            _activeUserTurns = Math.Max(0, _activeUserTurns - 1);
            IsProcessing = _activeUserTurns > 0;
            OnPropertyChanged(nameof(CanSend));
            _sendCommand.RaiseCanExecuteChanged();
        }
    }


    private async Task ProcessBackgroundResponsesAsync()
    {
        try
        {
            await foreach (
                NIRAOutputChunk chunk
                in _dispatcher.ReadAllAsync(
                    _shutdown.Token))
            {
                await System.Windows.Application
                    .Current
                    .Dispatcher
                    .InvokeAsync(
                        () =>
                            HandleBackgroundChunk(
                                chunk));
            }
        }
        catch (OperationCanceledException)
            when (_shutdown.IsCancellationRequested)
        {
        }
    }


    private void HandleBackgroundChunk(
        NIRAOutputChunk chunk)
    {
        if (chunk.Type == NIRAOutputChunkType.Progress)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(chunk.Content)) return;
            BackgroundResponseState progress = GetOrCreateBackgroundResponse(chunk.RunId, chunk.OriginPrompt);
            if (chunk.IsImageGenerationProgress)
                progress.Message.IsImageGenerationActive = true;
            if (!progress.Message.HasContent &&
                !progress.Message.HasRichElements &&
                !progress.Message.HasVisualArtifacts)
                progress.Message.ProgressText = chunk.Content;

            string spoken = chunk.SpeechContent.Trim();
            if (_settings.Current.VoiceEnabled &&
                _settings.Current.SpeakBackgroundUpdates &&
                !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(spoken) &&
                !string.Equals(spoken, _lastBackgroundJourneySpeechText,
                    StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) &&
                DateTimeOffset.UtcNow - _lastBackgroundJourneySpeech >=
                    (chunk.IsProgressCorrection
                        ? TimeSpan.FromSeconds(8)
                        : TimeSpan.FromSeconds(20)))
            {
                _voiceQueue.Enqueue(new VoiceUtterance(
                    Guid.NewGuid(), 1, spoken, NIRAVoiceExpression.Neutral));
                _lastBackgroundJourneySpeech = DateTimeOffset.UtcNow;
                _lastBackgroundJourneySpeechText = spoken;
            }
            return;
        }

        if (chunk.Type ==
            NIRAOutputChunkType.Cancelled)
        {
            RemoveBackgroundRun(
                chunk.RunId,
                removeMessage: true);


            return;
        }


        if (chunk.Type ==
            NIRAOutputChunkType.VisualArtifact)
        {
            if (chunk.VisualArtifact == null)
            {
                return;
            }

            if (chunk.VisualArtifact.Surface !=
                NIRAVisualArtifactPresentationSurface.ToastOnly)
            {
                BackgroundResponseState visualResponseState =
                    GetOrCreateBackgroundResponse(
                        chunk.RunId, chunk.OriginPrompt);

                visualResponseState.Message.AssociateRun(
                    chunk.RunId);

                visualResponseState.Message.AddVisualArtifact(
                    chunk.VisualArtifact);
            }

            VisualArtifactReceived?.Invoke(
                chunk.VisualArtifact);

            return;
        }


        if (chunk.Type ==
            NIRAOutputChunkType.Completed)
        {
            if (_backgroundResponses.TryGetValue(
                    chunk.RunId,
                    out BackgroundResponseState? state))
            {
                FlushSpeech(
                    state.SpeechChunker,
                    state.SpeechState,
                    _settings.Current.VoiceEnabled &&
                    _settings.Current.SpeakBackgroundUpdates);


                state.SpeechState.Reset();
                // Transient progress fades away when a real result exists.
                if (state.Message.HasContent ||
                    state.Message.HasRichElements ||
                    state.Message.HasVisualArtifacts)
                {
                    state.Message.BeginProgressFadeOut();
                }
                else
                {
                    state.Message.ClearProgressImmediately();
                    if (state.Message.IsEmpty)
                        Messages.Remove(state.Message);
                }

                _backgroundResponses.Remove(
                    chunk.RunId);
            }


            return;
        }


        if (
            chunk.Type !=
                NIRAOutputChunkType.Text
            ||
            (string.IsNullOrEmpty(chunk.Content) && chunk.DisplayBlocks.Count == 0 &&
             string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(chunk.SpeechContent)))
        {
            return;
        }


        BackgroundResponseState responseState =
            GetOrCreateBackgroundResponse(
                chunk.RunId, chunk.OriginPrompt);


        responseState.Message.BeginProgressFadeOut();
        HandleChunk(
            responseState.Message,
            chunk,
            responseState.SpeechChunker,
            responseState.SpeechState,
            _settings.Current.VoiceEnabled &&
            _settings.Current.SpeakBackgroundUpdates);
    }


    private BackgroundResponseState GetOrCreateBackgroundResponse(
        Guid runId, string originPrompt = "")
    {
        if (_backgroundResponses.TryGetValue(
                runId,
                out BackgroundResponseState? existing))
        {
            existing.Message.SetReplySource(originPrompt, background: true);
            return existing;
        }

        ChatMessageViewModel message =
            new(
                "assistant",
                string.Empty);

        message.AssociateRun(
            runId);
        message.SetReplySource(originPrompt.Length > 0 ? originPrompt :
            "Autonomous task update", background: true);

        message.BeginJourney();

        Messages.Add(
            message);

        BackgroundResponseState created =
            new(
                message);

        _backgroundResponses[
            runId] =
                created;

        return created;
    }


    private void RemoveBackgroundRun(
        Guid runId,
        bool removeMessage)
    {
        if (!_backgroundResponses.Remove(
                runId,
                out BackgroundResponseState? state))
        {
            return;
        }


        state.SpeechChunker.Clear();


        state.SpeechState.Reset();


        if (removeMessage)
        {
            Messages.Remove(
                state.Message);
        }
    }


    private void HandleChunk(
        ChatMessageViewModel message,
        NIRAOutputChunk chunk,
        SpeechChunker speechChunker,
        SpeechResponseState speechState,
        bool allowSpeech)
    {
        message.AssociateRun(
            chunk.RunId);

        if (chunk.Type ==
            NIRAOutputChunkType.VisualArtifact)
        {
            if (chunk.VisualArtifact != null)
            {
                if (chunk.VisualArtifact.Surface !=
                    NIRAVisualArtifactPresentationSurface.ToastOnly)
                {
                    message.AddVisualArtifact(
                        chunk.VisualArtifact);
                }

                VisualArtifactReceived?.Invoke(
                    chunk.VisualArtifact);
            }

            return;
        }

        if (
            chunk.Type !=
                NIRAOutputChunkType.Text
            ||
            (string.IsNullOrEmpty(chunk.Content) && chunk.DisplayBlocks.Count == 0 &&
             string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(chunk.SpeechContent)))
        {
            return;
        }


        speechState.Expression =
            chunk.VoiceExpression.Normalize();


        message.Content +=
            chunk.Content;

        if (chunk.DisplayBlocks.Count > 0)
            message.AddRichBlocks(chunk.DisplayBlocks, _conversationArchive,
                chunk.ArchiveMessageId, SubmitFollowUp);


        if (!allowSpeech)
        {
            speechChunker.Clear();
            speechState.Reset();
            return;
        }


        IReadOnlyList<string> speechParts =
            speechChunker.Add(
                string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(chunk.SpeechContent) ? chunk.Content : chunk.SpeechContent);


        foreach (
            string speechPart
            in speechParts)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                    speechPart))
            {
                continue;
            }


            _voiceQueue.Enqueue(
                speechState.Create(
                    speechPart));
        }
    }


    private void FlushSpeech(
        SpeechChunker speechChunker,
        SpeechResponseState speechState,
        bool allowSpeech)
    {
        if (!allowSpeech)
        {
            speechChunker.Clear();
            speechState.Reset();
            return;
        }


        string? remaining =
            speechChunker.Complete();


        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                remaining))
        {
            return;
        }


        _voiceQueue.Enqueue(
            speechState.Create(
                remaining));
    }


    private void Settings_Changed(
        NIRARuntimeSettings before,
        NIRARuntimeSettings after)
    {
        if (
            before.VoiceEnabled != after.VoiceEnabled
            ||
            before.SpeakBackgroundUpdates != after.SpeakBackgroundUpdates
            ||
            before.VoiceEngine != after.VoiceEngine)
        {
            _voiceQueue.Interrupt();
        }
    }


    public event PropertyChangedEventHandler?
        PropertyChanged;


    private void OnPropertyChanged(
        [CallerMemberName]
        string? propertyName = null)
    {
        PropertyChanged?.Invoke(
            this,
            new PropertyChangedEventArgs(
                propertyName));
    }


    public void Dispose()
    {
        _settings.Changed -=
            Settings_Changed;


        _shutdown.Cancel();


        _voiceQueue.Interrupt();


        foreach (
            BackgroundResponseState state
            in _backgroundResponses.Values)
        {
            state.SpeechChunker.Clear();


            state.SpeechState.Reset();
        }


        _backgroundResponses.Clear();


        try
        {
            _backgroundResponseTask
                .GetAwaiter()
                .GetResult();
        }
        catch (OperationCanceledException)
        {
        }


        _shutdown.Dispose();
    }


    private sealed class BackgroundResponseState
    {
        public ChatMessageViewModel Message
        {
            get;
        }


        public SpeechChunker SpeechChunker
        {
            get;
        } =
            new();


        public SpeechResponseState SpeechState
        {
            get;
        } =
            new();


        public BackgroundResponseState(
            ChatMessageViewModel message)
        {
            Message =
                message;
        }
    }


    private sealed class SpeechResponseState
    {
        public Guid ResponseId
        {
            get;
            private set;
        } =
            Guid.NewGuid();


        public int Sequence
        {
            get;
            private set;
        }


        public NIRAVoiceExpression Expression
        {
            get;
            set;
        } =
            NIRAVoiceExpression.Neutral;


        public VoiceUtterance Create(
            string text)
        {
            ArgumentException.ThrowIfNullOrWhiteSpace(
                text);


            Sequence++;


            return new VoiceUtterance(
                ResponseId,
                Sequence,
                text,
                Expression);
        }


        public void Reset()
        {
            ResponseId =
                Guid.NewGuid();


            Sequence =
                0;


            Expression =
                NIRAVoiceExpression.Neutral;
        }
    }
}


/// <summary>
/// Composer-only local file reference. The model gets only the path until the
/// separate content/vision ingestion stage is implemented.
/// </summary>
public sealed record NIRAComposerAttachment(string FullPath, string FileName)
{
    private string ExtensionLower => Path.GetExtension(FileName).ToLowerInvariant();

    public bool IsImage => ExtensionLower is ".png" or ".jpg" or ".jpeg" or ".webp" or ".gif" or ".bmp";
    // Do not ask WPF image decoders to open PDF or other non-image attachments.
    public string? PreviewPath => IsImage ? FullPath : null;
    public bool IsAudio => ExtensionLower is ".mp3" or ".wav" or ".m4a" or ".flac" or ".aac";
    public bool IsSpreadsheet => ExtensionLower is ".xlsx" or ".xls" or ".csv";
    public bool IsCodeOrData => ExtensionLower is ".json" or ".xml" or ".yaml" or ".yml" or ".md" or ".txt" or ".cs" or ".py";
    public bool IsPdf => ExtensionLower is ".pdf";

    public string ExtensionLabel
    {
        get
        {
            string ext = Path.GetExtension(FileName);
            return string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(ext) ? "FILE" : ext.TrimStart('.').ToUpperInvariant();
        }
    }

    public string TypeGlyph =>
        IsImage ? "▣" :
        IsAudio ? "♪" :
        IsSpreadsheet ? "▤" :
        IsPdf ? "▥" :
        IsCodeOrData ? "≣" : "•";

    public string TypeLabel =>
        IsImage ? "Image preview" :
        IsAudio ? "Audio reference" :
        IsSpreadsheet ? "Spreadsheet or table" :
        IsPdf ? "PDF document" :
        IsCodeOrData ? "Document or data" : "Attached file";
}

// Exactly three image tiles are shown in the composer. The tile wrapping is
// visual only; sending still includes ALL ComposerAttachments, unmodified.
public sealed record NIRAComposerGalleryTile(NIRAComposerAttachment Attachment, bool IsOverflowTile, int HiddenCount)
{
    public bool IsImage => Attachment.IsImage;
    public string? PreviewPath => Attachment.PreviewPath;
    public string FullPath => Attachment.FullPath;
    public string FileName => Attachment.FileName;
    public string TypeGlyph => Attachment.TypeGlyph;
    public string TypeLabel => Attachment.TypeLabel;
    public string ExtensionLabel => Attachment.ExtensionLabel;
    public string OverflowLabel => IsOverflowTile ? $"+{HiddenCount} more" : string.Empty;
}
```

## 75. `NIRAAgent.UI\ViewModels\NIRAVisualAnnotationRenderer.cs`

**File:** `NIRAAgent.UI\ViewModels\NIRAVisualAnnotationRenderer.cs`

```csharp
using System.Windows;
using System.Windows.Media;
using System.Windows.Media.Imaging;
using NIRAAgent.Artifacts;

namespace NIRAAgent.UI.ViewModels;

// WPF-only drawing: no model-generated XAML, scripts, or screen actions.
// Source images remain unmodified; the same visual is used in chat and viewer.
public static class NIRAVisualAnnotationRenderer
{
    public static ImageSource? Render(
        ImageSource? source, IReadOnlyList<NIRAVisualAnnotation> annotations)
    {
        if (source is not BitmapSource bitmap || annotations.Count == 0)
            return source;
        double w = bitmap.PixelWidth, h = bitmap.PixelHeight;
        if (w < 1 || h < 1) return source;
        DrawingGroup drawing = new();
        drawing.Children.Add(new ImageDrawing(bitmap, new Rect(0, 0, w, h)));
        Pen cyan = new(new SolidColorBrush(Color.FromRgb(34, 211, 238)),
            Math.Max(2, w * 0.003));
        cyan.Freeze();
        foreach (NIRAVisualAnnotation raw in annotations.Take(12))
        {
            NIRAVisualAnnotation a;
            try { a = raw.Normalize(); }
            catch (InvalidOperationException) { continue; }
            Rect box = new(a.X * w, a.Y * h, a.Width * w, a.Height * h);
            if (a.Kind == "rectangle")
            {
                drawing.Children.Add(new GeometryDrawing(
                    null, cyan, new RectangleGeometry(box, 5, 5)));
            }
            else
            {
                // Arrow from the start of the grounded source rectangle
                // toward its opposite corner. No UI clicks are generated.
                Point start = box.TopLeft, end = box.BottomRight;
                Vector backwards = start - end;
                if (backwards.Length < 1) continue;
                backwards.Normalize();
                Vector side = new(-backwards.Y, backwards.X);
                double length = Math.Max(12, w * 0.018);
                drawing.Children.Add(new GeometryDrawing(null, cyan,
                    new LineGeometry(start, end)));
                drawing.Children.Add(new GeometryDrawing(null, cyan,
                    new LineGeometry(end, end + backwards * length + side * length * 0.45)));
                drawing.Children.Add(new GeometryDrawing(null, cyan,
                    new LineGeometry(end, end + backwards * length - side * length * 0.45)));
            }
        }
        drawing.Freeze();
        DrawingImage rendered = new(drawing);
        rendered.Freeze();
        return rendered;
    }
}
```

```csharp
/*
 * filename: VisualArtifactViewModel.cs
 */

using System.IO;
using System.ComponentModel;
using System.Diagnostics;
using System.Runtime.CompilerServices;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using System.Windows;
using System.Windows.Threading;
using System.Windows.Media;
using System.Windows.Media.Imaging;

using NIRAAgent.Artifacts;
using NIRAAgent.Diagnostics;
using NIRAAgent.Presentation;

namespace NIRAAgent.UI.ViewModels;

public sealed class VisualArtifactViewModel : INotifyPropertyChanged
{
    public NIRAVisualArtifact Artifact
    {
        get;
    }


    public Guid ArtifactId =>
        Artifact.ArtifactId;


    public string Title =>
        string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(Artifact.Title)
            ? "Visual result"
            : Artifact.Title;


    public string Caption =>
        string.Join("\n", new[] { Artifact.Caption }
            .Concat(Artifact.Annotations.Select(a => a.Label))
            .Where(value => !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(value)));


    public bool HasCaption =>
        !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(Caption);


    public string LocalPath =>
        Artifact.LocalPath;

    // Source is optional provenance from an already verified visual artifact;
    // it does not cause a network request or manufacture an image preview.
    public string SourceUri => Artifact.SourceUri;
    public bool HasSourceUri => Uri.TryCreate(SourceUri, UriKind.Absolute, out var parsed)
        && (parsed.Scheme == Uri.UriSchemeHttps || parsed.Scheme == Uri.UriSchemeHttp);

    // Structured labels are derived from already retrieved, attributed images.
    // Other visual artifacts keep their original caption rather than being
    // misidentified as stock photography or as a licensed reference image.
    private NIRAReferenceImageCredit Credit =>
        NIRAReferenceImageCreditPolicy.Read(Artifact.Caption, SourceUri);
    public bool HasStructuredCredit => Credit.IsStructured;
    public string CreditProvider => IsGeneratedImage ? "AI GENERATED" : Credit.Provider;
    public string CreditCreator => Credit.Creator;
    public bool HasCreditCreator => Credit.HasCreator;
    public string CreditLicense => Credit.License;
    public bool HasCreditLicense => Credit.HasLicense;
    public string SourceActionLabel => Credit.LinkLabel;
    public string ReferenceCaption => Credit.IsStructured ? "" : Caption;
    public bool HasReferenceCaption => !Credit.IsStructured && HasCaption;

    // Generated images have no external source URL and carry NIRA's
    // provider-owned caption prefix. This lets chat/gallery cards render a
    // distinct AI-created presentation without mislabeling them as references.
    public bool IsGeneratedImage =>
        !HasSourceUri &&
        Artifact.Caption.StartsWith("Generated by NIRA", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);

    public string CardBadgeText =>
        IsGeneratedImage ? "NIRA  /  AI CREATED" : "NIRA  /  IMAGE REFERENCE";

    public string GeneratedMetaText =>
        IsGeneratedImage ? Artifact.Caption : string.Empty;


    public ImageSource? PreviewImage
    {
        get;
    }


    public bool HasPreview =>
        PreviewImage != null;

    // Never decode a full-resolution image in a WPF binding getter. WPF reads
    // FullImage during window.Show/layout, on the UI dispatcher; synchronous
    // file I/O and bitmap decoding here previously froze the entire app.
    private ImageSource? _fullImage;
    public ImageSource? FullImage => _fullImage ?? PreviewImage;

    // Called from the viewer's UI dispatcher. Only the expensive decode and
    // annotation composition run on a worker; the frozen result is delivered
    // back to the dispatcher, with the low-resolution preview shown meanwhile.
    public async Task LoadFullImageAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        if (_fullImage != null || !HasPreview) return;
        cancellationToken.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();

        string path = LocalPath;
        NIRAVisualAnnotation[] annotations = Artifact.Annotations.ToArray();
        var timer = Stopwatch.StartNew();
        NIRADiagnosticTrace.Event("IMAGE-VIEWER", "Stage=DecodeStart");

        ImageSource? decoded = await Task.Run(() =>
            NIRAVisualAnnotationRenderer.Render(
                TryLoadPreview(path, decodePixelWidth: 1600), annotations),
            cancellationToken);

        cancellationToken.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
        if (decoded == null)
        {
            NIRADiagnosticTrace.Event("IMAGE-VIEWER", $"Stage=DecodeUnavailable ElapsedMs={timer.ElapsedMilliseconds}");
            return;
        }

        // A continuation from a window Loaded callback normally runs on the
        // dispatcher. Explicit dispatch also protects future non-UI callers.
        Dispatcher? dispatcher = Application.Current?.Dispatcher;
        if (dispatcher != null && !dispatcher.CheckAccess())
        {
            await dispatcher.InvokeAsync(() => SetFullImage(decoded),
                DispatcherPriority.DataBind, cancellationToken);
        }
        else
        {
            SetFullImage(decoded);
        }
        NIRADiagnosticTrace.Event("IMAGE-VIEWER", $"Stage=DecodeReady ElapsedMs={timer.ElapsedMilliseconds}");
    }

    // Gallery navigation releases large images so inspecting many attachments
    // does not keep dozens of decoded bitmaps resident on an 8 GB PC.
    public void ReleaseFullImage()
    {
        if (_fullImage == null) return;
        _fullImage = null;
        OnPropertyChanged(nameof(FullImage));
    }

    private void SetFullImage(ImageSource source)
    {
        _fullImage = source;
        OnPropertyChanged(nameof(FullImage));
    }

    public event PropertyChangedEventHandler? PropertyChanged;
    private void OnPropertyChanged([CallerMemberName] string? propertyName = null) =>
        PropertyChanged?.Invoke(this, new PropertyChangedEventArgs(propertyName));


    public VisualArtifactViewModel(
        NIRAVisualArtifact artifact)
    {
        Artifact =
            artifact
            ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(
                nameof(artifact));

        PreviewImage =
            NIRAVisualAnnotationRenderer.Render(
                TryLoadPreview(artifact.LocalPath), artifact.Annotations);
    }


    public static ImageSource? TryLoadPreview(
        string path,
        int decodePixelWidth = 960)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(path)
            || !File.Exists(path))
        {
            return null;
        }

        try
        {
            BitmapImage bitmap =
                new();

            bitmap.BeginInit();
            bitmap.CacheOption =
                BitmapCacheOption.OnLoad;
            bitmap.CreateOptions =
                BitmapCreateOptions.IgnoreColorProfile;
            bitmap.DecodePixelWidth =
                Math.Max(1, decodePixelWidth);
            bitmap.UriSource =
                new Uri(
                    Path.GetFullPath(path),
                    UriKind.Absolute);
            bitmap.EndInit();
            bitmap.Freeze();

            return bitmap;
        }
        catch
        {
            return null;
        }
    }
}
```

**File:** `NIRAAgent.UI\Vision\NIRAForegroundWorkCoordinator.cs`

```csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Runtime.InteropServices;
using System.Text;
using System.Threading;
using System.Windows;
using System.Windows.Controls;
using System.Windows.Media;
using System.Windows.Threading;
using NIRAAgent.Diagnostics;
using NIRAAgent.Vision;

namespace NIRAAgent.UI.Vision;

// Never fakes keystrokes in another foreground window. A lease follows the
// actual HWND/PID across one or more capability calls. The first foreground
// action may activate the target; after a user switch, it never steals focus
// back automatically. Waiting is local: zero LLM calls, cancellable by the run.
internal sealed class NIRAForegroundWorkCoordinator
{
    private readonly object _gate = new();
    private readonly Dictionary<IntPtr, int> _acquired = new();
    private readonly Dictionary<IntPtr, NIRAForegroundLeaseState> _states = new();

    internal bool AwaitTarget(IntPtr hwnd, int pid, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        bool first;
        lock (_gate)
        {
            first = !_acquired.TryGetValue(hwnd, out int original) || original != pid;
            if (first)
            {
                _acquired[hwnd] = pid;
                _states[hwnd] = new NIRAForegroundLeaseState();
            }
        }

        CheckWindow(hwnd, pid);
        if (first && GetForegroundWindow() != hwnd)
        {
            if (IsIconic(hwnd)) ShowWindowAsync(hwnd, 9);
            SetForegroundWindow(hwnd); // only the initial activation
        }

        try
        {
            while (GetForegroundWindow() != hwnd)
            {
                cancellationToken.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
                CheckWindow(hwnd, pid);
                bool announce;
                lock (_gate) announce = _states[hwnd].Observe(false) == NIRAForegroundLeaseTransition.Paused;
                if (announce)
                {
                    NIRADiagnosticTrace.Event("DESKTOP-FOCUS-PAUSED", $"HWND=0x{hwnd.ToInt64():X} PID={pid}");
                    var caption = new StringBuilder(180);
                    GetWindowText(hwnd, caption, caption.Capacity);
                    NIRAForegroundWorkNotice.Display(true, caption.ToString());
                }
                // No UI thread blocking and no model call while awaiting owner focus.
                if (cancellationToken.WaitHandle.WaitOne(180))
                    cancellationToken.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
            }
            CheckWindow(hwnd, pid);
            bool resumed;
            lock (_gate) resumed = _states[hwnd].Observe(true) == NIRAForegroundLeaseTransition.Resumed;
            if (resumed)
            {
                NIRADiagnosticTrace.Event("DESKTOP-FOCUS-RESUMED", $"HWND=0x{hwnd.ToInt64():X} PID={pid}");
                NIRAForegroundWorkNotice.Display(false);
            }
            return resumed;
        }
        catch
        {
            lock (_gate)
            {
                _states.Remove(hwnd);
                _acquired.Remove(hwnd);
            }
            NIRAForegroundWorkNotice.Display(false);
            throw;
        }
    }

    private static void CheckWindow(IntPtr hwnd, int pid)
    {
        if (hwnd == IntPtr.Zero || !IsWindow(hwnd))
            throw new InvalidOperationException("The foreground task's target window has closed. Paused work cannot resume.");
        GetWindowThreadProcessId(hwnd, out uint livePid);
        if (livePid != (uint)pid)
            throw new InvalidOperationException("Target HWND was reused by another process. Paused work cannot resume.");
    }

    [DllImport("user32.dll", CharSet = CharSet.Unicode)]
    private static extern int GetWindowText(IntPtr hwnd, StringBuilder text, int maxLength);
    [DllImport("user32.dll")] [return: MarshalAs(UnmanagedType.Bool)]
    private static extern bool IsWindow(IntPtr hwnd);
    [DllImport("user32.dll")] private static extern uint GetWindowThreadProcessId(IntPtr hwnd, out uint pid);
    [DllImport("user32.dll")] private static extern IntPtr GetForegroundWindow();
    [DllImport("user32.dll")] [return: MarshalAs(UnmanagedType.Bool)]
    private static extern bool SetForegroundWindow(IntPtr hwnd);
    [DllImport("user32.dll")] [return: MarshalAs(UnmanagedType.Bool)]
    private static extern bool IsIconic(IntPtr hwnd);
    [DllImport("user32.dll")] [return: MarshalAs(UnmanagedType.Bool)]
    private static extern bool ShowWindowAsync(IntPtr hwnd, int cmd);
}

// A small, non-modal, non-activating warning. It never becomes the foreground
// window itself, so it cannot interfere with the user or the paused worker.
internal static class NIRAForegroundWorkNotice
{
    private static Window? _notice;
    internal static void Display(bool paused, string? windowTitle = null)
    {
        Dispatcher? dispatcher = Application.Current?.Dispatcher;
        if (dispatcher is null || dispatcher.HasShutdownStarted) return;
        dispatcher.BeginInvoke(new Action(() =>
        {
            if (paused)
            {
                if (_notice is null)
                {
                    var text = new TextBlock
                    {
                        Text = "NIRA paused desktop control. Bring the working application to the foreground to resume.",
                        Foreground = Brushes.White,
                        TextWrapping = TextWrapping.Wrap,
                        FontSize = 13
                    };
                    var border = new Border
                    {
                        Background = new SolidColorBrush(Color.FromRgb(22, 27, 40)),
                        BorderBrush = new SolidColorBrush(Color.FromRgb(60, 71, 91)),
                        BorderThickness = new Thickness(1), CornerRadius = new CornerRadius(12),
                        Padding = new Thickness(18, 14, 18, 14), Child = text
                    };
                    _notice = new Window
                    {
                        Title = "NIRA — Waiting for application focus",
                        WindowStyle = WindowStyle.None,
                        AllowsTransparency = true,
                        Background = Brushes.Transparent,
                        ShowActivated = false,
                        ShowInTaskbar = false,
                        Topmost = true,
                        ResizeMode = ResizeMode.NoResize,
                        Width = 390, Height = 112,
                        Content = border
                    };
                    _notice.Closed += (_, _) => _notice = null;
                }
                if (_notice.Content is Border noticeBorder &&
                    noticeBorder.Child is TextBlock noticeText)
                {
                    string caption = string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(windowTitle) ? "the working application"
                        : windowTitle.Length > 90 ? windowTitle[..90] + "…" : windowTitle;
                    noticeText.Text = "NIRA is waiting for " + caption +
                        ". Bring that window to the foreground to resume; you can keep using other apps.";
                }
                Rect area = SystemParameters.WorkArea;
                _notice.Left = area.Right - _notice.Width - 20;
                _notice.Top = area.Bottom - _notice.Height - 20;
                if (!_notice.IsVisible) _notice.Show();
            }
            else if (_notice is not null)
            {
                _notice.Close();
                _notice = null;
            }
        }), DispatcherPriority.Background);
    }
}
```

## 78. `NIRAAgent.UI\Vision\WindowsAccessibilityBackend.cs`

**File:** `NIRAAgent.UI\Vision\WindowsAccessibilityBackend.cs`

```csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Diagnostics;
using System.Runtime.InteropServices;
using System.Text;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using System.Windows.Automation;
using NIRAAgent.Vision;

namespace NIRAAgent.UI.Vision;

// A different observation modality than PrintWindow/BitBlt. Read-only UI
// Automation can return selected navigation controls for windows whose
// surface cannot be rendered or is currently minimized. Works generically
// for applications exposing UIA, without claiming every app supports it.
public sealed class WindowsAccessibilityBackend : INIRADesktopAccessibilityBackend
{
    public async Task<NIRADesktopAccessibilityResult> InspectAsync(
        IntPtr windowHandle, int expectedProcessId,
        CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        if (windowHandle == IntPtr.Zero || expectedProcessId <= 0 ||
            expectedProcessId == Environment.ProcessId)
            throw new InvalidOperationException("An external HWND and PID are required.");

        // UIA providers may be remote or temporarily unresponsive. This
        // operation is bounded for the caller and never traverses the desktop.
        return await Task.Run(() => ReadTree(windowHandle, expectedProcessId, cancellationToken),
            cancellationToken).WaitAsync(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(6), cancellationToken);
    }

    private static NIRADesktopAccessibilityResult ReadTree(
        IntPtr hwnd, int pid, CancellationToken token)
    {
        if (!IsWindow(hwnd))
            throw new InvalidOperationException("The target HWND no longer exists.");
        _ = GetWindowThreadProcessId(hwnd, out uint nativePid);
        if (nativePid != (uint)pid)
            throw new InvalidOperationException("Target HWND changed process identity.");
        AutomationElement root = AutomationElement.FromHandle(hwnd)
            ?? throw new InvalidOperationException("Windows UI Automation cannot inspect the selected HWND.");
        StringBuilder output = new();
        Queue<(AutomationElement Node, int Depth)> todo = new();
        todo.Enqueue((root, 0));
        int examined = 0;
        const int limit = 220;
        const int charLimit = 14500;
        TreeWalker walker = TreeWalker.ControlViewWalker;
        while (todo.Count > 0 && examined < limit && output.Length < charLimit)
        {
            token.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
            var (node, depth) = todo.Dequeue();
            examined++;
            try
            {
                string kind = node.Current.ControlType?.ProgrammaticName ?? "Unknown";
                string name = Clean(node.Current.Name, 180);
                string autoId = Clean(node.Current.AutomationId, 120);
                bool selected = false;
                bool hasSelection = false;
                if (node.TryGetCurrentPattern(SelectionItemPattern.Pattern, out object pattern) &&
                    pattern is SelectionItemPattern selection)
                {
                    selected = selection.Current.IsSelected;
                    hasSelection = true;
                }
                if (name.Length > 0 || autoId.Length > 0 || hasSelection)
                    output.Append("Depth=").Append(depth).Append(" | Control=").Append(kind)
                        .Append(" | Name='").Append(name).Append("' | AutomationId='")
                        .Append(autoId).Append('\'')
                        .Append(hasSelection ? " | IsSelected=" + selected : "")
                        .AppendLine();
                if (depth >= 12) continue;
                AutomationElement? child = walker.GetFirstChild(node);
                int siblings = 0;
                while (child != null && siblings++ < 90 && todo.Count < limit)
                {
                    todo.Enqueue((child, depth + 1));
                    child = walker.GetNextSibling(child);
                }
            }
            catch (ElementNotAvailableException) { }
            catch (InvalidOperationException) { }
            catch (COMException) { }
        }
        if (!IsWindow(hwnd))
            throw new InvalidOperationException("The target window disappeared during accessibility inspection.");
        _ = GetWindowThreadProcessId(hwnd, out nativePid);
        if (nativePid != (uint)pid)
            throw new InvalidOperationException("The target process changed during accessibility inspection.");
        if (output.Length == 0)
            throw new InvalidOperationException("The selected application exposed no readable UI Automation controls.");
        return new NIRADesktopAccessibilityResult
        {
            ControlTree = output.ToString(),
            ElementsRead = examined,
            Truncated = todo.Count != 0 || output.Length >= charLimit
        };
    }

    private static string Clean(string? value, int limit)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(value)) return string.Empty;
        string clean = value.Replace('\r', ' ').Replace('\n', ' ').Replace('\t', ' ').Trim();
        return clean.Length > limit ? clean[..limit] : clean;
    }

    [DllImport("user32.dll")]
    [return: MarshalAs(UnmanagedType.Bool)]
    private static extern bool IsWindow(IntPtr hwnd);
    [DllImport("user32.dll")]
    private static extern uint GetWindowThreadProcessId(IntPtr hwnd, out uint pid);
}
```
