            if (depth > 2)
            {
                return;
            }

            if (item.ValueKind == JsonValueKind.String)
            {
                string value = item.GetString()?.Trim() ?? string.Empty;

                if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(value))
                {
                    values.Add(value);
                }

                return;
            }

            if (item.ValueKind == JsonValueKind.Array)
            {
                foreach (JsonElement nested in item.EnumerateArray())
                {
                    Add(nested, depth + 1);
                }

                return;
            }

            if (item.ValueKind == JsonValueKind.Object)
            {
                foreach (string alias in new[] { "name", "section", "id", "value" })
                {
                    if (TryGetProperty(item, alias, out JsonElement candidate) &&
                        candidate.ValueKind == JsonValueKind.String)
                    {
                        Add(candidate, depth + 1);
                        return;
                    }
                }
            }

            Debug.WriteLine(
                $"[Cognition] OPTIONAL ITEM DROPPED | Property={propertyName} | " +
                $"Reason=Expected string-compatible item, got {item.ValueKind}.");
        }

        foreach (JsonElement item in array.EnumerateArray())
        {
            Add(item, 0);
        }

        return values
            .Distinct(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
            .Take(32)
            .ToArray();
    }


    private IReadOnlyList<T> ReadArrayItems<T>(
        JsonElement root,
        string propertyName)
    {
        if (!TryGetProperty(
                root,
                propertyName,
                out JsonElement array)
            || array.ValueKind !=
                JsonValueKind.Array)
        {
            return Array.Empty<T>();
        }


        List<T> values =
            new();


        foreach (JsonElement item in
                 array.EnumerateArray())
        {
            try
            {
                T? value =
                    item.Deserialize<T>(
                        _jsonOptions);


                if (value is not null)
                {
                    values.Add(value);
                }
            }
            catch (JsonException ex)
            {
                Debug.WriteLine(
                    $"[Cognition] OPTIONAL ITEM DROPPED | Property={propertyName} | Reason={ex.Message}");
            }
            catch (NotSupportedException ex)
            {
                Debug.WriteLine(
                    $"[Cognition] OPTIONAL ITEM DROPPED | Property={propertyName} | Reason={ex.Message}");
            }
        }


        return values;
    }


    private T ReadValue<T>(
        JsonElement root,
        string propertyName,
        T fallback)
    {
        if (!TryGetProperty(
                root,
                propertyName,
                out JsonElement element))
        {
            return fallback;
        }


        try
        {
            T? value =
                element.Deserialize<T>(
                    _jsonOptions);


            return value is null
                ? fallback
                : value;
        }
        catch (JsonException)
        {
            return fallback;
        }
        catch (NotSupportedException)
        {
            return fallback;
        }
    }


    private T? ReadOptional<T>(
        JsonElement root,
        string propertyName)
        where T : class
    {
        if (!TryGetProperty(
                root,
                propertyName,
                out JsonElement element)
            || element.ValueKind is
                JsonValueKind.Null
                or JsonValueKind.Undefined)
        {
            return null;
        }


        try
        {
            return element.Deserialize<T>(
                _jsonOptions);
        }
        catch (JsonException)
        {
            return null;
        }
        catch (NotSupportedException)
        {
            return null;
        }
    }


    private static bool TryGetProperty(
        JsonElement root,
        string propertyName,
        out JsonElement value)
    {
        if (root.TryGetProperty(
                propertyName,
                out value))
        {
            return true;
        }


        foreach (JsonProperty property in
                 root.EnumerateObject())
        {
            if (string.Equals(
                    property.Name,
                    propertyName,
                    StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
            {
                value =
                    property.Value;

                return true;
            }
        }


        value =
            default;

        return false;
    }


    // Narrow lexical recovery: 1. before a JSON delimiter becomes 1.0;
    // 0..75 becomes 0.75. All quoted text and other invalid syntax remain
    // untouched, so the parser can reject ambiguous model output safely.
    private static string NormalizeUnambiguousJsonDecimals(string json)
    {
        StringBuilder builder = new(json.Length + 8);
        bool inString = false;
        bool escaped = false;
        for (int i = 0; i < json.Length; i++)
        {
            char c = json[i];
            if (inString)
            {
                builder.Append(c);
                if (escaped) escaped = false;
                else if (c == '\\') escaped = true;
                else if (c == '"') inString = false;
                continue;
            }
            if (c == '"')
            {
                inString = true;
                builder.Append(c);
                continue;
            }
            if (c == '.' && i > 0 && char.IsAsciiDigit(json[i - 1]))
            {
                if (i + 2 < json.Length && json[i + 1] == '.' &&
                    char.IsAsciiDigit(json[i + 2]))
                {
                    // Skip only the redundant first dot of two.
                    continue;
                }
                int lookAhead = i + 1;
                while (lookAhead < json.Length &&
                    (json[lookAhead] == ' ' || json[lookAhead] == '\n' ||
                     json[lookAhead] == '\r' || json[lookAhead] == '\t'))
                    lookAhead++;
                if (lookAhead < json.Length &&
                    (json[lookAhead] == ',' || json[lookAhead] == '}' ||
                     json[lookAhead] == ']'))
                {
                    builder.Append(".0");
                    continue;
                }
            }
            builder.Append(c);
        }
        return builder.ToString();
    }

    private static string StripCodeFence(
        string raw)
    {
        string value =
            raw.Trim();


        if (!value.StartsWith(
                "```",
                StringComparison.Ordinal))
        {
            return value;
        }


        int firstLineBreak =
            value.IndexOf('\n');


        if (firstLineBreak >=
            0)
        {
            value =
                value[(firstLineBreak + 1)..];
        }


        int closing =
            value.LastIndexOf(
                "```",
                StringComparison.Ordinal);


        if (closing >=
            0)
        {
            value =
                value[..closing];
        }


        return value.Trim();
    }


    private static string NormalizeContext(
        string? value,
        string fallback)
    {
        return string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                value)
            ? fallback
            : value.Trim();
    }


    private static string LoadPromptFile(
        string fileName)
    {
        string path =
            Path.Combine(
                AppContext.BaseDirectory,
                "Prompt",
                fileName);


        if (!File.Exists(
                path))
        {
            throw new FileNotFoundException(
                $"Required NIRA prompt file was not found: {path}",
                path);
        }


        string content =
            File.ReadAllText(
                path);


        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                content))
        {
            throw new InvalidOperationException(
                $"Required NIRA prompt file is empty: {path}");
        }


        return content.Trim();
    }
}

internal sealed class NIRABranchEvidenceSourceJsonConverter
    : JsonConverter<NIRABranchEvidenceSource>
{
    public override NIRABranchEvidenceSource Read(
        ref Utf8JsonReader reader,
        Type typeToConvert,
        JsonSerializerOptions options)
    {
        if (reader.TokenType ==
            JsonTokenType.String)
        {
            string value =
                reader.GetString()?.Trim()
                ?? string.Empty;


            if (Enum.TryParse(
                    value,
                    ignoreCase: true,
                    out NIRABranchEvidenceSource parsed))
            {
                return parsed;
            }


            string normalized =
                new string(
                    value
                        .Where(char.IsLetterOrDigit)
                        .Select(char.ToLowerInvariant)
                        .ToArray());


            return normalized switch
            {
                "userrequest" or
                "usermessage" or
                "currentuser" or
                "currentusermessage" or
                "currentevent" or
                "event" or
                "systemevent" or
                "branchresult" or
                "branchworkresult" or
                "workresult" =>
                    NIRABranchEvidenceSource.CurrentEvent,

                "NIRAreply" or
                "NIRAresponse" or
                "assistantreply" or
                "assistantresponse" or
                "reply" =>
                    NIRABranchEvidenceSource.NIRAReply,

                "executiveplan" or
                "executive" or
                "plan" or
                "planning" or
                "reasoning" =>
                    NIRABranchEvidenceSource.ExecutivePlan,

                "capabilityresult" or
                "capability" or
                "capabilityevidence" or
                "toolresult" or
                "toolevidence" or
                "dynamictoolresult" =>
                    NIRABranchEvidenceSource.CapabilityResult,

                _ =>
                    NIRABranchEvidenceSource.CurrentEvent
            };
        }


        if (reader.TokenType ==
            JsonTokenType.Number
            && reader.TryGetInt32(
                out int numeric)
            && Enum.IsDefined(
                typeof(NIRABranchEvidenceSource),
                numeric))
        {
            return (NIRABranchEvidenceSource)numeric;
        }


        if (reader.TokenType ==
            JsonTokenType.Null)
        {
            return NIRABranchEvidenceSource.CurrentEvent;
        }


        using JsonDocument _ =
            JsonDocument.ParseValue(
                ref reader);


        return NIRABranchEvidenceSource.CurrentEvent;
    }


    public override void Write(
        Utf8JsonWriter writer,
        NIRABranchEvidenceSource value,
        JsonSerializerOptions options)
    {
        writer.WriteStringValue(
            value.ToString());
    }
}

**File:** `NIRAAgent\AI\Cognition\NIRAConversationCadencePolicy.cs`

```csharp
using System.Text;
using System.Text.RegularExpressions;

namespace NIRAAgent.AI.Cognition;

/// <summary>
/// Presentation-only cadence evidence from the SAME bounded conversation
/// provided to cognition. No phrase lists, canned responses, sentiment rules,
/// user-intent classifiers, new memory stores, or changes to character state.
/// It detects near-duplicate opening wording, not semantic disagreement.
/// </summary>
internal static class NIRAConversationCadencePolicy
{
    private static readonly Regex Words = new(@"[\p{L}\p{N}]+",
        RegexOptions.Compiled | RegexOptions.CultureInvariant);

    // The conversation owner serializes each turn as "role: content". A
    // continuation may contain arbitrary line breaks; only explicit role
    // headings begin a new message. Avoid relying on words in the reply.
    public static IReadOnlyList<string> RecentAssistantOpenings(string? context, int maximum = 6)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(context)) return Array.Empty<string>();
        maximum = Math.Clamp(maximum, 1, 12);
        var openings = new List<string>();
        var turn = new StringBuilder();
        bool isAssistant = false;

        void Finish()
        {
            if (isAssistant && turn.Length > 0)
            {
                string opening = Opening(turn.ToString());
                if (opening.Length > 0) openings.Add(opening);
            }
            turn.Clear();
        }

        foreach (string line in context.Replace("\r\n", "\n", StringComparison.Ordinal)
                     .Replace('\r', '\n').Split('\n'))
        {
            int colon = line.IndexOf(':');
            string role = colon >= 0 && colon < 16 ? line[..colon].Trim() : "";
            if (role.Equals("assistant", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
                role.Equals("nira", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
                role.Equals("user", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
                role.Equals("system", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
            {
                Finish();
                isAssistant = role.Equals("assistant", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
                              role.Equals("nira", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
                if (isAssistant) turn.Append(line[(colon + 1)..].TrimStart());
            }
            else if (isAssistant)
            {
                turn.Append('\n').Append(line);
            }
        }
        Finish();
        return openings.TakeLast(maximum).ToArray();
    }

    public static bool RepeatsOpening(string? candidate, string? conversation)
    {
        string[] current = Tokens(Opening(candidate));
        if (current.Length < 5) return false;
        foreach (string previousOpening in RecentAssistantOpenings(conversation))
        {
            string[] previous = Tokens(previousOpening);
            if (previous.Length < 5) continue;
            // Identical 3+ word entry into a full sentence is enough evidence
            // to request a rephrasing, but is never a reason to erase facts.
            int matchingPrefix = 0;
            while (matchingPrefix < Math.Min(current.Length, previous.Length) &&
                   current[matchingPrefix] == previous[matchingPrefix])
                matchingPrefix++;
            if (matchingPrefix >= 3) return true;
            // Also detect longer rearranged stock introductions. Compare
            // contiguous four-word shingles, not a user-specific phrase list.
            var priorShingles = Shingles(previous);
            int matches = Shingles(current).Count(priorShingles.Contains);
            if (matches >= 2 && matches >= Math.Min(current.Length - 3, previous.Length - 3) * 0.55)
                return true;
        }
        return false;
    }

    public static string DescribeRecentOpenings(string? conversation)
    {
        var openings = RecentAssistantOpenings(conversation, 5);
        if (openings.Count < 2) return string.Empty;
        return "RECENT NIRA OPENINGS (actual conversation, NOT example lines to imitate):\n" +
               string.Join("\n", openings.Select(line => "- " + line)) + "\n" +
               "Continue the SAME conversation without reintroducing NIRA or commenting on " +
               "the user's frequency of questions. If an answer has results/visual blocks, " +
               "lead with the substance. Personality is expressed through judgment and " +
               "wording, not a repeated introductory performance.";
    }

    private static string Opening(string? text)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(text)) return "";
        string normalized = text.Trim();
        // Take one opening sentence or visible line; never copy an entire
        // factual result/technical document into the cadence summary.
        int end = Math.Min(normalized.Length, 240);
        for (int i = 0; i < end; i++)
        {
            char c = normalized[i];
            if (c == '\n' || c is '!' or '?') { end = i + 1; break; }
            if (c == '.' && (i + 1 == normalized.Length ||
                (i + 1 < normalized.Length && char.IsWhiteSpace(normalized[i + 1]))))
            { end = i + 1; break; }
        }
        return normalized[..end].Trim();
    }

    private static string[] Tokens(string source) =>
        Words.Matches(source.ToLowerInvariant()).Select(match => match.Value).Take(24).ToArray();

    private static HashSet<string> Shingles(string[] tokens)
    {
        var shingles = new HashSet<string>(StringComparer.Ordinal);
        for (int i = 0; i + 3 < tokens.Length; i++)
            shingles.Add(string.Join(" ", tokens.Skip(i).Take(4)));
        return shingles;
    }
}

using NIRAAgent.Mind;

namespace NIRAAgent.AI.Cognition;

/// <summary>
/// A narrow latency optimization for NIRA's already authored, interpersonal
/// first-turn response. No keyword classifier, tool authorization or factual
/// completion inference is performed here. A non-social task always uses the
/// independent completion reviewer and normal character-delivery process.
/// </summary>
public static class NIRAConversationFastPath
{
    public static bool CanUseDirectReply(
        NIRACognitionDecision d, bool firstUserCycle,
        bool hasTrustedWorkEvidence, bool hasPendingOwnedTask,
        bool embeddedApplication)
    {
        return firstUserCycle && !hasTrustedWorkEvidence &&
            !hasPendingOwnedTask && !embeddedApplication &&
            (d.ConversationOnly ^ d.SelfContainedAnswer) &&
            d.ReplyReady && d.CharacterReady &&
            d.State == NIRACognitionState.Complete && d.EmitReply &&
            d.ReplyPresentation == NIRAReplyPresentationMode.Natural &&
            !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(d.Reply) &&
            !d.ReviewCommitment && !d.ReviewExperience &&
            string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(d.NovelExperienceEvidence) &&
            d.ResourceIntent is null &&
            d.DisplayBlocks.Count == 0 &&
            d.ContextRequests.Count == 0 && d.CapabilityIds.Count == 0 &&
            d.CapabilityRequests.Count == 0 &&
            d.MemorySearches.Count == 0 && d.ConversationSearches.Count == 0 &&
            d.GoalProposals.Count == 0 && d.BranchProposals.Count == 0 &&
            d.BranchWorkProposals.Count == 0 && d.ControlRequests.Count == 0 &&
            d.DynamicToolProposals.Count == 0 && d.DynamicToolInvocations.Count == 0 &&
            d.VisualPresentations.Count == 0 &&
            string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(d.ProgressUpdate) &&
            d.RuntimeContractDiagnostics.Count == 0 &&
            d.CommitmentProposals.Count == 0;
    }
}

## 97. `NIRAAgent\AI\Cognition\NIRAImageInput.cs`

**File:** `NIRAAgent\AI\Cognition\NIRAImageInput.cs`

```csharp
using System.Text.Json;
using System.Text.RegularExpressions;

namespace NIRAAgent.AI.Cognition;

/// <summary>One trusted image input contract for chat attachments, screenshots and discovered local files.</summary>
public static class NIRAImageInput
{
    public const string MetadataKey = "nira.user.images.v1";
    // User turns may include a larger collection. Only bounded image batches
    // are sent to the model, so no image is silently dropped.
    public const int MaximumImagesPerTurn = 24;
    public const int MaximumImagesPerModelCall = 8;
    private const long MaximumImageBytes = 20L * 1024 * 1024;
    public const long MaximumModelCallBytes = 32L * 1024 * 1024;
    private const long MaximumCombinedBytes = 96L * 1024 * 1024;
    private static readonly HashSet<string> Extensions = new(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
        { ".png", ".jpg", ".jpeg", ".webp", ".bmp", ".gif" };

    public static IReadOnlyList<string> Validate(IEnumerable<string> paths)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(paths);
        var result = new List<string>();
        long total = 0;
        foreach (string candidate in paths.Where(p => !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(p)))
        {
            string path = Path.GetFullPath(candidate.Trim().Trim('"'));
            if (!Extensions.Contains(Path.GetExtension(path)))
                throw new InvalidOperationException("Unsupported image type: " + Path.GetExtension(path));
            if (result.Contains(path, StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)) continue;
            if (result.Count >= MaximumImagesPerTurn)
                throw new InvalidOperationException(
                    $"A single message supports up to {MaximumImagesPerTurn} images. " +
                    "Send additional images in a separate message.");
            var file = new FileInfo(path);
            if (!file.Exists) throw new FileNotFoundException("Selected image does not exist.", path);
            if (file.Length == 0 || file.Length > MaximumImageBytes)
                throw new InvalidOperationException("Image is empty or exceeds the 20 MiB individual limit.");
            total += file.Length;
            if (total > MaximumCombinedBytes)
                throw new InvalidOperationException("Images exceed the 96 MiB combined limit for one message.");
            result.Add(path);
        }
        return result;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Groups ALL validated images in original order into bounded requests.
    /// One group means one direct multimodal cognition call; more than one
    /// group is first observed in batches and then synthesized by cognition.
    /// This method performs no LLM calls and never discards images.
    /// </summary>
    public static IReadOnlyList<NIRAImageBatch> PlanBatches(IEnumerable<string> paths)
    {
        IReadOnlyList<string> images = Validate(paths);
        if (images.Count == 0) return Array.Empty<NIRAImageBatch>();

        var result = new List<NIRAImageBatch>();
        var current = new List<string>();
        long currentBytes = 0;
        int firstIndex = 1;

        foreach (string path in images)
        {
            long length = new FileInfo(path).Length;
            if (current.Count > 0 &&
                (current.Count == MaximumImagesPerModelCall ||
                 currentBytes + length > MaximumModelCallBytes))
            {
                result.Add(new NIRAImageBatch(firstIndex, current.ToArray()));
                firstIndex += current.Count;
                current = new List<string>();
                currentBytes = 0;
            }

            current.Add(path);
            currentBytes += length;
        }

        if (current.Count > 0)
            result.Add(new NIRAImageBatch(firstIndex, current.ToArray()));

        return result;
    }

    public static string Serialize(IEnumerable<string> paths) => JsonSerializer.Serialize(Validate(paths));

    public static IReadOnlyList<string> ReadMetadata(IReadOnlyDictionary<string, string> metadata)
    {
        if (!metadata.TryGetValue(MetadataKey, out string? encoded) || string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(encoded))
            return Array.Empty<string>();
        try { return Validate(JsonSerializer.Deserialize<string[]>(encoded) ?? Array.Empty<string>()); }
        catch (JsonException) { throw new InvalidOperationException("Invalid image attachment metadata."); }
    }

    // Explicit absolute image paths in user text are admitted only when the
    // file actually exists; a missing path never becomes hallucinated vision.
    public static IReadOnlyList<string> FindExplicitLocalImages(string userText)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(userText)) return Array.Empty<string>();
        var found = new List<string>();
        foreach (Match match in Regex.Matches(userText,
            """[A-Za-z]:\\[^\r\n"<>|*?]+?\.(?:png|jpe?g|webp|bmp|gif)(?=\s|$|"|[),;])""",
            RegexOptions.IgnoreCase | RegexOptions.CultureInvariant))
        {
            string path = match.Value.Trim();
            if (File.Exists(path)) found.Add(path);
        }
        return found.Count == 0 ? Array.Empty<string>() : Validate(found);
    }
}

/// <summary>One contiguous, locally validated set of images for a vision request.</summary>
public sealed record NIRAImageBatch(int FirstImageNumber, IReadOnlyList<string> Paths);

**File:** `NIRAAgent\AI\Cognition\NIRAProductionContinuityPolicy.cs`

```csharp
using NIRAAgent.Mind;

namespace NIRAAgent.AI.Cognition;

/// <summary>
/// Production boundary invariants shared with the isolated Character Lab.
/// Never reads or writes a relationship, conversation, memory, or credential store.
/// </summary>
public static class NIRAProductionContinuityPolicy
{
    /// <summary>
    /// A vetted missing-input question is a valid terminal handoff, not a
    /// claim that NIRA has completed the user's underlying objective.
    /// The completion reviewer must agree with the actual proposed state.
    /// </summary>
    public static bool AcceptsObjectiveReview(
        NIRACognitionDecision decision, NIRATaskCompletionReview? review)
    {
        if (review is null || !decision.EmitReply ||
            string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(decision.Reply))
            return false;
        return (decision.State == NIRACognitionState.Complete &&
                review.Verdict == "Complete") ||
               (decision.State == NIRACognitionState.NeedUser &&
                review.Verdict == "AwaitingUser");
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// A user-facing NeedUser without a visible question cannot be handed off:
    /// the user sees silence and ConversationManager cannot remember the missing input.
    /// Only repair otherwise idle user decisions, never a pending capability or work proposal.
    /// </summary>
    public static bool HasEmptyUserHandoff(NIRAMindEventSource source, NIRACognitionDecision decision)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(decision);

        return source == NIRAMindEventSource.User &&
            decision.State == NIRACognitionState.NeedUser &&
            (!decision.EmitReply || string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(decision.Reply)) &&
            decision.ControlRequests.Count == 0 &&
            decision.CapabilityRequests.Count == 0 &&
            decision.ContextRequests.Count == 0 &&
            decision.CapabilityIds.Count == 0 &&
            decision.MemorySearches.Count == 0 &&
            decision.ConversationSearches.Count == 0 &&
            decision.GoalProposals.Count == 0 &&
            decision.BranchProposals.Count == 0 &&
            decision.BranchWorkProposals.Count == 0 &&
            decision.DynamicToolProposals.Count == 0 &&
            decision.DynamicToolInvocations.Count == 0 &&
            decision.RuntimeContractDiagnostics.Count == 0;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Trusted evidence for exactly one model correction. No user data or model
    /// speculation is converted into a requirement or an authorization.
    /// </summary>
    public const string MissingHandoffCorrection =
        "RUNTIME USER-HANDOFF CORRECTION: The previous model decision returned " +
        "NeedUser without a visible clarification question. That cannot be " +
        "delivered to the user or saved for continuation. Reconsider the SAME " +
        "original request and available evidence: if it can be answered now, " +
        "use Complete with emitReply=true and a helpful final reply. Otherwise " +
        "use NeedUser with emitReply=true and ONE precise question about a " +
        "genuinely missing user-provided detail. Do not fabricate observations, " +
        "request secrets in normal chat, invent previous work, or issue a tool call " +
        "solely to satisfy this correction.";

    /// <summary>
    /// Fail closed after the bounded correction attempt. The handoff must be
    /// visible and noncommittal rather than an empty model reply or fake observation.
    /// </summary>
    public static NIRACognitionDecision MakeVisibleFallback(NIRACognitionDecision decision)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(decision);
        if (decision.State != NIRACognitionState.NeedUser)
            throw new ArgumentException("Fallback is restricted to NeedUser decisions.", nameof(decision));

        return decision with
        {
            EmitReply = true,
            Reply = "I can help, but I need a little more detail to continue. What should I focus on?",
            Speech = string.Empty,
            ReplyReady = true,
            CharacterReady = true,
            ReviewExperience = false,
            ReviewCommitment = false,
            DecisionSummary = "The user-facing clarification was missing after a bounded model retry; a neutral, non-factual question was supplied."
        };
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Metadata-only production telemetry. Never logs conversation text, memory
    /// content, secret material, or relationship values.
    /// </summary>
    public static string DescribeContext(NIRACognitionContext context)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(context);
        return $"Cycle={context.Cycle}; Character={(context.CharacterContext.Length > 0)}; " +
            $"Delivery={(context.CharacterDeliveryContext.Length > 0)}; " +
            $"RecentConversationChars={context.ConversationPulseContext.Length}; " +
            $"HistoricalSocialChars={context.SocialCarryoverContext.Length}; " +
            $"MemoryMode={context.MemoryContextMode}; MemoryChars={context.LongTermMemoryContext.Length}; " +
            $"PendingClarification={(context.TaskContinuityContext.Length > 0)}";
    }
}

**File:** `NIRAAgent\AI\Cognition\NIRAPublicCharacterDelivery.cs`

```csharp
using System.Diagnostics;
using System.Text.RegularExpressions;
using NIRAAgent.Mind;

namespace NIRAAgent.AI.Cognition;

// Single policy for early public terminal exits, which do not pass through
// the Executive's regular post-commit response route. The normal route keeps
// its own goal/evidence review and realization. This boundary NEVER owns state,
// creates a capability, or changes an authorization decision.
public enum NIRAPublicReplyKind
{
    Natural,
    VerifiedResult,
    Protected,
    PreserveExact,
    Progress
}

public static class NIRAPublicCharacterDelivery
{
    private const int MaximumEarlyNaturalReplyCharacters = 1600;

    // Explicit categories are assigned at trusted call sites, NOT guessed
    // from user message keywords or the model's mood/character-ready flags.
    public static bool NeedsNaturalRealization(NIRAPublicReplyKind kind, string? draft) =>
        (kind is NIRAPublicReplyKind.Natural or NIRAPublicReplyKind.VerifiedResult) &&
        !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(draft) &&
        draft.Length <= MaximumEarlyNaturalReplyCharacters &&
        !LooksLikeVerbatimArtifact(draft);

    // Executable source, serialized outputs and large verified branch results
    // should not be reauthored for personality. They remain exact.
    public static bool LooksLikeVerbatimArtifact(string? draft) =>
        string.IsNullOrEmpty(draft) ||
        draft.Contains("```", StringComparison.Ordinal) ||
        draft.Contains("<xml", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
        draft.TrimStart().StartsWith('{') ||
        draft.TrimStart().StartsWith('[') && draft.Contains(']') ||
        draft.Length > MaximumEarlyNaturalReplyCharacters;

    // Guard specific observed data: path, URL, percentages, numbers, and IDs.
    // Anchors protect against replacing exact values in a completed action.
    private static readonly Regex GroundedTokens = new(
        @"(?<![A-Za-z0-9_])(?:[A-Za-z]:\\[^\s\r\n<>""|?*]+|https?://[^\s<>""']+|\b\d+(?:[.,:/-]\d+)*(?:\s?%)?\b)",
        RegexOptions.Compiled | RegexOptions.CultureInvariant | RegexOptions.IgnoreCase);

    public static IReadOnlyList<string> Anchors(string source) =>
        GroundedTokens.Matches(source ?? string.Empty)
            .Select(m => m.Value.Trim().TrimEnd('.', ',', ';', ':', ')', ']'))
            .Where(token => token.Length > 0)
            .Distinct(StringComparer.Ordinal)
            .Take(48)
            .ToArray();

    public static bool PreservesGroundedResult(string original, string candidate)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(candidate)) return false;
        IReadOnlyList<string> originalAnchors = Anchors(original);
        IReadOnlyList<string> candidateAnchors = Anchors(candidate);
        // The model may change presentation, but it cannot add/remove
        // concrete facts. A candidate that changes evidence is discarded.
        return originalAnchors.All(x => candidate.Contains(x, StringComparison.Ordinal)) &&
               candidateAnchors.All(x => original.Contains(x, StringComparison.Ordinal));
    }

    public static async Task<string> DeliverAsync(
        NIRAResponseRealizationService realization,
        NIRAMindEvent mindEvent,
        string groundedDraft,
        NIRAPublicReplyKind kind,
        CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(realization);
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(mindEvent);
        if (!NeedsNaturalRealization(kind, groundedDraft))
        {
            Debug.WriteLine($"[PublicCharacterDelivery] PROTECTED | Kind={kind} | Event={mindEvent.Name}");
            return groundedDraft;
        }

        try
        {
            // Use the SAME production character state, attitude, social history,
            // personality assets and realization validator as normal chat.
            NIRAResponseRealizationResult result = await realization.RealizeAsync(
                new NIRAResponseRealizationRequest
                {
                    DraftReply = groundedDraft,
                    EventSource = mindEvent.Source.ToString(),
                    EventName = mindEvent.Name,
                    TopicKey = mindEvent.TopicKey,
                    EventContent = mindEvent.Source == NIRAMindEventSource.User
                        ? mindEvent.Content : string.Empty,
                    DecisionSummary = kind == NIRAPublicReplyKind.VerifiedResult
                        ? "A trusted runtime action or reviewed background result is already committed. " +
                          "Express it naturally without changing status, facts, paths, limits or evidence."
                        : "A real delegated action is in progress. Keep the status truthful; " +
                          "do not imply that the work has already finished.",
                    RequiredVerbatimFragments = Anchors(groundedDraft)
                }, cancellationToken);
            if (!PreservesGroundedResult(groundedDraft, result.Reply))
            {
                Debug.WriteLine("[PublicCharacterDelivery] REVERT | Evidence changed");
                return groundedDraft;
            }
            Debug.WriteLine($"[PublicCharacterDelivery] DELIVERED | Kind={kind} | " +
                $"Draft={groundedDraft.Length} | Final={result.Reply.Length}");
            return result.Reply;
        }
        catch (OperationCanceledException) when (cancellationToken.IsCancellationRequested)
        {
            throw;
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            Debug.WriteLine($"[PublicCharacterDelivery] FALLBACK | {ex.GetType().Name}");
            return groundedDraft;
        }
    }
}

**File:** `NIRAAgent\AI\Cognition\NIRAResourceIntentPlanner.cs`

```csharp
using System.Text.Json;
using NIRAAgent.Capabilities;

namespace NIRAAgent.AI.Cognition;

/// <summary>
/// Converts OPTIONAL model-selected, high-value resource intentions into
/// ordinary capability requests without another classification model call.
/// NEVER infers media from topic words, item names, user test prompts or domains.
/// The Executive still applies normal capability schema/permission/evidence rules.
/// </summary>
public static class NIRAResourceIntentPlanner
{
    public static NIRACognitionDecision Apply(
        NIRACognitionDecision decision, bool isInitialUserCycle)
    {
        if (!isInitialUserCycle || decision.ResourceIntent is null ||
            decision.State is not (NIRACognitionState.Complete or NIRACognitionState.Continue) ||
            decision.ReplyPresentation == NIRAReplyPresentationMode.PreserveExact ||
            decision.ControlRequests.Count > 0 || decision.ReviewCommitment ||
            decision.GoalProposals.Count > 0 || decision.BranchProposals.Count > 0 ||
            decision.BranchWorkProposals.Count > 0 ||
            decision.DynamicToolProposals.Count > 0 || decision.DynamicToolInvocations.Count > 0)
            return decision;

        // These are model-generated SEARCH QUERIES, not executable URLs or paths.
        // Reject malformed input rather than rewriting or extending it.
        static string ValidQuery(string? value, int max)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(value)) return string.Empty;
            // Validate the RAW model field before trimming. Trimming first can
            // launder a leading newline or another control character into a
            // seemingly valid query. No model-provided URL is a search phrase.
            if (value.Any(char.IsControl) || value.Contains('\u2028') ||
                value.Contains('\u2029'))
                return string.Empty;
            string trimmed = value.Trim();
            if (trimmed.Length < 3 || trimmed.Length > max ||
                trimmed.Contains("https://", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
                trimmed.Contains("http://", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
                trimmed.Contains("www.", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
                Uri.TryCreate(trimmed, UriKind.Absolute, out _))
                return string.Empty;
            return trimmed;
        }

        string imageQuery = ValidQuery(decision.ResourceIntent.ImageQuery, 160);
        string webQuery = ValidQuery(decision.ResourceIntent.WebQuery, 250);
        string videoQuery = ValidQuery(decision.ResourceIntent.VideoQuery, 250);

        // This is one model-selected intent, not three unrelated grants. If
        // ANY provided nonblank query is malformed, discard the entire plan;
        // never execute a valid-looking remainder of untrusted mixed input.
        if ((!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(decision.ResourceIntent.ImageQuery) && imageQuery.Length == 0) ||
            (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(decision.ResourceIntent.WebQuery) && webQuery.Length == 0) ||
            (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(decision.ResourceIntent.VideoQuery) && videoQuery.Length == 0) ||
            (imageQuery.Length == 0 && webQuery.Length == 0 && videoQuery.Length == 0))
            return decision;

        // Explicit image generation remains an entirely separate user-requested
        // creation task. Never replace it with web image retrieval.
        if (decision.CapabilityRequests.Any(r => r.CapabilityId == NIRACapabilityIds.ImageGenerate))
            return decision;

        var requests = decision.CapabilityRequests.ToList();
        // If NIRA independently chooses both research and a useful reference
        // image, ONE Tavily response can carry both. This avoids paying for a
        // second image-search API call. If the user asks only for photos, use
        // image.search unchanged. No subject/topic keywords are hardcoded.
        bool sharedTavily = imageQuery.Length > 0 && webQuery.Length > 0 &&
            !requests.Any(r => r.CapabilityId is NIRACapabilityIds.ImageSearch or
                NIRACapabilityIds.ImageRetrieve or NIRACapabilityIds.WebSearch);
        // Do not duplicate capability families the model has already planned.
        if (imageQuery.Length > 0 && !sharedTavily && !requests.Any(r => r.CapabilityId is
                NIRACapabilityIds.ImageSearch or NIRACapabilityIds.ImageRetrieve))
            requests.Add(new NIRACapabilityRequest {
                CapabilityId = NIRACapabilityIds.ImageSearch,
                // Opted in by the SAME model decision: download one provider-ranked,
                // allowlisted candidate within this authorized read-only operation.
                // No extra LLM call just to copy a candidate ID into image.retrieve.
                Arguments = JsonSerializer.SerializeToElement(new {
                    query = imageQuery, limit = 6, retrieveBest = true,
                    retrieveCount = Math.Clamp(decision.ResourceIntent.ImageCount, 1, 3)
                }),
                Reason = "Model-selected real visual evidence materially improves this answer."
            });
        // One web request can cover independent documentation and a published
        // demonstration without spending a second paid provider request.
        string[] webQueries = new[] { webQuery, videoQuery }
            .Where(q => q.Length > 0)
            .Distinct(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
            .ToArray();
        if (webQueries.Length > 0 && !requests.Any(r => r.CapabilityId == NIRACapabilityIds.WebSearch))
            requests.Add(new NIRACapabilityRequest {
                CapabilityId = NIRACapabilityIds.WebSearch,
                Arguments = JsonSerializer.SerializeToElement(new {
                    queries = webQueries, maxSources = 6,
                    evidenceDepth = string.Equals(decision.ResourceIntent.WebEvidenceDepth,
                        "detailed", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ? "detailed" : "brief",
                    includeImages = sharedTavily, imageQuery = sharedTavily ? imageQuery : "",
                    retrieveCount = Math.Clamp(decision.ResourceIntent.ImageCount, 1, 3),
                    provider = sharedTavily ? "tavily" : "auto"
                }),
                Reason = "Model-selected published evidence would substantively improve the answer."
            });
        if (requests.Count == decision.CapabilityRequests.Count) return decision;

        // ConversationOnly and SelfContainedAnswer are model-classification
        // hints, not permission to discard the SAME model's concrete evidence
        // plan. A valid selected resource makes this an observable work turn.
        // Do not infer a tool from the user text, or modify images/media here.
        // An answer isn't final until the proposed evidence has been observed.
        // One ordinary Executive dispatch batch; next model cycle synthesizes
        // actual results. Tool failures must still lead to useful text, not fiction.
        return decision with {
            State = NIRACognitionState.Continue,
            EmitReply = false,
            ReplyReady = false,
            CharacterReady = false,
            ConversationOnly = false,
            SelfContainedAnswer = false,
            CapabilityRequests = requests.ToArray(),
            ResourceIntent = null
        };
    }
}
