/*
 * filename: FilesystemCapabilityHandlers.cs
 */

using System.Security.Cryptography;
using System.Text;

namespace NIRAAgent.Capabilities;


public sealed class NIRAFileReadCapabilityHandler
    : INIRACapabilityHandler
{
    public NIRACapabilityDescriptor Descriptor
    {
        get;
    } =
        new NIRACapabilityDescriptor
        {
            Id =
                NIRACapabilityIds.FileRead,

            Description =
                "Read a bounded text window from a file with line numbers and metadata; a complete CSV/TSV read additionally reports exact audited numeric-column totals when unambiguous.",

            DefaultRisk =
                NIRACapabilityRisk.Observe,

            Parameters =
                new[]
                {
                    Parameter("path", "string", true, "Verified file path. An ordinary relative name resolves under NIRA's working directory; a window title or historic file mention is not proof of an existing local file."),
                    Parameter("startLine", "integer", false, "1-based first line. Default 1."),
                    Parameter("maxLines", "integer", false, "Maximum returned lines. Default 300, maximum 1000."),
                    Parameter("maxChars", "integer", false, "Maximum returned characters. Default 24000, maximum 48000.")
                }
        };


    public NIRACapabilityRisk ResolveRisk(
        NIRACapabilityRequest request)
    {
        return NIRACapabilityRisk.Observe;
    }


    public async Task<NIRACapabilityHandlerResult> ExecuteAsync(
        NIRACapabilityRequest request,
        CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        string requestedPath = NIRACapabilityArguments.RequireString(
            request, "path", 32760);
        string path = NIRACapabilityArguments.NormalizePath(requestedPath);


        int startLine =
            NIRACapabilityArguments.GetInteger(
                request,
                "startLine",
                1,
                1,
                5_000_000);


        int maxLines =
            NIRACapabilityArguments.GetInteger(
                request,
                "maxLines",
                300,
                1,
                1000);


        int maxChars =
            NIRACapabilityArguments.GetInteger(
                request,
                "maxChars",
                24000,
                1000,
                48000);


        FileInfo file =
            new(
                path);


        if (!file.Exists)
        {
            // Do not silently interpret a process/window caption as a physical
            // file or try invented directories. Preserve legacy relative reads
            // when their real normalized target exists, but explain the missing
            // location so cognition can choose a bounded discovery operation.
            bool relative = !Path.IsPathFullyQualified(
                Environment.ExpandEnvironmentVariables(requestedPath.Trim()));
            string locationHint = relative
                ? "The supplied name was relative. Only explicit user-folder prefixes " +
                  "resolve outside NIRA's working directory. A process window title " +
                  "is not a verified file path; locate an existing file before reading it."
                : "This absolute file path is unavailable on this machine. " +
                  "A location remembered from another session is not proof of local existence.";
            throw new FileNotFoundException(
                $"Requested file does not exist at '{path}'. {locationHint}",
                path);
        }


        StringBuilder output =
            new();


        int currentLine =
            0;


        int includedLines =
            0;


        bool truncated =
            false;

        // Only the actual complete, bounded text read may be audited. A page
        // or character-limited read is never represented as a file-wide total.
        List<string> rawLines = new();

        await using FileStream stream =
            new(
                path,
                FileMode.Open,
                FileAccess.Read,
                FileShare.ReadWrite | FileShare.Delete,
                4096,
                FileOptions.Asynchronous | FileOptions.SequentialScan);


        using StreamReader reader =
            new(
                stream,
                Encoding.UTF8,
                detectEncodingFromByteOrderMarks: true,
                bufferSize: 4096,
                leaveOpen: false);


        while (true)
        {
            cancellationToken.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();


            string? line =
                await reader.ReadLineAsync(
                    cancellationToken);


            if (line ==
                null)
            {
                break;
            }


            currentLine++;


            if (currentLine <
                startLine)
            {
                continue;
            }


            if (line.IndexOf('\0') >=
                0)
            {
                throw new InvalidOperationException(
                    "The requested file appears to be binary. Use filesystem.metadata instead of text read.");
            }


            string rendered =
                $"L{currentLine}: {line}";


            if (output.Length +
                    rendered.Length +
                    Environment.NewLine.Length >
                maxChars)
            {
                truncated =
                    true;


                break;
            }


            output.AppendLine(
                rendered);
            rawLines.Add(line);

            includedLines++;


            if (includedLines >=
                maxLines)
            {
                string? remainingLine =
                    await reader.ReadLineAsync(
                        cancellationToken);


                if (remainingLine !=
                    null)
                {
                    truncated =
                        true;
                }


                break;
            }
        }


        file.Refresh();


        string summary =
            $"Read {includedLines} line(s) from '{path}' starting at line {startLine}. " +
            $"Length={file.Length} bytes | LastWriteUtc={file.LastWriteTimeUtc:O} | Truncated={truncated}.";

        // Deterministic numeric evidence supplements (never replaces) raw file
        // content. It is completely generic: no project, column name, or fixture
        // is assumed. Skip ambiguous columns instead of inventing a sum.
        if (startLine == 1 && !truncated && file.Length <= 500_000)
        {
            string? audit = NIRADelimitedNumericAudit.TryAudit(path, rawLines);
            if (audit is not null)
                summary += " " + audit;
        }


        return new NIRACapabilityHandlerResult
        {
            Summary =
                summary,

            Output =
                output.ToString().TrimEnd(),

            ChangedSystemState =
                false
        };
    }


    private static NIRACapabilityParameterDescriptor Parameter(
        string name,
        string type,
        bool required,
        string description)
    {
        return new NIRACapabilityParameterDescriptor
        {
            Name = name,
            Type = type,
            Required = required,
            Description = description
        };
    }
}


public sealed class NIRADirectoryListCapabilityHandler
    : INIRACapabilityHandler
{
    public NIRACapabilityDescriptor Descriptor
    {
        get;
    } =
        new NIRACapabilityDescriptor
        {
            Id =
                NIRACapabilityIds.DirectoryList,

            Description =
                "Enumerate a bounded directory listing, optionally recursive and filtered by search pattern. A zero-match result does not imply that the directory has no other files or subfolders.",

            DefaultRisk =
                NIRACapabilityRisk.Observe,

            Parameters =
                new[]
                {
                    Parameter("path", "string", true, "Directory path."),
                    Parameter("pattern", "string", false, "Filesystem search pattern such as *.cs. Default *."),
                    Parameter("recursive", "boolean", false, "Whether to recurse into child directories. Default false."),
                    Parameter("maxEntries", "integer", false, "Maximum entries per page. Default 200, maximum 1000."),
                    Parameter("offset", "integer", false, "Optional zero-based page offset (default 0). For a limited result, use NextOffset to read the next page; do not repeat offset 0."),
                    Parameter("sortBy", "string", false, "Optional LastWriteUtc (newest), SizeBytes (largest individual files), or Name (alphabetical). Directories do NOT have aggregated sizes; filesystem.usage measures them. Default none preserves legacy order and format."),
                    Parameter("filesOnly", "boolean", false, "Omit folders independently of sortBy. Default false; legacy output unchanged when omitted.")
                }
        };


    public NIRACapabilityRisk ResolveRisk(
        NIRACapabilityRequest request)
    {
        return NIRACapabilityRisk.Observe;
    }


    public Task<NIRACapabilityHandlerResult> ExecuteAsync(
        NIRACapabilityRequest request,
        CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        string path =
            NIRACapabilityArguments.NormalizePath(
                NIRACapabilityArguments.RequireString(
                    request,
                    "path",
                    32760));


        string pattern =
            NIRACapabilityArguments.GetOptionalString(
                request,
                "pattern",
                256)
            ?? "*";


        bool recursive =
            NIRACapabilityArguments.GetBoolean(
                request,
                "recursive");


        int maxEntries =
            NIRACapabilityArguments.GetInteger(
                request,
                "maxEntries",
                200,
                1,
                1000);


        int offset = NIRACapabilityArguments.GetInteger(request, "offset", 0, 0, 20000);

        string? sortBy = NIRACapabilityArguments.GetOptionalString(request, "sortBy", 40);
        bool filesOnly = NIRACapabilityArguments.GetBoolean(request, "filesOnly");
        // Only proven-equivalent ranking labels are accepted. No arbitrary
        // sort expression is interpreted or executed.
        string sortToken = new string((sortBy ?? string.Empty)
            .Where(char.IsLetterOrDigit).ToArray());
        if (sortToken.Equals("LastWriteUtc", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
            sortToken.Equals("Modified", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
            sortToken.Equals("ModifiedTime", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
            sortBy = "LastWriteUtc";
        else if (sortToken.Equals("Size", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
                 sortToken.Equals("SizeBytes", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
                 sortToken.Equals("FileSize", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
                 sortToken.Equals("SizeDescending", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
            sortBy = "SizeBytes";
        else if (sortToken.Equals("Name", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
                 sortToken.Equals("FileName", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
                 sortToken.Equals("Alphabetical", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
            sortBy = "Name";
        else if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(sortBy))
            throw new ArgumentException("sortBy must be LastWriteUtc, SizeBytes, or Name when supplied.");

        if (!Directory.Exists(
                path))
        {
            throw new DirectoryNotFoundException(
                $"Requested directory does not exist: {path}");
        }


        EnumerationOptions options =
            new()
            {
                RecurseSubdirectories =
                    recursive,

                IgnoreInaccessible =
                    true,

                ReturnSpecialDirectories =
                    false,

                AttributesToSkip =
                    FileAttributes.ReparsePoint
            };


        // Opt-in bounded, source-grounded ranking. A legacy listing preserves
        // its original enumeration order and output format below.
        if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(sortBy))
        {
            const int maximumScannedEntries = 20000;
            List<(string Path, bool IsDirectory, long SizeBytes, DateTime ModifiedUtc)> observed = new();
            int scanned = 0;
            int unavailable = 0;
            bool scanTruncated = false;
            foreach (string entry in Directory.EnumerateFileSystemEntries(path, pattern, options))
            {
                cancellationToken.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
                if (scanned >= maximumScannedEntries)
                {
                    scanTruncated = true;
                    break;
                }
                scanned++;
                try
                {
                    bool isDirectory = Directory.Exists(entry);
                    if (isDirectory && filesOnly) continue;
                    if (isDirectory)
                    {
                        DirectoryInfo info = new(entry);
                        observed.Add((entry, true, 0L, info.LastWriteTimeUtc));
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        FileInfo info = new(entry);
                        observed.Add((entry, false, info.Length, info.LastWriteTimeUtc));
                    }
                }
                catch (UnauthorizedAccessException) { unavailable++; }
                catch (IOException) { unavailable++; }
            }

            var ranked = (sortBy switch
            {
                "SizeBytes" => observed.OrderByDescending(e => e.IsDirectory ? -1L : e.SizeBytes)
                    .ThenBy(e => e.Path, StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase),
                "Name" => observed.OrderBy(e => e.Path, StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase),
                _ => observed.OrderByDescending(e => e.ModifiedUtc)
                    .ThenBy(e => e.Path, StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
            }).Skip(offset).Take(maxEntries).ToArray();
            StringBuilder rankedOutput = new();
            foreach (var entry in ranked)
            {
                if (entry.IsDirectory)
                    rankedOutput.AppendLine(sortBy == "SizeBytes"
                        ? $"DIR\t{entry.Path}\tLastWriteUtc={entry.ModifiedUtc:O}\tSizeBytes=NotAggregated"
                        : $"DIR\t{entry.Path}\tLastWriteUtc={entry.ModifiedUtc:O}");
                else
                    rankedOutput.AppendLine($"FILE\t{entry.SizeBytes}\t{entry.Path}\tLastWriteUtc={entry.ModifiedUtc:O}");
            }
            bool? rankedRootHasEntries = ranked.Length == 0 ? RootHasEntries(path) : null;
            return Task.FromResult(new NIRACapabilityHandlerResult
            {
                Summary = $"Enumerated {ranked.Length} ranked entr(y/ies) under '{path}'. " +
                    $"SortBy={sortBy} | FilesOnly={filesOnly} | Scanned={scanned} | " +
                    $"Truncated={scanTruncated || observed.Count > offset + ranked.Length} | " +
                    $"ResultLimited={observed.Count > offset + ranked.Length} | " +
                    $"Offset={offset} | NextOffset={(observed.Count > offset + ranked.Length ? (offset + ranked.Length).ToString() : "None")} | " +
                    $"ScanComplete={!scanTruncated && unavailable == 0} | " +
                    $"RankingComplete={!scanTruncated && unavailable == 0} | Unreadable={unavailable}. " +
                    (ranked.Length == 0 ? $"ZeroMatchScope=Pattern:{pattern},Recursive:{recursive},FilesOnly:{filesOnly} | RootHasOtherEntries={DescribeExistence(rankedRootHasEntries)}. A zero-match result does not prove the directory is empty. " : string.Empty) +
                    (sortBy == "SizeBytes"
                        ? "Directory sizes are NOT calculated; this ranks individual file sizes. "
                        : string.Empty) +
                    (!scanTruncated && unavailable == 0
                        ? "The ranking is complete for the scanned scope. When NextOffset is present, request that offset only if more results are needed; do not repeat the same page."
                        : "The scan was incomplete; the top-ranked entries may not represent the full requested scope."),
                Output = rankedOutput.ToString().TrimEnd(),
                ChangedSystemState = false
            });
        }

        StringBuilder output =
            new();


        int count =
            0;


        bool truncated =
            false;

        // A file-only query could otherwise traverse arbitrarily many folders
        // before finding maxEntries files. Keep the legacy listing unchanged.
        const int maximumFilteredScan = 20000;
        int filteredScanned = 0;
        int skipped = 0;

        foreach (
            string entry
            in Directory.EnumerateFileSystemEntries(
                path,
                pattern,
                options))
        {
            cancellationToken.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();

            if (filesOnly && filteredScanned >= maximumFilteredScan)
            {
                truncated = true;
                break;
            }
            filteredScanned++;

            if (count >=
                maxEntries)
            {
                truncated =
                    true;


                break;
            }


            if (Directory.Exists(
                    entry))
            {
                // File filtering is independent of chronological ordering.
                // Excluded directories do not consume maxEntries.
                if (filesOnly)
                    continue;

                if (skipped++ < offset) continue;
                output.AppendLine(
                    $"DIR\t{entry}");
            }
            else
            {
                if (skipped++ < offset) continue;
                FileInfo file =
                    new(
                        entry);


                output.AppendLine(
                    $"FILE\t{file.Length}\t{entry}");
            }


            count++;
        }


        bool? rootHasEntries = count == 0 ? RootHasEntries(path) : null;
        return Task.FromResult(
            new NIRACapabilityHandlerResult
            {
                Summary =
                    $"Enumerated {count} entry/entries under '{path}'. Recursive={recursive} | Pattern='{pattern}' | Truncated={truncated} | Offset={offset} | NextOffset={(truncated ? (offset + count).ToString() : "None")}." +
                    (count == 0 ? $" ZeroMatchScope=Pattern:{pattern},Recursive:{recursive},FilesOnly:{filesOnly} | RootHasOtherEntries={DescribeExistence(rootHasEntries)}. A zero-match result does not prove the directory is empty." : string.Empty) +
                    (filesOnly ? $" FilesOnly=True | Scanned={filteredScanned} | ScanComplete={!truncated}." : string.Empty),

                Output =
                    output.ToString().TrimEnd(),

                ChangedSystemState =
                    false
            });
    }


    // A filtered query can return zero even when the folder contains other
    // extensions or directories. Keep this observation separate from matches.
    // One top-level entry is enough; never enumerate the whole tree to verify.
    private static bool? RootHasEntries(string path)
    {
        try
        {
            return Directory.EnumerateFileSystemEntries(path, "*", new EnumerationOptions
            {
                IgnoreInaccessible = true,
                RecurseSubdirectories = false,
                ReturnSpecialDirectories = false,
                AttributesToSkip = 0
            }).Any();
        }
        catch (IOException) { return null; }
        catch (UnauthorizedAccessException) { return null; }
    }

    private static string DescribeExistence(bool? hasEntries) => hasEntries switch
    {
        true => "True",
        false => "False",
        _ => "Unknown"
    };

    private static NIRACapabilityParameterDescriptor Parameter(
        string name,
        string type,
        bool required,
        string description)
    {
        return new NIRACapabilityParameterDescriptor
        {
            Name = name,
            Type = type,
            Required = required,
            Description = description
        };
    }
}

public sealed class NIRAFileWriteCapabilityHandler
    : INIRACapabilityHandler
{
    private readonly NIRAWindowsProtectedFolderAccessService? _windowsAccess;
    public NIRAFileWriteCapabilityHandler(NIRAWindowsProtectedFolderAccessService? windowsAccess = null)
    {
        _windowsAccess = windowsAccess;
    }

    public NIRACapabilityDescriptor Descriptor
    {
        get;
    } =
        new NIRACapabilityDescriptor
        {
            Id =
                NIRACapabilityIds.FileWrite,

            Description =
                "Write UTF-8 text to an existing or new file. Supports overwrite or append and returns post-write hash evidence.",

            DefaultRisk =
                NIRACapabilityRisk.Modify,

            Parameters =
                new[]
                {
                    Parameter("path", "string", true, "Destination file path."),
                    Parameter("content", "string", true, "Text to write."),
                    Parameter("mode", "string", false, "overwrite or append. Default overwrite."),
                    Parameter("expectedLastWriteUtc", "string", false, "Optional optimistic-concurrency guard using prior ISO-8601 LastWriteUtc.")
                }
        };


    public NIRACapabilityRisk ResolveRisk(
        NIRACapabilityRequest request)
    {
        return NIRACapabilityRisk.Modify;
    }


    public async Task<NIRACapabilityHandlerResult> ExecuteAsync(
        NIRACapabilityRequest request,
        CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        try
        {
            return await ExecuteWriteOnceAsync(request, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(false);
        }
        catch (Exception failure) when (failure is IOException or UnauthorizedAccessException)
        {
            string target = NIRACapabilityArguments.NormalizePath(
                NIRACapabilityArguments.RequireString(request, "path", 32760));
            if (_windowsAccess is null ||
                !Directory.Exists(Path.GetDirectoryName(target)) ||
                !await _windowsAccess.TryRecoverAsync(target, failure, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(false))
                throw;
            // The original write remains atomic and its optimistic guards are
            // rechecked. Never change destination or overwrite semantics.
            return await ExecuteWriteOnceAsync(request, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(false);
        }
    }

    private async Task<NIRACapabilityHandlerResult> ExecuteWriteOnceAsync(
        NIRACapabilityRequest request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        string path =
            NIRACapabilityArguments.NormalizePath(
                NIRACapabilityArguments.RequireString(
                    request,
                    "path",
                    32760));


        NIRAWindowsProtectedFolderAccessService.RejectRedirectedKnownFolderShadow(path);

        string content =
            NIRACapabilityArguments.RequireRawString(
                request,
                "content",
                2_000_000);


        string mode =
            NIRACapabilityArguments.GetOptionalString(
                request,
                "mode",
                32)
            ?? "overwrite";


        mode =
            mode.Trim().ToLowerInvariant();


        if (mode is not
            ("overwrite" or "append"))
        {
            throw new InvalidOperationException(
                "filesystem.write mode must be 'overwrite' or 'append'.");
        }


        string? expectedLastWrite =
            NIRACapabilityArguments.GetOptionalString(
                request,
                "expectedLastWriteUtc",
                128);


        if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                expectedLastWrite)
            &&
            File.Exists(
                path))
        {
            if (!DateTimeOffset.TryParse(
                    expectedLastWrite,
                    out DateTimeOffset expected))
            {
                throw new InvalidOperationException(
                    "expectedLastWriteUtc must be a valid ISO-8601 timestamp.");
            }


            DateTimeOffset actual =
                File.GetLastWriteTimeUtc(
                    path);


            if (Math.Abs(
                    (actual - expected.ToUniversalTime()).TotalSeconds) >
                1.0)
            {
                throw new InvalidOperationException(
                    $"Optimistic write guard failed. Expected LastWriteUtc={expected:O}, actual={actual:O}.");
            }
        }


        string? directory =
            Path.GetDirectoryName(
                path);


        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                directory)
            ||
            !Directory.Exists(
                directory))
        {
            throw new DirectoryNotFoundException(
                "Destination directory does not exist: '" + directory + "'. " +
                "A prior directory-create request must actually succeed before writing. " +
                "Check its last failure (including Windows folder protection or OneDrive availability); " +
                "repeating filesystem.write cannot create a blocked parent.");
        }


        // Stage the complete replacement next to its destination. Cancellation
        // before the move leaves the original file intact.
        string temporary = path + ".NIRA-write-" + Guid.NewGuid().ToString("N") + ".tmp";
        try
        {
            await using (FileStream output = new(temporary, FileMode.CreateNew, FileAccess.Write,
                FileShare.None, 81920, FileOptions.Asynchronous))
            {
                if (mode == "append" && File.Exists(path))
                {
                    await using FileStream input = new(path, FileMode.Open, FileAccess.Read,
                        FileShare.Read, 81920, FileOptions.Asynchronous);
                    await input.CopyToAsync(output, cancellationToken);
                }
                byte[] bytes = new UTF8Encoding(false).GetBytes(content);
                await output.WriteAsync(bytes.AsMemory(), cancellationToken);
                await output.FlushAsync(cancellationToken);
            }
            cancellationToken.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
            // Recheck the optional concurrency guard immediately before replacing.
            if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(expectedLastWrite))
            {
                if (!File.Exists(path) || !DateTimeOffset.TryParse(expectedLastWrite, out DateTimeOffset expectedNow) ||
                    Math.Abs((new DateTimeOffset(File.GetLastWriteTimeUtc(path)) - expectedNow.ToUniversalTime()).TotalSeconds) > 1.0)
                    throw new InvalidOperationException("Optimistic write guard failed before replacing the file.");
            }
            File.Move(temporary, path, overwrite: !request.RequireCreateNew);
        }
        finally
        {
            if (File.Exists(temporary))
            {
                try { File.Delete(temporary); } catch { }
            }
        }

        FileInfo file =
            new(
                path);


        string hash =
            ComputeSha256(
                path);


        return new NIRACapabilityHandlerResult
        {
            Summary =
                $"Wrote '{path}' successfully. Mode={mode} | Length={file.Length} | LastWriteUtc={file.LastWriteTimeUtc:O} | SHA256={hash}.",

            Output =
                $"FullPath={path}\nLength={file.Length}\nLastWriteUtc={file.LastWriteTimeUtc:O}\nSHA256={hash}",

            ChangedSystemState =
                true
        };
    }


    private static string ComputeSha256(
        string path)
    {
        using FileStream stream =
            File.OpenRead(
                path);


        byte[] hash =
            SHA256.HashData(
                stream);


        return Convert.ToHexString(
            hash)
            .ToLowerInvariant();
    }


    private static NIRACapabilityParameterDescriptor Parameter(
        string name,
        string type,
        bool required,
        string description)
    {
        return new NIRACapabilityParameterDescriptor
        {
            Name = name,
            Type = type,
            Required = required,
            Description = description
        };
    }
}

public sealed class NIRAFileDeleteCapabilityHandler
    : INIRACapabilityHandler
{
    public NIRACapabilityDescriptor Descriptor
    {
        get;
    } =
        new NIRACapabilityDescriptor
        {
            Id =
                NIRACapabilityIds.FileDelete,

            Description =
                "Delete one file or directory. Directory deletion requires explicit recursive=true for non-empty trees.",

            DefaultRisk =
                NIRACapabilityRisk.Destructive,

            Parameters =
                new[]
                {
                    Parameter("path", "string", true, "File or directory path to delete."),
                    Parameter("recursive", "boolean", false, "For directory deletion, remove child contents too. Default false.")
                }
        };


    public NIRACapabilityRisk ResolveRisk(
        NIRACapabilityRequest request)
    {
        return NIRACapabilityRisk.Destructive;
    }


    public Task<NIRACapabilityHandlerResult> ExecuteAsync(
        NIRACapabilityRequest request,
        CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        cancellationToken.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();


        string path =
            NIRACapabilityArguments.NormalizePath(
                NIRACapabilityArguments.RequireString(
                    request,
                    "path",
                    32760));


        bool recursive =
            NIRACapabilityArguments.GetBoolean(
                request,
                "recursive");


        if (File.Exists(
                path))
        {
            File.Delete(
                path);


            return Task.FromResult(
                new NIRACapabilityHandlerResult
                {
                    Summary =
                        $"Deleted file '{path}'.",

                    ChangedSystemState =
                        true
                });
        }


        if (Directory.Exists(
                path))
        {
            Directory.Delete(
                path,
                recursive);


            return Task.FromResult(
                new NIRACapabilityHandlerResult
                {
                    Summary =
                        $"Deleted directory '{path}'. Recursive={recursive}.",

                    ChangedSystemState =
                        true
                });
        }


        // Delete is idempotent at the capability boundary. If the target
        // is already absent, the requested end-state is already satisfied.
        // Treating that as a failure makes stale/repeated cognition believe
        // it must keep deleting the same path and can reopen destructive
        // authorization unnecessarily.
        return Task.FromResult(
            new NIRACapabilityHandlerResult
            {
                Summary =
                    $"Filesystem path '{path}' is already absent; nothing needed to be deleted.",

                ChangedSystemState =
                    false
            });
    }


    private static NIRACapabilityParameterDescriptor Parameter(
        string name,
        string type,
        bool required,
        string description)
    {
        return new NIRACapabilityParameterDescriptor
        {
            Name = name,
            Type = type,
            Required = required,
            Description = description
        };
    }
}


public sealed class NIRADirectoryCreateCapabilityHandler
    : INIRACapabilityHandler
{
    private readonly NIRAWindowsProtectedFolderAccessService? _windowsAccess;

    public NIRADirectoryCreateCapabilityHandler(NIRAWindowsProtectedFolderAccessService? windowsAccess = null)
    {
        _windowsAccess = windowsAccess;
    }

    public NIRACapabilityDescriptor Descriptor
    {
        get;
    } =
        new NIRACapabilityDescriptor
        {
            Id =
                NIRACapabilityIds.DirectoryCreate,

            Description =
                "Create a directory path, including missing parents.",

            DefaultRisk =
                NIRACapabilityRisk.Modify,

            Parameters =
                new[]
                {
                    Parameter("path", "string", true, "Directory path to create.")
                }
        };


    public NIRACapabilityRisk ResolveRisk(
        NIRACapabilityRequest request)
    {
        return NIRACapabilityRisk.Modify;
    }


    public async Task<NIRACapabilityHandlerResult> ExecuteAsync(
        NIRACapabilityRequest request,
        CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        cancellationToken.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();

        string path = NIRACapabilityArguments.NormalizePath(
            NIRACapabilityArguments.RequireString(request, "path", 32760));
        string parent = Path.GetDirectoryName(path) ?? string.Empty;
        NIRAWindowsProtectedFolderAccessService.RejectRedirectedKnownFolderShadow(path);
        bool existedBefore = Directory.Exists(path);
        bool recovered = false;
        bool retried = false;

        try
        {
            try
            {
                // Directory.CreateDirectory already creates missing parents.
                // A normal new folder is a routine, silent user-authorized
                // operation; it does not require administrator elevation.
                Directory.CreateDirectory(path);
                if (!Directory.Exists(path))
                    throw new DirectoryNotFoundException(
                        "The provider did not expose the created directory.");
            }
            catch (Exception first) when (first is IOException or UnauthorizedAccessException)
            {
                // Some redirected/sync folders transiently report an absent
                // path while its existing parent is being materialized. One
                // bounded retry requires no new model decision or user prompt.
                // Never retry an access denial, a missing parent, or a generic
                // I/O fault; that is not a permission-bypass mechanism.
                bool parentAvailable = Directory.Exists(parent);
                if (!NIRADirectoryRecoveryPolicy.ShouldRetry(
                        first, parentAvailable, Directory.Exists(path), 0))
                    throw;

                retried = true;
                await Task.Delay(180, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(false);
                cancellationToken.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
                if (!Directory.Exists(path))
                    Directory.CreateDirectory(path);
                if (!Directory.Exists(path))
                    throw new DirectoryNotFoundException(
                        "The redirected directory is still unavailable after a bounded retry.");
                recovered = true;
            }
        }
        catch (Exception ex) when (ex is IOException or UnauthorizedAccessException)
        {
            Exception observedFailure = ex;
            // A blocked operation in a protected Windows known folder can ask
            // the owner once for an OS-managed, persistent application allowance.
            // The user sees its broad scope before UAC. No model authorization
            // or silent security modification is involved.
            if (_windowsAccess is not null &&
                await _windowsAccess.TryRecoverAsync(path, ex, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(false))
            {
                // Exactly one replay of the ORIGINAL destination, then verify.
                // If Windows still denies it, normal diagnostics below apply.
                try
                {
                    Directory.CreateDirectory(path);
                    if (!Directory.Exists(path))
                        throw new DirectoryNotFoundException("Directory was not visible after OS approval.");
                    return new NIRACapabilityHandlerResult
                    {
                        Summary = $"Directory created and verified after explicit Windows owner approval: '{path}'.",
                        ChangedSystemState = !existedBefore
                    };
                }
                catch (Exception replay) when (replay is IOException or UnauthorizedAccessException)
                {
                    observedFailure = replay;
                }
            }
            // Report a verified OS/provider outcome, not a guessed Defender
            // diagnosis. A full-autonomy setting inside NIRA cannot overrule
            // Windows access control. Never substitute an unrequested folder.
            bool parentAvailable = Directory.Exists(parent);
            bool targetAvailable = Directory.Exists(path);
            string failureKind = NIRADirectoryRecoveryPolicy.Classify(observedFailure);
            string nextStep = failureKind == "AccessDenied"
                ? "Windows denied this path. Ask the owner once to choose an accessible location or use the OS-managed app-access configuration; do not launch NIRA as administrator."
                : parentAvailable
                    ? "The parent exists, but Windows did not expose the requested child. Controlled Folder Access and sync-provider failures can look similar; do not attribute this to OneDrive without independent evidence."
                    : "The actual parent path is unavailable. Recheck the resolved known-folder location, without guessing another user profile.";
            throw new IOException(
                $"DirectoryCreateFailed | Kind={failureKind} | Target='{path}' | " +
                $"ParentExists={parentAvailable} | TargetExists={targetAvailable} | " +
                $"AutomaticRetryUsed={retried} | Exception={observedFailure.GetType().Name} | " +
                $"HResult=0x{observedFailure.HResult:X8} | Detail={observedFailure.Message}. " +
                nextStep + " No repeat approval or identical retry will resolve an unchanged OS restriction.", observedFailure);
        }

        // Verify the requested exact path. Never silently save to Public,
        // AppData, or a different account in order to claim task success.
        return new NIRACapabilityHandlerResult
        {
            Summary = existedBefore
                ? $"Directory was already present: '{path}'."
                : $"Directory created and verified: '{path}'. " +
                  $"SilentRecovery={(recovered ? "TransientProviderRetry" : "NotNeeded")}",
            ChangedSystemState = !existedBefore
        };
    }


    private static NIRACapabilityParameterDescriptor Parameter(
        string name,
        string type,
        bool required,
        string description)
    {
        return new NIRACapabilityParameterDescriptor
        {
            Name = name,
            Type = type,
            Required = required,
            Description = description
        };
    }
}

// Platform-independent decision rules make a single safe provider retry
// testable without changing the ordinary authorization or capability set.
internal static class NIRADirectoryRecoveryPolicy
{
    internal static bool ShouldRetry(
        Exception error, bool parentExists, bool targetExists, int retryNumber) =>
        retryNumber == 0 && parentExists && !targetExists &&
        (error is FileNotFoundException or DirectoryNotFoundException);

    internal static string Classify(Exception error) => error switch
    {
        UnauthorizedAccessException => "AccessDenied",
        IOException e when e.HResult == unchecked((int)0x80070005) => "AccessDenied",
        FileNotFoundException => "PathOrProviderNotFound",
        DirectoryNotFoundException => "ParentPathUnavailable",
        IOException => "FilesystemIOError",
        _ => "UnexpectedFailure"
    };
}

/*

using System.Net;
using System.Net.Http.Headers;
using System.Security.Cryptography;
using System.Text;
using System.Text.Json;

namespace NIRAAgent.Capabilities;


public sealed class NIRAHttpRequestCapabilityHandler
    : INIRACapabilityHandler,
      IDisposable
{
    private readonly HttpClient
        _http;


    public NIRACapabilityDescriptor Descriptor
    {
        get;
    } =
        new NIRACapabilityDescriptor
        {
            Id =
                NIRACapabilityIds.HttpRequest,

            Description =
                "Make a bounded HTTP/HTTPS request. GET/HEAD are observation risk; methods that can change remote state require authorization.",

            DefaultRisk =
                NIRACapabilityRisk.Observe,

            Parameters =
                new[]
                {
                    Parameter("url", "string", true, "Absolute http/https URL."),
                    Parameter("method", "string", false, "GET, HEAD, POST, PUT, PATCH, or DELETE. Default GET."),
                    Parameter("headers", "object", false, "Optional request headers."),
                    Parameter("body", "string", false, "Optional UTF-8 request body."),
                    Parameter("contentType", "string", false, "Body content type. Default application/json when body exists."),
                    Parameter("timeoutSeconds", "integer", false, "Timeout from 1-120 seconds. Default 30."),
                    Parameter("maxResponseChars", "integer", false, "Maximum response body characters. Default 20000, maximum 48000.")
                }
        };


    public NIRAHttpRequestCapabilityHandler()
    {
        SocketsHttpHandler handler =
            new()
            {
                AllowAutoRedirect = false,
                UseCookies = false,

                AutomaticDecompression =
                    DecompressionMethods.GZip |
                    DecompressionMethods.Deflate |
                    DecompressionMethods.Brotli
            };


        _http =
            new HttpClient(
                handler,
                disposeHandler: true)
            {
                Timeout =
                    Timeout.InfiniteTimeSpan
            };


        _http.DefaultRequestHeaders.UserAgent.Add(
            new ProductInfoHeaderValue(
                "NIRAAgent",
                "1.0"));
    }


    public NIRACapabilityRisk ResolveRisk(
        NIRACapabilityRequest request)
    {
        string method =
            NIRACapabilityArguments.GetOptionalString(
                request,
                "method",
                16)
            ?? "GET";


        return method.Trim().ToUpperInvariant() is
            "GET" or "HEAD"
            ? NIRACapabilityRisk.Observe
            : NIRACapabilityRisk.Execute;
    }


    public async Task<NIRACapabilityHandlerResult> ExecuteAsync(
        NIRACapabilityRequest request,
        CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        Uri uri =
            ParseUri(
                NIRACapabilityArguments.RequireString(
                    request,
                    "url",
                    4096));


        string methodText =
            NIRACapabilityArguments.GetOptionalString(
                request,
                "method",
                16)
            ?? "GET";


        HttpMethod method =
            ParseMethod(
                methodText);


        string? body =
            NIRACapabilityArguments.GetOptionalRawString(
                request,
                "body",
                2_000_000);


        string contentType =
            NIRACapabilityArguments.GetOptionalString(
                request,
                "contentType",
                256)
            ?? "application/json";


        int timeoutSeconds =
            NIRACapabilityArguments.GetInteger(
                request,
                "timeoutSeconds",
                30,
                1,
                120);


        int maxResponseChars =
            NIRACapabilityArguments.GetInteger(
                request,
                "maxResponseChars",
                20000,
                1000,
                48000);


        using HttpRequestMessage message =
            new(
                method,
                uri);


        if (body !=
            null)
        {
            message.Content =
                new StringContent(
                    body,
                    Encoding.UTF8,
                    contentType);
        }


        JsonElement? headers =
            NIRACapabilityArguments.GetOptionalObject(
                request,
                "headers");


        if (headers.HasValue)
        {
            foreach (
                JsonProperty property
                in headers.Value.EnumerateObject())
            {
                if (property.Value.ValueKind !=
                    JsonValueKind.String)
                {
                    throw new InvalidOperationException(
                        $"HTTP header '{property.Name}' must have a string value.");
                }


                string value =
                    property.Value.GetString()
                    ?? string.Empty;


                if (!message.Headers.TryAddWithoutValidation(
                        property.Name,
                        value))
                {
                    if (message.Content ==
                        null)
                    {
                        message.Content =
                            new StringContent(
                                string.Empty,
                                Encoding.UTF8,
                                "text/plain");
                    }


                    message.Content.Headers.TryAddWithoutValidation(
                        property.Name,
                        value);
                }
            }
        }


        using CancellationTokenSource timeout =
            CancellationTokenSource.CreateLinkedTokenSource(
                cancellationToken);


        timeout.CancelAfter(
            TimeSpan.FromSeconds(
                timeoutSeconds));


        using HttpResponseMessage response =
            await _http.SendAsync(
                message,
                HttpCompletionOption.ResponseHeadersRead,
                timeout.Token);


        StringBuilder output =
            new();


        output.AppendLine(
            $"Status={(int)response.StatusCode} {response.ReasonPhrase}");
        output.AppendLine(
            $"FinalUrl={response.RequestMessage?.RequestUri}");


        foreach (
            KeyValuePair<string, IEnumerable<string>> header
            in response.Headers)
        {
            if (!header.Key.Equals("Set-Cookie", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                output.AppendLine($"Header:{header.Key}={string.Join(", ", header.Value)}");
        }


        if (response.Content !=
            null)
        {
            foreach (
                KeyValuePair<string, IEnumerable<string>> header
                in response.Content.Headers)
            {
                output.AppendLine(
                    $"ContentHeader:{header.Key}={string.Join(", ", header.Value)}");
            }


            if (method !=
                HttpMethod.Head)
            {
                string text = await ReadBoundedTextAsync(response.Content, maxResponseChars, timeout.Token);


                output.AppendLine();
                output.AppendLine(
                    "BODY:");
                output.Append(
                    NIRACapabilityArguments.Truncate(
                        text,
                        maxResponseChars));
            }
        }


        return new NIRACapabilityHandlerResult
        {
            Succeeded = response.IsSuccessStatusCode,
            HttpStatusCode = (int)response.StatusCode,
            Summary =
                $"HTTP {method.Method} '{uri}' returned {(int)response.StatusCode} {response.ReasonPhrase}.",

            Output =
                output.ToString().TrimEnd(),

            ChangedSystemState =
                method !=
                    HttpMethod.Get
                &&
                method !=
                    HttpMethod.Head
        };
    }


    private static async Task<string> ReadBoundedTextAsync(HttpContent content, int limit, CancellationToken ct)
    {
        await using Stream stream = await content.ReadAsStreamAsync(ct);
        using StreamReader reader = new(stream, Encoding.UTF8, detectEncodingFromByteOrderMarks: true);
        char[] buffer = new char[Math.Min(limit + 1, 4096)];
        StringBuilder text = new();
        while (text.Length <= limit)
        {
            int read = await reader.ReadAsync(buffer.AsMemory(0, Math.Min(buffer.Length, limit + 1 - text.Length)), ct);
            if (read == 0) break;
            text.Append(buffer, 0, read);
        }
        return text.Length > limit ? text.ToString(0, limit) + "\n[Response truncated.]" : text.ToString();
    }

    public void Dispose()
    {
        _http.Dispose();
    }


    private static Uri ParseUri(
        string value)
    {
        if (!Uri.TryCreate(
                value,
                UriKind.Absolute,
                out Uri? uri)
            ||
            (uri.Scheme !=
                Uri.UriSchemeHttp
             &&
             uri.Scheme !=
                Uri.UriSchemeHttps))
        {
            throw new InvalidOperationException(
                "HTTP capability requires an absolute http:// or https:// URL.");
        }


        return uri;
    }


    private static HttpMethod ParseMethod(
        string value)
    {
        return value.Trim().ToUpperInvariant() switch
        {
            "GET" =>
                HttpMethod.Get,

            "HEAD" =>
                HttpMethod.Head,

            "POST" =>
                HttpMethod.Post,

            "PUT" =>
                HttpMethod.Put,

            "PATCH" =>
                HttpMethod.Patch,

            "DELETE" =>
                HttpMethod.Delete,

            _ =>
                throw new InvalidOperationException(
                    "HTTP method must be GET, HEAD, POST, PUT, PATCH, or DELETE.")
        };
    }


    private static NIRACapabilityParameterDescriptor Parameter(
        string name,
        string type,
        bool required,
        string description)
    {
        return new NIRACapabilityParameterDescriptor
        {
            Name = name,
            Type = type,
            Required = required,
            Description = description
        };
    }
}


public sealed class NIRAHttpDownloadCapabilityHandler
    : INIRACapabilityHandler,
      IDisposable
{
    private readonly HttpClient
        _http;


    public NIRACapabilityDescriptor Descriptor
    {
        get;
    } =
        new NIRACapabilityDescriptor
        {
            Id =
                NIRACapabilityIds.HttpDownload,

            Description =
                "Download one HTTP/HTTPS resource to a file using a temporary file and atomic final move, returning size/hash evidence.",

            DefaultRisk =
                NIRACapabilityRisk.Modify,

            Parameters =
                new[]
                {
                    Parameter("url", "string", true, "Absolute http/https URL."),
                    Parameter("destination", "string", true, "Fully-qualified absolute destination file path. Do not use a relative path or application working directory."),
                    Parameter("overwrite", "boolean", false, "Replace an existing destination. Default false."),
                    Parameter("timeoutSeconds", "integer", false, "Timeout from 1-600 seconds. Default 120."),
                    Parameter("maxBytes", "integer", false, "Maximum download size in bytes. Default 268435456 (256 MiB), maximum 1073741824 (1 GiB).")
                }
        };


    public NIRAHttpDownloadCapabilityHandler()
    {
        SocketsHttpHandler handler =
            new()
            {
                AllowAutoRedirect = false,
                UseCookies = false,

                AutomaticDecompression =
                    DecompressionMethods.GZip |
                    DecompressionMethods.Deflate |
                    DecompressionMethods.Brotli
            };


        _http =
            new HttpClient(
                handler,
                disposeHandler: true)
            {
                Timeout =
                    Timeout.InfiniteTimeSpan
            };


        _http.DefaultRequestHeaders.UserAgent.Add(
            new ProductInfoHeaderValue(
                "NIRAAgent",
                "1.0"));
    }


    public NIRACapabilityRisk ResolveRisk(
        NIRACapabilityRequest request)
    {
        return NIRACapabilityArguments.GetBoolean(
                request,
                "overwrite")
            ? NIRACapabilityRisk.Destructive
            : NIRACapabilityRisk.Modify;
    }


    public async Task<NIRACapabilityHandlerResult> ExecuteAsync(
        NIRACapabilityRequest request,
        CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        Uri uri =
            ParseUri(
                NIRACapabilityArguments.RequireString(
                    request,
                    "url",
                    4096));


        string requestedDestination = NIRACapabilityArguments.RequireString(
            request, "destination", 32760);
        if (!Path.IsPathFullyQualified(requestedDestination))
            throw new ArgumentException(
                "destination must be an absolute file path. Relative paths must not resolve inside NIRA's application directory.");
        string destination =
            NIRACapabilityArguments.NormalizePath(requestedDestination);


        bool overwrite =
            NIRACapabilityArguments.GetBoolean(
                request,
                "overwrite");


        int timeoutSeconds =
            NIRACapabilityArguments.GetInteger(
                request,
                "timeoutSeconds",
                120,
                1,
                600);


        int maxBytes =
            NIRACapabilityArguments.GetInteger(
                request,
                "maxBytes",
                268_435_456,
                1,
                1_073_741_824);


        string? directory =
            Path.GetDirectoryName(
                destination);


        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                directory)
            ||
            !Directory.Exists(
                directory))
        {
            throw new DirectoryNotFoundException(
                "Download destination directory does not exist. Create it explicitly when intended.");
        }


        if (File.Exists(
                destination)
            &&
            !overwrite)
        {
            throw new IOException(
                "Download destination already exists and overwrite=false.");
        }


        string temporary =
            destination
            + ".NIRA-download-"
            + Guid.NewGuid().ToString("N")
            + ".tmp";


        using CancellationTokenSource timeout =
            CancellationTokenSource.CreateLinkedTokenSource(
                cancellationToken);


        timeout.CancelAfter(
            TimeSpan.FromSeconds(
                timeoutSeconds));


        try
        {
            using HttpResponseMessage response =
                await _http.GetAsync(
                    uri,
                    HttpCompletionOption.ResponseHeadersRead,
                    timeout.Token);


            if ((int)response.StatusCode is >= 300 and < 400)
                return new NIRACapabilityHandlerResult
                {
                    Succeeded = false,
                    HttpStatusCode = (int)response.StatusCode,
                    Summary = "Download returned a redirect. Submit its Location as a separate authorized request.",
                    Output = $"Status={(int)response.StatusCode}\nLocation={response.Headers.Location}",
                    ChangedSystemState = false
                };
            response.EnsureSuccessStatusCode();


            long? declaredLength =
                response.Content.Headers.ContentLength;


            if (declaredLength.HasValue
                &&
                declaredLength.Value >
                    maxBytes)
            {
                throw new InvalidOperationException(
                    $"Download Content-Length {declaredLength.Value} exceeds maxBytes={maxBytes}.");
            }


            await using Stream input =
                await response.Content.ReadAsStreamAsync(
                    timeout.Token);


            await using FileStream output =
                new(
                    temporary,
                    FileMode.CreateNew,
                    FileAccess.Write,
                    FileShare.None,
                    81920,
                    FileOptions.Asynchronous | FileOptions.SequentialScan);


            byte[] buffer =
                new byte[81920];


            long total =
                0;


            while (true)
            {
                int read =
                    await input.ReadAsync(
                        buffer,
                        timeout.Token);


                if (read ==
                    0)
                {
                    break;
                }


                total +=
                    read;


                if (total >
                    maxBytes)
                {
                    throw new InvalidOperationException(
                        $"Download exceeded maxBytes={maxBytes}.");
                }


                await output.WriteAsync(
                    buffer.AsMemory(
                        0,
                        read),
                    timeout.Token);
            }


            await output.FlushAsync(
                timeout.Token);


            await output.DisposeAsync();
            timeout.Token.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
            File.Move(temporary, destination, overwrite);

            string hash =
                ComputeSha256(
                    destination);


            FileInfo file =
                new(
                    destination);


            return new NIRACapabilityHandlerResult
            {
                Summary =
                    $"Downloaded '{uri}' to '{destination}'. Length={file.Length} | SHA256={hash}.",

                Output =
                    $"Url={uri}\nDestination={destination}\nLength={file.Length}\nSHA256={hash}\nLastWriteUtc={file.LastWriteTimeUtc:O}",

                ChangedSystemState =
                    true
            };
        }
        finally
        {
            if (File.Exists(
                    temporary))
            {
                try
                {
                    File.Delete(
                        temporary);
                }
                catch
                {
                }
            }
        }
    }


    public void Dispose()
    {
        _http.Dispose();
    }


    private static Uri ParseUri(
        string value)
    {
        if (!Uri.TryCreate(
                value,
                UriKind.Absolute,
                out Uri? uri)
            ||
            (uri.Scheme !=
                Uri.UriSchemeHttp
             &&
             uri.Scheme !=
                Uri.UriSchemeHttps))
        {
            throw new InvalidOperationException(
                "HTTP download requires an absolute http:// or https:// URL.");
        }


        return uri;
    }


    private static string ComputeSha256(
        string path)
    {
        using FileStream stream =
            File.OpenRead(
                path);


        byte[] hash =
            SHA256.HashData(
                stream);


        return Convert.ToHexString(
            hash)
            .ToLowerInvariant();
    }


    private static NIRACapabilityParameterDescriptor Parameter(
        string name,
        string type,
        bool required,
        string description)
    {
        return new NIRACapabilityParameterDescriptor
        {
            Name = name,
            Type = type,
            Required = required,
            Description = description
        };
    }
}

using NIRAAgent.Images;
using NIRAAgent.Diagnostics;
using System.Text;

namespace NIRAAgent.Capabilities;

public sealed class NIRAImageSearchCapabilityHandler : INIRACapabilityHandler
{
    private readonly INIRAImageDiscoveryService _service;
    public NIRAImageSearchCapabilityHandler(INIRAImageDiscoveryService service) => _service = service;

    public NIRACapabilityDescriptor Descriptor { get; } = new()
    {
        Id = NIRACapabilityIds.ImageSearch,
        Description = "Search genuine current web images via Tavily (existing NIRA_TAVILY_API_KEY; no generation). Returns short-lived candidateId, title, source URL and rights status (third-party licensing is not verified). Then call image.retrieve with a returned candidateId to show a real image; never invent IDs or URLs.",
        DefaultRisk = NIRACapabilityRisk.Observe,
        Parameters = new[] {
            new NIRACapabilityParameterDescriptor { Name="query", Type="string", Required=true, Description="Specific visual subject, 2-160 characters; no URLs." },
            new NIRACapabilityParameterDescriptor { Name="limit", Type="integer", Required=false, Description="Number of ranked candidates, 1-12; default 6." },
            new NIRACapabilityParameterDescriptor { Name="retrieveBest", Type="boolean", Required=false,
                Description="Retrieve and present real licensed images in chat by default. Set false only to inspect candidate metadata without downloading. Does not create/generate images." },
            new NIRACapabilityParameterDescriptor { Name="retrieveCount", Type="integer", Required=false,
                Description="Optional count of distinct verified images to show when retrieveBest is true, 1-3; default 1. Pick based on actual user value, never as a quota." },
            new NIRACapabilityParameterDescriptor { Name="photographsOnly", Type="boolean", Required=false,
                Description="When true, prefer authentic photos and exclude identifiable diagrams, illustrations, models and renderings; default false." }
        }
    };

    public NIRACapabilityRisk ResolveRisk(NIRACapabilityRequest request) => NIRACapabilityRisk.Observe;

    public async Task<NIRACapabilityHandlerResult> ExecuteAsync(NIRACapabilityRequest request,
        CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        string query = NIRACapabilityArguments.RequireString(request, "query", 160);
        int limit = NIRACapabilityArguments.GetInteger(request, "limit", 6, 1, 12);
        // Searching for photos normally means the user wants visible photos,
        // not a list of IDs. Direct model capabilityRequests may omit this
        // optional argument even when the resource planner explicitly sets it.
        // Preserve the ability to opt out with retrieveBest=false.
        bool retrieveBest = !request.Arguments.TryGetProperty("retrieveBest", out _) ||
            NIRACapabilityArguments.GetBoolean(request, "retrieveBest");
        int retrieveCount = NIRACapabilityArguments.GetInteger(request, "retrieveCount", 1, 1, 3);
        bool photographsOnly = NIRACapabilityArguments.GetBoolean(request, "photographsOnly");
        string safeQuery = query.Replace('\r', ' ').Replace('\n', ' ');
        NIRADiagnosticTrace.Event("IMAGE-TOOL-REQUEST",
            $"Capability=image.search Query={safeQuery} Limit={limit} " +
            $"RetrieveBest={retrieveBest} RetrieveCount={retrieveCount} PhotographsOnly={photographsOnly}");
        var images = await _service.SearchAsync(query, limit, cancellationToken, photographsOnly);
        NIRADiagnosticTrace.Event("IMAGE-TOOL-RESULT",
            $"Capability=image.search Query={query} Candidates={images.Count} " +
            $"ProviderStatus={_service.LastSearchStatus}");
        var output = new StringBuilder();
        output.AppendLine($"Provider=Tavily | Query={query} | Candidates={images.Count} | ResultsAreCandidatesOnly=True");
        foreach (var item in images)
        {
            output.AppendLine($"CandidateId={item.CandidateId}");
            output.AppendLine($"Provider={item.Provider}");
            output.AppendLine($"Title={item.Title}");
            output.AppendLine($"Description={item.Description}");
            output.AppendLine($"Author={item.Author}");
            output.AppendLine($"License={(item.License.Length == 0 ? "See source page" : item.License)}");
            output.AppendLine($"LicenseUrl={item.LicenseUrl}");
            output.AppendLine($"SourceUri={item.SourceUri}");
            output.AppendLine($"Dimensions={item.Width}x{item.Height}");
            output.AppendLine("---");
        }
        if (images.Count == 0)
        {
            // A successful HTTP response with zero usable images is a completed
            // negative observation. Tell the Executive plainly so it does not
            // ask the model to repeat an equivalent search in another cycle.
            // The link is to a REAL Wikimedia search page, NOT an image or a
            // fabricated source attribution. Search text is URL-encoded only.
            output.AppendLine("IMAGE_DISCOVERY_EMPTY=True");
            output.AppendLine("ImageSubjectMatch=False");
            output.AppendLine("VerifiedImageRetrieved=False");
            // Do not invent or promote an unrelated image-search page.
            output.AppendLine("ImageSearchPageIsNotVerifiedImage=True");
            return new NIRACapabilityHandlerResult {
                Summary = "IMAGE_DISCOVERY_EMPTY: Tavily search completed, but no subject-relevant reference image was verified. No image was displayed.",
                Output = output.ToString(), ChangedSystemState = false
            };
        }
        // The SAME initial model decision may ask for one or a few distinct
        // licensed images. No second model turn is required to choose IDs.
        // Actual bytes, not the requested count, determine what gets shown.
        if (retrieveBest && images.Count > 0)
        {
            var shown = new List<NIRACapabilityVisualArtifact>();
            var hashes = new HashSet<string>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
            using var budget = CancellationTokenSource.CreateLinkedTokenSource(cancellationToken);
            budget.CancelAfter(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(28));
            foreach (var candidate in images)
            {
                if (shown.Count >= retrieveCount || budget.IsCancellationRequested) break;
                try
                {
                    var image = await _service.RetrieveAsync(candidate.CandidateId, budget.Token);
                    if (!hashes.Add(image.Sha256)) continue;
                    NIRADiagnosticTrace.Event("IMAGE-TOOL-SELECT",
                        $"Capability=image.search SelectedTitle={image.Title} " +
                        $"SourceUri={image.SourceUri} Bytes={image.Bytes} " +
                        $"SelectionNumber={shown.Count + 1}");
                    shown.Add(new NIRACapabilityVisualArtifact {
                        LocalPath = image.LocalPath, Title = image.Title, Caption = image.Caption,
                        SourceUri = image.SourceUri, PresentToUser = true, Surface = "InlineOnly"
                    });
                    output.AppendLine($"VerifiedImageTitle={image.Title}");
                    output.AppendLine($"VerifiedImageSourceUri={image.SourceUri}");
                }
                catch (NIRAImageRetrievalUnavailableException)
                {
                    // Exhaustion of this already-searched batch is terminal.
                    // The retrieval service itself tried independent candidates.
                    break;
                }
                catch (OperationCanceledException) when (!cancellationToken.IsCancellationRequested)
                {
                    break;
                }
            }
            if (shown.Count > 0)
            {
                NIRAAgent.Diagnostics.NIRADiagnosticTrace.Event("IMAGE-DELIVERY",
                    $"Outcome=ArtifactsPrepared Count={shown.Count} Surface=InlineOnly");
                output.AppendLine($"VerifiedImageRetrieved=True\nVerifiedImageCount={shown.Count}");
                return new NIRACapabilityHandlerResult {
                    Summary = $"Displayed {shown.Count} distinct verified raster image(s) out of {images.Count} retrieved candidates.",
                    Output = output.ToString(), ChangedSystemState = false,
                    VisualArtifacts = shown.ToArray()
                };
            }
            output.AppendLine("VerifiedImageRetrieved=False\nImageMediaUnavailable=True");
        }
        output.AppendLine("Candidates alone are NOT displayed images. Use image.retrieve with a returned candidateId if a different verified photo is needed.");
        return new NIRACapabilityHandlerResult {
            Summary = $"Found {images.Count} Tavily image candidate(s); no verified image has been displayed.",
            Output = output.ToString(), ChangedSystemState = false
        };
    }
}

public sealed class NIRAImageRetrieveCapabilityHandler : INIRACapabilityHandler
{
    private readonly INIRAImageDiscoveryService _service;
    public NIRAImageRetrieveCapabilityHandler(INIRAImageDiscoveryService service) => _service = service;

    public NIRACapabilityDescriptor Descriptor { get; } = new()
    {
        Id = NIRACapabilityIds.ImageRetrieve,
        Description = "Retrieve a verified raster image candidate into NIRA's own bounded visual cache and automatically present it in chat with its known source and explicit rights status. CandidateId MUST come from image.search. This does not write user files, require a browser, or accept a URL/path from the model.",

        }

            Output = $"LocalPath={download.LocalPath}\nTitle={download.Title}\nCaption={download.Caption}\nSourceUri={download.SourceUri}\nSHA256={download.Sha256}\nBytes={download.Bytes}\nVerifiedImageRetrieved=True",
            VisualArtifacts = new [] { new NIRACapabilityVisualArtifact {
                LocalPath=download.LocalPath, Title=download.Title, Caption=download.Caption,
                SourceUri=download.SourceUri, PresentToUser=true, Surface="InlineOnly"
            } },
            ChangedSystemState = false // Runtime-owned bounded visual cache, not a user-file mutation.
        };
    }
}

using System.Text.RegularExpressions;

using NIRAAgent.Images;

namespace NIRAAgent.Capabilities;

// One pre-authorized generation (Cloudflare may consume daily quota). Never retries or calls another LLM.
public sealed class NIRAImageGenerateCapabilityHandler : INIRACapabilityHandler
{
    private readonly NIRACloudflareImageGenerationService _generator;
    public NIRAImageGenerateCapabilityHandler(NIRACloudflareImageGenerationService generator) => _generator = generator;
    public NIRACapabilityDescriptor Descriptor { get; } = new()
    {
        Id = NIRACapabilityIds.ImageGenerate,
        Description = "Generate exactly ONE NEW original image using Cloudflare Workers AI FLUX.2 Klein 4B. " +
            "This consumes image-generation quota. Use only when the user explicitly requests creation; NEVER for reference-image searches. " +
            "In your SAME cognition pass, enhance the user's prompt into a vivid, faithful 1-2400 character description, " +
            "preserve their subjects and constraints, choose dimensions, and invoke image.generate ONCE. " +
            "The result is verified and automatically displayed in chat and saved under Gallery > AI Generated. " +
            "Do not retry on failure and do not call another reasoning model for prompt enhancement.",
        DefaultRisk = NIRACapabilityRisk.Execute,
        Parameters = new[]
        {
            new NIRACapabilityParameterDescriptor { Name="prompt", Type="string", Required=true,
                Description="An enhanced but faithful visual prompt (4-2400 chars) from the same cognition call." },
            new NIRACapabilityParameterDescriptor { Name="width", Type="integer", Required=false,
                Description="Width in pixels, multiple of 8. Default 1024; 1024 square, 1280x720 landscape, 720x1280 portrait." },
            new NIRACapabilityParameterDescriptor { Name="height", Type="integer", Required=false,
                Description="Height in pixels, multiple of 8. Default 768; max one megapixel for test generation." }
        }
    };
    public NIRACapabilityRisk ResolveRisk(NIRACapabilityRequest _) => NIRACapabilityRisk.Execute;
    public async Task<NIRACapabilityHandlerResult> ExecuteAsync(NIRACapabilityRequest request,
        CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        string prompt = NIRACapabilityArguments.RequireString(request, "prompt", 2400);
        int width = NIRACapabilityArguments.GetInteger(request, "width", 1024, 256, 1920);
        int height = NIRACapabilityArguments.GetInteger(request, "height", 768, 256, 1920);
        var result = await _generator.GenerateAsync(new NIRAImageGenerationRequest(prompt, width, height), cancellationToken);
        return new NIRACapabilityHandlerResult
        {
            Summary = $"Generated one verified image with FLUX.2 Klein 4B ({result.Width}x{result.Height}); shown in chat and added to AI Generated Gallery.",
            Output = $"VerifiedImageGenerated=True\nModel={result.Model}\nWidth={result.Width}\nHeight={result.Height}\nLocalPath={result.LocalPath}\nSHA256={result.Sha256}\nBytes={result.Bytes}\nOneGeneration=True",
            VisualArtifacts = new[] { new NIRACapabilityVisualArtifact
            {
                LocalPath = result.LocalPath,
                Title = BuildDisplayTitle(prompt),
                Caption = NIRACloudflareImageGenerationService.GeneratedCaptionPrefix,
                PresentToUser = true,
                Surface = "InlineOnly"
            } },
            ChangedSystemState = false // Only NIRA's own managed cache, no user-owned filesystem mutation.
        };
    }


    private static string BuildDisplayTitle(string prompt)
    {
        string normalized = Regex.Replace(prompt ?? string.Empty, @"\s+", " ").Trim();
        if (normalized.Length == 0)
            return "NIRA generated image";

        string candidate = Regex.Split(normalized,
            @"(?<=[.!?])\s+|\s+(?:with|featuring|showing|including|surrounded by)\s+",
            RegexOptions.IgnoreCase | RegexOptions.CultureInvariant)
            .FirstOrDefault(part => !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(part))?
            .Trim(' ', ',', ';', '.', ':') ?? normalized;

        candidate = Regex.Replace(candidate, @"^(?:create|generate|make|render)\s+", string.Empty,
            RegexOptions.IgnoreCase | RegexOptions.CultureInvariant).Trim();
        if (candidate.Length > 72)
            candidate = candidate[..72].TrimEnd() + "…";
        if (candidate.Length == 0)
            return "NIRA generated image";
        return char.ToUpperInvariant(candidate[0]) + candidate[1..];
    }
}

/*
