```csharp
using System.Diagnostics;
using System.Globalization;
using System.Text;

namespace NIRAAgent.Capabilities;

/// <summary>
/// Bounded, metadata-only disk-usage observation. Child-directory totals are
/// measured rather than inferred from directory metadata. A partial scan is
/// never represented as a complete accounting of disk usage.
/// </summary>
public sealed class NIRADirectoryUsageCapabilityHandler : INIRACapabilityHandler
{
    public NIRACapabilityDescriptor Descriptor { get; } = new()
    {
        Id = NIRACapabilityIds.DirectoryUsage,
        Description = "Measure actual file bytes under a directory and rank its immediate child folders by cumulative file size. " +
            "Use for storage investigations; filesystem.list sortBy=SizeBytes only ranks individual files. " +
            "Read-only metadata scan. Bound by maxDepth, maxScannedEntries and maxSeconds; partial totals are lower bounds, NOT true folder totals.",
        DefaultRisk = NIRACapabilityRisk.Observe,
        Parameters = new[]
        {
            Parameter("path", "string", true, "Verified directory path to measure; no wildcard."),
            Parameter("maxDepth", "integer", false, "Maximum folder depth beneath root (default 5; 1..12)."),
            Parameter("maxScannedEntries", "integer", false, "Maximum files/folders examined (default 15000, maximum 100000)."),
            Parameter("maxSeconds", "integer", false, "Maximum scan duration in seconds (default 4, maximum 30)."),
            Parameter("top", "integer", false, "Number of immediate-child groups returned (default 12, maximum 50).")
        }
    };

    public NIRACapabilityRisk ResolveRisk(NIRACapabilityRequest request) => NIRACapabilityRisk.Observe;

    public Task<NIRACapabilityHandlerResult> ExecuteAsync(
        NIRACapabilityRequest request, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        string path = NIRACapabilityArguments.NormalizePath(
            NIRACapabilityArguments.RequireString(request, "path", 32760));
        int maxDepth = NIRACapabilityArguments.GetInteger(request, "maxDepth", 5, 1, 12);
        int maxEntries = NIRACapabilityArguments.GetInteger(request, "maxScannedEntries", 15000, 1, 100000);
        int maxSeconds = NIRACapabilityArguments.GetInteger(request, "maxSeconds", 4, 1, 30);
        int top = NIRACapabilityArguments.GetInteger(request, "top", 12, 1, 50);
        if (!Directory.Exists(path))
            throw new DirectoryNotFoundException($"Directory for usage analysis does not exist: {path}");
        if ((File.GetAttributes(path) & FileAttributes.ReparsePoint) != 0)
            throw new InvalidOperationException("Cannot scan a junction/symlink as the root; supply the real directory path.");

        // A normal background worker, not the UI dispatcher, performs the scan.
        return Task.Run(() => Scan(path, maxDepth, maxEntries, maxSeconds, top, cancellationToken), cancellationToken);
    }

    private static NIRACapabilityHandlerResult Scan(
        string root, int maxDepth, int maxEntries, int maxSeconds, int top, CancellationToken token)
    {
        var stopwatch = Stopwatch.StartNew();
        var totals = new Dictionary<string, (long Bytes, int Files)>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
        var pending = new Queue<(string Folder, int Depth, string Group)>();
        pending.Enqueue((root, 0, root));
        int examined = 0, files = 0, unreadable = 0, depthLimited = 0;
        long totalBytes = 0;
        bool limited = false;

        while (pending.Count > 0 && !limited)
        {
            token.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
            if (examined >= maxEntries || stopwatch.Elapsed.TotalSeconds >= maxSeconds)
            {
                limited = true;
                break;
            }
            var (folder, depth, group) = pending.Dequeue();
            IEnumerator<string>? iterator;
            try { iterator = Directory.EnumerateFileSystemEntries(folder).GetEnumerator(); }
            catch (UnauthorizedAccessException) { unreadable++; continue; }
            catch (IOException) { unreadable++; continue; }
            using (iterator)
            {
                while (true)
                {
                    token.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
                    if (examined >= maxEntries || stopwatch.Elapsed.TotalSeconds >= maxSeconds)
                    {
                        limited = true;
                        break;
                    }
                    string child;
                    try
                    {
                        if (!iterator.MoveNext()) break;
                        child = iterator.Current;
                    }
                    catch (UnauthorizedAccessException) { unreadable++; break; }
                    catch (IOException) { unreadable++; break; }
                    examined++;
                    try
                    {
                        FileAttributes attributes = File.GetAttributes(child);
                        if ((attributes & FileAttributes.ReparsePoint) != 0)
                        {
                            // Skipping links prevents cycles and inadvertent traversal.
                            depthLimited++;
                            continue;
                        }
                        bool directory = (attributes & FileAttributes.Directory) != 0;
                        string childGroup = depth == 0 ? child : group;
                        if (directory)
                        {
                            if (!totals.ContainsKey(childGroup)) totals[childGroup] = (0, 0);
                            if (depth < maxDepth)
                                pending.Enqueue((child, depth + 1, childGroup));
                            else
                                depthLimited++;
                        }
                        else
                        {
                            long size = new FileInfo(child).Length;
                            var current = totals.GetValueOrDefault(childGroup);
                            totals[childGroup] = (current.Bytes + size, current.Files + 1);
                            totalBytes += size;
                            files++;
                        }
                    }
                    catch (IOException) { unreadable++; }
                    catch (UnauthorizedAccessException) { unreadable++; }
                }
            }
        }

        bool complete = !limited && unreadable == 0 && depthLimited == 0;
        var ranked = totals.OrderByDescending(group => group.Value.Bytes)
            .ThenBy(group => group.Key, StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
            .Take(top).ToArray();
        StringBuilder output = new();
        output.AppendLine("Path\tObservedBytes\tObservedFiles\tAccounting");
        foreach (var entry in ranked)
        {
            string display = string.Equals(entry.Key, root, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
                ? root + " [files directly inside root]" : entry.Key;
            output.Append(display).Append('\t')
                .Append(entry.Value.Bytes.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)).Append('\t')
                .Append(entry.Value.Files.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)).Append('\t')
                .AppendLine(complete ? "MeasuredWithinDepth" : "LowerBoundIncomplete");
        }
        return new NIRACapabilityHandlerResult
        {
            Summary = $"DirectoryUsage | Root='{root}' | ObservedFiles={files} | " +
                $"ObservedBytes={totalBytes} | EntriesExamined={examined} | " +
                $"EntriesLimit={maxEntries} | DepthLimit={maxDepth} | SecondsLimit={maxSeconds} | " +
                $"ScanComplete={complete} | Incomplete={(!complete)} | " +
                $"Unreadable={unreadable} | LinksOrDepthOmitted={depthLimited} | " +
                $"TimeLimited={limited && stopwatch.Elapsed.TotalSeconds >= maxSeconds} | " +
                $"EntryLimited={limited && examined >= maxEntries} | RankedGroups={ranked.Length}. " +
                (complete ? "These groups total observed contents of this scanned subtree." :
                    "All byte totals are observed LOWER BOUNDS, not full folder sizes. Narrow the root or adjust bounds for better coverage."),
            Output = output.ToString().TrimEnd(),
            ChangedSystemState = false
        };
    }

    private static NIRACapabilityParameterDescriptor Parameter(string name, string type, bool required, string description) =>
        new() { Name = name, Type = type, Required = required, Description = description };
}
```

## 151. `NIRAAgent\Capabilities\NIRAFileLocationCapabilityHandler.cs`

**File:** `NIRAAgent\Capabilities\NIRAFileLocationCapabilityHandler.cs`

```csharp
/*
 * filename: NIRAFileLocationCapabilityHandler.cs
 * Bounded, observation-only discovery under an evidence-grounded directory.
 * It never selects a write target or grants access to the discovered path.
 */
using System.Text;
using System.Runtime.InteropServices;

namespace NIRAAgent.Capabilities;

public sealed class NIRAFileLocationCapabilityHandler : INIRACapabilityHandler
{
    private static readonly EnumerationOptions SafeEnumeration =
        new()
        {
            IgnoreInaccessible = true,
            RecurseSubdirectories = false,
            ReturnSpecialDirectories = false,
            AttributesToSkip = FileAttributes.ReparsePoint
        };

    public NIRACapabilityDescriptor Descriptor { get; } =
        new NIRACapabilityDescriptor
        {
            Id = NIRACapabilityIds.FileLocate,
            Description =
                "Find a filesystem file or folder by exact name or explicit contains-name match with bounded observation-only traversal. " +
                "For installed-application identity/location by human application name, prefer application.resolve; " +
                "do not guess conventional installation roots and use this as a substitute for Windows application discovery. " +
                "Use a grounded absolute root when one is known. If no root is supplied, the " +
                "handler first searches Windows-resolved user known folders (such as the current redirected Desktop), then ready fixed local drives, so an explicit whole-PC exact-name locate " +
                "request does not require the user to invent a base directory. File matches include " +
                "basic metadata (size and last-write time) so a location/size request does not need " +
                "a second filesystem.metadata call. It never accesses file contents.",
            DefaultRisk = NIRACapabilityRisk.Observe,
            Parameters = new[]
            {
                Parameter("root", "string", false, "Optional grounded absolute directory. Omit for scope=CurrentUserFolder or for a whole-PC search."),
                Parameter("scope", "string", false, "CurrentUserFolder resolves an exact OS known folder or discovers an ordinary named item within current-user content; CurrentUserContent searches current-user known directories. Omit for whole-PC/root behavior."),
                Parameter("name", "string", true, "File/folder name or name fragment when matchMode=Contains. No wildcard or path."),
                Parameter("matchMode", "string", false, "Exact (default) or Contains (case-insensitive substring of filename). Must be explicit to broaden name matching."),
                Parameter("kind", "string", false, "Directory (folder), File or Either (both). Default Either. Use these values, not arbitrary kinds."),
                Parameter("maxDepth", "integer", false, "Child-directory depth, 0-6; default 3 for a known root, 6 for whole-PC search."),
                Parameter("maxEntries", "integer", false, "Maximum entries examined per search root, 1-12000; default 1000 for a known root, 8000 for whole-PC search."),
                Parameter("maxMatches", "integer", false, "Maximum returned matches, 1-50; default 20.")
            }
        };

    public NIRACapabilityRisk ResolveRisk(NIRACapabilityRequest request) =>
        NIRACapabilityRisk.Observe;

    public Task<NIRACapabilityHandlerResult> ExecuteAsync(
        NIRACapabilityRequest request,
        CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        cancellationToken.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
        string? requestedRoot =
            NIRACapabilityArguments.GetOptionalString(request, "root", 32760);
        string name = NIRACapabilityArguments.RequireString(request, "name", 255).Trim();
        string? scope = NIRACapabilityArguments.GetOptionalString(request, "scope", 40);
        string matchMode = (NIRACapabilityArguments.GetOptionalString(request, "matchMode", 40)
            ?? "Exact").Trim();
        if (!matchMode.Equals("Exact", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) &&
            !matchMode.Equals("Contains", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
            throw new ArgumentException("matchMode must be Exact or Contains.");
        bool containsName = matchMode.Equals("Contains", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
        string kind = (NIRACapabilityArguments.GetOptionalString(request, "kind", 32)
            ?? "Either").Trim();
        // Canonicalize common *meaning-equivalent* labels without broadening the
        // allowed search kind or guessing a different target.
        if (kind.Equals("Folder", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
            kind.Equals("Dir", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
            kind.Equals("Directories", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
            kind = "Directory";
        else if (kind.Equals("Files", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
            kind = "File";
        else if (kind.Equals("Both", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
            kind.Equals("Any", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
            kind = "Either";
        // Multi-folder discovery uses a smaller default budget than a deliberate
        // whole-drive search; the caller can still explicitly increase bounds.
        bool limitedUserContent = scope?.Equals("CurrentUserContent", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) == true;
        int maxDepth = NIRACapabilityArguments.GetInteger(
            request, "maxDepth", limitedUserContent ? 4 : string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(requestedRoot) ? 6 : 3, 0, 6);
        int maxEntries = NIRACapabilityArguments.GetInteger(
            request, "maxEntries", limitedUserContent ? 2000 : string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(requestedRoot) ? 8000 : 1000, 1, 12000);
        int maxMatches = NIRACapabilityArguments.GetInteger(request, "maxMatches", 20, 1, 50);

        // A name is deliberately one path segment: the model cannot use this
        // observation primitive to change its traversal root via '..' or globbing.
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(name) ||
            name is "." or ".." ||
            name.IndexOfAny(new[] { '/', '\\', '*', '?', ':' }) >= 0 ||
            !string.Equals(name, Path.GetFileName(name), StringComparison.Ordinal))
            throw new ArgumentException("name must be a single exact file or directory name.");
        // Opt-in OS-owned location, not a search through other users' folders.
        // Default filesystem.locate behavior and all legacy callers are untouched.
        if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(scope) &&
            !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(requestedRoot))
            throw new ArgumentException("A known-folder scope cannot also specify root.");
        bool currentFolderScope =
            scope?.Equals("CurrentUserFolder", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) == true;
        // A known Windows folder is an identity lookup, but models also use this
        // scope for ordinary *named* directories inside the user profile.
        // Do not throw merely because a name is not one of six OS identities:
        // safely fall back to bounded discovery within CURRENT user content.
        if (currentFolderScope && !containsName &&
            NIRACapabilityArguments.IsCurrentUserKnownFolderName(name) &&
            (kind.Equals("Directory", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
             kind.Equals("Either", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)))
        {
            string folder = ResolveConfiguredCurrentUserFolder(name);
            if (!Directory.Exists(folder))
                return Task.FromResult(new NIRACapabilityHandlerResult
                {
                    Summary = $"LocationSearch=ConfiguredButMissing | Scope=CurrentUserFolder | Name='{name}' | " +
                        "Matches=0 | ScanComplete=True | NoDirectoryWasObserved=True",
                    Output = $"ConfiguredKnownFolder={folder}\n" +
                        "The current Windows user has this known-folder location configured, " +
                        "but the directory does not exist. This is NOT a verified directory. " +
                        "If the user requested file creation there, first use filesystem.directory.create " +
                        "for this exact configured path; otherwise ask for clarification. " +
                        "Do NOT broaden filesystem.locate to search unrelated drives.",
                    ChangedSystemState = false
                });
            return Task.FromResult(new NIRACapabilityHandlerResult
            {
                Summary = $"LocationSearch=Unique | Scope=CurrentUserFolder | Name='{name}' | " +
                    "Kind=Directory | Matches=1 | Truncated=False | Origin=WindowsUserProfile",
                Output = $"MatchEvidence=WindowsCurrentUserKnownFolder\nDIR\t{folder}",
                ChangedSystemState = false
            });
        }
        bool userContentScope =
            currentFolderScope ||
            scope?.Equals("CurrentUserContent", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) == true;
        if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(scope) && !userContentScope)
            throw new ArgumentException("scope must be CurrentUserFolder or CurrentUserContent.");

        string[] roots;
        if (userContentScope)
        {
            // Only the CURRENT Windows user's resolved locations; no guessing
            // other users' folders or silently broadening into whole-drive search.
            roots = new[] { "Documents", "Downloads", "Desktop", "Pictures", "Music", "Videos" }
                .Select(folder =>
                {
                    try { return ResolveCurrentUserFolder(folder); }
                    catch (DirectoryNotFoundException) { return null; }
                })
                .Where(path => !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(path))
                .Select(path => path!)
                .Distinct(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
                .ToArray();
            if (roots.Length == 0)
                throw new DirectoryNotFoundException("No current-user known content folders were available.");
        }
        else if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(requestedRoot))
        {
            roots = ResolveWholePcSearchRoots();

            if (roots.Length == 0)
                throw new InvalidOperationException(
                    "No ready fixed local drives are available for a whole-PC location search.");
        }
        else
        {
            string root = NIRACapabilityArguments.NormalizePath(requestedRoot);
            if (!Path.IsPathFullyQualified(root))
                throw new ArgumentException("root must be an absolute directory path.");
            if (!Directory.Exists(root))
                throw new DirectoryNotFoundException($"Search root does not exist: {root}");
            if ((File.GetAttributes(root) & FileAttributes.ReparsePoint) != 0)
                throw new InvalidOperationException(
                    "A linked/junction search root is not supported; use its real scoped path.");
            roots = new[] { root };
        }

        bool wantFiles;
        bool wantDirectories;
        if (kind.Equals("File", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
            (wantFiles, wantDirectories) = (true, false);
        else if (kind.Equals("Directory", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
            (wantFiles, wantDirectories) = (false, true);
        else if (kind.Equals("Either", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
            (wantFiles, wantDirectories) = (true, true);
        else
            throw new ArgumentException("kind must be File, Directory, or Either.");

        StringBuilder output = new();
        int examined = 0;
        int unreadable = 0;
        int matches = 0;
        bool truncated = false;
        List<string> truncatedRoots = new();

        foreach (string root in roots)
        {
            if (matches >= maxMatches)
            {
                truncated = true;
                break;
            }

            Queue<(string Directory, int Depth)> queue = new();
            queue.Enqueue((root, 0));
            int examinedThisRoot = 0;
            bool rootTruncated = false;

            while (queue.Count > 0 && !rootTruncated && matches < maxMatches)
            {
                cancellationToken.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
                var (directory, depth) = queue.Dequeue();
                IEnumerator<string> enumerator;
                try
                {
                    enumerator = Directory.EnumerateFileSystemEntries(
                        directory,
                        "*",
                        SafeEnumeration).GetEnumerator();
                }
                catch (UnauthorizedAccessException) { unreadable++; continue; }
                catch (IOException) { unreadable++; continue; }

                using (enumerator)
                {
                    while (true)
                    {
                        cancellationToken.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
                        string entry;
                        try
                        {
                            if (!enumerator.MoveNext()) break;
                            entry = enumerator.Current;
                        }
                        catch (UnauthorizedAccessException) { unreadable++; break; }
                        catch (IOException) { unreadable++; break; }

                        if (examinedThisRoot >= maxEntries)
                        {
                            rootTruncated = true;
                            truncated = true;
                            truncatedRoots.Add(root);
                            break;
                        }

                        examinedThisRoot++;
                        examined++;

                        FileAttributes attributes;
                        try { attributes = File.GetAttributes(entry); }
                        catch (UnauthorizedAccessException) { unreadable++; continue; }
                        catch (IOException) { unreadable++; continue; }

                        // Never descend through symbolic links, junctions, or mount points.
                        if ((attributes & FileAttributes.ReparsePoint) != 0) continue;

                        bool isDirectory = (attributes & FileAttributes.Directory) != 0;
                        string entryName = Path.GetFileName(entry);
                        if ((containsName
                                ? entryName.Contains(name, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
                                : string.Equals(entryName, name, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)) &&
                            (isDirectory ? wantDirectories : wantFiles))
                        {
                            if (isDirectory)
                            {
                                output.AppendLine($"DIR\t{entry}");
                            }
                            else
                            {
                                try
                                {
                                    FileInfo fileInfo =
                                        new(entry);

                                    output.AppendLine(
                                        $"FILE\t{entry}\tSizeBytes={fileInfo.Length}\t" +
                                        $"LastWriteUtc={fileInfo.LastWriteTimeUtc:O}");
                                }
                                catch (UnauthorizedAccessException)
                                {
                                    output.AppendLine(
                                        $"FILE\t{entry}\tSizeBytes=Unknown\tLastWriteUtc=Unknown");
                                }
                                catch (IOException)
                                {
                                    output.AppendLine(
                                        $"FILE\t{entry}\tSizeBytes=Unknown\tLastWriteUtc=Unknown");
                                }
                            }

                            matches++;
                            if (matches >= maxMatches)
                            {
                                truncated = true;
                                break;
                            }
                        }

                        if (isDirectory && depth < maxDepth)
                            queue.Enqueue((entry, depth + 1));
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        string resolution = matches == 1 && !truncated && unreadable == 0
            ? "Unique"
            : matches == 0 && !truncated && unreadable == 0
                ? "NotFound"
                : matches > 1 ? "Ambiguous" : "Incomplete";
        string rootSummary = roots.Length == 1
            ? roots[0]
            : string.Join(", ", roots);

        return Task.FromResult(new NIRACapabilityHandlerResult
        {
            Summary = $"LocationSearch={resolution} | Scope={(userContentScope ? "CurrentUserContent" : "RootOrWholePc")} | " +
                $"MatchMode={(containsName ? "Contains" : "Exact")} | Roots='{rootSummary}' | Name='{name}' | " +
                $"Kind={kind} | Matches={matches} | Examined={examined} | " +
                $"UnreadableDirectories={unreadable} | Truncated={truncated} | " +
                $"TruncatedRoots={truncatedRoots.Count} | MaxEntriesPerRoot={maxEntries} | " +
                $"MaxDepth={maxDepth}. Results are path observations, not authorization or proof of content.",
            Output =
                (matches > 0
                    ? (containsName ? "MatchEvidence=BoundedFilenameContainsObservation\n" : "MatchEvidence=ExactNamePathObservation\n") +
                      "FileMetadataIncluded=True\n"
                    : string.Empty) +
                output.ToString().TrimEnd(),
            ChangedSystemState = false
        });
    }

    // Resolve the configured current-user Windows shell target; it is not
    // necessarily a folder that exists yet. This method NEVER substitutes an
    // unredirected profile shadow for a redirected Documents/OneDrive folder.
    // Callers doing observations must check existence independently.
    internal static string ResolveConfiguredCurrentUserFolder(string name)
    {
        string key = name.Trim().ToLowerInvariant();
        string? configured = null;
        if (OperatingSystem.IsWindows())
            configured = NIRAWindowsKnownFolderPath.GetConfiguredPath(key);

        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(configured))
            configured = key switch
            {
                "desktop" => Environment.GetFolderPath(Environment.SpecialFolder.DesktopDirectory),
                "documents" => Environment.GetFolderPath(Environment.SpecialFolder.MyDocuments),
                "pictures" => Environment.GetFolderPath(Environment.SpecialFolder.MyPictures),
                "music" => Environment.GetFolderPath(Environment.SpecialFolder.MyMusic),
                "videos" => Environment.GetFolderPath(Environment.SpecialFolder.MyVideos),
                "downloads" => ResolveCurrentUserDownloads(),
                _ => throw new ArgumentException("Unknown current-user known folder name.")
            };
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(configured) || !Path.IsPathFullyQualified(configured))
            throw new DirectoryNotFoundException(
                $"WindowsKnownFolderUnconfigured | Folder={name} | " +
                "Windows did not expose an absolute per-user folder location. " +
                "No replacement folder was guessed.");
        return Path.GetFullPath(configured);
    }

    // Location discovery describes EXISTING folders only. Missing-but-configured
    // roots are a different fact and must not be presented as found directories.
    internal static string ResolveCurrentUserFolder(string name)
    {
        string configured = ResolveConfiguredCurrentUserFolder(name);
        if (!Directory.Exists(configured))
            throw new DirectoryNotFoundException(
                $"WindowsKnownFolderConfiguredButMissing | Folder={name} | " +
                $"ConfiguredPath='{configured}' | Create that exact directory " +
                "through an authorized filesystem.directory.create operation, " +
                "or ask the user to repair Windows' folder configuration. " +
                "Do not repeat filesystem.locate or guess a shadow directory.");
        return configured;
    }

    private static string? ResolveCurrentUserDownloads()
    {
        // Windows redirects Downloads through the per-user Shell Folders value.
        // Use the value only when present, not a guessed different user's path.
        if (OperatingSystem.IsWindows())
        {
            try
            {
                using Microsoft.Win32.RegistryKey? key =
                    Microsoft.Win32.Registry.CurrentUser.OpenSubKey(
                        @"Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Explorer\User Shell Folders");
                string? configured = key?.GetValue(
                    "{374DE290-123F-4565-9164-39C4925E467B}") as string;
                if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(configured))
                    return Environment.ExpandEnvironmentVariables(configured);
            }
            catch (System.Security.SecurityException) { }
            catch (UnauthorizedAccessException) { }
        }
        string profile = Environment.GetFolderPath(Environment.SpecialFolder.UserProfile);
        return string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(profile) ? null : Path.Combine(profile, "Downloads");
    }

    // Windows Known Folder resolution respects OneDrive/enterprise redirection.
    // Do not substitute C:\Users\Default, Public, or a guessed user name.
    // These are read-only search roots; the explicit absolute-root contract
    // remains unchanged.
    internal static string[] ResolveWholePcSearchRoots()
    {
        List<string> roots = new();
        void AddDirectory(string? candidate)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(candidate) ||
                !Path.IsPathFullyQualified(candidate) ||
                !Directory.Exists(candidate)) return;
            string resolved = Path.GetFullPath(candidate);
            if (!roots.Contains(resolved, StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                roots.Add(resolved);
        }

        AddDirectory(Environment.GetFolderPath(Environment.SpecialFolder.DesktopDirectory));
        // Some Windows setups redirect the user's Desktop through OneDrive.
        // The environment exposes the provider's actual configured root.
        foreach (string variable in new[] { "OneDrive", "OneDriveConsumer", "OneDriveCommercial" })
        {
            string? providerRoot = Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable(variable);
            if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(providerRoot))
                AddDirectory(Path.Combine(providerRoot, "Desktop"));
        }
        AddDirectory(Path.Combine(
            Environment.GetFolderPath(Environment.SpecialFolder.UserProfile), "Desktop"));

        foreach (DriveInfo drive in DriveInfo.GetDrives())
        {
            if (drive.IsReady && drive.DriveType == DriveType.Fixed)
                AddDirectory(drive.RootDirectory.FullName);
        }
        return roots.ToArray();
    }

    private static NIRACapabilityParameterDescriptor Parameter(
        string name, string type, bool required, string description) => new()
    {
        Name = name, Type = type, Required = required, Description = description
    };
}
```

## 152. `NIRAAgent\Capabilities\NIRAMathCalculationCapabilityHandler.cs`

**File:** `NIRAAgent\Capabilities\NIRAMathCalculationCapabilityHandler.cs`

```csharp
using System.Globalization;
using System.Text.Json;

namespace NIRAAgent.Capabilities;

// A pure, bounded decimal calculator. Expressions are parsed as arithmetic,
// NEVER executed as C#, JavaScript, PowerShell or dynamically compiled code.
// No problem-specific formulas, financial assumptions or saved-answer tables.
public sealed class NIRAMathCalculationCapabilityHandler : INIRACapabilityHandler
{
    public NIRACapabilityDescriptor Descriptor { get; } = new()
    {
        Id = NIRACapabilityIds.MathCalculate,
        Description = "Deterministically calculate arithmetic from an explicit expression. Supports decimal/scientific numbers, + - * / ^, parentheses, postfix percent (9% = 0.09), sqrt/abs/min/max/round, variables and optional ordered named steps. Use for multi-step mathematics, finance, rates and unit-converted arithmetic instead of mental computation. Integer exponents only; .NET decimal has approximately 28-29 significant digits. Read-only, no code execution, no external data. Always derive the expression and units from the user's actual problem; verify the expression represents the requested situation.",
        DefaultRisk = NIRACapabilityRisk.Observe,
        Parameters = new[]
        {
            new NIRACapabilityParameterDescriptor
            {
                Name = "expression", Type = "string", Required = true,
                Description = "Final arithmetic expression, e.g. (a+b)/c, or last named step. Use ^ for integer powers and 9% for 0.09. No variable assignment or programming code."
            },
            new NIRACapabilityParameterDescriptor
            {
                Name = "variables", Type = "object", Required = false,
                Description = "Optional variable-name to finite decimal-number mapping, e.g. {\"x\":12.5,\"y\":4}."
            },
            new NIRACapabilityParameterDescriptor
            {
                Name = "steps", Type = "array", Required = false,
                Description = "Optional ordered intermediate steps: [{\"name\":\"first\",\"expression\":\"...\"}]. Later steps and final expression can use prior step names WITHOUT displayed rounding. Maximum 16."
            },
            new NIRACapabilityParameterDescriptor
            {
                Name = "displayDecimals", Type = "integer", Required = false,
                Description = "Final-display decimal places (0..12, default 6); underlying step values are never rounded to this setting. For money often use 2."
            }
        }
    };

    public NIRACapabilityRisk ResolveRisk(NIRACapabilityRequest _) => NIRACapabilityRisk.Observe;

    public Task<NIRACapabilityHandlerResult> ExecuteAsync(
        NIRACapabilityRequest request, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        cancellationToken.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
        string expression = NIRACapabilityArguments.RequireString(request, "expression", 1500);
        int displayDecimals = NIRACapabilityArguments.GetInteger(request, "displayDecimals", 6, 0, 12);
        if (request.Arguments.ValueKind != JsonValueKind.Object)
            throw new InvalidOperationException("Math calculation arguments must be a JSON object.");

        var variables = new Dictionary<string, decimal>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
        if (request.Arguments.TryGetProperty("variables", out JsonElement variableElement) &&
            variableElement.ValueKind != JsonValueKind.Null)
        {
            if (variableElement.ValueKind != JsonValueKind.Object || variableElement.EnumerateObject().Count() > 24)
                throw new InvalidOperationException("variables must be an object with at most 24 numeric entries.");
            foreach (JsonProperty property in variableElement.EnumerateObject())
            {
                NIRADecimalExpressionEvaluator.ValidateName(property.Name);
                if (variables.ContainsKey(property.Name))
                    throw new InvalidOperationException("Duplicate variable name: " + property.Name);
                variables.Add(property.Name, ParseDecimal(property.Value));
            }
        }

        var results = new List<MathResult>();
        int budget = expression.Length;
        if (request.Arguments.TryGetProperty("steps", out JsonElement stepsElement) &&
            stepsElement.ValueKind != JsonValueKind.Null)
        {
            if (stepsElement.ValueKind != JsonValueKind.Array || stepsElement.GetArrayLength() > 16)
                throw new InvalidOperationException("steps must be an array of at most 16 named expressions.");
            foreach (JsonElement step in stepsElement.EnumerateArray())
            {
                cancellationToken.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
                if (step.ValueKind != JsonValueKind.Object ||
                    !step.TryGetProperty("name", out JsonElement nameValue) ||
                    !step.TryGetProperty("expression", out JsonElement formulaValue) ||
                    nameValue.ValueKind != JsonValueKind.String ||
                    formulaValue.ValueKind != JsonValueKind.String ||
                    step.EnumerateObject().Count() != 2)
                    throw new InvalidOperationException("Each step requires only name and expression strings.");
                string name = nameValue.GetString() ?? "";
                string formula = formulaValue.GetString() ?? "";
                NIRADecimalExpressionEvaluator.ValidateName(name);
                if (formula.Length is < 1 or > 1500 || variables.ContainsKey(name))
                    throw new InvalidOperationException("Empty/oversized step expression or duplicate step name: " + name);
                budget += formula.Length;
                if (budget > 8000)
                    throw new InvalidOperationException("Total expression length exceeds 8000 characters.");
                decimal value = NIRADecimalExpressionEvaluator.Calculate(formula, variables, cancellationToken);
                variables.Add(name, value);  // Full decimal value, NEVER the display-rounded value.
                results.Add(new MathResult(name, formula, FormatExact(value),
                    FormatDisplay(value, displayDecimals)));
            }
        }
        decimal finalValue = NIRADecimalExpressionEvaluator.Calculate(expression, variables, cancellationToken);
        var payload = new
        {
            engine = "bounded-decimal-expression-v1",
            numericSystem = ".NET decimal (~28-29 significant digits; divisions/square roots may round internally)",
            displayRounding = "AwayFromZero, at requested displayDecimals only; named steps retain unrounded decimal values",
            displayDecimals,
            steps = results,
            final = new MathResult("result", expression, FormatExact(finalValue),
                FormatDisplay(finalValue, displayDecimals)),
            units = "Not inferred by calculator; apply user-grounded units in the answer",
            externalStateAccess = false
        };
        return Task.FromResult(new NIRACapabilityHandlerResult
        {
            Summary = $"Calculated {results.Count} intermediate step(s). Final = {FormatDisplay(finalValue, displayDecimals)}; unrounded decimal value = {FormatExact(finalValue)}. Read-only calculator; units not inferred.",
            Output = JsonSerializer.Serialize(payload, new JsonSerializerOptions
            { PropertyNamingPolicy = JsonNamingPolicy.CamelCase }),
            ChangedSystemState = false
        });
    }

    private static decimal ParseDecimal(JsonElement element)
    {
        string input = element.ValueKind switch
        {
            JsonValueKind.Number => element.GetRawText(),
            JsonValueKind.String => element.GetString() ?? "",
            _ => throw new InvalidOperationException("Variable values must be decimal numbers or numeric strings.")
        };
        return NIRADecimalExpressionEvaluator.ParseFiniteDecimal(input);
    }

    private static string FormatExact(decimal value) =>
        value.ToString("G29", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);

    private static string FormatDisplay(decimal value, int places) =>
        decimal.Round(value, places, MidpointRounding.AwayFromZero)
            .ToString("F" + places.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture), CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);

    private sealed record MathResult(string Name, string Expression, string Value, string DisplayValue);
}

// Explicit arithmetic grammar (no reflection, scripting, network, file I/O,
// unbounded loops or user-defined functions). The value of a named step is
// carried forward WITHOUT formatting/rounding and is not hardcoded to a test.
public static class NIRADecimalExpressionEvaluator
{
    public static decimal Calculate(string expression,
        IReadOnlyDictionary<string, decimal>? variables = null,
        CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(expression) || expression.Length > 1500)
            throw new InvalidOperationException("Expression must contain 1..1500 characters.");
        try
        {
            var parser = new Parser(expression, variables, cancellationToken);
            return parser.Evaluate();
        }
        catch (DivideByZeroException)
        {
            throw new InvalidOperationException("Division by zero in calculation.");
        }
        catch (OverflowException)
        {
            throw new InvalidOperationException("Calculation exceeds .NET decimal's finite numeric range.");
        }
    }

    internal static decimal ParseFiniteDecimal(string input)
    {
        if (!decimal.TryParse(input, NumberStyles.Float, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture,
                out decimal value))
            throw new InvalidOperationException("Invalid or out-of-range decimal number.");
        int exponent = input.IndexOfAny(new[] { 'e', 'E' });
        string significand = exponent < 0 ? input : input[..exponent];
        if (value == 0m && significand.Any(ch => ch is >= '1' and <= '9'))
            throw new InvalidOperationException("Nonzero number is smaller than .NET decimal's minimum precision; cannot silently underflow to zero.");
        return value;
    }

    public static void ValidateName(string name)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(name) || name.Length > 40 ||
            !(name[0] is >= 'A' and <= 'Z' or >= 'a' and <= 'z' or '_') ||
            name.Any(ch => !(ch is >= 'A' and <= 'Z' or >= 'a' and <= 'z' or >= '0' and <= '9' or '_')))
            throw new InvalidOperationException("Variable names must be 1..40 ASCII letters/digits/underscores, starting with a letter or underscore.");
    }

    private sealed class Parser
    {
        private readonly string _source;
        private readonly IReadOnlyDictionary<string, decimal> _variables;
        private readonly CancellationToken _token;
        private int _index;
        private int _operations;
        private int _depth;

        public Parser(string source, IReadOnlyDictionary<string, decimal>? variables, CancellationToken token)
        {
            _source = source;
            _variables = variables ?? new Dictionary<string, decimal>();
            _token = token;
        }

        public decimal Evaluate()
        {
            decimal result = Sum();
            SkipWhitespace();
            if (_index != _source.Length)
                throw Error("Unexpected token");
            return result;
        }

        private decimal Sum()
        {
            Enter();
            try
            {
                decimal result = Product();
                while (true)
                {
                    if (Eat('+')) result = checked(result + Product());
                    else if (Eat('-')) result = checked(result - Product());
                    else return result;
                }
            }
            finally { _depth--; }
        }

        private decimal Product()
        {
            Enter();
            try
            {
                decimal result = Unary();
                while (true)
                {
                    if (Eat('*')) result = Multiply(result, Unary());
                    else if (Eat('/')) result = Divide(result, Unary());
                    else return result;
                }
            }
            finally { _depth--; }
        }

        private decimal Unary()
        {
            Enter();
            try
            {
                if (Eat('+')) return Unary();
                if (Eat('-')) return checked(-Unary());
                return Power();
            }
            finally { _depth--; }
        }

        private decimal Power()
        {
            Enter();
            try
            {
                decimal b = Postfix();
                // Right-associative: 2^3^2 = 2^(3^2); unary binds looser than ^.
                if (Eat('^')) b = IntegerPower(b, Unary());
                return b;
            }
            finally { _depth--; }
        }

        private decimal Postfix()
        {
            Enter();
            try
            {
                decimal number = Primary();
                while (Eat('%')) number = Divide(number, 100m);
                return number;
            }
            finally { _depth--; }
        }

        private decimal Primary()
        {
            Enter();
            try
            {
                if (Eat('('))
                {
                    decimal groupedValue = Sum();
                    if (!Eat(')')) throw Error("Expected closing parenthesis");
                    return groupedValue;
                }
                SkipWhitespace();
                if (_index < _source.Length &&
                    (char.IsAsciiDigit(_source[_index]) || _source[_index] == '.'))
                    return ParseNumber();

                string name = ParseName();
                if (name.Length == 0) throw Error("Expected a number, variable or function");
                if (Eat('('))
                {
                    var args = new List<decimal>();
                    if (!Eat(')'))
                    {
                        while (true)
                        {
                            if (args.Count == 16) throw Error("Too many function arguments");
                            args.Add(Sum());
                            if (Eat(')')) break;
                            if (!Eat(',')) throw Error("Expected comma between function arguments");
                        }
                    }
                    return Call(name, args);
                }
                if (_variables.TryGetValue(name, out decimal value)) return value;
                // Defensively support externally supplied case-insensitive dictionaries too.
                foreach (KeyValuePair<string, decimal> variable in _variables)
                    if (string.Equals(variable.Key, name, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                        return variable.Value;
                throw Error("Unknown variable: " + name);
            }
            finally { _depth--; }
        }

        private decimal ParseNumber()
        {
            int start = _index;
            bool digits = false;
            while (_index < _source.Length && char.IsAsciiDigit(_source[_index])) { _index++; digits = true; }
            if (_index < _source.Length && _source[_index] == '.')
            {
                _index++;
                while (_index < _source.Length && char.IsAsciiDigit(_source[_index])) { _index++; digits = true; }
            }
            if (!digits) throw Error("Decimal point must have a digit");
            if (_index < _source.Length && _source[_index] is 'e' or 'E')
            {
                _index++;
                if (_index < _source.Length && _source[_index] is '+' or '-') _index++;
                int exponentStart = _index;
                while (_index < _source.Length && char.IsAsciiDigit(_source[_index])) _index++;
                if (_index == exponentStart) throw Error("Invalid scientific-notation exponent");
            }
            return ParseFiniteDecimal(_source[start.._index]);
        }

        private string ParseName()
        {
            SkipWhitespace();
            int start = _index;
            if (_index < _source.Length &&
                (_source[_index] is >= 'a' and <= 'z' or >= 'A' and <= 'Z' or '_'))
            {
                _index++;
                while (_index < _source.Length &&
                    (_source[_index] is >= 'a' and <= 'z' or >= 'A' and <= 'Z' or >= '0' and <= '9' or '_'))
                    _index++;
            }
            return _source[start.._index];
        }

        private decimal Call(string name, IReadOnlyList<decimal> args)
        {
            string id = name.ToLowerInvariant();
            switch (id)
            {
                case "abs" when args.Count == 1: return Math.Abs(args[0]);
                case "sqrt" when args.Count == 1: return Sqrt(args[0]);
                case "min" when args.Count >= 2: return args.Min();
                case "max" when args.Count >= 2: return args.Max();
                case "round" when args.Count is 1 or 2:
                    int places = args.Count == 1 ? 0 : WholeInteger(args[1], 0, 12, "round places");
                    return decimal.Round(args[0], places, MidpointRounding.AwayFromZero);
                default:
                    throw Error("Unsupported function or argument count: " + name);
            }
        }

        private static decimal Sqrt(decimal number)
        {
            if (number < 0m) throw new InvalidOperationException("Square root requires a nonnegative operand.");
            if (number == 0m) return 0m;
            decimal guess = (decimal)Math.Sqrt((double)number);
            for (int i = 0; i < 48; i++)
            {
                decimal next = (guess + number / guess) / 2m;
                if (next == guess) break;
                guess = next;
            }
            return guess;
        }

        private static decimal IntegerPower(decimal basis, decimal exponent)
        {
            int n = WholeInteger(exponent, -64, 64, "Exponent");
            if (basis == 0m && n < 0)
                throw new InvalidOperationException("Zero cannot be raised to a negative power.");
            decimal result = 1m;
            decimal factor = basis;
            int remaining = Math.Abs(n);
            while (remaining > 0)
            {
                if ((remaining & 1) != 0) result = Multiply(result, factor);
                remaining /= 2;
                if (remaining > 0) factor = Multiply(factor, factor);
            }
            return n < 0 ? Divide(1m, result) : result;
        }

        private static decimal Multiply(decimal left, decimal right)
        {
            decimal result = checked(left * right);
            if (left != 0m && right != 0m && result == 0m)
                throw new InvalidOperationException("Nonzero decimal multiplication underflowed the supported precision.");
            return result;
        }

        private static decimal Divide(decimal numerator, decimal denominator)
        {
            decimal result = numerator / denominator;
            if (numerator != 0m && result == 0m)
                throw new InvalidOperationException("Nonzero decimal division underflowed the supported precision.");
            return result;
        }

        private static int WholeInteger(decimal value, int minimum, int maximum, string label)
        {
            if (value != decimal.Truncate(value) || value < minimum || value > maximum)
                throw new InvalidOperationException($"{label} must be a whole number from {minimum} to {maximum}.");
            return (int)value;
        }

        private bool Eat(char symbol)
        {
            SkipWhitespace();
            if (_index >= _source.Length || _source[_index] != symbol) return false;
            _index++;
            return true;
        }

        private void SkipWhitespace()
        {
            while (_index < _source.Length && char.IsWhiteSpace(_source[_index])) _index++;
        }

        private void Enter()
        {
            _token.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
            if (++_operations > 512 || ++_depth > 64)
                throw new InvalidOperationException("Expression complexity exceeds the safe evaluation limit.");
        }

        private InvalidOperationException Error(string message) =>
            new($"{message} (near character {_index + 1}).");
    }
}
```

```csharp
/*
 * filename: NIRAStage9CapabilityAuthorizer.cs
 */

namespace NIRAAgent.Capabilities;

public sealed class NIRAStage9CapabilityAuthorizer
    : INIRACapabilityAuthorizer
{
    public Task<NIRACapabilityAuthorizationDecision> AuthorizeAsync(
        NIRACapabilityDescriptor descriptor,
        NIRACapabilityRisk risk,
        NIRACapabilityRequest request,
        CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        cancellationToken.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();


        if (risk ==
            NIRACapabilityRisk.Observe)
        {
            return Task.FromResult(
                NIRACapabilityAuthorizationDecision.Allow(
                    "Read-only observation capability is enabled by the Stage 9 baseline authority boundary."));
        }


        return Task.FromResult(
            NIRACapabilityAuthorizationDecision.RequireAuthorization(
                "This capability can change or execute state. Persistent scoped authorization is intentionally deferred to Stage 10."));
    }
}
```

```csharp
using System.Globalization;
using System.Text.Json;

namespace NIRAAgent.Capabilities;

// General-purpose temporal relation. Neither the capability nor its policy
// knows about lectures, meetings, appointments, markets, or any domain entity.
// The caller provides full dated local instants grounded in prior evidence;
// this runtime alone computes their relationship to the CURRENT OS clock.
public sealed class NIRATemporalRelationCapabilityHandler : INIRACapabilityHandler
{
    public NIRACapabilityDescriptor Descriptor { get; } = new()
    {
        Id = NIRACapabilityIds.TemporalRelate,
        Description = "Compare an evidence-grounded dated start and optional end against the current authoritative clock. Uses complete local ISO dates/times and the specified or OS timezone. Returns Upcoming, Active, Ended, or Started (end unknown); does NOT prove a website or meeting is still open. Use when temporal status materially affects the user's answer.",
        DefaultRisk = NIRACapabilityRisk.Observe,
        Parameters = new[]
        {
            new NIRACapabilityParameterDescriptor { Name = "startLocal", Type = "string", Required = true,
                Description = "Source-grounded date and time yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm or yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss. No guessed dates." },
            new NIRACapabilityParameterDescriptor { Name = "endLocal", Type = "string", Required = false,
                Description = "Source-grounded local end date/time. Leave absent when unknown; a past start alone does NOT prove an event ended." },
            new NIRACapabilityParameterDescriptor { Name = "timeZoneId", Type = "string", Required = false,
                Description = "IANA or Windows time-zone ID when source specifies one; otherwise OS local zone." }
        }
    };

    public NIRACapabilityRisk ResolveRisk(NIRACapabilityRequest request) =>
        NIRACapabilityRisk.Observe;

    public Task<NIRACapabilityHandlerResult> ExecuteAsync(
        NIRACapabilityRequest request,
        CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        cancellationToken.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
        string startText = NIRACapabilityArguments.RequireString(request, "startLocal", 64);
        string? endText = NIRACapabilityArguments.GetOptionalString(request, "endLocal", 64);
        string? zoneId = NIRACapabilityArguments.GetOptionalString(request, "timeZoneId", 150);
        TimeZoneInfo zone = string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(zoneId)
            ? TimeZoneInfo.Local
            : TimeZoneInfo.FindSystemTimeZoneById(zoneId);

        DateTimeOffset start = Resolve(startText, zone);
        DateTimeOffset? end = string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(endText)
            ? null : Resolve(endText, zone);
        if (end.HasValue && end.Value <= start)
            throw new InvalidOperationException(
                "End must be strictly later than start. Provide full calendar dates for overnight/cross-day ranges.");

        DateTimeOffset now = DateTimeOffset.UtcNow;
        string relation = now < start.ToUniversalTime() ? "Upcoming"
            : end.HasValue && now >= end.Value.ToUniversalTime() ? "Ended"
            : end.HasValue ? "Active" : "StartedEndUnknown";
        var evidence = new
        {
            comparison = "Deterministic clock comparison; source dates must be independently grounded",
            nowUtc = now.ToString("O"),
            nowLocal = TimeZoneInfo.ConvertTime(now, zone).ToString("O"),
            timeZoneId = zone.Id,
            startLocal = start.ToString("O"),
            endLocal = end?.ToString("O"),
            relation,
            liveServiceStatusVerified = false
        };
        return Task.FromResult(new NIRACapabilityHandlerResult
        {
            Summary = $"Temporal relation: {relation} as of {now:O} (scheduled times, not live-service status).",
            Output = JsonSerializer.Serialize(evidence),
            ChangedSystemState = false
        });
    }

    private static DateTimeOffset Resolve(string value, TimeZoneInfo zone)
    {
        string[] formats = ["yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm", "yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss"];
        if (!DateTime.TryParseExact(value, formats, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture,
                DateTimeStyles.None, out DateTime local))
            throw new InvalidOperationException(
                "A full source-grounded local date/time is required (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm[:ss]). Do not infer a missing calendar date.");
        local = DateTime.SpecifyKind(local, DateTimeKind.Unspecified);
        if (zone.IsInvalidTime(local) || zone.IsAmbiguousTime(local))
            throw new InvalidOperationException(
                "The provided local instant is missing or ambiguous under this timezone; obtain an unambiguous source time.");
        return new DateTimeOffset(local, zone.GetUtcOffset(local));
    }
}
```
