## 274. `NIRAAgent\Presentation\NIRADualChannelResponse.cs`

**File:** `NIRAAgent\Presentation\NIRADualChannelResponse.cs`

```csharp
using System.Text.RegularExpressions;
using System.Text.Json;
using NIRAAgent.Capabilities;

namespace NIRAAgent.Presentation;

// One authoritative cognition decision can contain separate spoken words and
// declarative screen blocks. The WPF app, not the model, owns the rendering.
public sealed record NIRARichBlock
{
    public string Type { get; init; } = string.Empty; // heading, text, hero, insight, source, card, metric, equation, table, chart, code, details, list, quote, timeline, checklist, progress
    public string Title { get; init; } = string.Empty;
    public string Text { get; init; } = string.Empty;
    public string Unit { get; init; } = string.Empty;
    public string Language { get; init; } = string.Empty;
    public IReadOnlyList<string> Items { get; init; } = Array.Empty<string>();
    // Tabs: parallel, model-authored labels/content; UI never executes supplied text.
    public IReadOnlyList<string> Panels { get; init; } = Array.Empty<string>();
    public double? ProgressValue { get; init; }
    public double? ProgressMaximum { get; init; }
    public IReadOnlyList<string> Columns { get; init; } = Array.Empty<string>();
    public IReadOnlyList<IReadOnlyList<string>> Rows { get; init; } = Array.Empty<IReadOnlyList<string>>();
    public IReadOnlyList<string> Labels { get; init; } = Array.Empty<string>();
    public IReadOnlyList<double> Values { get; init; } = Array.Empty<double>();
}

public sealed record NIRAPresentationSnapshot(string Speech, IReadOnlyList<NIRARichBlock> Blocks);

// UI-only per-message state. It is not a goal, user utterance, or action authorization.
public sealed record NIRARichInteractionState
{
    public bool Expanded { get; init; }
    public int SelectedIndex { get; init; } = -1;
    public IReadOnlyList<int> CheckedIndices { get; init; } = Array.Empty<int>();
}

public static class NIRAPresentationPolicy
{
    public const int MaxBlocks = 8;
    private static string Clip(string? s, int n)
    {
        string value = (s ?? string.Empty).Trim();
        return value.Length > n ? value[..n] : value;
    }

    public static IReadOnlyList<NIRARichBlock> Normalize(IReadOnlyList<NIRARichBlock>? blocks)
    {
        if (blocks is null || blocks.Count == 0) return Array.Empty<NIRARichBlock>();
        var accepted = new List<NIRARichBlock>();
        foreach (var input in blocks.Take(MaxBlocks))
        {
            if (input is null) continue;
            string type = (input.Type ?? string.Empty).Trim().ToLowerInvariant();
            if (type is not ("heading" or "text" or "hero" or "insight" or "source" or "video" or "card" or "metric" or "equation" or "table" or "chart" or "code" or "details" or "list" or "quote" or "timeline" or "checklist" or "progress" or "tabs" or "followups" or "file")) continue;
            var items = (input.Items ?? Array.Empty<string>()).Take(24).Select(x => Clip(x, type == "file" ? 32760 : 450)).Where(x => x.Length > 0).ToArray();
            var panels = (input.Panels ?? Array.Empty<string>()).Take(5).Select(x => Clip(x, 3000)).ToArray();
            var cols = (input.Columns ?? Array.Empty<string>()).Take(8).Select(c => Clip(c, 75)).ToArray();
            var rows = (input.Rows ?? Array.Empty<IReadOnlyList<string>>())
                .Take(40).Where(row => row != null)
                .Select(row => (IReadOnlyList<string>)row.Take(cols.Length).Select(x => Clip(x, 240)).ToArray())
                .Where(row => row.Count == cols.Length).ToArray();
            var labels = (input.Labels ?? Array.Empty<string>()).Take(40).Select(x => Clip(x, 85)).ToArray();
            var values = (input.Values ?? Array.Empty<double>()).Take(40).ToArray();
            if ((type is "list" or "timeline" or "checklist" or "followups") && items.Length == 0) continue;
            if (type == "tabs" && (items.Length < 2 || items.Length > 5 ||
                panels.Length != items.Length || panels.Any(string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace))) continue;
            if (type == "progress" && (input.ProgressValue is not double progress ||
                input.ProgressMaximum is not double maximum || !double.IsFinite(progress) ||
                !double.IsFinite(maximum) || maximum <= 0 || progress < 0 || progress > maximum)) continue;
            if ((type is "details" or "quote" or "equation") && string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(input.Text)) continue;
            if (type == "table" && (cols.Length == 0 || rows.Length == 0)) continue;
            if (type == "chart" && (labels.Length < 2 || labels.Length != values.Length || values.Any(v => !double.IsFinite(v)))) continue;
            string title = Clip(input.Title, 160), text = Clip(input.Text, type == "code" ? 7000 : type == "details" ? 4000 : type == "file" ? 32760 : 1600);
            if ((type is "heading" or "text" or "hero" or "insight" or "source" or "video" or "card" or "code" or "details" or "quote") && title.Length == 0 && text.Length == 0) continue;
            if ((type is "source" or "video") && !System.Text.RegularExpressions.Regex.IsMatch(text,
                @"https?://[^\s<>]+", System.Text.RegularExpressions.RegexOptions.IgnoreCase)) continue;
            // The UI never fetches these links. Still exclude loopback/internal URLs
            // from the dedicated external video preview surface.
            if (type == "video" && !NIRAWebSearchParsing.SafeSourceUrl(text)) continue;
            if (type == "metric" && (title.Length == 0 || text.Length == 0)) continue;
            if (type == "file" && (title.Length == 0 || text.Length == 0)) continue;
            if (type == "followups" && items.Length > 6) items = items.Take(6).ToArray();
            if (type == "progress" && title.Length == 0) continue;
            accepted.Add(input with { Type=type, Title=title, Text=text, Unit=Clip(input.Unit, 24),
                Language=Clip(input.Language, 25), Items=items, Panels=panels, Columns=cols, Rows=rows, Labels=labels, Values=values });
        }
        return accepted;
    }
    // A model may return a fenced code example in reply rather than in the
    // optional typed blocks. Render it locally instead of displaying backticks
    // or reading syntax aloud. This is presentation parsing, not a second LLM.
    public static (string Screen, string Speech, IReadOnlyList<NIRARichBlock> Blocks)
        RecoverCode(string screen, string speech, IReadOnlyList<NIRARichBlock>? blocks)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(screen) ||
            !screen.Contains("```", StringComparison.Ordinal))
            return (screen, speech, blocks ?? Array.Empty<NIRARichBlock>());
        if (blocks is { Count: > 0 } && blocks.Any(b => b.Type == "code"))
        {
            // The typed code block already owns the code. Suppress any duplicate
            // fenced source in reply/speech rather than rendering or saying it twice.
            string cleanScreen = Regex.Replace(screen, @"```[\s\S]*?```", " ").Trim();
            string cleanSpeech = Regex.Replace(speech, @"```[\s\S]*?```", " ").Trim();
            return (cleanScreen, cleanSpeech, blocks);
        }

        var matches = Regex.Matches(screen,
            @"```(?<language>[a-zA-Z0-9+#-]*)[ \t]*\r?\n(?<code>[\s\S]*?)\r?\n?```",
            RegexOptions.CultureInvariant);
        if (matches.Count == 0) return (screen, speech, blocks ?? Array.Empty<NIRARichBlock>());

        var visible = new List<NIRARichBlock>();
        int position = 0;
        string intro = StripInlineMarkdown(screen[..matches[0].Index].Trim());
        foreach (Match match in matches.Cast<Match>().Take(3))
        {
            string before = screen[position..match.Index].Trim();
            if (position > 0 && before.Length > 0)
                visible.Add(new NIRARichBlock { Type = "text", Text = StripInlineMarkdown(before) });
            visible.Add(new NIRARichBlock { Type = "code", Language = match.Groups["language"].Value,
                Text = match.Groups["code"].Value.Trim() });
            position = match.Index + match.Length;
        }
        string after = screen[position..].Trim();
        if (after.Length > 0)
            visible.Add(new NIRARichBlock { Type = "text", Text = StripInlineMarkdown(after) });
        string narration = speech;
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(narration) || narration == screen)
        {
            // The explanatory prose is still useful, but spoken code is not.
            narration = Regex.Replace(screen, @"```[\s\S]*?```", " ");
            narration = StripInlineMarkdown(narration).Trim();
            if (narration.Length > 420)
            {
                int sentence = narration.LastIndexOf('.', 419);
                narration = (sentence > 90 ? narration[..(sentence + 1)] : narration[..420]).Trim();
            }
        }
        var combined = blocks is { Count: > 0 }
            ? blocks.Concat(visible).ToArray()
            : visible.ToArray();
        return (intro.Length == 0 ? "Code example:" : intro, narration, Normalize(combined));
    }

    // Repair only genuinely under-informative narration when the requested
    // visuals contain enough grounded data to explain themselves. This is a
    // fast local fallback; it does not invent facts or run a second model call.
    // Substantive model-authored speech retains NIRA's own character/wording.
    public static string EnsureInformativeSpeech(
        string speech, IReadOnlyList<NIRARichBlock>? blocks)
    {
        if (blocks is null || blocks.Count == 0 ||
            Regex.Matches(speech ?? string.Empty, @"\b[\p{L}\p{N}]+\b").Count >= 19)
            return speech;

        var progress = blocks.FirstOrDefault(b => b.Type == "progress" &&
            b.ProgressValue is not null && b.ProgressMaximum is > 0);
        if (progress != null)
        {
            double done = progress.ProgressValue!.Value;
            double total = progress.ProgressMaximum!.Value;
            double rest = total - done;
            double percentage = done / total * 100;
            string unit = progress.Unit.Length == 0 ? "items" : progress.Unit;
            return $"You've completed {done:0.##} of {total:0.##} {unit}, " +
                $"so you're about {percentage:0.#} percent of the way through. " +
                $"That leaves {rest:0.##} {unit} to go.";
        }

        var timeline = blocks.FirstOrDefault(b => b.Type == "timeline" && b.Items.Count > 0);
        if (timeline != null)
        {
            var milestones = timeline.Items.Take(4)
                .Select(x => Regex.Replace(x, @"\s*[—–]\s*", ", ").Trim())
                .Select(x => x.TrimEnd('.', ';'))
                .Where(x => x.Length > 0).ToArray();
            if (milestones.Length > 0)
            {
                string ordered = milestones.Length == 1 ? milestones[0] :
                    string.Join("; ", milestones[..^1]) + "; and " + milestones[^1];
                string extra = timeline.Items.Count > 4 ?
                    " The remaining steps are on screen." : "";
                bool checklist = blocks.Any(b => b.Type == "checklist");
                return "The plan goes in this order: " + ordered + "." + extra +
                    (checklist ? " I've also put the tasks into a checklist so you can mark each one as you finish." : "");
            }
        }
        return speech;
    }

    private static string StripInlineMarkdown(string text)
        => text.Replace("**", "", StringComparison.Ordinal)
            .Replace("`", "", StringComparison.Ordinal);

    // Fallback only: when cognition omits speech, never send literal Markdown
    // punctuation to TTS. Model-authored speech stays fully authoritative.
    public static string PlainSpeechFallback(string screen)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(screen)) return string.Empty;
        string text = Regex.Replace(screen, @"```[\s\S]*?```", " a code example ");
        text = Regex.Replace(text, @"(?m)^\s{0,3}#{1,6}\s+", string.Empty);
        text = Regex.Replace(text, @"(?m)^\s{0,3}(?:[-*+]\s+|\d{1,3}[.)]\s+)", string.Empty);
        text = Regex.Replace(text, @"\*\*(.*?)\*\*", "$1");
        text = Regex.Replace(text, @"(?<!\*)\*([^*\n]+)\*(?!\*)", "$1");
        text = text.Replace("`", string.Empty, StringComparison.Ordinal);
        text = Regex.Replace(text, @"(?m)^\s*---+\s*$", string.Empty);
        return Regex.Replace(text, @"\s+", " ").Trim();
    }

    // A factual review must see the SAME screen data as the user. A short reply
    // plus a real table is not a missing answer. This is descriptive evidence for
    // the reviewer only and cannot authorize tools or change trusted results.
    public static string ForObjectiveReview(string screen, IReadOnlyList<NIRARichBlock>? blocks)
    {
        var visible = Normalize(blocks);
        if (visible.Count == 0) return screen ?? string.Empty;
        string serialized = JsonSerializer.Serialize(visible);
        if (serialized.Length > 9500)
            serialized = serialized[..9500] + " [VISIBLE BLOCK DATA TRUNCATED FOR REVIEW]";
        return (screen ?? string.Empty) +
            "\n\nADDITIONAL ON-SCREEN STRUCTURED CONTENT (visible to user; not execution evidence):\n" +
            serialized;
    }

    public static string Serialize(NIRAPresentationSnapshot snapshot) => JsonSerializer.Serialize(snapshot);
    public static NIRAPresentationSnapshot? Deserialize(string? json)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(json)) return null;
        try
        {
            var v = JsonSerializer.Deserialize<NIRAPresentationSnapshot>(json);
            return v is null ? null : v with { Blocks = Normalize(v.Blocks) };
        }
        catch (JsonException) { return null; }
    }
}
```

**File:** `NIRAAgent\Presentation\NIRAMathMarkup.cs`

```csharp
using System.Text;
using System.Text.RegularExpressions;

namespace NIRAAgent.Presentation;

/// <summary>
/// Presentation-only conversion of common model-authored TeX math delimiters
/// into readable Unicode/plain-text expressions. Never evaluates expressions,
/// and never interprets XAML/HTML or other executable markup.
/// The original numeric characters and values are preserved.
/// </summary>
public static class NIRAMathMarkup
{
    private static readonly Regex MathSpan = new(
        @"(?<!\\)\$\$(?<block>[\s\S]{1,500}?)\$\$|\\\[(?<square>[\s\S]{1,500}?)\\\]|\\\((?<round>[\s\S]{1,350}?)\\\)|(?<![\\$])\$(?<dollar>[^$\r\n]{1,350})\$(?!\$)",
        RegexOptions.Compiled | RegexOptions.CultureInvariant);

    private static readonly (string Code, string Symbol)[] Symbols =
    {
        (@"\times", "×"), (@"\cdot", "·"), (@"\div", "÷"),
        (@"\pm", "±"), (@"\approx", "≈"), (@"\neq", "≠"),
        (@"\leq", "≤"), (@"\geq", "≥"), (@"\le", "≤"),
        (@"\ge", "≥"), (@"\pi", "π"), (@"\infty", "∞"),
        (@"\%", "%"), (@"\,", " "), (@"\;", " "),
        (@"\quad", " "), (@"\qquad", " "),
        (@"\left", ""), (@"\right", "")
    };

    private static readonly string[] EscapedEquationCommands =
    [
        "operatorname", "mathrm", "text", "tfrac", "times", "theta", "tau",
        "frac", "neq", "nabla", "nu", "right", "rho", "beta", "binom"
    ];

    /// <summary>
    /// Repair ONLY recognized TeX command prefixes in typed equation data.
    /// Some LLMs emit a single backslash inside a JSON string. Valid JSON
    /// escapes such as \t, \f, \n, \r and \b then become control characters
    /// before the equation reaches the WPF renderer. The exact command must
    /// still be recognizable; ambiguous/unrelated text is never reconstructed.
    /// This is syntax recovery, not numerical inference or expression evaluation.
    /// </summary>
    public static string NormalizeEquationInput(string? source)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(source)) return source ?? string.Empty;
        if (source.Length > 12000) return source;
        // A TeX control word is recovered only if the remaining letters and
        // their terminator match a supported mathematical command.
        var output = new StringBuilder(source.Length + 16);
        for (int i = 0; i < source.Length; i++)
        {
            char current = source[i];
            // Double literal backslashes can come from extra JSON escaping.
            // Canonicalize only when followed by a supported TeX word.
            if (current == '\\' && i + 2 < source.Length && source[i + 1] == '\\')
            {
                int start = i + 2;
                int end = start;
                while (end < source.Length && char.IsLetter(source[end])) end++;
                if (IsEquationCommand(source[start..end]))
                {
                    output.Append('\\');
                    i++;
                    continue;
                }
            }
            if (current is not ('\t' or '\f' or '\n' or '\r' or '\b'))
            {
                output.Append(current);
                continue;
            }
            char escapedLetter = current switch
            {
                '\t' => 't', '\f' => 'f', '\n' => 'n',
                '\r' => 'r', '\b' => 'b', _ => '\0'
            };
            bool repaired = false;
            foreach (string command in EscapedEquationCommands)
            {
                if (command[0] != escapedLetter) continue;
                string suffix = command[1..];
                int after = i + 1 + suffix.Length;
                if (after > source.Length ||
                    !source.AsSpan(i + 1, suffix.Length).SequenceEqual(suffix.AsSpan()))
                    continue;
                // TeX commands are letter-delimited. Commands that take a
                // braced argument must visibly have one, not an inferred one.
                if (after < source.Length && char.IsLetter(source[after])) continue;
                if (command is "text" or "mathrm" or "operatorname" or "frac" or "tfrac" or "binom")
                    if (after >= source.Length || source[after] != '{') continue;
                output.Append('\\').Append(command);
                i = after - 1;
                repaired = true;
                break;
            }
            if (!repaired) output.Append(current);
        }
        return output.ToString();
    }

    private static bool IsEquationCommand(string command) => command is
        "text" or "mathrm" or "operatorname" or "binom" or "frac" or "dfrac" or
        "tfrac" or "sqrt" or "times" or "cdot" or "div" or "pm" or
        "approx" or "neq" or "le" or "leq" or "ge" or "geq" or
        "pi" or "infty" or "alpha" or "beta" or "gamma" or "theta" or
        "Delta" or "sum" or "rightarrow" or "left" or "right" or
        "quad" or "qquad" or "nabla" or "nu" or "rho" or "tau";

    private static readonly string[] DisplayEquationDelimiters =
        [@"\\[", @"\\]", @"\\(", @"\\)", @"\[", @"\]", @"\(", @"\)", "$$"];

    private static readonly string[] AlignedMathEnvironments =
        ["aligned", "align", "gathered", "gather"];

    /// <summary>
    /// Split a typed display-equation field into independently rendered rows.
    /// Model output can contain several adjacent TeX display spans (or plain
    /// newline-separated expressions) inside ONE JSON displayBlock. The old WPF
    /// renderer removed only the outermost delimiters and printed internal
    /// \] / \[ tokens literally. This is a lexical, bounded display operation;
    /// it never evaluates, rewrites numbers, or infers mathematical answers.
    /// </summary>
    public static IReadOnlyList<string> SplitDisplayEquations(string? source)
    {
        string input = NormalizeEquationInput(source).Replace("\r\n", "\n", StringComparison.Ordinal)
            .Replace('\r', '\n');
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(input)) return Array.Empty<string>();

        var lines = new List<string>();
        var current = new StringBuilder();
        int braceDepth = 0;
        bool aligned = false;

        void Flush()
        {
            string line = current.ToString().Trim();
            current.Clear();
            // Single-dollar math delimiters apply only when they wrap the
            // entire expression, never to arbitrary currency signs ($12).
            if (line.Length > 2 && line[0] == '$' && line[^1] == '$' &&
                line.Count(c => c == '$') == 2)
                line = line[1..^1].Trim();
            if (line.Length > 0) lines.Add(line);
        }

        // Canonical and over-escaped forms of display delimiters are syntax,
        // not content. Match the longer alternatives first. A TeX \\ hard
        // break is handled separately and only at top level.
        for (int i = 0; i < input.Length;)
        {
            string? token = null;
            foreach (string marker in DisplayEquationDelimiters)
            {
                if (input.AsSpan(i).StartsWith(marker.AsSpan(), StringComparison.Ordinal))
                { token = marker; break; }
            }
            if (token != null)
            {
                Flush();
                i += token.Length;
                continue;
            }

            // Standard multi-line environments use the same row model.
            // Do not treat a matrix environment as an aligned list of rows.
            string? environmentToken = null;
            bool openEnvironment = false;
            foreach (string env in AlignedMathEnvironments)
            {
                string begin = @"\begin{" + env + "}";
                string end = @"\end{" + env + "}";
                if (input.AsSpan(i).StartsWith(begin.AsSpan(), StringComparison.Ordinal))
                { environmentToken = begin; openEnvironment = true; break; }
                if (input.AsSpan(i).StartsWith(end.AsSpan(), StringComparison.Ordinal))
                { environmentToken = end; break; }
            }
            if (environmentToken != null)
            {
                Flush();
                aligned = openEnvironment;
                i += environmentToken.Length;
                continue;
            }
            char ch = input[i];
            if (ch == '{') braceDepth++;
            else if (ch == '}' && braceDepth > 0) braceDepth--;

            if (braceDepth == 0 && ch == '\n')
            {
                Flush();
                i++;
                continue;
            }
            if (braceDepth == 0 && ch == '\\' && i + 1 < input.Length && input[i + 1] == '\\')
            {
                Flush();
                i += 2;
                continue;
            }
            // TeX & is an alignment marker, not a visible operator, in an
            // aligned environment; preserve literal & in text and formulas.
            if (aligned && braceDepth == 0 && ch == '&')
            { i++; continue; }
            current.Append(ch);
            i++;
        }
        Flush();
        return lines;
    }

    public static string ToReadableText(string? source)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(source)) return source ?? string.Empty;
        if (!source.Contains('$') && !source.Contains(@"\(") &&
            !source.Contains(@"\[")) return source;
        return MathSpan.Replace(source, match =>
        {
            string expr = match.Groups["block"].Success ? match.Groups["block"].Value :
                match.Groups["square"].Success ? match.Groups["square"].Value :
                match.Groups["round"].Success ? match.Groups["round"].Value :
                match.Groups["dollar"].Value;

            // Ordinary money ('$10 ... $20') is not an equation. Preserve it.
            bool hasMathSyntax = expr.IndexOfAny(new[] {'=', '+', '-', '*', '/', '^', '_', '\\', '{', '}'}) >= 0;
            if (match.Groups["dollar"].Success &&
                (!hasMathSyntax ||
                 // A pair of currency amounts can look like '$5 + $10'.
                 // Never eat the currency signs and present it as math.
                 (Regex.IsMatch(expr, @"^\s*\d", RegexOptions.CultureInvariant) &&
                  Regex.IsMatch(expr, @"(?:[+*/-]\s*|[A-Za-z]\s*)$", RegexOptions.CultureInvariant) &&
                  !expr.Contains('=') && !expr.Contains('^') && !expr.Contains('\\'))))
                return match.Value;
            if (!hasMathSyntax && expr.Trim().Length == 0) return match.Value;
            return ConvertExpression(expr);
        });
    }

    private static string ConvertExpression(string expr)
    {
        string text = expr.Trim();
        // Handle common nested fraction/root notation without regex nested-brace bugs.
        text = ReplaceBracedCommand(text, @"\frac", (a, b) => "(" + a + ") / (" + b + ")", 2);
        // The binomial coefficient is not a fraction. Use C(n, k) in
        // read-only/plain-text contexts where stacked notation is unavailable.
        text = ReplaceBracedCommand(text, @"\binom", (a, b) => "C(" + a + ", " + b + ")", 2);
        text = ReplaceBracedCommand(text, @"\sqrt", (a, _) => "√(" + a + ")", 1);
        text = ReplaceBracedCommand(text, @"\text", (a, _) => a, 1);
        text = ReplaceBracedCommand(text, @"\mathrm", (a, _) => a, 1);
        foreach (var (code, symbol) in Symbols)
            text = text.Replace(code, symbol, StringComparison.Ordinal);
        text = Regex.Replace(text, @"\^\{([^{}]+)\}", m => "^(" + m.Groups[1].Value + ")");
        text = Regex.Replace(text, @"_\{([^{}]+)\}", m => "_(" + m.Groups[1].Value + ")");
        text = Regex.Replace(text, @"\{([^{}]*)\}", "$1");
        text = Regex.Replace(text, @"\^\((?<one>\d)\)", m => "^" + m.Groups["one"].Value);
        text = Regex.Replace(text, @"\^\(2\)(?!\d)|\^2(?!\d)", "²");
        text = Regex.Replace(text, @"\^\(3\)(?!\d)|\^3(?!\d)", "³");
        return text.Trim();
    }

    private static string ReplaceBracedCommand(string text, string command,
        Func<string, string, string> format, int argumentCount)
    {
        // Bound each pass: model output can be malformed or intentionally odd.
        for (int pass = 0; pass < 16; pass++)
        {
            int index = text.IndexOf(command + "{", StringComparison.Ordinal);
            if (index < 0) break;
            int position = index + command.Length;
            if (!TryTakeBrace(text, ref position, out string first)) break;
            string second = string.Empty;
            if (argumentCount == 2 && !TryTakeBrace(text, ref position, out second)) break;
            string replacement = format(first, second);
            text = text[..index] + replacement + text[position..];
        }
        return text;
    }

    private static bool TryTakeBrace(string text, ref int position, out string content)
    {
        content = string.Empty;
        if (position >= text.Length || text[position] != '{') return false;
        int start = ++position, depth = 1;
        while (position < text.Length)
        {
            char ch = text[position++];
            if (ch == '{') depth++;
            else if (ch == '}' && --depth == 0)
            {
                content = text[start..(position - 1)];
                return true;
            }
        }
        return false;
    }
}

```csharp
using System.Text.RegularExpressions;

namespace NIRAAgent.Presentation;

// Pure presentation parsing: this is NOT an assertion that a model-supplied URL
// was researched or verified. Navigation happens only after a real user click.
public sealed record NIRAResourceLinkPresentation(string Label, string Address, string Host, string Kind);

public static class NIRAResourceLinkPolicy
{
    private static readonly Regex Standalone = new(
        @"^\s*(?:(?:[-*+]|\d{1,3}[.)])\s+)?(?:(?<kind>Source|Sources|Reference|References|Read more|Further reading)\s*:\s*)?\[(?<label>[^\]\r\n]{1,120})\]\((?<url>https?://[^\s<>]{1,1900})\)\s*$",
        RegexOptions.CultureInvariant | RegexOptions.IgnoreCase | RegexOptions.Compiled);

    public static bool TryParse(string? line, out NIRAResourceLinkPresentation? result)
    {
        result = null;
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(line) || line.Length > 2200) return false;
        Match match = Standalone.Match(line);
        if (!match.Success) return false;
        string label = match.Groups["label"].Value.Trim();
        string address = match.Groups["url"].Value;
        if (!Uri.TryCreate(address, UriKind.Absolute, out Uri? uri) ||
            (uri.Scheme != Uri.UriSchemeHttps && uri.Scheme != Uri.UriSchemeHttp) ||
            uri.Host.Length == 0 || uri.UserInfo.Length > 0)
            return false;
        string kind = match.Groups["kind"].Value.Trim();
        result = new(label, uri.AbsoluteUri, uri.Host,
            kind.Length == 0 ? "REFERENCE" : kind.StartsWith("Source", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
                ? "SOURCE" : "REFERENCE");
        return true;
    }
}

// Sourced image credits are taken only from the already-grounded artifact
// caption/source generated by the trusted retrieval capability, never from
// independently inferred EXIF, captions, or web URLs.
public sealed record NIRAReferenceImageCredit(
    string Provider, string Creator, string License, string LinkLabel, bool IsStructured)
{
    public bool HasCreator => Creator.Length > 0;
    public bool HasLicense => License.Length > 0;
}

public static class NIRAReferenceImageCreditPolicy
{
    public static NIRAReferenceImageCredit Read(string? caption, string? sourceUri)
    {
        string linkLabel = "View original source  ↗";
        if (Uri.TryCreate(sourceUri, UriKind.Absolute, out Uri? source) &&
            source.Scheme == Uri.UriSchemeHttps)
        {
            linkLabel = source.Host.ToLowerInvariant() switch
            {
                "www.flickr.com" or "flickr.com" => "View on Flickr  ↗",
                "commons.wikimedia.org" => "View on Wikimedia Commons  ↗",
                _ => linkLabel
            };
        }
        string[] fields = (caption ?? "").Split('•', StringSplitOptions.TrimEntries);
        if (fields.Length < 3 ||
            fields[0] is not ("Openverse" or "Wikimedia Commons" or "Wikipedia"))
            return new("", "", "", linkLabel, false);

        string creator = fields[1];
        if (creator.Equals("Author listed at source", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
            creator.Equals("See source", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)) creator = "";
        string license = fields[2];
        if (license.StartsWith("License:", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
            license.Equals("license: see source", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)) license = "";
        else if (license.StartsWith("BY ", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
                 license.StartsWith("BY-", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)) license = "CC " + license;
        return new(fields[0], creator, license, linkLabel, true);
    }
}

// R33: a successfully retrieved image already has a trusted visual credit panel.
// An LLM-authored standalone credit-only panel is not independent evidence.
// Suppression is permitted ONLY when the actual image has source-backed credits;
// explanatory cards, unrelated source cards and unsourced screenshots remain.
public static class NIRAImageCreditLayoutPolicy
{
    private static readonly HashSet<string> CreditTitles = new(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
    {
        "Image Details", "Image Credits", "Image Attribution", "Image Source",
        "Photo Details", "Photo Credits", "Photo Attribution", "Photo Source",
        "Photograph Details", "Photograph Credits"
    };

    public static bool IsDuplicatePhotoCredit(NIRARichBlock? block, bool hasRetrievedCreditedImage)
    {
        if (!hasRetrievedCreditedImage || block is null ||
            block.Type is not ("card" or "details" or "source" or "list")) return false;
        if (!CreditTitles.Contains(block.Title.Trim())) return false;
        // Additional substantive interpretation must not disappear with metadata.
        string body = string.Join("\n", new[] { block.Text }
            .Concat(block.Items).Concat(block.Columns)
            .Concat(block.Rows.SelectMany(row => row)));
        if (body.Length > 1000) return false;
        return !Regex.IsMatch(body,
            @"\b(?:architecture|construction|history|explanation|comparison|analysis|engineering|restoration|geography|interpretation)\b",
            RegexOptions.IgnoreCase | RegexOptions.CultureInvariant);
    }
}

```csharp
using System.Diagnostics;
using System.Globalization;
using System.Text.Json;
using System.Text.RegularExpressions;

namespace NIRAAgent.Presentation;

/// <summary>
/// Reads model-authored, DECLARATIVE presentation data. Accepts equivalent
/// object/array envelopes, but never invents a card, chart value, or source fact.
/// The renderer, not the model, owns all UI markup and interaction.
/// </summary>
public static class NIRARichBlockJsonReader
{
    private static readonly string[] RootNames =
        { "displayBlocks", "screenBlocks", "richBlocks", "contentBlocks", "blocks" };
    private static readonly string[] ContainerNames =
        { "blocks", "displayBlocks", "cards", "items", "entries" };
    private static readonly string[] TitleNames = { "title", "heading", "name", "label" };
    private static readonly string[] BodyNames =
        { "text", "body", "content", "description", "summary" };

    public static IReadOnlyList<NIRARichBlock> Read(JsonElement root)
    {
        var result = new List<NIRARichBlock>();
        JsonElement envelope = default;
        string source = "none";
        foreach (string name in RootNames)
            if (Property(root, name, out var candidate))
            {
                // Prefer the canonical key, but don't let an empty canonical
                // array hide actual blocks supplied under another known key.
                if (source == "none") { source = name; envelope = candidate; }
                if (candidate.ValueKind == JsonValueKind.Array && candidate.GetArrayLength() == 0)
                    continue;
                if (candidate.ValueKind is JsonValueKind.Null or JsonValueKind.Undefined)
                    continue;
                source = name; envelope = candidate; break;
            }

        if (source == "none" || envelope.ValueKind is JsonValueKind.Null or JsonValueKind.Undefined ||
            (envelope.ValueKind == JsonValueKind.Array && envelope.GetArrayLength() == 0))
        {
            // A model can place its screen payload under a presentation object.
            // Only descend when that object actually contains typed display data.
            foreach (string name in new[] { "screen", "presentation", "ui" })
                if (Property(root, name, out var candidate) &&
                    candidate.ValueKind == JsonValueKind.Object)
                {
                    foreach (string nested in RootNames.Concat(new[] { "cards", "items" }))
                        if (Property(candidate, nested, out envelope))
                        { source = name + "." + nested; break; }
                    if (source != "none") break;
                }
        }

        // Distinguish the LLM omitting blocks from a parser/rendering failure.
        // Diagnostics include ONLY shape/count metadata, never model content.
        if (source == "none")
        {
            Debug.WriteLine("[RichPresentation] Source=none | Raw=none | Accepted=0 | Reason=NotProvided");
            return Array.Empty<NIRARichBlock>();
        }

        int raw = envelope.ValueKind == JsonValueKind.Array
            ? envelope.GetArrayLength() : envelope.ValueKind == JsonValueKind.Null ? 0 : 1;
        ReadBlocks(envelope, result, 0, source.EndsWith(".cards", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ? "card" : "text");
        // The model can provide valid facts in a generic table/card while ignoring
        // a more specific typed screen component. Adapt only unambiguous
        // semantic schemas; never synthesize tasks, dates, or completion values.
        var shaped = result.Select(AdaptSemanticShape).ToArray();
        int adapted = shaped.Where((b, i) => b.Type != result[i].Type).Count();
        IReadOnlyList<NIRARichBlock> accepted = NIRAPresentationPolicy.Normalize(shaped);
        Debug.WriteLine($"[RichPresentation] Source={source} | Raw={raw} | Read={result.Count} | Adapted={adapted} | Accepted={accepted.Count} | Types={string.Join(",", accepted.Select(b => b.Type))}" +
            (accepted.Count == 0 && raw > 0 ? " | Reason=UnsupportedOrIncompleteShape" : ""));
        if (accepted.Count == 0 && result.Count > 0)
            Debug.WriteLine("[RichPresentation] REJECTED_SHAPES | " +
                string.Join(";", shaped.Select(b =>
                    $"{b.Type}:title={(!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(b.Title) ? 1 : 0)}," +
                    $"text={(!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(b.Text) ? 1 : 0)}," +
                    $"items={b.Items.Count},panels={b.Panels.Count}")));
        return accepted;
    }

    private static void ReadBlocks(JsonElement element, List<NIRARichBlock> results,
        int depth, string defaultType)
    {
        if (depth > 7 || results.Count >= NIRAPresentationPolicy.MaxBlocks) return;
        if (element.ValueKind == JsonValueKind.Array)
        {
            foreach (var child in element.EnumerateArray())
            {
                ReadBlocks(child, results, depth + 1, defaultType);
                if (results.Count >= NIRAPresentationPolicy.MaxBlocks) break;
            }
            return;
        }
        if (element.ValueKind == JsonValueKind.String)
        {
            string raw = (element.GetString() ?? "").Trim();
            if (raw.Length == 0 || raw.Length > 12000) return;
            if (raw.StartsWith('{') || raw.StartsWith('['))
            {
                try
                {
                    using var nested = JsonDocument.Parse(raw);
                    ReadBlocks(nested.RootElement, results, depth + 1, defaultType);
                    return;
                }
                catch (JsonException) { /* Keep ordinary strings as text. */ }
            }
            int colon = raw.IndexOf(':');
            results.Add(defaultType == "card" && colon is > 0 and < 45
                ? new NIRARichBlock { Type = "card", Title = raw[..colon].Trim(),
                    Text = raw[(colon + 1)..].Trim() }
                : new NIRARichBlock { Type = defaultType, Text = raw });
            return;
        }
        if (element.ValueKind != JsonValueKind.Object) return;

        string kind = First(element, "", "type", "kind", "blockType")
            .Trim().ToLowerInvariant().Replace("_", "").Replace("-", "");
        bool group = kind is "cards" or "cardgroup" or "comparison" or "grid" or "cardlist";
        foreach (string key in ContainerNames)
            if (Property(element, key, out var nested) &&
                (nested.ValueKind == JsonValueKind.Array || nested.ValueKind == JsonValueKind.Object) &&
                (group || key is "cards" or "blocks" or "displayBlocks"))
            {
                if (nested.ValueKind == JsonValueKind.Object && key == "cards")
                {
                    // {"cards":{"Option A":{"description":"..."}, ...}}
                    foreach (var named in nested.EnumerateObject())
                    {
                        if (results.Count >= NIRAPresentationPolicy.MaxBlocks) break;
                        if (named.Value.ValueKind == JsonValueKind.Object)
                        {
                            var card = Block(named.Value, "card", named.Name);
                            if (card != null) results.Add(card);
                        }
                        else results.Add(new NIRARichBlock { Type = "card",
                            Title = named.Name, Text = AsText(named.Value) });
                    }
                }
                else ReadBlocks(nested, results, depth + 1,
                    key is "cards" or "items" or "entries" ? "card" : defaultType);
                return;
            }

        // An array of cards can be placed under a single {type:"card",items:[...]}.
        if (kind == "card" && Property(element, "items", out var cardItems) &&
            cardItems.ValueKind == JsonValueKind.Array)
        {
            ReadBlocks(cardItems, results, depth + 1, "card");
            return;
        }

        var block = Block(element, defaultType, "");
        if (block != null) results.Add(block);
    }

    // Structural compatibility for typed UI. This operates on the data the model
    // actually returned, not a second LLM call or a guess based on a user phrase.
    // Important: a "date" cell in a generated table has no provenance. A timeline
    // uses its ordinal day/stage and task here, never an unverified date cell.
    private static NIRARichBlock AdaptSemanticShape(NIRARichBlock block)
    {
        if (block.Type == "table" && block.Rows.Count > 0)
        {
            int FindColumn(params string[] names) =>
                Enumerable.Range(0, block.Columns.Count).FirstOrDefault(
                    i => names.Any(name => string.Equals(block.Columns[i].Trim().TrimEnd('?', ':'),
                        name, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)), -1);
            int eventColumn = FindColumn("task", "event", "activity", "milestone", "action", "step");
            int whenColumn = FindColumn("day", "phase", "stage", "when", "time", "date");
            bool timeline = Regex.IsMatch(block.Title, @"\b(timeline|milestones|chronology)\b",
                RegexOptions.IgnoreCase | RegexOptions.CultureInvariant);
            if (timeline && eventColumn >= 0 && whenColumn >= 0 && eventColumn != whenColumn)
            {
                var events = block.Rows
                    .Where(row => row.Count > Math.Max(eventColumn, whenColumn))
                    .Select(row => row[whenColumn].Trim() + " — " + row[eventColumn].Trim())
                    .Where(value => value.Length > 3).ToArray();
                if (events.Length > 0)
                    return block with { Type = "timeline", Items = events };
            }

            int taskColumn = FindColumn("task", "item", "action", "step", "to do", "todo");
            int doneColumn = FindColumn("done", "complete", "completed", "checked", "status");
            bool checklist = Regex.IsMatch(block.Title, @"\b(checklist|to.do list)\b",
                RegexOptions.IgnoreCase | RegexOptions.CultureInvariant);
            if (taskColumn >= 0 && (checklist || doneColumn >= 0))
            {
                var tasks = block.Rows.Where(row => row.Count > taskColumn)
                    .Select(row => Regex.Replace(row[taskColumn].Trim(), @"^\s*(?:\[.\]|☐|☑)\s*", ""))
                    .Where(item => item.Length > 0).ToArray();
                if (tasks.Length > 0)
                    return block with { Type = "checklist", Items = tasks };
            }
        }
        if (block.Type == "card" &&
            Regex.IsMatch(block.Title, @"\b(progress|completion)\b",
                RegexOptions.IgnoreCase | RegexOptions.CultureInvariant))
        {
            double? value = block.ProgressValue, maximum = block.ProgressMaximum;
            if (!value.HasValue || !maximum.HasValue)
            {
                // Only an explicitly supplied count ratio is valid evidence.
                // The calculated percentage comes from the WPF renderer, not
                // from the model's possibly rounded percentage in the card.
                Match ratio = Regex.Match(block.Text,
                    @"(?<!\d)(?<done>\d+(?:\.\d+)?)\s*/\s*(?<total>\d+(?:\.\d+)?)(?!\d)",
                    RegexOptions.CultureInvariant);
                if (ratio.Success &&
                    double.TryParse(ratio.Groups["done"].Value, NumberStyles.Float,
                        CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, out double completed) &&
                    double.TryParse(ratio.Groups["total"].Value, NumberStyles.Float,
                        CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, out double total))
                { value = completed; maximum = total; }
            }
            if (value is double v && maximum is double max &&
                double.IsFinite(v) && double.IsFinite(max) && max > 0 && v >= 0 && v <= max)
            {
                string unit = block.Unit;
                if (unit.Length == 0)
                {
                    Match units = Regex.Match(block.Text,
                        @"\b(chapters?|pages?|hours?|minutes?|tasks?|items?|lessons?|days?|steps?)\b",
                        RegexOptions.IgnoreCase | RegexOptions.CultureInvariant);
                    if (units.Success) unit = units.Value.ToLowerInvariant();
                }
                string remainder = (max - v).ToString("0.##", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
                return block with { Type = "progress", ProgressValue = v,
                    ProgressMaximum = max, Unit = unit,
                    Text = remainder + (unit.Length > 0 ? " " + unit : "") + " remaining" };
            }
        }
        return block;
    }

    private static NIRARichBlock? Block(JsonElement element, string defaultType, string titleFallback)
    {
        string type = First(element, defaultType, "type", "kind", "blockType")
            .Trim().ToLowerInvariant().Replace("_", "").Replace("-", "");
        type = type switch
        {
            "paragraph" or "markdown" => "text",
            "snippet" or "codeblock" => "code",
            "accordion" or "collapsible" or "expandable" => "details",
            "bullets" or "bulletlist" or "steps" => "list",
            "tasklist" or "checkboxes" => "checklist",
            "milestones" or "history" => "timeline",
            "progressbar" or "completion" => "progress",
            "tabbed" or "tabgroup" => "tabs",
            "choices" or "suggestions" or "followup" or "quickreplies" => "followups",
            "blockquote" => "quote",
            "line" or "linechart" or "bar" or "barchart" => "chart",
            "comparison" or "cards" or "cardgroup" => "card",
            "feature" or "featured" or "spotlight" or "hero" => "hero",
            "takeaway" or "keyinsight" or "highlight" or "insight" => "insight",
            "resource" or "reference" or "sourcelink" or "source" => "source",
            "videolink" or "videoreference" or "video" => "video",
            "stat" or "statcard" or "statistic" or "kpi" or "metriccard" or "metricpanel" => "metric",
            "math" or "latex" or "formula" or "mathequation" => "equation",
            _ => type
        };
        // "file" cards are reserved for authoritative runtime tool evidence.
        // A model's unverified success claim must never impersonate that status UI.
        if (type == "file") return null;
        if (type is not ("heading" or "text" or "hero" or "insight" or "source" or "video" or "card" or "metric" or "equation" or "table" or "chart" or "code" or "details" or "list" or "quote" or "timeline" or "checklist" or "progress" or "tabs" or "followups"))
            type = defaultType;

        // A model may use objects instead of the contracted string arrays.
        // Extract their human-readable fields; never print JSON property names
        // such as "text:", "title:" or "checked: false" on screen.
        List<string> items = PresentationItems(element, "items", type);
        if (items.Count == 0) items = PresentationItems(element, "bullets", type);
        if (items.Count == 0 && type == "timeline") items = PresentationItems(element, "events", type);
        if (items.Count == 0 && type == "checklist") items = PresentationItems(element, "tasks", type);
        if (items.Count == 0 && type == "tabs") items = PresentationItems(element, "labels", type);
        if (items.Count == 0 && type == "followups") items = PresentationItems(element, "options", type);
        if (items.Count == 0 && type == "followups") items = PresentationItems(element, "suggestions", type);
        var panels = type == "tabs" ? TabPanelStrings(element, "panels") : Strings(element, "panels");
        if (panels.Count == 0 && type == "tabs") panels = TabPanelStrings(element, "contents");
        // Also accept tabs authored as items:[{label,content}, ...].
        if (type == "tabs" && panels.Count == 0 &&
            Property(element, "items", out var tabItems) && tabItems.ValueKind == JsonValueKind.Array)
        {
            var objects = tabItems.EnumerateArray().ToArray();
            if (objects.Length >= 2 && objects.All(e => e.ValueKind == JsonValueKind.Object))
            {
                var labelsFromItems = objects.Select(e => First(e, "", "label", "title", "name")).ToList();
                var contentFromItems = objects.Select(PanelContent).ToList();
                if (labelsFromItems.All(x => x.Length > 0) && contentFromItems.All(x => x.Length > 0))
                { items = labelsFromItems; panels = contentFromItems; }
            }
        }
        List<string> cols = Strings(element, "columns");
        if (cols.Count == 0) cols = Strings(element, "headers");
        var rows = new List<IReadOnlyList<string>>();
        if (Property(element, "rows", out var rowArray) && rowArray.ValueKind == JsonValueKind.Array)
            foreach (var row in rowArray.EnumerateArray())
            {
                if (row.ValueKind == JsonValueKind.Array)
                    rows.Add(row.EnumerateArray().Select(AsText).ToArray());
                else if (row.ValueKind == JsonValueKind.Object && cols.Count > 0)
                    rows.Add(cols.Select(c => Property(row, c, out var cell) ? AsText(cell) : "").ToArray());
            }
        var labels = Strings(element, "labels");
        var values = new List<double>();
        if (Property(element, "values", out var valArray) && valArray.ValueKind == JsonValueKind.Array)
            foreach (var value in valArray.EnumerateArray())
                if (ParseNumber(value, out var number)) values.Add(number);
        if ((labels.Count == 0 || values.Count == 0) &&
            Property(element, "data", out var data) && data.ValueKind == JsonValueKind.Array)
        {
            labels = new List<string>(); values.Clear();
            foreach (var point in data.EnumerateArray())
            {
                if (point.ValueKind != JsonValueKind.Object ||
                    !Property(point, "value", out var value) ||
                    !ParseNumber(value, out var number)) continue;
                string label = First(point, "", "label", "name");
                if (label.Length == 0) continue;
                labels.Add(label); values.Add(number);
            }
        }

        string body = First(element, "", BodyNames);
        if (type == "metric")
        {
            // Metric schemas commonly use {label,value,unit}, not {title,text,unit}.
            // Preserve the model-supplied value instead of dropping an otherwise
            // valid metric as an empty text block. No value is inferred here.
            string explicitValue = First(element, "", "value", "metricValue", "amount", "number");
            if (explicitValue.Length > 0) body = explicitValue;
        }
        if (type == "code" && body.Length == 0) body = First(element, "", "code");
        if (type == "equation" && body.Length == 0)
            body = First(element, "", "latex", "formula", "expression");
        if (type == "equation") body = NIRAMathMarkup.NormalizeEquationInput(body);
        // A source card may use a conventional URL field. This only preserves
        // model-supplied link text; it does not fetch or verify the destination.
        if ((type is "source" or "video") && body.Length == 0)
            body = First(element, "", "url", "href", "uri");
        if (type == "card")
        {
            var details = new List<string>();
            foreach (var p in element.EnumerateObject())
            {
                if (p.NameEquals("type") || p.NameEquals("kind") ||
                    p.NameEquals("blockType") ||
                    TitleNames.Contains(p.Name, StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
                    BodyNames.Contains(p.Name, StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)) continue;
                if (p.Name is "items" or "cards" or "blocks" or "data" or "unit" or "tone" or "accent") continue;
                string value = AsText(p.Value);
                if (value.Length > 0) details.Add(p.Name + ": " + value);
            }
            if (details.Count > 0)
                body = string.Join("\n", new[] { body }.Where(s => s.Length > 0).Concat(details));
        }
        return new NIRARichBlock
        {
            Type = type,
            Title = First(element, titleFallback, TitleNames),
            Text = body,
            Language = First(element, "", "language"),
            Unit = First(element, "", "unit"),
            Items = items,
            Panels = panels,
            Columns = cols,
            Rows = rows,
            Labels = labels,
            Values = values,
            ProgressValue = Number(element, "value"),
            ProgressMaximum = Number(element, "maximum") ?? Number(element, "total")
        };
    }

    // Presentation-only shape compatibility. These routines preserve supplied
    // words and dates; they do not infer task completion or invent milestones.
    private static List<string> PresentationItems(JsonElement obj, string key, string type)
    {
        if (!Property(obj, key, out var values) || values.ValueKind != JsonValueKind.Array)
            return new List<string>();
        var items = new List<string>();
        foreach (var value in values.EnumerateArray())
        {
            string text;
            if (value.ValueKind != JsonValueKind.Object)
                text = AsText(value);
            else if (type == "timeline")
            {
                string when = First(value, "", "date", "year", "period", "when", "day", "stage", "time");
                string title = First(value, "", "title", "event", "milestone", "label", "name");
                string description = First(value, "", "text", "description", "body", "content", "summary");
                if (title.Length == 0) title = description;
                else if (description.Length > 0 && !string.Equals(title, description, StringComparison.Ordinal))
                    title += "\n" + description;
                text = when.Length > 0 && title.Length > 0 ? when + " — " + title : title;
            }
            else if (type == "checklist")
            {
                text = First(value, "", "text", "task", "label", "title", "description", "name");
                string detail = First(value, "", "details", "note");
                if (text.Length > 0 && detail.Length > 0) text += "\n" + detail;
                // A model's checked/done flag is NEVER proof that work was done.
            }
            else
                text = First(value, "", "label", "title", "name", "text", "description");
            if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(text)) items.Add(text.Trim());
        }
        return items;
    }

    private static List<string> TabPanelStrings(JsonElement obj, string key)
    {
        if (!Property(obj, key, out var values) || values.ValueKind != JsonValueKind.Array)
            return new List<string>();
        return values.EnumerateArray().Select(PanelContent).ToList();
    }

    // Return meaningful Markdown, not an object's property dump. Markdown is
    // interpreted only by NIRA's safe local WPF renderer, never as executable UI.
    private static string PanelContent(JsonElement value)
    {
        if (value.ValueKind == JsonValueKind.String) return value.GetString() ?? "";
        if (value.ValueKind == JsonValueKind.Array)
            return string.Join("\n", value.EnumerateArray().Select(PanelContent)
                .Where(x => !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(x)));
        if (value.ValueKind != JsonValueKind.Object) return AsText(value);
        var parts = new List<string>();
        string title = First(value, "", "heading", "title");
        if (title.Length > 0) parts.Add("### " + title);
        string body = First(value, "", "text", "body", "content", "description", "summary", "overview");
        if (body.Length > 0) parts.Add(body);
        if (Property(value, "sections", out var sections) && sections.ValueKind == JsonValueKind.Array)
            foreach (var section in sections.EnumerateArray().Take(12))
            {
                string sectionText = PanelContent(section);
                if (sectionText.Length > 0) parts.Add(sectionText);
            }
        foreach (var key in new[] { "bullets", "steps", "points" })
            if (Property(value, key, out var bullets) && bullets.ValueKind == JsonValueKind.Array)
            {
                var lines = bullets.EnumerateArray().Take(24).Select(e =>
                    e.ValueKind == JsonValueKind.Object
                        ? First(e, "", "text", "label", "title", "description") : AsText(e));
                parts.Add(string.Join("\n", lines.Where(x => x.Length > 0).Select(x => "- " + x)));
            }
        return string.Join("\n\n", parts.Where(x => !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(x)));
    }

    private static List<string> Strings(JsonElement obj, string key) =>
        Property(obj, key, out var arr) && arr.ValueKind == JsonValueKind.Array
            ? arr.EnumerateArray().Select(AsText).ToList()
            : new List<string>();

    private static string First(JsonElement obj, string fallback, params string[] keys)
    {
        foreach (string key in keys)
            if (Property(obj, key, out var value))
            {
                string text = AsText(value);
                if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(text)) return text;
            }
        return fallback;
    }

    private static string AsText(JsonElement value) => value.ValueKind switch
    {
        JsonValueKind.String => value.GetString() ?? "",
        JsonValueKind.Number => value.GetRawText(),
        JsonValueKind.True => "true",
        JsonValueKind.False => "false",
        JsonValueKind.Array => string.Join(", ", value.EnumerateArray().Select(AsText)),
        JsonValueKind.Object => string.Join("; ", value.EnumerateObject()
            .Select(p => p.Name + ": " + AsText(p.Value))),
        _ => ""
    };

    private static double? Number(JsonElement element, string key) =>
        Property(element, key, out var candidate) && ParseNumber(candidate, out var number)
            ? number : null;

    private static bool ParseNumber(JsonElement value, out double number)
    {
        number = 0;
        bool valid = value.ValueKind switch
        {
            JsonValueKind.Number => value.TryGetDouble(out number),
            JsonValueKind.String => double.TryParse(value.GetString(), NumberStyles.Float,
                CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, out number),
            _ => false
        };
        return valid && double.IsFinite(number);
    }

    private static bool Property(JsonElement element, string key, out JsonElement value)
    {
        if (element.ValueKind == JsonValueKind.Object)
        {
            if (element.TryGetProperty(key, out value)) return true;
            foreach (var p in element.EnumerateObject())
                if (string.Equals(p.Name, key, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                { value = p.Value; return true; }
        }
        value = default;
        return false;
    }
}

## 278. `NIRAAgent\Presentation\NIRAVerifiedFilePresentation.cs`

**File:** `NIRAAgent\Presentation\NIRAVerifiedFilePresentation.cs`

```csharp
using System.Text.Json;
using NIRAAgent.Capabilities;

namespace NIRAAgent.Presentation;

/// <summary>
/// UI evidence generated only from capability results in the *current run*.
/// Neither an LLM-authored completion claim nor a filename guess creates a verified card.
/// The file paths are display/copy-only; rendering does not grant further permissions.
/// </summary>
public static class NIRAVerifiedFilePresentation
{
    public static IReadOnlyList<NIRARichBlock> Attach(
        IReadOnlyList<NIRARichBlock>? modelBlocks,
        IReadOnlyDictionary<string, NIRACapabilityRequest> requests,
        IReadOnlyDictionary<string, NIRACapabilityResult> results,
        string finalReply)
    {
        var existing = NIRAPresentationPolicy.Normalize(modelBlocks);
        if (existing.Count >= NIRAPresentationPolicy.MaxBlocks ||
            requests.Count == 0 || results.Count == 0)
            return existing;

        var proven = requests
            .Where(p => results.TryGetValue(p.Key, out var result) &&
                result.Succeeded && !result.OutcomeUncertain)
            .Select(p => (Request: p.Value, Result: results[p.Key]))
            .ToArray();

        // A copy is stronger evidence of a new artifact than a preceding directory listing.
        foreach (var (request, result) in proven.Reverse())
        {
            if (request.CapabilityId != NIRACapabilityIds.FileCopy ||
                !result.ChangedSystemState ||
                !TryArgument(request.Arguments, "destination", out var destination) ||
                !TryArgument(request.Arguments, "source", out var source) ||
                !IsAbsoluteWindowsFilePath(destination))
                continue;

            return Add(existing, new NIRARichBlock
            {
                Type = "file",
                Title = FileName(destination),
                Text = destination,
                Unit = "COPY SAVED",
                Items = IsAbsoluteWindowsFilePath(source) ? new[] { source } : Array.Empty<string>()
            });
        }

        // For read-only file discovery, we only promote an actual observed FILE line
        // that agrees with the exact pathname NIRA put in the reviewed user reply.
        foreach (var (_, result) in proven.Reverse())
        {
            if (result.CapabilityId is not (NIRACapabilityIds.DirectoryList or NIRACapabilityIds.FileLocate))
                continue;
            foreach (string path in ObservedFilePaths(result.Output))
            {
                if (!IsAbsoluteWindowsFilePath(path) ||
                    string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(finalReply) ||
                    !finalReply.Contains(path, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                    continue;

                return Add(existing, new NIRARichBlock
                {
                    Type = "file",
                    Title = FileName(path),
                    Text = path,
                    Unit = "FILE FOUND"
                });
            }
        }
        return existing;
    }

    private static IReadOnlyList<NIRARichBlock> Add(
        IReadOnlyList<NIRARichBlock> existing, NIRARichBlock verified) =>
        NIRAPresentationPolicy.Normalize(existing.Concat(new[] { verified }).ToArray());

    private static bool TryArgument(JsonElement args, string key, out string value)
    {
        value = string.Empty;
        if (args.ValueKind != JsonValueKind.Object ||
            !args.TryGetProperty(key, out var element) ||
            element.ValueKind != JsonValueKind.String)
            return false;
        value = (element.GetString() ?? string.Empty).Trim();
        return value.Length is > 2 and <= 32760;
    }

    private static IEnumerable<string> ObservedFilePaths(string output)
    {
        foreach (var rawLine in (output ?? string.Empty).Split('\n'))
        {
            string[] columns = rawLine.TrimEnd('\r').Split('\t');
            if (columns.Length < 2 || columns[0] != "FILE") continue;
            // filesystem.list: FILE\tSizeBytes\tPath
            // filesystem.locate: FILE\tPath\tSizeBytes=...\tLastWriteUtc=...
            string path = columns.Length >= 3 && long.TryParse(columns[1], out _)
                ? columns[2].Trim() : columns[1].Trim();
            if (path.Length is > 2 and <= 32760) yield return path;
        }
    }

    private static string FileName(string path)
    {
        int index = path.LastIndexOfAny(new[] { '\\', '/' });
        return index < 0 ? path : path[(index + 1)..];
    }

    private static bool IsAbsoluteWindowsFilePath(string path) =>
        path.Length > 3 &&
        ((char.IsLetter(path[0]) && path[1] == ':' && (path[2] is '\\' or '/')) ||
         (path.StartsWith("\\\\", StringComparison.Ordinal) && path.Length > 5)) &&
        FileName(path).Length > 0;
}

## 279. `NIRAAgent\Prompt\cognition.yaml`

**File:** `NIRAAgent\Prompt\cognition.yaml`

```yaml
# filename: cognition.yaml


purpose:
  - Guide one main NIRA cognition cycle: decide whether the current event is complete, needs more memory, needs the user, must wait, or is blocked; also produce social appraisal, vocal intent, and a visible reply when appropriate.
  - Preserve NIRA's personality, relationship and mood across turns.
  - Produce visible responses that work naturally as both chat and spoken conversation.


authority_interaction:
  rules:
    - The trusted permission dialog is the one confirmation for an unambiguous consequential action that needs runtime approval. Do not ask a second chat yes/no before that dialog, including when the user says "ask before deleting" an explicitly named file.
    - A conversational "yes" is not itself a capability grant; runtime approval remains separate and authoritative.
    - Ask a conversational question only for genuine uncertainty about target, requested outcome, or user choice that the permission dialog cannot resolve.
    - If the user denies the runtime permission, treat the operation as blocked. Do not retry the same target/action by choosing another primitive or repeating the approval request; a new explicit user request can reopen it.

task_continuity:
  rules:
    - Resolve indirect requests using the current message, the recent conversation,
      and the currently unresolved task; do not replace the original outcome with
      the wording of a short confirmation.
    - If the user answers a question, continue the original authorized work instead
      of asking for information already provided or discoverable.
    - Distinguish locating a resource, observing contents, verifying contents, and
      finishing the requested comparison; each requires its own evidence.
    - Ask only when actual ambiguity changes an important action or outcome and
      cannot be resolved from existing context or permitted observation.
    - For a broad but actionable request such as checking whether something is
      correct, begin with the safest relevant permitted observations. Infer a
      sensible verification scope from available facts, source format and
      prior task contract. Check what can be established, then report precisely
      what was checked and any remaining unverifiable requirement. Do not
      invent specifications or ask the user to design your inspection plan.
    - When an exact filename extension is unknown but the user already supplied a directory and a basename, enumerate that directory using the registered read-only filesystem.list; use the observed names to resolve the target. If a full object name is known but not its directory, a bounded filesystem.locate is available. Do not invent an extension or ask the user to repeat an inspectable pathname.
    - When the user delegates harmless artistic decisions ("surprise me", "you choose"), select sensible formatting after inspecting the actual material. Only ask about indispensable choices; do not demand subjective style specifications the user intentionally delegated.
    - For a requested safe backup-before-edit workflow, inspect the source, make a non-overwriting copy through runtime permission, verify that copy, then edit only via a verified document-aware capability or authorized
      tool composition. A raw text writer is not a DOCX editor. Do not pretend raw text file primitives can safely edit every binary document format.
    - A friendly social invitation to laugh or tease is permission for responsive natural banter, not a literal objective demanding a laugh performance or invented technical facts.
    - Before NeedUser, consider whether the question is actually answered by
      reading the target, inspecting a page, listing a directory, using the
      current conversation, or another permitted reversible observation. If
      yes, execute that observation; don't ask first. Do not equate this with
      permission for a consequential operation; trusted runtime authority
      still controls actions and genuinely missing material choices require
      the user.
    - Stop rather than claim full completion when the requested evidence is missing.
    - When one message contains independent tasks, keep each task's outcome separately: execute permissible portions, explicitly limit forbidden or unsupported portions, and report both. A denial or missing result for one subtask must not discard already successful observations for another.
    - Before a terminal reply, compare what is actually being answered against the original current user message, not the latest tool result or stale conversation. Successful calls are evidence of execution, not proof the reply addressed every subtask. Never reset to an unrelated greeting after carrying out real work.
    - If an explicit target is absent from observed results, state that it was not verified instead of defaulting to a previous target or looping on the same completed read.

situational_reasoning:
  principle: >-
    Cognition is not complete merely because a tool worked or a page revealed
    where the actual answer might be. Interpret evidence against the original
    user objective, authoritative clock, and current world situation.

  rules:
    - For an action request, continue through relevant reachable pages/results
      until the requested outcome is observed, meaningfully blocked, or the user
      must supply genuinely missing information. A link or menu is a next step,
      not the requested answer, unless the user specifically asked for that link.
    - Make every substantive conclusion traceable to fresh observations or
      clearly identified reasoning from those observations; absence of observed
      evidence is not evidence of absence.
    - CURRENT AUTHORITATIVE CLOCK is refreshed each cognition cycle. Use it for
      all material today/tomorrow/elapsed-time/schedule/deadline judgements.
      Old conversation timestamps never override the live clock.
    - Calendar wording must be internally consistent. If a final answer places a
      named weekday beside an explicit yyyy-MM-dd date, that weekday must actually
      belong to that date. If source evidence itself conflicts, report the conflict
      instead of silently combining incompatible values. Never derive a missing
      calendar date from a weekday name, or a weekday from an ungrounded guess.
    - When source evidence provides a complete dated time interval and its
      current temporal relationship matters, call temporal.relate using only
      source-grounded full local instants, with the source timezone or OS local
      timezone as appropriate. Use its result in the final answer. Never
      manufacture a missing date, end time, timezone or a live-service status.
    - Do not say a scheduled event is currently available just because it is
      listed as active in an account, schedule or dashboard. Separate account
      status, scheduled time, actual live status and join-link existence.
    - A successful interaction is not the answer when the user asked for the
      contents or implications behind it. Perform an accessible next step
      instead of delegating it back to the user without a real blocker.
    - If important temporal evidence is incomplete, identify the uncertainty
      plainly; do not infer that a started event already ended with no end time.
    - An INDEPENDENT COMPLETION REVIEW in executive evidence is a model
      assessment, not an observed fact or authority grant; examine its gap
      against the original request and actual evidence before acting.
    - Do not inject source text or passwords into long-term memory as a side
      effect of interpreting evidence. Credentials belong to the trusted broker.

cognition_loop:
  rules:
    - A cognition cycle is not automatically a final response.
    - OTHER ACTIVE USER WORK is context for interpreting an explicit task-status question, not material to insert into an unrelated new answer. When the current request asks for images, an explanation, or another independent task, answer that request without volunteering earlier-turn lifecycle bookkeeping.
    - If NIRA already has enough information, finish immediately instead of forcing another model call.
    - When a live, read-only capability can directly observe the requested current machine state, prefer that observation over searching memory for a possibly stale path or status. Memory may help ground a narrower target, but it is not a substitute for live evidence.
    - Prefer the most specific registered Observe primitive that directly supplies the needed evidence. Do not use shell.execute as an observation shortcut when a registered read-only primitive already covers the same information; shell.execute is a general execution fallback.
    - In the compact capability directory, args={} explicitly means the primitive takes no arguments; request a relevant parameterless Observe primitive directly with an empty arguments object instead of spending a cycle expanding its signature.
    - In quick signatures, ! marks a required parameter and requiredHints carries bounded runtime-declared constraints for required values. Treat those hints as part of the current call contract. Never invent a constrained value outside them. If a required value still cannot be selected safely, request only that exact capability's detailed schema once.
    - When capability execution is likely and signatures are not yet expanded, request all obviously needed read-only context sections and exact capability IDs together in one expansion cycle rather than serially asking for capabilities and then PC/world context.
    - If important long-term context is missing, request memory search and continue only after results return.
    - Do not invent missing information just to avoid another cycle.
    - Multiple cognition cycles are normal for difficult inputs.
    - Do not repeat the original social appraisal on later cycles of the same run.
    - Do not re-propose memory merely because recalled memory appeared in context.
    - decisionSummary is a short operational status, never private chain-of-thought.


memory_context:
  modes:
    Full:
      description: >-
        Every active durable memory currently fits inside the available
        cognition memory budget and is supplied directly.

    Map:
      description: >-
        The durable-memory set is larger than the current cognition memory
        budget. The supplied content is a navigation map, not exhaustive
        remembered content.

  rules:
    - Full mode may be used directly when the needed remembered information is present.
    - Map mode is intentionally incomplete. Absence from the map never proves NIRA lacks a memory.
    - In Map mode, use structured memory search when exact remembered content could materially affect the answer or next decision.
    - Do not ask the user to repeat something merely because it is absent from the map if a memory search could resolve it first.
    - Do not force memory search when the current event can already be handled correctly without deeper recall.



memory_retrieval:
  principle: >-
    Main cognition decides what additional memory it needs. Retrieval produces
    candidates; retrieval scores do not decide whether a memory is actually
    relevant.

  request_fields:
    query:
      description: semantic and lexical description of what should be found

    kinds:
      description: optional durable-memory kinds to narrow the search

    canonicalKeys:
      description: optional exact canonical keys already supported by current evidence or the memory map

    topicKeys:
      description: optional topic keys/prefixes already supported by current evidence or the memory map

    concepts:
      description: optional conceptual anchors already supported by the map, current event, or prior search results

    entities:
      description: optional named entities already supported by the map, current event, or prior search results

    expandAssociations:
      description: when true, candidate generation may also surface one-hop memories linked by shared topic, concept, or entity

    maximumResults:
      description: requested candidate count; runtime validates and clamps it

  rules:
    - Prefer a descriptive query that captures the underlying remembered concept, not only the user's exact wording.
    - Multiple different searches in one cognition cycle are allowed when they explore genuinely different retrieval paths.
    - Do not invent canonical keys, topic keys, concepts, entities or memory kinds merely to make a search look precise.
    - Use expandAssociations when the user is referring indirectly to a subject, project, person, decision, or shared history and connected memories may matter.
    - Search again with a different request when returned candidates are insufficient or ambiguous.
    - A low semantic similarity does not by itself mean a candidate is irrelevant.
    - A high semantic similarity does not by itself make a candidate authoritative.
    - Retrieval descriptions, cues, concepts and entities are navigation metadata around a stored memory; the memory Content remains the remembered proposition.
    - Judge candidate content together with kind, canonical/topic metadata, associative metadata, provenance and the current event.


delivery:
  primary_mode: speech_first_conversation

  principle: >-
    NIRA's visible response should normally sound like something she
    would naturally say aloud to the user in the current moment.

  default_rules:
    - Prefer natural conversational prose.
    - Prefer direct first-person speech.
    - Ordinary conversation should usually be short.
    - A familiar social greeting should sound situated in NIRA's ongoing relationship and present mood, not repeatedly collapse to a generic one-word acknowledgment. An occasional brief greeting is natural; do not script a fixed response or force irrelevant memory references.
    - When changing topics, answer the current user's actual request. Previous questions and live observations are not a substitute for a new explicit target or operation.
    - In a restricted embedded app surface, never ask for missing paths/parameters for an operation that the surface cannot execute, and never promise unavailable actions on a different surface.
    - Do not answer with data for a different instrument or target when the requested one is unsupported or could not be confirmed.
    - A simple social question normally needs only a few natural sentences.
    - Conversational tone does not necessarily mean social-only intent. When the user invites information about a subject or follows up asking for details, provide a concise, sufficiently rounded answer instead of just a witty reaction. Choose context by relevance, not by a fixed list or a mandatory response length. Even with informal wording, specific factual claims about changing prices, schedules, status or reception may require current sources.
    - Keep an informational answer easy to scan and readable in one sitting: high-value details, important caveats and useful links, without every tangential specification.
